-- INSTANT RE-EXEC: keep all startup implementation locals INSIDE one
-- function. Only pvSession remains live in the main Luau chunk, avoiding the
-- 200-register overflow in the item UI builder.
local pvSession = (function()
    local shared = (type(getgenv)=="function" and getgenv()) or _G
    local old = rawget(shared,"__porkVisualsSession") or rawget(_G,"__porkVisualsSession")
    if type(old)=="table" and type(old.shutdown)=="function" then
        pcall(old.shutdown)
    end
    _G.pvGen = (_G.pvGen or 0) + 1
    _G.pvInvRepinGen = (_G.pvInvRepinGen or 0) + 1
    _G.pvAutoTrade = false
    _G.pvBlockInProgress = false

    pcall(function()
        if _G.pvGuiAncestryConn then
            _G.pvGuiAncestryConn:Disconnect()
            _G.pvGuiAncestryConn=nil
        end
    end)
    local function clearPreviousRoots()
        -- CoreGui:GetChildren() can be security-restricted even if
        -- game:GetService("CoreGui") succeeds. Never let GUI cleanup abort startup.
        local containers = {}
        local p = Players.LocalPlayer
        local pg = p and p:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if pg then containers[#containers+1]=pg end
        local ok,core=pcall(function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        if ok and core then containers[#containers+1]=core end
        if type(gethui)=="function" then
            local good,h=pcall(gethui)
            if good and h then containers[#containers+1]=h end
        end
        local kill={porkVisuals=true,porkToggle=true,PorkVisualsFPSCounter=true,
                    pvTradeReq=true,pvTradeGUI=true,pvBlocked=true}
        local visited={}
        for _,root in ipairs(containers) do
            if root and not visited[root] then
                visited[root]=true
                local allowed,children=pcall(function() return root:GetChildren() end)
                if allowed and children then
                    for _,child in ipairs(children) do
                        if kill[child.Name] then pcall(function() child:Destroy() end) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    clearPreviousRoots()

    local session={alive=true,generation=_G.pvGen,connections={},cleanups={},roots={},streamerHidden=false}
    session.streamerSaved=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    function session.setStreamerHidden(enabled)
        enabled=enabled==true
        session.streamerHidden=enabled
        for _,root in ipairs(session.roots) do
            if root then
                local ok,isScreenGui=pcall(function() return root:IsA("ScreenGui") end)
                if ok and isScreenGui then
                    if enabled then
                        if session.streamerSaved[root]==nil then
                            local readOk,wasEnabled=pcall(function() return root.Enabled end)
                            if readOk then session.streamerSaved[root]=wasEnabled end
                        end
                        pcall(function() root.Enabled=false end)
                    else
                        local wasEnabled=session.streamerSaved[root]
                        if wasEnabled~=nil then pcall(function() root.Enabled=wasEnabled end) end
                        session.streamerSaved[root]=nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function session.connect(signal,callback)
        local conn=signal:Connect(callback)
        if session.alive then
            session.connections[#session.connections+1]=conn
        else
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
        return conn
    end
    function session.addCleanup(fn)
        session.cleanups[#session.cleanups+1]=fn
    end
    function session.ownRoot(root)
        session.roots[#session.roots+1]=root
        if session.streamerHidden and root then
            local ok,isScreenGui=pcall(function() return root:IsA("ScreenGui") end)
            if ok and isScreenGui then
                local readOk,wasEnabled=pcall(function() return root.Enabled end)
                if readOk then session.streamerSaved[root]=wasEnabled end
                pcall(function() root.Enabled=false end)
            end
        end
        return root
    end
    function session.shutdown()
        if not session.alive then return end
        session.alive=false
        if _G.pvGen==session.generation then _G.pvGen=_G.pvGen+1 end
        _G.pvInvRepinGen=(_G.pvInvRepinGen or 0)+1
        _G.pvAutoTrade=false
        _G.pvBlockInProgress=false
        -- Remove visible windows before slower event and tool cleanup.
        for i=#session.roots,1,-1 do
            local root=session.roots[i]
            if root then pcall(function() root:Destroy() end) end
        end
        for i=#session.cleanups,1,-1 do pcall(session.cleanups[i]) end
        for i=#session.connections,1,-1 do
            pcall(function() session.connections[i]:Disconnect() end)
        end
        table.clear(session.connections)
        pcall(function()
            if _G.pvGuiAncestryConn then
                _G.pvGuiAncestryConn:Disconnect()
                _G.pvGuiAncestryConn=nil
            end
        end)
        clearPreviousRoots()
        if rawget(shared,"__porkVisualsSession")==session then
            shared.__porkVisualsSession=nil
        end
        if rawget(_G,"__porkVisualsSession")==session then
            _G.__porkVisualsSession=nil
        end
    end
    shared.__porkVisualsSession=session
    _G.__porkVisualsSession=session
    return session
end)()

function pvTick(name, secs)
    if not _G.pvProfOn then task.wait(secs) return end
    _G.pvProf   = _G.pvProf   or {}
    _G.pvTickAt = _G.pvTickAt or {}
    local t = _G.pvProf[name]
    if not t then t={n=0,tot=0,max=0}; _G.pvProf[name]=t end
    local last = _G.pvTickAt[name]
    if last then
        local dt=(os.clock()-last)*1000
        t.n=t.n+1; t.tot=t.tot+dt; if dt>t.max then t.max=dt end
    end
    task.wait(secs)
    _G.pvTickAt[name]=os.clock()
end
function pvProf(name, fn)
    if not _G.pvProfOn then return fn() end
    _G.pvProf = _G.pvProf or {}
    local t = _G.pvProf[name]
    if not t then t = {n=0, tot=0, max=0}; _G.pvProf[name]=t end
    local t0 = os.clock()
    local a,b = fn()
    local dt = (os.clock()-t0)*1000
    t.n = t.n + 1
    t.tot = t.tot + dt
    if dt > t.max then t.max = dt end
    return a,b
end

local pvAPI = {}
do
    local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
    local function firstOf(...)
        for _,n in ipairs({...}) do
            local f = rawget(genv, n)
            if type(f)~="function" then f = rawget(_G, n) end
            if type(f)~="function" then local ok,g=pcall(function() return getfenv(0)[n] end); if ok then f=g end end
            if type(f)=="function" then return f end
        end
    end
    pvAPI.gethui        = firstOf("gethui","get_hidden_gui","gethiddenui")
    pvAPI.setclipboard  = firstOf("setclipboard","toclipboard","set_clipboard","write_clipboard")
    pvAPI.getclipboard  = firstOf("getclipboard","get_clipboard","readclipboard","read_clipboard")
    pvAPI.getconnections= firstOf("getconnections","get_signal_cons")
    pvAPI.firetouch     = firstOf("firetouchinterest","firetouchinterest")
    pvAPI.mousemoveabs  = firstOf("mousemoveabs","mousemoveabsolute")
    pvAPI.mouse1press   = firstOf("mouse1press","mouse1down")
    pvAPI.mouse1release = firstOf("mouse1release","mouse1up")
    pvAPI.mouse1click   = firstOf("mouse1click")
    pvAPI.hookfunction  = firstOf("hookfunction","replaceclosure","hookfunc")
    pvAPI.setfpscap     = firstOf("setfpscap","set_fps_cap","setfpsmax")
    pvAPI.setfflag      = firstOf("setfflag","set_fflag","setfastflag")
    pvAPI.getcustomasset= firstOf("getcustomasset","getsynasset","getcustomasseturi")
    pvAPI.protectgui    = firstOf("protectgui","protect_gui")
    pvAPI.readfile      = firstOf("readfile")
    pvAPI.writefile     = firstOf("writefile")
    pvAPI.isfile        = firstOf("isfile")
    pvAPI.delfile       = firstOf("delfile","delfile")
    pvAPI.request       = firstOf("request","http_request","httprequest") or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)

    pvAPI.has = {}
    for k,v in pairs(pvAPI) do if k~="has" then pvAPI.has[k] = (v ~= nil) end end


    if not gethui and pvAPI.gethui then
        pcall(function() genv.gethui = pvAPI.gethui end)
    end
    _G.pvAPI = pvAPI
end
do
    local function execName()
        local n
        pcall(function() if identifyexecutor then n = (identifyexecutor()) end end)
        pcall(function() if not n and getexecutorname then n = getexecutorname() end end)
        return tostring(n or ""):lower()
    end
    local name = execName()


    if name:find("xeno",1,true) then
        pcall(function()
            local g=Instance.new("ScreenGui"); g.Name="pvBlocked"; g.IgnoreGuiInset=true
            g.DisplayOrder=2e9; g.Parent=(gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
            local f=Instance.new("Frame"); f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(360,120)
            f.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-180,0,80); f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(16,16,18)
            f.BorderSizePixel=0; f.Parent=g
            local t=Instance.new("TextLabel"); t.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-20); t.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10)
            t.BackgroundTransparency=1; t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; t.TextSize=13; t.TextWrapped=true
            t.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
            t.Text="porkVisuals doesn't run on Xeno.\nXeno is compromised (ratted) -- use any other executor (Delta, Volt, Wave, Synapse, Codex...)."
            t.Parent=f
        end)
        return
    end
end
local function host()
    -- Prefer supported executor hidden-UI containers only when readable.
    -- CoreGui itself is not a safe fallback in restricted Plugin/client threads.
    if UIS.TouchEnabled then return PG end
    local getter=(pvAPI and pvAPI.gethui) or (type(gethui)=="function" and gethui)
    if type(getter)=="function" then
        local ok,h=pcall(getter)
        if ok and h then
            local readable=pcall(function() return h:GetChildren() end)
            if readable then return h end
        end
    end
    return PG
end

_invPending, _invArgs = false, nil

function pvInvOpen()
    local ok,res = pcall(function()
        local mg = LP and LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        mg = mg and mg:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
        local g  = mg and mg:FindFirstChild("Game")
        if not g then return false end
        for _,n in ipairs({"Inventory2","Inventory"}) do
            local inv=g:FindFirstChild(n)
            if inv and inv.Visible then return true end
        end
        return false
    end)
    return ok and res or false
end
function invChanged(cat, id, n)


    if not pvInvOpen() then
        _G.pvPendingInv = {id, n}
        return
    end
    _invArgs = {cat or "Weapons", id, n}
    if _invPending then return end
    _invPending = true
    task.delay(0.2, function()
        _invPending = false
        local a = _invArgs or {"Weapons"}
        pcall(function() InvChangedEvent:Fire(a[1], a[2], a[3]) end)
    end)
end


function pvNormalInventoryLeaf(id)
    local e=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]
    if not e then return nil end
    local mg=LP and LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
    local g=mg and mg:FindFirstChild("Game")
    local inv=g and (g:FindFirstChild("Inventory2") or g:FindFirstChild("Inventory"))
    local main=inv and inv:FindFirstChild("Main")
    local weap=main and main:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
    local its=weap and weap:FindFirstChild("Items")
    local root=its and its:FindFirstChild("Container")
    if not root then return nil end

    local function directContainer(x)
        return x and (x:FindFirstChild("Container") or x) or nil
    end
    if e.Event=="Christmas" or e.Event=="Halloween" then
        local h=root:FindFirstChild("Holiday")
        if not h then return nil end

        local hc=h:FindFirstChild("Container") or h
        local ev=hc:FindFirstChild(tostring(e.Event)) or h:FindFirstChild(tostring(e.Event),true)
        return directContainer(ev) or hc
    elseif e.Season then
        return directContainer(root:FindFirstChild("Current"))
    else
        return directContainer(root:FindFirstChild("Classic"))
    end
end


function pvNormalInventoryRow(id)
    local found
    pcall(function()
        local m=require(RS.Modules.InventoryModule)
        local root=m and m.MyInventory and m.MyInventory.Data and m.MyInventory.Data.Weapons
        local seen={}
        local function walk(t,depth)
            if found or type(t)~="table" or seen[t] or depth>10 then return end
            seen[t]=true
            if tostring(rawget(t,"DataID") or "")==tostring(id) then found=t return end
            for _,v in pairs(t) do if type(v)=="table" then walk(v,depth+1) end end
        end
        walk(root,0)
    end)
    return found
end

function pvNormalInventoryHasLiveTile(id, rowIndex)
    local leaf=pvNormalInventoryLeaf(id)
    local row=rowIndex and rowIndex[tostring(id)] or (not rowIndex and pvNormalInventoryRow(id))
    local f=row and row.Frame
    if f and f.Parent then
        if not leaf then return true end
        local ok,res=pcall(function() return f==leaf or f:IsDescendantOf(leaf) end)
        if ok and res then return true end
    end
    if leaf then
        for _,d in ipairs(leaf:GetChildren()) do
            if d:GetAttribute("pvNormalId")==tostring(id) and d.Parent then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function pvInjectNormalInventoryTile(id,amount,rowIndex)
    local e=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]
    if not e then return false end
    local leaf=pvNormalInventoryLeaf(id)
    if not leaf then return false end


    local row=rowIndex and rowIndex[tostring(id)] or (not rowIndex and pvNormalInventoryRow(id))
    local rf=row and row.Frame
    if rf and rf.Parent then
        local ok,res=pcall(function() return rf==leaf or rf:IsDescendantOf(leaf) end)
        if ok and res then return true end
    end

    for _,d in ipairs(leaf:GetChildren()) do
        if d:GetAttribute("pvNormalId")==tostring(id) then
            local data={}; for k,v in pairs(e) do data[k]=v end
            data.Amount=amount or (ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[id] or 1); data.DataID=id
            pcall(function() _IMod().DisplayItem(d,data,nil,true) end)
            pcall(pvEnforceTags,d,e)
            d.Visible=true
            return true
        end
    end

    local tmpl=RS.Modules.InventoryModule:FindFirstChild("NewItem")
    if not tmpl then return false end
    local t=tmpl:Clone()
    t.Name="NewItem"
    t:SetAttribute("pvNormalInjected",true)
    t:SetAttribute("pvNormalId",tostring(id))
    local data={}; for k,v in pairs(e) do data[k]=v end
    data.Amount=amount or (ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[id] or 1); data.DataID=id
    t.Parent=leaf
    pcall(function() _IMod().DisplayItem(t,data,nil,true) end)
    pcall(pvEnforceTags,t,e)
    local b=t:FindFirstChild("ActionButton",true) or t:FindFirstChild("Button",true)
    if b and b:IsA("GuiButton") then
        pvSession.connect(b.Activated,function()
            pcall(function() EquipService:EquipItem("Weapons",id) end)
        end)
    end
    t.Visible=true
    return true
end


function pvSyncNormalInventoryItems(records,onDone)
    records=records or {}
    task.spawn(function()
        local total=#records
        local fired=0
        if total==1 then
            local r=records[1]
            local ok=pcall(function() InvChangedEvent:Fire(r.cat or "Weapons",r.id,r.n) end)
            if ok then fired=1 end
        elseif total>1 then
            local ok=pcall(function() InvChangedEvent:Fire() end)
            if ok then fired=1 end
        end


        if total>0 then task.wait(total==1 and 0.12 or 0.18) end

        -- Index native rows once per refresh instead of walking the entire
        -- inventory again for every spawned item (and again for every repair).
        local rowIndex = {}
        local indexed = pcall(function()
            local m = require(RS.Modules.InventoryModule)
            local root = m and m.MyInventory and m.MyInventory.Data and m.MyInventory.Data.Weapons
            assert(type(root)=="table")
            local seen, visited = {}, 0
            local function walk(t,depth)
                if type(t)~="table" or seen[t] or depth>10 then return end
                seen[t]=true
                local id=rawget(t,"DataID")
                if id then rowIndex[tostring(id)]=t end
                visited=visited+1
                if visited%100==0 then task.wait() end
                for _,v in pairs(t) do
                    if type(v)=="table" then walk(v,depth+1) end
                end
            end
            walk(root,0)
        end)
        if not indexed then rowIndex=nil end
        local repaired=0
        local sliceStart=os.clock()
        for i,r in ipairs(records) do
            if r.id and not pvNormalInventoryHasLiveTile(r.id,rowIndex) then
                if pvInjectNormalInventoryTile(r.id,r.n,rowIndex) then repaired=repaired+1 end
            end
            if os.clock()-sliceStart>=0.003 or i%8==0 then
                task.wait()
                sliceStart=os.clock()
            end
        end
        if onDone then pcall(onDone,total,fired,repaired) end
    end)
end

function pvForceInventoryRefresh()
    pcall(function() InvChangedEvent:Fire() end)
end
function pvBulkInvChanged(cat,id,n)

    pvForceInventoryRefresh()
end


function pvWeaponTopTab(id)
    local e=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]
    if not e then return "Current", "Season 1" end
    if e.Event=="Christmas" or e.Event=="Halloween" then return "Holiday", "Holiday" end
    if e.Season then return "Current", "Season 1" end
    return "Classic", "Classic"
end
function pvShowSpawnedWeapon(id, searchIt)
    local top,label=pvWeaponTopTab(id)
    pcall(function()
        local mg=LP and LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") and LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
        local g=mg and mg:FindFirstChild("Game")
        local inv=g and (g:FindFirstChild("Inventory2") or g:FindFirstChild("Inventory"))
        local main=inv and inv:FindFirstChild("Main")
        local weap=main and main:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
        local its=weap and weap:FindFirstChild("Items")
        local cont=its and its:FindFirstChild("Container")
        local tabs=(its and its:FindFirstChild("Tabs")) or (weap and weap:FindFirstChild("Tabs"))
        if not (cont and tabs) then return end


        for _,c in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c.Visible=(c.Name==top) end
        end
        for _,t in ipairs(tabs:GetChildren()) do
            local view=t:FindFirstChild("View")
            if view then
                local on=(t.Name==top)
                local border=t:FindFirstChild("ViewBorder")
                if border and border:IsA("GuiObject") then border.Visible=on end
                if t:IsA("GuiObject") then t.BackgroundTransparency=on and 0.8 or 0.9 end
            end
        end


        if searchIt then
            local e=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]
            local search=tabs:FindFirstChild("Search")
            local box=search and search:FindFirstChild("Container") and search.Container:FindFirstChild("SearchText")
            if box and box:IsA("TextBox") then
                local desired=tostring((e and e.ItemName) or id)
                if box.Text~=desired then box.Text=desired end
            end
        end
    end)
    return label
end

local savedSpawns = {}
pcall(function()
    if hasFile and isfileSafe(SPAWN_PATH) then
        savedSpawns = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SPAWN_PATH)) or {}
    end
end)
local saveQueued = false
_lastCfgBlob, _lastSpawnBlob = nil, nil
_G.pvCfgEpoch = _G.pvCfgEpoch or 0
local function saveCfg()
    if not hasFile or saveQueued then return end
    saveQueued = true
    local epoch = _G.pvCfgEpoch
    task.delay(0.6, function()
        saveQueued = false


        if epoch ~= _G.pvCfgEpoch then return end
        pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
            local a = HttpService:JSONEncode(settings)
            if a ~= _lastCfgBlob then writefile(CFG_PATH, a); _lastCfgBlob = a end
            local b = HttpService:JSONEncode(savedSpawns)
            if b ~= _lastSpawnBlob then writefile(SPAWN_PATH, b); _lastSpawnBlob = b end
        end)
    end)
end
pcall(function()
    if hasFile and isfileSafe(CFG_PATH) then
        local t = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CFG_PATH))
        for k,v in pairs(t) do settings[k]=v end
    end
end)
if type(settings.keys)~="table" then settings.keys={} end
if settings.keys.streamerMode==nil then settings.keys.streamerMode="F8" end
if type(settings.hiddenChatKeywords) ~= "string" then settings.hiddenChatKeywords = "" end
if type(settings.customBackground)~="string" then settings.customBackground="" end
if type(settings.christmasBackground)~="string" then settings.christmasBackground="" end
if type(settings.inventoryWhitelist)~="table" then settings.inventoryWhitelist={} end
if type(settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled)~="boolean" then settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled=false end
-- One-time migration for pre-Custom builds. New theme selections stay saved:
-- switching back to Pork/Halloween won't reopen Custom on the next launch.
if settings.customThemeVersion~=1 then
    if settings.customBackground~="" then settings.uiTheme="Custom" end
    settings.customThemeVersion=1
    saveCfg()
end

local SC = IS_TOUCH and 1.1 or 1.1
local function px(n) return math.floor(n*SC+0.5) end

function corner(i,r)
    local c=i:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or px(7));c.Parent=i;return c
end


function bevel(inst, inset, hiCol, loCol, thick) do return inst end
    local t = thick or px(2)
    local hi = hiCol or T.hi
    local lo = loCol or T.lo
    local function edge(name,sz,pos,col,z)
        local f=Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name=name; f.Size=sz; f.Position=pos
        f.BackgroundColor3=col; f.BorderSizePixel=0
        f.ZIndex=(inst.ZIndex or 1)+(z or 1)
        f.Parent=inst
        return f
    end

    local topCol = inset and lo or hi
    local botCol = inset and hi or lo
    edge("mcTop",   UDim2.new(1,0,0,t),  UDim2.new(0,0,0,0),  topCol)
    edge("mcLeft",  UDim2.new(0,t,1,0),  UDim2.new(0,0,0,0),  topCol)
    edge("mcBottom",UDim2.new(1,0,0,t),  UDim2.new(0,0,1,-t), botCol)
    edge("mcRight", UDim2.new(0,t,1,0),  UDim2.new(1,-t,0,0), botCol)
    return inst
end
local function pad(i,l,t,r,b) local u=Instance.new("UIPadding");u.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,l);u.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,r or l);u.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,t or l);u.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,b or t or l);u.Parent=i;return u end


local function stroke(i,tr,th,col)
    local s=Instance.new("UIStroke");s.Color=col or T.line;s.Thickness=th or px(2)
    s.Transparency=tr or 0.5;s.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border;s.Parent=i;return s
end

local function shadow(parent,spread,tr)
    local s=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    s.Name="Shadow";s.BackgroundTransparency=1
    s.Image="rbxassetid://6014261993";s.ImageColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
    s.ImageTransparency=tr or 0.28
    s.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Slice;s.SliceCenter=Rect.new(49,49,450,450)
    s.Size=UDim2.new(1,spread or 40,1,spread or 40)
    s.Position=UDim2.new(0,-(spread or 40)/2,0,-(spread or 40)/2+4)
    s.ZIndex=0;s.Parent=parent;return s
end
-- Clean up the previous PorkVisuals UI without letting its old
-- AncestryChanged remount callback fire after Destroy() locks Parent.
pcall(function()
    if _G.pvGuiAncestryConn then
        _G.pvGuiAncestryConn:Disconnect()
        _G.pvGuiAncestryConn=nil
    end
end)
for _,root in ipairs({HOST,PG}) do
    local readable,children=pcall(function() return root:GetChildren() end)
    for _,c in ipairs(readable and children or {}) do
        if c.Name=="porkVisuals" or c.Name=="porkToggle" then
            -- Older builds did not store their connection globally, so disable
            -- AncestryChanged connections when the executor exposes getconnections.
            pcall(function()
                local gc=(pvAPI and pvAPI.getconnections) or getconnections
                if type(gc)=="function" then
                    for _,con in ipairs(gc(c.AncestryChanged)) do
                        pcall(function()
                            if type(con.Disable)=="function" then con:Disable()
                            elseif type(con.Disconnect)=="function" then con:Disconnect() end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
            pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

-- Convert small animated GIFs into Roblox-playable PNG frame assets entirely
-- locally. GIF binaries cannot be played by ImageLabel; this decoder supports
-- GIF87a/89a palettes, LZW, transparency, disposal and interlacing.
local function pvDecodeGIF(bytes,shouldStop)
    if bytes:sub(1,6)~="GIF87a" and bytes:sub(1,6)~="GIF89a" then
        return nil,"Not a valid GIF image"
    end
    -- Time-sliced decoding: yield only when a short work budget has elapsed.
    -- This makes the import take longer but prevents multi-second UI stalls.
    local lastYield=os.clock()
    local function breathe(force)
        if shouldStop and shouldStop() then error("GIF load cancelled") end
        if force or os.clock()-lastYield>=0.003 then
            task.wait()
            lastYield=os.clock()
        end
    end
    local pos=7
    local function b()
        local n=bytes:byte(pos)
        if not n then error("Truncated GIF") end
        pos=pos+1
        return n
    end
    local function u16() local l=b();return l+b()*256 end
    local function palette(n)
        local t={}
        for i=1,n do t[i]=string.char(b(),b(),b(),255) end
        return t
    end
    local function blocks()
        local chunks={}
        while true do
            local n=b()
            if n==0 then break end
            if pos+n-1>#bytes then error("Truncated GIF data block") end
            chunks[#chunks+1]=bytes:sub(pos,pos+n-1)
            pos=pos+n
        end
        return table.concat(chunks)
    end
    local function lzw(data,minSize,expected)
        if minSize<2 or minSize>8 then error("Unsupported GIF compression") end
        local clear=2^minSize
        local finish=clear+1
        local dict,nextCode,codeSize
        local function reset()
            dict={}
            for i=0,clear-1 do dict[i]=string.char(i) end
            nextCode=finish+1
            codeSize=minSize+1
        end
        reset()
        local index,acc,bits=1,0,0
        local function readCode()
            while bits<codeSize do
                local n=data:byte(index)
                if not n then return nil end
                acc=acc+n*2^bits
                bits=bits+8
                index=index+1
            end
            local code=bit32.band(acc,2^codeSize-1)
            acc=bit32.rshift(acc,codeSize)
            bits=bits-codeSize
            return code
        end
        local out,previous,total={},nil,0
        local step=0
        while total<expected do
            step=step+1
            if step%1024==0 then breathe() end
            local code=readCode()
            if code==nil or code==finish then break end
            if code==clear then
                reset()
                previous=nil
            else
                local entry=dict[code]
                if not entry and previous and code==nextCode then
                    entry=previous..previous:sub(1,1)
                end
                if not entry then error("Corrupt GIF LZW stream") end
                out[#out+1]=entry
                total=total+#entry
                if previous and nextCode<4096 then
                    dict[nextCode]=previous..entry:sub(1,1)
                    nextCode=nextCode+1
                    if nextCode==2^codeSize and codeSize<12 then
                        codeSize=codeSize+1
                    end
                end
                previous=entry
            end
        end
        if total<expected then error("Incomplete GIF frame") end
        return table.concat(out):sub(1,expected)
    end
    -- PNG format: 8-bit RGBA, filter 0, RFC1950 zlib + stored deflate blocks.
    -- Build the CRC lookup table once, shared by every generated GIF frame.
    local crcTable={}
    for i=0,255 do
        local c=i
        for _=1,8 do
            c=bit32.band(c,1)==1 and bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(c,1),0xEDB88320) or bit32.rshift(c,1)
        end
        crcTable[i]=c
    end
    local function pngRGBA(w,h,rgba)
        local function be32(n)
            return string.char(math.floor(n/16777216)%256,math.floor(n/65536)%256,math.floor(n/256)%256,n%256)
        end
        local function chunk(tag,payload)
            local crc=0xFFFFFFFF
            local body=tag..payload
            for i=1,#body do
                if i%4096==0 then breathe() end
                local idx=bit32.band(bit32.bxor(crc,body:byte(i)),255)
                crc=bit32.bxor(bit32.rshift(crc,8),crcTable[idx])
            end
            return be32(#payload)..body..be32(bit32.bxor(crc,0xFFFFFFFF))
        end
        local rows={}
        for y=0,h-1 do
            if y%8==0 then breathe() end
            rows[#rows+1]="\0"..table.concat(rgba,"",y*w+1,(y+1)*w)
        end
        local raw=table.concat(rows)
        local a,bb=1,0
        for i=1,#raw do
            if i%8192==0 then breathe() end
            a=(a+raw:byte(i))%65521
            bb=(bb+a)%65521
        end
        local z={"\120\001"}
        local offset=1
        while offset<=#raw do
            local n=math.min(65535,#raw-offset+1)
            local inv=65535-n
            z[#z+1]=string.char(offset+n>#raw and 1 or 0,n%256,math.floor(n/256),inv%256,math.floor(inv/256))
            z[#z+1]=raw:sub(offset,offset+n-1)
            offset=offset+n
            breathe()
        end
        z[#z+1]=be32(bb*65536+a)
        return "\137PNG\r\n\26\n"..chunk("IHDR",be32(w)..be32(h)..string.char(8,6,0,0,0))
            ..chunk("IDAT",table.concat(z))..chunk("IEND","")
    end
    local function scaleCanvas(srcW,srcH,src,dstW,dstH)
        if srcW==dstW and srcH==dstH then return src end
        local out=table.create and table.create(dstW*dstH) or {}
        for y=0,dstH-1 do
            if y%8==0 then breathe() end
            local sy=math.min(srcH-1,math.floor((y+0.5)*srcH/dstH))
            local srcRow=sy*srcW
            local dstRow=y*dstW
            for x=0,dstW-1 do
                local sx=math.min(srcW-1,math.floor((x+0.5)*srcW/dstW))
                out[dstRow+x+1]=src[srcRow+sx+1]
            end
        end
        return out
    end
    local function decode()
        local width,height=u16(),u16()
        if width<1 or height<1 then
            error("GIF has invalid dimensions")
        end
        -- Huge source GIFs can consume hundreds of MB before resizing.
        if width*height>6000000 then
            error("GIF is too large to decode safely (maximum 6M source pixels)")
        end
        -- Animated wallpaper is viewed in a ~270px-wide panel, so decoding
        -- full 480px frames wastes CPU, file I/O and memory without adding
        -- visible detail at normal UI sizes. Static pictures are unaffected.
        local maxSide=320
        local scale=math.min(1,maxSide/math.max(width,height))
        local outWidth=math.max(1,math.floor(width*scale+0.5))
        local outHeight=math.max(1,math.floor(height*scale+0.5))
        local flags=b()
        b() -- background palette index
        b() -- pixel aspect ratio
        local globalPalette
        if bit32.band(flags,128)~=0 then globalPalette=palette(2^(bit32.band(flags,7)+1)) end
        local transparent=string.char(0,0,0,0)
        local canvas={}
        for i=1,width*height do
            if i%8192==0 then breathe() end
            canvas[i]=transparent
        end
        local frames={}
        local disposal=0
        local prevRect=nil
        local prevCanvas=nil
        local gce={delay=10,dispose=0,transparent=nil}
        local totalPixels=0
        while pos<=#bytes do
            breathe()
            local marker=b()
            if marker==0x3B then break end
            if marker==0x21 then
                local extension=b()
                if extension==0xF9 then
                    local n=b()
                    if n~=4 then error("Invalid GIF animation extension") end
                    local bits=b()
                    local delay=u16()
                    local trans=b()
                    b()
                    gce={delay=delay,dispose=bit32.band(bit32.rshift(bits,2),7),transparent=bit32.band(bits,1)==1 and trans or nil}
                else
                    blocks()
                end
            elseif marker==0x2C then
                local left,top,fw,fh=u16(),u16(),u16(),u16()
                local localFlags=b()
                if fw<1 or fh<1 or left+fw>width or top+fh>height then
                    error("GIF contains an invalid frame rectangle")
                end
                local colors=bit32.band(localFlags,128)~=0 and palette(2^(bit32.band(localFlags,7)+1)) or globalPalette
                if not colors then error("GIF has no palette") end
                local minSize=b()
                local compressed=blocks()
                if #frames>=48 or totalPixels+outWidth*outHeight>4000000 then
                    error("GIF too long for UI (max 48 frames / 4M frame pixels)")
                end
                if prevRect then
                    if disposal==2 then
                        for y=prevRect.top,prevRect.top+prevRect.height-1 do
                            if y%8==0 then breathe() end
                            for x=prevRect.left,prevRect.left+prevRect.width-1 do
                                canvas[y*width+x+1]=transparent
                            end
                        end
                    elseif disposal==3 and prevCanvas then
                        canvas=prevCanvas
                    end
                end
                local before=(gce.dispose==3) and table.clone(canvas) or nil
                local decoded=lzw(compressed,minSize,fw*fh)
                local yOrder={}
                if bit32.band(localFlags,64)~=0 then
                    for _,pass in ipairs({{0,8},{4,8},{2,4},{1,2}}) do
                        for y=pass[1],fh-1,pass[2] do yOrder[#yOrder+1]=y end
                    end
                else
                    for y=0,fh-1 do yOrder[#yOrder+1]=y end
                end
                local p=1
                for _,dy in ipairs(yOrder) do
                    if dy%8==0 then breathe() end
                    local row=(top+dy)*width+left+1
                    for x=0,fw-1 do
                        local ci=decoded:byte(p);p=p+1
                        if ci~=gce.transparent then canvas[row+x]=colors[ci+1] or transparent end
                    end
                end
                local renderCanvas=scale<1 and scaleCanvas(width,height,canvas,outWidth,outHeight) or canvas
                totalPixels=totalPixels+outWidth*outHeight
                frames[#frames+1]={png=pngRGBA(outWidth,outHeight,renderCanvas),delay=math.max(0.07,(gce.delay==0 and 10 or gce.delay)/100)}
                breathe(true) -- leave rendering time between decoded frames
                prevRect={left=left,top=top,width=fw,height=fh}
                prevCanvas=before
                disposal=gce.dispose
                gce={delay=10,dispose=0,transparent=nil}
                if #frames%4==0 then task.wait() end
            else
                error("Invalid GIF data")
            end
        end
        if #frames==0 then error("GIF contains no frames") end
        return frames
    end
    local ok,result=pcall(decode)
    if ok then return result end
    return nil,tostring(result)
end

-- One Custom theme input supports still images, small animated GIFs and
-- approved Roblox videos. Arbitrary MP4/WebM URLs are not directly playable
-- in Roblox; a playable Roblox video asset (video:12345) is recommended.
do
    -- Keep custom wallpapers almost flush with the rounded outer window.
    -- A fractional-pixel inset avoids the visible dark stripe of the old
    -- 2px inset. Do not use px(0.1), which rounds to 0.
    -- The image, video and dim layer share this corner geometry.
    local wallpaperInset=0.1
    local wallpaperCornerRadius=px(14)-wallpaperInset
    local picture=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    picture.Name="pvCustomBackgroundImage"
    picture.Size=UDim2.new(1,-wallpaperInset*2,1,-wallpaperInset*2)
    picture.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(wallpaperInset,wallpaperInset)
    picture.BackgroundTransparency=1
    picture.BorderSizePixel=0
    picture.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    picture.ImageTransparency=0.10
    picture.ZIndex=0
    picture.Active=false
    picture.Visible=false
    picture.Parent=sky
    corner(picture,wallpaperCornerRadius)

    local video=Instance.new("VideoFrame")
    video.Name="pvCustomBackgroundVideo"
    video.Size=picture.Size
    video.Position=picture.Position
    video.BackgroundTransparency=1
    video.BorderSizePixel=0
    -- VideoFrame fills the panel; Roblox VideoFrame has no ScaleType property.
    video.Looped=true
    video.Volume=0
    video.Playing=false
    video.ZIndex=0
    video.Active=false
    video.Visible=false
    video.Parent=sky
    corner(video,wallpaperCornerRadius)

    local darken=Instance.new("Frame")
    darken.Name="pvCustomBackgroundDim"
    darken.Size=picture.Size
    darken.Position=picture.Position
    darken.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(13,9,20)
    darken.BackgroundTransparency=0.48
    darken.BorderSizePixel=0
    darken.ZIndex=0
    darken.Active=false
    darken.Visible=false
    darken.Parent=sky
    corner(darken,wallpaperCornerRadius)

    local requestToken=0
    local activeKind="none"
    local temporaryFiles={}
    local animatedFrames=nil

    local function trim(value)
        return tostring(value or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
    end
    local function cleanupFiles(files)
        if pvAPI.delfile then
            for _,path in ipairs(files or {}) do pcall(pvAPI.delfile,path) end
        end
    end
    pvSession.addCleanup(function() cleanupFiles(temporaryFiles) end)

    function pvRefreshCustomBackgroundVisibility()
        local show=settings.uiTheme=="Custom"
        picture.Visible=show and (activeKind=="image" or activeKind=="gif")
        video.Visible=show and activeKind=="video"
        darken.Visible=show and activeKind~="none"
        if activeKind=="video" then
            pcall(function() video.Playing=show end)
        end
    end

    local function imageKind(bytes)
        if bytes:sub(1,8)=="\137PNG\r\n\26\n" then return "png" end
        if bytes:sub(1,3)=="\255\216\255" then return "jpg" end
        if bytes:sub(1,6)=="GIF89a" or bytes:sub(1,6)=="GIF87a" then return "gif" end
        if bytes:sub(1,4)=="RIFF" and bytes:sub(9,12)=="WEBP" then
            if bytes:sub(13,100):find("ANIM",1,true) then return "animated_webp" end
            return "webp"
        end
        if bytes:sub(5,8)=="ftyp" then return "mp4" end
        if bytes:sub(1,4)=="\026\069\223\163" then return "webm" end
        return nil
    end

    local function makeFolder()
        local ok=pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder)=="function" and type(makefolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then
                makefolder(CFG_DIR)
            end
        end)
        return ok
    end
    local function writeAsset(bytes,extension,files)
        if not (pvAPI.writefile and pvAPI.getcustomasset) then
            return nil,"This executor needs writefile and getcustomasset"
        end
        if not makeFolder() then return nil,"Could not create PorkHub folder" end
        local path=CFG_DIR.."/pv_wallpaper_"..HttpService:GenerateGUID(false).."."..extension
        local ok=pcall(pvAPI.writefile,path,bytes)
        if not ok then return nil,"Could not write background file" end
        files[#files+1]=path
        local success,asset=pcall(pvAPI.getcustomasset,path)
        if not success or type(asset)~="string" or asset=="" then
            return nil,"Executor couldn't load the "..extension.." file"
        end
        return asset
    end
    local function getBytes(url)
        local body=nil
        if pvAPI.request then
            local ok,response=pcall(pvAPI.request,{Url=url,Method="GET"})
            if ok and type(response)=="table" then
                local status=tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.Status)
                if (status==200 or (not status and response.Success==true)) and type(response.Body)=="string" then
                    body=response.Body
                end
            end
        end
        if not body then body=httpGet(url) end
        if type(body)~="string" then return nil,"Couldn't download URL" end
        if #body<12 then return nil,"Image/video download is empty" end
        if #body>15*1024*1024 then return nil,"File must be under 15 MB" end
        return body
    end
    local function commit(kind,source,saveIt,files,asset,frames)
        if not isCurrent() then cleanupFiles(files);return end
        local previous=temporaryFiles
        temporaryFiles=files or {}
        activeKind=kind
        animatedFrames=frames
        picture.Image=kind=="video" and "" or (asset or (frames and frames[1].asset) or "")
        if kind~="video" then pcall(function() video.Playing=false;video.Video="" end) end
        if saveIt then settings.customBackground=source;saveCfg() end
        pvRefreshCustomBackgroundVisibility()
        cleanupFiles(previous)
    end

    -- Incremented for every new Apply/Reset; old GIF animations exit on change.
    local function startGifPlayback(frames,token)
        if #frames<=1 then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local i=1
            while isCurrent() and requestToken==token and activeKind=="gif" and animatedFrames==frames do
                if settings.uiTheme=="Custom" then
                    local frame=frames[i]
                    picture.Image=frame.asset
                    task.wait(frame.delay)
                    i=(i%#frames)+1
                else
                    task.wait(0.20)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Try VideoFrame only for content Roblox can play. Verify that it loaded
    -- before overwriting the user's previous, working background.
    local function tryVideo(asset,source,saveIt,files,token,done)
        if not asset or asset=="" then cleanupFiles(files);done(false,"No video asset available");return end
        local oldVideo=video.Video
        local oldPlaying=video.Playing
        local ok=pcall(function()
            video.Video=asset
            video.Looped=true
            video.Volume=0
            video.Playing=true
        end)
        if not ok then
            pcall(function() video.Video=oldVideo;video.Playing=oldPlaying end)
            cleanupFiles(files)
            done(false,"This Roblox client can't play the video")
            return
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local started=os.clock()
            local loaded=false
            while isCurrent() and requestToken==token and os.clock()-started<8 do
                local fine,result=pcall(function() return video.IsLoaded end)
                if fine and result then loaded=true;break end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
            if requestToken~=token or not isCurrent() then cleanupFiles(files);return end
            if not loaded then
                pcall(function() video.Video=oldVideo;video.Playing=oldPlaying end)
                cleanupFiles(files)
                pvRefreshCustomBackgroundVisibility()
                done(false,"Video not playable here. Use an approved Roblox video ID (video:123)")
                return
            end
            commit("video",source,saveIt,files)
            done(true,"Looping video background applied")
        end)
    end

    local function processBytes(bytes,source,saveIt,token,done)
        local kind=imageKind(bytes)
        if not kind then done(false,"Unsupported file: use PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF or a Roblox video asset");return end
        if kind=="animated_webp" then
            done(false,"Animated WebP isn't playable here. Convert to GIF or Roblox video")
            return
        end
        local files={}
        if kind=="gif" then
            if not (pvAPI.writefile and pvAPI.getcustomasset) then
                done(false,"GIF playback needs writefile + getcustomasset")
                return
            end
            local frames,err=pvDecodeGIF(bytes,function() return requestToken~=token or not isCurrent() end)
            if not frames then done(false,"GIF couldn't load: "..tostring(err));return end
            for i,frame in ipairs(frames) do
                if token~=requestToken or not isCurrent() then cleanupFiles(files);return end
                local asset,why=writeAsset(frame.png,"png",files)
                frame.png=nil -- Don't keep raw PNG buffers after loading each frame.
                if not asset then cleanupFiles(files);done(false,why);return end
                frame.asset=asset
                task.wait() -- asset registration is costly; keep UI responsive between frames
            end
            if token~=requestToken or not isCurrent() then cleanupFiles(files);return end
            commit("gif",source,saveIt,files,nil,frames)
            startGifPlayback(frames,token)
            done(true,"Animated GIF background applied ("..#frames.." frames)")
        elseif kind=="mp4" or kind=="webm" then
            if not (pvAPI.getcustomasset and pvAPI.writefile) then
                done(false,"MP4/WebM need an approved Roblox video ID (video:123)")
                return
            end
            local asset,why=writeAsset(bytes,kind,files)
            if not asset then cleanupFiles(files);done(false,why.."; try a Roblox video ID");return end
            tryVideo(asset,source,saveIt,files,token,done)
        else
            local asset,why=writeAsset(bytes,kind,files)
            if not asset then cleanupFiles(files);done(false,why);return end
            if token~=requestToken or not isCurrent() then cleanupFiles(files);return end
            commit("image",source,saveIt,files,asset)
            done(true,"Custom image background applied")
        end
    end

    -- Automatic format detection from file signatures when available, and
    -- explicit `video:ID` for Roblox video assets (plain IDs remain images).
    function pvSetCustomBackground(source,persist,callback)
        source=trim(source)
        requestToken=requestToken+1
        local token=requestToken
        local function done(ok,message)
            if callback and requestToken==token and isCurrent() then pcall(callback,ok,message) end
        end
        if source=="" then
            commit("none","",persist,{})
            done(true,"Custom background reset")
            return true
        end
        if #source>2048 then done(false,"Background input is too long");return false end
        local videoId=source:match("^[Vv][Ii][Dd][Ee][Oo]:%s*(%d+)$")
            or source:match("^rbxvideo://(%d+)$")
            or source:match("roblox%.com/videos/(%d+)")
        if videoId then
            tryVideo("rbxassetid://"..videoId,source,persist,{},token,done)
            return true
        end
        local id=source:match("^(%d+)$") or source:match("^rbxassetid://(%d+)$")
        if not id and (source:find("roblox.com",1,true) or source:find("robloxusercontent.com",1,true)) then
            id=source:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or source:match("/store/asset/(%d+)")
                or source:match("/library/(%d+)") or source:match("/catalog/(%d+)")
        end
        if id then
            commit("image",source,persist,{},"rbxassetid://"..id)
            done(true,"Roblox image background applied")
            return true
        end
        if source:match("^https://") then
            task.spawn(function()
                local bytes,err=getBytes(source)
                if token~=requestToken or not isCurrent() then return end
                if not bytes then done(false,err);return end
                processBytes(bytes,source,persist,token,done)
            end)
            return true
        end
        if source:match("^https?://") then
            done(false,"Please use HTTPS links")
            return false
        end
        if not pvAPI.readfile then
            done(false,"Local files need executor readfile")
            return false
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,bytes=pcall(pvAPI.readfile,source)
            if requestToken~=token or not isCurrent() then return end
            if not ok or type(bytes)~="string" then
                done(false,"Can't find/read that local file")
                return
            end
            if #bytes>15*1024*1024 then done(false,"File must be under 15 MB");return end
            processBytes(bytes,source,persist,token,done)
        end)
        return true
    end
end


-- CHRISTMAS BACKDROP: bundled image asset, preloaded locally for instant theme toggles.
do
    local wallpaperInset=0.1
    local wallpaperCornerRadius=px(14)-wallpaperInset
    local picture=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    picture.Name="pvChristmasBackgroundImage"
    picture.Size=UDim2.new(1,-wallpaperInset*2,1,-wallpaperInset*2)
    picture.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(wallpaperInset,wallpaperInset)
    picture.BackgroundTransparency=1
    picture.BorderSizePixel=0
    picture.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    picture.ImageTransparency=0.07
    picture.ZIndex=0
    picture.Active=false
    picture.Visible=false
    picture.Parent=sky
    corner(picture,wallpaperCornerRadius)

    local darken=Instance.new("Frame")
    darken.Name="pvChristmasBackgroundDim"
    darken.Size=picture.Size
    darken.Position=picture.Position
    darken.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(5,14,19)
    darken.BackgroundTransparency=0.58
    darken.BorderSizePixel=0
    darken.ZIndex=0
    darken.Active=false
    darken.Visible=false
    darken.Parent=sky
    corner(darken,wallpaperCornerRadius)

    local christmasAsset=""
    local christmasReady=false
    local christmasAttempted=false
    local bundledBlob=[=[]=]

    -- Decode the embedded PNG using standard Luau operations. No executor-specific decoder needed.
    local function decodeBundledBase64(value)
        local alphabet="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local lookup={}
        for i=1,#alphabet do lookup[string.byte(alphabet,i)]=i-1 end
        local output={}
        for i=1,#value,4 do
            local a,b,c,d=string.byte(value,i,i+3)
            local x,y=lookup[a],lookup[b]
            if x==nil or y==nil then error("Invalid Christmas image data") end
            local z,w=lookup[c],lookup[d]
            local n=x*262144+y*4096+(z or 0)*64+(w or 0)
            local first=math.floor(n/65536)%256
            if z==nil then
                if c~=61 or d~=61 then error("Invalid Base64 padding") end
                output[#output+1]=string.char(first)
            elseif w==nil then
                if d~=61 then error("Invalid Base64 padding") end
                output[#output+1]=string.char(first,math.floor(n/256)%256)
            else
                output[#output+1]=string.char(first,math.floor(n/256)%256,n%256)
            end
        end
        return table.concat(output)
    end

    local function ensureBundledChristmasAsset()
        if christmasReady and christmasAsset~="" then return true end
        if christmasAttempted then return christmasAsset~="" end
        christmasAttempted=true
        if not (pvAPI and pvAPI.writefile and pvAPI.getcustomasset) then return false end
        local okFolder=pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder)=="function" and type(makefolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then
                makefolder(CFG_DIR)
            end
        end)
        if not okFolder then return false end
        local path=CFG_DIR.."/pv_builtin_christmas_bg_clean_68bbaaf6f5.png"
        if not isfileSafe(path) then
            local okDecode,bytes=pcall(function() return decodeBundledBase64(bundledBlob) end)
            if not okDecode or type(bytes)~="string" or #bytes<512 then return false end
            local okWrite=pcall(function() pvAPI.writefile(path,bytes) end)
            if not okWrite then return false end
        end
        local okAsset,asset=pcall(function() return pvAPI.getcustomasset(path) end)
        if not okAsset or type(asset)~="string" or asset=="" then return false end
        christmasAsset=asset
        christmasReady=true
        picture.Image=asset
        return true
    end
    function pvHasBundledChristmasBackground()
        return ensureBundledChristmasAsset()
    end
    function pvRefreshChristmasBackgroundVisibility()
        local show=settings.uiTheme=="Christmas"
        if show then ensureBundledChristmasAsset() end
        picture.Visible=show and christmasAsset~=""
        darken.Visible=show and christmasAsset~=""
    end
    -- One small embedded atlas, reused by every snowflake across theme switches.
    -- The long literal avoids Luau's concatenation register limit.
    local snowAtlasBlob=[=[]=]
    local snowAtlasAsset
    function pvSession.getChristmasSnowAtlas()
        if snowAtlasAsset then return snowAtlasAsset end
        if not (pvAPI.writefile and pvAPI.getcustomasset) then return nil end
        local path=CFG_DIR.."/pv_christmas_snowflakes_bf223464d0.png"
        local ok,asset=pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder)=="function" and type(makefolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
            if not isfileSafe(path) then pvAPI.writefile(path,decodeBundledBase64(snowAtlasBlob)) end
            return pvAPI.getcustomasset(path)
        end)
        if ok and type(asset)=="string" and asset~="" then snowAtlasAsset=asset end
        return snowAtlasAsset
    end
    task.defer(function()
        pcall(ensureBundledChristmasAsset)
        local asset=pvSession.getChristmasSnowAtlas()
        if asset and isCurrent() then
            pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({asset}) end)
        end
    end)
end

-- HALLOWEEN UI: native, non-interactive ornaments, scoped to this window.
do
    local function piece(parent, name, x, y, w, h, color, radius)
        local f=Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name=name; f.BorderSizePixel=0; f.Active=false; f.Selectable=false
        f.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(x),px(y)); f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(w),px(h))
        f.BackgroundColor3=color; f.ZIndex=1; f.Parent=parent
        if radius then corner(f,px(radius)) end
        return f
    end
    -- Draw unrotated scanline runs clipped against the actual rounded corner.
    -- Rotated Roblox Frames can escape ancestor clipping, so trim the geometry.
    for _,right in ipairs({false,true}) do
        local extent,radius=px(60),px(14)
        local web=Instance.new("Frame")
        web.Name="HalloweenWeb";web.BackgroundTransparency=1;web.Active=false
        web.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(extent,extent);web.ZIndex=0;web.ClipsDescendants=true;web.Parent=sky
        web.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(right and 1 or 0,0)
        web.Position=UDim2.fromScale(right and 1 or 0,0)
        local pixels={}
        local function line(x1,y1,x2,y2)
            x1,y1,x2,y2=x1*SC,y1*SC,x2*SC,y2*SC
            local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
            local steps=math.max(1,math.ceil(math.max(math.abs(dx),math.abs(dy))*2))
            for i=0,steps do
                local x=math.floor(x1+dx*i/steps+0.5)
                local y=math.floor(y1+dy*i/steps+0.5)
                -- Check the entire pixel square, not just its center.
                local inside=x>=1 and y>=1 and x<extent-1 and y<extent-1
                if inside and x<radius and y<radius then
                    inside=(x-radius)^2+(y-radius)^2<=(radius-1)^2
                end
                if inside then
                    local sx=right and extent-1-x or x
                    pixels[y]=pixels[y] or {};pixels[y][sx]=true
                end
            end
        end
        for i=0,4 do
            local a=i*math.pi/8
            line(0,0,math.cos(a)*59,math.sin(a)*59)
        end
        for _,r in ipairs({19,36,55}) do
            for i=0,3 do
                local a,b=i*math.pi/8,(i+1)*math.pi/8
                line(math.cos(a)*r,math.sin(a)*r,math.cos(b)*r,math.sin(b)*r)
            end
        end
        for y,row in pairs(pixels) do
            local x=0
            while x<extent do
                if row[x] then
                    local first=x
                    repeat x=x+1 until not row[x]
                    local f=Instance.new("Frame")
                    f.Name="WebSilk";f.BorderSizePixel=0;f.Active=false
                    f.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(first,y);f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(x-first,1)
                    f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(179,164,150);f.BackgroundTransparency=0.88
                    f.ZIndex=1;f.Parent=web
                else x=x+1 end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Small head-down spider hanging from the top-left web; native UI artwork.
    local spider=Instance.new("Frame")
    spider.Name="HalloweenSpider";spider.BackgroundTransparency=1;spider.Active=false
    spider.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(24),px(54));spider.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(13),px(34))
    spider.ZIndex=1;spider.Parent=win
    -- Extend the hanging silk upward to meet the web's 45-degree strand.
    -- The spider/body and animation travel stay in their existing positions.
    -- Match the same copper-grey and opacity used by the top-corner WebSilk strands.
    local thread=piece(spider,"SilkThread",12,-9,1,33,Color3.fromRGB(179,164,150))
    thread.BackgroundTransparency=0.76
    local body=Instance.new("Frame")
    body.Name="SpiderBody";body.BackgroundTransparency=1;body.Active=false
    body.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(24),px(31));body.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,px(18))
    body.ZIndex=2;body.Parent=spider
    local legs={}
    local function leg(x1,y1,x2,y2)
        local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
        local f=piece(body,"SpiderLeg",(x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2,math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy),1,Color3.fromRGB(146,112,97),1)
        f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
        f.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(dy,dx))
        f.BackgroundTransparency=0.12
        legs[#legs+1]=f
        return f
    end
    local bridge=piece(body,"SpiderBridge",11,0,2,10,Color3.fromRGB(125,96,84),1)
    bridge.BackgroundTransparency=0.16
    for _,side in ipairs({-1,1}) do
        for _,v in ipairs({{17,5,12,8,8},{18,7,15,10,12},{19,7,21,10,24},{20,4,24,5,28}}) do
            leg(12+side*2,v[1],12+side*v[2],v[3])
            leg(12+side*v[2],v[3],12+side*v[4],v[5])
        end
    end
    local abdomen=piece(body,"Abdomen",8,10,9,11,Color3.new(1,1,1),6)
    local shading=Instance.new("UIGradient");shading.Rotation=45
    shading.Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(155,123,103)),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4,Color3.fromRGB(82,50,46)),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(25,12,18))})
    shading.Parent=abdomen
    local thorax=piece(body,"Thorax",9,18,7,6,Color3.fromRGB(51,26,35),4)
    local edge=Instance.new("UIStroke");edge.Color=Color3.fromRGB(178,133,105)
    edge.Thickness=0.6;edge.Transparency=0.45;edge.Parent=thorax
    leg(11,23,10,25);leg(14,23,15,25)
    do
        local startY,endY=px(20),px(12)
        -- Nine extra pixels above the former silk start; lower endpoint unchanged.
        local startLen,endLen=px(35),px(27)
        body.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,startY)
        body.Rotation=-1
        thread.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(1),startLen)
        local bodyTw=Tween:Create(body,TweenInfo.new(1.8,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),{
            Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,endY),
            Rotation=2
        })
        local silkTw=Tween:Create(thread,TweenInfo.new(1.8,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),{
            Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(1),endLen)
        })
        bodyTw:Play();silkTw:Play()
        for i,f in ipairs(legs) do
            local dir=((f.Position.X.Offset or 0) < px(12)) and -1 or 1
            local amp=((i % 2)==0) and 6 or 4
            local tw=Tween:Create(f,TweenInfo.new(0.8+(i%3)*0.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),{
                Rotation=f.Rotation + dir*amp
            })
            tw:Play()
        end
    end
    -- Softly textured ivory crescent. Keep details low contrast at icon size:
    -- no crater outlines, bright dots, or orange "cheese" coloring.
    do
        local moon=Instance.new("Frame")
        moon.Name="HalloweenMoon"
        moon.Active=false;moon.Selectable=false
        moon.BackgroundTransparency=1
        -- Slightly smaller than before (20px instead of 24px), same centre.
        moon.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(20),px(20))
        moon.Position=UDim2.new(1,-px(31),0,px(61))
        -- Scale texture and crescent mask together so the proportions stay intact.
        local function moonPx(n) return px(n*20/24) end
        moon.ClipsDescendants=true
        moon.ZIndex=2
        moon.Parent=win

        local gold=Instance.new("Frame")
        gold.Name="MoonGold"
        gold.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        gold.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,228,173)
        gold.BorderSizePixel=0
        gold.ZIndex=2
        gold.Parent=moon
        Instance.new("UICorner",gold).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)

        -- Creamy moonlight rather than saturated pumpkin orange.
        local surface=Instance.new("UIGradient")
        surface.Name="MoonSoftShading"
        surface.Rotation=105
        surface.Color=ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(255,245,210)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38,Color3.fromRGB(255,231,177)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.72,Color3.fromRGB(250,214,152)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(231,178,112)),
        })
        surface.Parent=gold

        local function spot(name,x,y,w,h,color,opacity)
            local f=Instance.new("Frame")
            f.Name=name
            f.Active=false;f.Selectable=false
            f.BorderSizePixel=0
            f.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(moonPx(x),moonPx(y))
            f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(moonPx(w),moonPx(h))
            f.BackgroundColor3=color
            f.BackgroundTransparency=opacity
            f.ZIndex=3
            f.Parent=gold
            Instance.new("UICorner",f).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
            return f
        end

        -- Diffuse lunar maria: very faint irregular-looking tonal areas.
        -- They sit beneath the mask, so nothing bleeds across the inner edge.
        local mareColor=Color3.fromRGB(148,115,93)
        spot("MoonMareUpper",2.0,7.0,5.5,7.5,mareColor,0.94)
        spot("MoonMareLower",6.5,16.6,7.0,4.0,mareColor,0.95)

        -- Dimples are tiny, soft shadows rather than outlined holes.
        -- Even a thin white rim reads as cartoon cheese at icon size.
        local craterColor=Color3.fromRGB(158,117,81)
        for i,p in ipairs({
            {4.1,5.7,2.8,0.84},
            {3.7,13.5,2.2,0.87},
            {10.5,19.8,2.5,0.87},
        }) do
            local crater=spot("MoonCrater"..i,p[1],p[2],p[3],p[3],craterColor,p[4])
            local diffuse=Instance.new("UIGradient")
            diffuse.Rotation=50
            diffuse.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.65),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,0),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.7),
            })
            diffuse.Parent=crater
        end

        -- The inner circular cover follows the moving panel background.
        local cutout=Instance.new("Frame")
        cutout.Name="MoonCutout"
        cutout.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(moonPx(9),-moonPx(4))
        cutout.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(moonPx(22),moonPx(22))
        cutout.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(39,17,33)
        cutout.BorderSizePixel=0
        cutout.ZIndex=4
        cutout.Parent=moon
        Instance.new("UICorner",cutout).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)

        local function matchBackground()
            if not win.Parent or not moon.Parent then return end
            local points=galaxy.Color.Keypoints
            if #points<2 then return end
            local h=math.max(1,win.AbsoluteSize.Y)
            local centerY=moon.AbsolutePosition.Y+moon.AbsoluteSize.Y*0.5
            local relative=(centerY-win.AbsolutePosition.Y)/h
            local t=math.clamp(relative-galaxy.Offset.Y,0,1)
            cutout.BackgroundColor3=points[1].Value:Lerp(points[#points].Value,t)
        end
        pvSession.connect(galaxy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"),matchBackground)
        pvSession.connect(galaxy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Offset"),matchBackground)
        pvSession.connect(win:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"),matchBackground)
        task.defer(matchBackground)
    end
    local rim=Instance.new("UIGradient")
    rim.Rotation=25;rim.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,157,57),Color3.fromRGB(158,79,34))
    -- Only the border is graded; text stays high contrast.
    local edge=Instance.new("UIStroke");edge.Name="HalloweenInnerRim"
    edge.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border;edge.Thickness=1;edge.Transparency=0.55
    edge.Color=Color3.new(1,1,1);rim.Parent=edge;edge.Parent=win
end

    local tw=Tween:Create(inst,
        TweenInfo.new(secs,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,-1,true),
        props)
    tw:Play()

end

local function drag(handle)
    local d,sp,si
    pvSession.connect(handle.InputBegan,function(i)
        if settings.uiLocked then return end
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            d=true;sp=win.Position;si=i.Position
            pvSession.connect(i.Changed,function() if i.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.End then d=false end end)
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(i)
        if d and not settings.uiLocked and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local dd=i.Position-si
            win.Position=UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale,sp.X.Offset+dd.X,sp.Y.Scale,sp.Y.Offset+dd.Y)
        end
    end)
end


do
    local dragging, dStart, wStart = false, nil, nil
    local function inCaption(pos)
        local wp, ws = win.AbsolutePosition, win.AbsoluteSize
        return pos.X >= wp.X and pos.X <= wp.X + ws.X - px(46)
           and pos.Y >= wp.Y and pos.Y <= wp.Y + px(30)
    end
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(i)
        if settings.uiLocked then return end
        if (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
           and win.Visible and inCaption(i.Position) then
            dragging=true; dStart=i.Position; wStart=win.Position
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if dragging then dragging=false; if _G.pvSaveWinGeom then _G.pvSaveWinGeom() end end
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(i)
        if dragging and not settings.uiLocked
           and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local dd=i.Position-dStart
            win.Position=UDim2.new(wStart.X.Scale, wStart.X.Offset+dd.X, wStart.Y.Scale, wStart.Y.Offset+dd.Y)
        end
    end)
end
local hidden=false
function setHidden(s)


    _G.pvUiAnimToken = (_G.pvUiAnimToken or 0) + 1
    local token = _G.pvUiAnimToken
    hidden=s

    pcall(function() if _G.pvUiTweenWin then _G.pvUiTweenWin:Cancel() end end)
    pcall(function() if _G.pvUiTweenSettle then _G.pvUiTweenSettle:Cancel() end end)
    pcall(function() uiScale.Scale=1 end)

    if s then
        -- v66: close instantly. Open animation below is unchanged.
        pvSavedWinPos = pvSavedWinPos or win.Position
        if win.Visible then pvSavedWinPos=win.Position end

        pcall(function() if _G.pvUiTweenWin then _G.pvUiTweenWin:Cancel() end end)
        pcall(function() if _G.pvUiTweenSettle then _G.pvUiTweenSettle:Cancel() end end)

        win.Visible=false
        win.Position=pvSavedWinPos
        win.BackgroundTransparency=0
        uiScale.Scale=1

    else
        if pvSavedWinPos then win.Position=pvSavedWinPos end
        local base=win.Position

        local fromPos=UDim2.new(
            base.X.Scale,base.X.Offset,
            base.Y.Scale,base.Y.Offset+px(10)
        )
        local settlePos=UDim2.new(
            base.X.Scale,base.X.Offset,
            base.Y.Scale,base.Y.Offset-px(1)
        )

        uiScale.Scale=1
        win.Position=fromPos
        win.BackgroundTransparency=0.18
        win.Visible=true

        _G.pvUiTweenWin=Tween:Create(
            win,
            TweenInfo.new(0.23,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Position=settlePos,BackgroundTransparency=0}
        )
        _G.pvUiTweenWin:Play()

        task.delay(0.23,function()
            if _G.pvUiAnimToken~=token or hidden then return end
            _G.pvUiTweenSettle=Tween:Create(
                win,
                TweenInfo.new(0.08,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Position=base}
            )
            _G.pvUiTweenSettle:Play()
        end)

        task.delay(0.32,function()
            if _G.pvUiAnimToken~=token or hidden then return end
            win.Position=base
            win.BackgroundTransparency=0
            uiScale.Scale=1
        end)
    end
end
local keyActions={}
local keyCapture=nil

keyActions.toggleUI = function() setHidden(not hidden, false) end
keyActions.streamerMode = function()
    local enabled=not pvSession.streamerHidden
    pvSession.setStreamerHidden(enabled)
    if not enabled then notify("Streamer Mode OFF — PorkVisuals UI restored") end
end
keyActions.panic    = function() setHidden(true, false) end
pvSession.connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(i,g)
    if not isCurrent() then return end
    if i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    local kn=i.KeyCode.Name
    if keyCapture then local f=keyCapture;keyCapture=nil;f(kn);return end
    -- FPS toggle remains available when another game action consumes the key,
    -- but never while typing into chat or any other text box.
    if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
    if settings.keys.restoreFPS==kn and keyActions.restoreFPS then
        task.spawn(keyActions.restoreFPS)
        return
    end
    if g then return end
    for act,key in pairs(settings.keys) do
        if key~="" and key==kn then
            local fn=keyActions[act]
            if fn then task.spawn(fn) end
        end
    end
end)

do


    local moved,lastTap=false,0
    local startX,startY=0,0
    local function tap()
        if moved then return end
        local now=os.clock()
        if now-lastTap < 0.30 then return end
        lastTap=now
        setHidden(not hidden,false)
    end
    pvSession.connect(tog.MouseButton1Click,tap)
    pvSession.connect(tog.Activated,tap)
    pvSession.connect(tog.TouchTap,tap)
    pvSession.connect(tog.InputBegan,function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            moved=false; startX,startY=i.Position.X,i.Position.Y
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(tog.InputChanged,function(i)


        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local dx,dy=i.Position.X-startX, i.Position.Y-startY
            if (dx*dx+dy*dy) > 100 then moved=true end
        end
    end)


    pvSession.connect(tog.InputEnded,function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not moved then tap() end
    end)
    _G.pvToggleUI = tap
end
