        if tog.Parent==nil then pcall(function() tog.Parent=togGui end) end
    end
end)
do
    local d,sp,si
    pvSession.connect(tog.InputBegan,function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            d=true;sp=tog.Position;si=i.Position
            pvSession.connect(i.Changed,function() if i.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.End then d=false end end)
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(i)
        if d and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local dd=i.Position-si
            tog.Position=UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale,sp.X.Offset+dd.X,sp.Y.Scale,sp.Y.Offset+dd.Y)
        end
    end)
end
function pvControlDepth(button)
    if button:FindFirstChild("HalloweenControlDepth") then return end
    local depth=Instance.new("UIGradient")
    depth.Name="HalloweenControlDepth";depth.Rotation=90
    depth.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(213,207,222))
    if settings.uiTheme=="Christmas" then depth.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(204,215,219)) end
    depth.Enabled=settings.uiTheme=="Halloween" or settings.uiTheme=="Christmas";depth.Parent=button
end
function pvConfigColor(button)
    local role=button:GetAttribute("pvConfigRole")
    if settings.uiTheme=="Christmas" then
        if role=="SAVE CONFIG" then return Color3.fromRGB(34,103,70) end
        if role=="LOAD CONFIG" then return Color3.fromRGB(121,94,44) end
        return Color3.fromRGB(145,37,54)
    end
    if settings.uiTheme~="Halloween" then return button:GetAttribute("pvConfigOriginal") end
    if role=="SAVE CONFIG" then return Color3.fromRGB(163,77,22) end
    if role=="LOAD CONFIG" then return Color3.fromRGB(86,56,125) end
    return Color3.fromRGB(104,39,51)
end
local pages,navBtns={},{}
_G.pvTabDrag=nil
_G.pvTabMoved=false
local function showPage(n)
    for k,p in pairs(pages) do p.Visible=(k==n) end
    for k,b in pairs(navBtns) do
        local on=(k==n)
        Tween:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(0.16),{
            BackgroundColor3=on and (settings.uiTheme=="Christmas" and Color3.fromRGB(113,35,49) or T.pink) or T.black,
            BackgroundTransparency=on and 0 or 0.28,
        }):Play()
        b.TextColor3=on and Color3.fromRGB(255,244,230) or T.sub
        b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    end
    -- Restore the heading of the active subview when returning to a tab.
    pcall(function()
        local trade=pages.Trade
        local blockPanel=trade and trade:FindFirstChild("TradeBlockPanel")
        if n=="Settings" and pvSession.activeSettingsPanel then
            pageTitle.Text=pvSession.activeSettingsPanel:GetAttribute("Heading")
        elseif n=="Trade" and blockPanel and blockPanel.Visible then
            pageTitle.Text="PLAYER PANEL"
        else
            pageTitle.Text=string.upper(n)
        end
        -- The picker uses the heading space for its weapon list. Switching
        -- to another tab restores that tab's normal centered heading.
        local picker=blockPanel and blockPanel:FindFirstChild("InventoryWeaponPicker")
        pageTitle.Visible=not (n=="Trade" and blockPanel and blockPanel.Visible
            and picker and picker.Visible)
    end)
end
local function relayoutTabs()
    local vis={}
    for _,b in pairs(navBtns) do if b.Parent==nav then vis[#vis+1]=b end end
    local n=math.max(#vis,1)
    for _,b in ipairs(vis) do b.Size=UDim2.new(1/n,-px(3),1,0) end
end


function pvTabDragMove(mx)
    local d=_G.pvTabDrag; if not d or not d.Parent then return end
    local vis={}
    for _,b in pairs(navBtns) do if b.Parent==nav then vis[#vis+1]=b end end
    table.sort(vis,function(a,c) return a.LayoutOrder<c.LayoutOrder end)
    local idx=0
    for _,b in ipairs(vis) do
        if b~=d then
            local cx=b.AbsolutePosition.X + b.AbsoluteSize.X/2
            if mx>cx then idx=idx+1 end
        end
    end
    local others={}
    for _,b in ipairs(vis) do if b~=d then others[#others+1]=b end end
    table.insert(others, math.clamp(idx+1,1,#others+1), d)
    for i,b in ipairs(others) do b.LayoutOrder=i end
end
function pvSaveTabOrder()
    -- Export the intended tab order even if an old config contained a swap.
    settings.tabOrder={"Items","Trade","Settings"}
    pcall(saveCfg)
end
function pvApplyTabOrder()
    -- Fixed top-level order. Older configurations may contain an accidental
    -- drag-swapped order; never restore it over the intended tabs.
    local order={Items=1,Trade=2,Settings=3}
    settings.tabOrder={"Items","Trade","Settings"}
    for name,b in pairs(navBtns) do
        if order[name] then b.LayoutOrder=order[name] end
    end
end
pvSession.connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(i)
    if not _G.pvTabDrag then return end
    if i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and i.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    if math.abs(i.Position.X-(_G.pvTabStartX or i.Position.X)) > px(6) then _G.pvTabMoved=true end
    if _G.pvTabMoved then pcall(pvTabDragMove, i.Position.X) end
end)

local function makePage(name,hidden)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1/3,-px(3),1,0)
    b.Text=string.upper(name);b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.TextSize=px(9)
    b.TextColor3=T.sub;b.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    b.BackgroundColor3=T.black;b.BackgroundTransparency=0.28

    b.AutoButtonColor=false
    if not hidden then b.Parent=nav end
    corner(b,px(7))
    pvControlDepth(b)
    pcall(pvSmoothButton,b)
    pvSession.connect(b.MouseEnter,function()
        local cur; for k,p in pairs(pages) do if p.Visible then cur=k end end
        if cur~=name then Tween:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(0.12),{BackgroundColor3=T.pinkDim,BackgroundTransparency=0.12}):Play() end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(b.MouseLeave,function()
        local cur; for k,p in pairs(pages) do if p.Visible then cur=k end end
        if cur~=name then Tween:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(0.12),{BackgroundColor3=T.black,BackgroundTransparency=0.28}):Play() end
    end)
    local p=Instance.new("Frame");p.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0);p.BackgroundTransparency=1;p.Visible=false;p.Parent=pageHost
    pages[name]=p;navBtns[name]=b
    b.LayoutOrder = _G.pvNavN or 0; _G.pvNavN = b.LayoutOrder + 1

    -- Use normal button activation instead of dragging to reorder tabs.
    -- This prevents accidental Trade/Items swaps on touch and mouse.
    pvSession.connect(b.Activated,function()
        -- The Player Panel is a remembered Trade subview. Only clicking Trade
        -- WHILE already on Trade returns to normal Trade controls. A click
        -- from Settings/Items simply reveals whichever Trade subview was open.
        if name=="Trade" and p.Visible and type(pvSession.playerPanelReturn)=="function" then
            pvSession.playerPanelReturn()
        elseif name=="Settings" and p.Visible and pvSession.settingsPanelReturn then
            pvSession.settingsPanelReturn()
        end
        showPage(name)
    end)
    relayoutTabs()
    return p
end
local function scroll(parent)
    local s=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    s.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0);s.BackgroundTransparency=1;s.BorderSizePixel=0
    s.ScrollBarThickness=2;s.ScrollBarImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);s.ScrollBarImageTransparency=0.65
    s.CanvasSize=UDim2.new();s.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;s.Parent=parent

    s.ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    s.VerticalScrollBarInset=Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always
    s.Active=true
    pad(s,px(3),px(3),px(6),px(5))


    local l=Instance.new("UIListLayout");l.Padding=UDim.new(0,px(7))
    l.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;l.Parent=s
    return s
end

PINK_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(41,35,48)
PINK_ON  = Color3.fromRGB(157,61,17)
local BTN_BG, BTN_TR = PINK_OFF, 0

-- Weapon rows follow the selected UI theme without altering weapon data or clicks.
-- Custom gets its own softly tinted, rounded glass cards so the user's wallpaper
-- remains visible and the list matches the Custom theme's panel/border styling.
-- Pork and Halloween deliberately retain their original appearance.
function pvStyleWeaponSurface(inst)
    local role=inst:GetAttribute("pvWeaponSurface")
    if not role then return end
    local halloween=settings.uiTheme=="Halloween"
    local custom=settings.uiTheme=="Custom"
    local christmas=settings.uiTheme=="Christmas"
    local color,transparency
    if role=="List" then
        -- Don't put a second opaque rectangular tray on top of the custom photo.
        color=Color3.fromRGB(14,14,16)
        transparency=(halloween or custom or christmas) and 1 or 0.15
    elseif role=="Row" then
        local selected=inst:GetAttribute("pvWeaponSelected")==true
        if christmas then
            color=selected and PINK_ON or Color3.fromRGB(26,38,44)
            transparency=selected and 0.04 or 0.24
        elseif custom then
            -- A slightly transparent plum glass surface lets the custom image
            -- show through; a fine pink outline echoes the window's edge.
            color=selected and PINK_ON or Color3.fromRGB(31,24,38)
            transparency=selected and 0.16 or 0.43
        else
            color=selected and PINK_ON or (halloween and Color3.fromRGB(38,32,45) or BTN_BG)
            transparency=selected and 0 or (halloween and 0.03 or 0.25)
        end

        -- Maintain the old row radius when changing back to either other theme.
        local rounding=inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if rounding then rounding.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,px(custom and 8 or 5)) end

        local depth=inst:FindFirstChild("pvHalloweenCardDepth")
        if halloween and not depth then
            depth=Instance.new("UIGradient")
            depth.Name="pvHalloweenCardDepth";depth.Rotation=90
            depth.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220))
            depth.Parent=inst
        end
        if depth then depth.Enabled=halloween end
        local outline=inst:FindFirstChild("pvHalloweenWeaponOutline")
        if halloween and not outline then
            outline=Instance.new("UIStroke")
            outline.Name="pvHalloweenWeaponOutline"
            outline.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            outline.LineJoinMode=Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
            outline.Parent=inst
        end
        if outline then
            outline.Enabled=halloween
            if halloween then
                outline.Color=selected and Color3.fromRGB(255,164,64) or Color3.fromRGB(117,83,128)
                outline.Thickness=1
                outline.Transparency=selected and 0.12 or 0.54
            end
        end

        local customOutline=inst:FindFirstChild("pvCustomWeaponOutline")
        if (custom or christmas) and not customOutline then
            customOutline=Instance.new("UIStroke")
            customOutline.Name="pvCustomWeaponOutline"
            customOutline.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            customOutline.LineJoinMode=Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
            customOutline.Parent=inst
        end
        if customOutline then
            customOutline.Enabled=custom or christmas
            if christmas then
                customOutline.Color=selected and Color3.fromRGB(246,208,130) or Color3.fromRGB(112,156,120)
                customOutline.Thickness=selected and 1.2 or 0.8
                customOutline.Transparency=selected and 0.16 or 0.55
            elseif custom then
                customOutline.Color=selected and Color3.fromRGB(255,115,192) or Color3.fromRGB(235,113,190)
                customOutline.Thickness=0.8
                customOutline.Transparency=selected and 0.22 or 0.68
            end
        end
    end
    if color and inst.BackgroundColor3~=color then inst.BackgroundColor3=color end
    if transparency~=nil and inst.BackgroundTransparency~=transparency then inst.BackgroundTransparency=transparency end
end

-- Selected player targets use a distinct, theme-aware highlight.
function pvStylePlayerTarget(button)
    if not button:GetAttribute("pvPlayerTargetSelected") then return end
    local halloween=settings.uiTheme=="Halloween"
    button.BackgroundColor3=halloween and Color3.fromRGB(112,55,20) or Color3.fromRGB(30,78,47)
    button.BackgroundTransparency=0
    button.TextColor3=halloween and Color3.fromRGB(255,191,106) or Color3.fromRGB(140,240,170)
    local outline=button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if outline then outline.Color=button.TextColor3;outline.Transparency=0.1 end
end

-- CHRISTMAS UI: floating snowflake field, winter chrome, no top snow.
do
    pvSession.attachChristmas=(function()
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local Theme = {}
        local rgb = Color3.fromRGB
        local C = {
            night=rgb(5,19,22), pine=rgb(12,43,35), forest=rgb(17,65,47),
            panel=rgb(13,40,34), gold=rgb(234,195,122), goldDark=rgb(128,91,46),
            red=rgb(140,39,57), redDark=rgb(84,23,36), cream=rgb(255,244,221),
            muted=rgb(168,205,190), ice=rgb(216,244,255), ice2=rgb(232,247,255), green=rgb(93,218,157),
        }
        Theme.Colors = C
        local function corner(obj, radius)
            local u=obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
            u.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,radius); u.Parent=obj; return u
        end
        local function round(obj)
            local u=Instance.new("UICorner"); u.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0.5,0); u.Parent=obj
        end
        local function block(parent, name, pos, size, color, z, alpha, radius)
            local f=Instance.new("Frame")
            f.Name=name; f.BackgroundColor3=color; f.BorderSizePixel=0; f.BackgroundTransparency=alpha or 0
            f.Position=pos; f.Size=size; f.ZIndex=z; f.Active=false; f.Selectable=false
            if radius then corner(f,radius) end
            f.Parent=parent; return f
        end
        local function gradient(parent, name, stops, angle)
            local g=Instance.new("UIGradient"); g.Name=name; g.Rotation=angle or 90
            local keys={}; for i,v in ipairs(stops) do keys[i]=ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(v[1],v[2]) end
            g.Color=ColorSequence.new(keys); g.Parent=parent; return g
        end
        local function edge(parent, name, color, thickness, alpha)
            local s=Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Name=name; s.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            s.Color=color; s.Thickness=thickness; s.Transparency=alpha or 0; s.Parent=parent; return s
        end
        local function layer(parent,name,z)
            local f=block(parent,name,UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),C.night,z,1)
            f.ClipsDescendants=true; f.Interactable=false; return f
        end
        local function line(parent,name,x1,y1,x2,y2,thickness,color,z,alpha)
            local dx,dy=x2-x1,y2-y1
            local f=block(parent,name,UDim2.fromOffset((x1+x2)/2,(y1+y2)/2),UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy),thickness),color,z,alpha,1)
            f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); f.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(dy,dx)); return f
        end
        local function disk(parent,name,x,y,w,h,color,z,alpha)
            local f=block(parent,name,UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),color,z,alpha)
            f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); round(f); return f
        end
        local function colorGradient(parent,name,a,b)
            return gradient(parent,name,{{0,a},{1,b}},90)
        end
        function Theme.Attach(window, options)
            assert(window:IsA("Frame"),"Attach expects a Frame")
            options=options or {}
            local old=window:FindFirstChild("ChristmasBackdrop")
            assert(not old,"Destroy the previous theme handle before attaching again")
            local bz=options.BackgroundZ or 0; local oz=options.OrnamentZ or 20
            local hasBundled=type(pvHasBundledChristmasBackground)=="function" and pvHasBundledChristmasBackground() or false
            local back=layer(window,"ChristmasBackdrop",bz)
            back:SetAttribute("pvChristmasArt",true)
            local front=layer(window,"ChristmasTrim",oz)
            front:SetAttribute("pvChristmasArt",true)
            local wallpaper=block(back,"ForestNight",UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),rgb(12,31,34),bz,hasBundled and 0.80 or 0.10,15)
            local wallGrad=gradient(wallpaper,"EvergreenSky",{{0,rgb(24,50,48)},{.42,rgb(14,24,30)},{.77,rgb(10,17,24)},{1,rgb(18,30,35)}},90)
            if hasBundled then wallGrad.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.15),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.42)}) end
            -- Use a two-layer outer stroke so the rounded corners keep the same visual weight
            -- as Halloween, without bringing back any extra inner outline.
            local rimBase=edge(window,"ChristmasGoldRimBase",rgb(154,108,56),2.3,.42)
            rimBase:SetAttribute("pvChristmasArt",true)
            local rim=edge(window,"ChristmasGoldRim",Color3.new(1,1,1),1.45,.04)
            rim:SetAttribute("pvChristmasArt",true)
            gradient(rim,"ChampagneMetal",{{0,rgb(143,97,45)},{.2,rgb(255,226,161)},{.45,rgb(193,145,75)},{.72,rgb(255,241,177)},{1,rgb(132,87,44)}},45)
            local glow=block(back,"WinterLight",UDim2.fromScale(0,0),UDim2.fromScale(1,1),Color3.new(1,1,1),bz+1,0,15)
            local gg=gradient(glow,"WinterLightFade",{{0,rgb(64,96,90)},{.38,rgb(21,40,40)},{1,rgb(8,13,20)}},112)
            gg.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(hasBundled and {
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.78),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.45,.95),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.98)
            } or {
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.62),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.48,.90),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.98)
            })
            local divider=window:FindFirstChild("RefinedAccent")
            local dividerWasVisible=divider and divider.Visible
            if divider then divider.Visible=false end

            -- Top lights removed by request.
            local lights=nil
            local bulbs={}
            -- Floating crystal field: high-resolution, antialiased snowflake art.
            -- Background flakes stay behind controls; a few soft edge flakes
            -- remain visible even on opaque pages. No layout offsets or top snow.
            local atlas=pvSession.getChristmasSnowAtlas()
            local random=Random.new(231225); local flakes={}
            local function snowflake(parent,size,z,alpha,variant)
                if atlas then
                    local f=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                    f.Name="ChristmasSnowflake"; f.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    f.BorderSizePixel=0; f.Active=false; f.Selectable=false
                    f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)
                    f.ZIndex=z; f.Image=atlas; f.ImageTransparency=alpha
                    f.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(128*variant,0); f.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(128,128)
                    f.Parent=parent
                    return f
                end
                -- Native six-arm backup for clients without local image support.
                local f=block(parent,"ChristmasSnowflake",UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),UDim2.fromOffset(size,size),C.night,z,1)
                f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
                local c=size/2; local r=size*.33
                for k=0,5 do
                    local a=k*math.pi/3; local dx,dy=math.cos(a),math.sin(a)
                    line(f,"CrystalArm",c,c,c+dx*r,c+dy*r,1,C.ice,z+1,alpha)
                    for _,sign in ipairs({-1,1}) do
                        local u=a+sign*math.pi/3
                        local bx,by=c+dx*r*.56,c+dy*r*.56
                        line(f,"CrystalBranch",bx,by,bx+math.cos(u)*r*.35,by+math.sin(u)*r*.35,.8,C.ice,z+1,alpha)
                    end
                end
                return f
            end
            -- Stratified positions: one background crystal per cell, and
            -- equal foreground coverage along each edge, including the top.
            -- Small jitter keeps the field organic without creating clusters.
            for i=1,42 do
                local near=i>28
                local size=px(near and random:NextNumber(11,19) or random:NextNumber(15,27))
                local alpha=near and random:NextNumber(.48,.64) or random:NextNumber(.22,.46)
                local x,y
                if near then
                    local j=i-29
                    local row=math.floor(j/2)
                    x=(j%2==0 and .065 or .935)+random:NextNumber(-.008,.008)
                    y=.085+row*.146+random:NextNumber(-.012,.012)
                else
                    local j=i-1
                    local col,row=j%4,math.floor(j/4)
                    x=.15+col*(.70/3)+random:NextNumber(-.035,.035)
                    y=.092+row*.144+random:NextNumber(-.020,.020)
                end
                local f=snowflake(near and front or back,size,near and oz+1 or bz+2,alpha,(i-1)%4)
                f.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x,y)
                local rotation=random:NextNumber(0,360);f.Rotation=rotation
                flakes[i]={f=f,x=x,y=y,size=size,alpha=alpha,phase=random:NextNumber(0,math.pi*2),
                    speed=random:NextNumber(.22,.52),rotation=rotation,spin=random:NextNumber(4,13)*(i%2==0 and 1 or -1),near=near}
            end
            local handle={Snow=options.Snow~=false,Lights=options.Lights~=false,ReducedMotion=options.ReducedMotion==true}
            local stopped=false; local elapsed=0; local acc=0
            local visible=window.Visible; local conn; local visConn; local destroyConn
            local function updateVisibility()
                visible=window.Visible
                for _,p in ipairs(flakes) do p.f.Visible=handle.Snow end
                if lights then lights.Visible=handle.Lights end
            end
            function handle:SetSnow(on) self.Snow=on==true; updateVisibility() end
            function handle:SetLights(on) self.Lights=on==true; updateVisibility() end
            function handle:SetReducedMotion(on)
                self.ReducedMotion=on==true
                if self.ReducedMotion then for _,b in ipairs(bulbs) do b.glow.BackgroundTransparency=.95; b.inner.BackgroundTransparency=.84; b.bulb.BackgroundTransparency=0 end end
            end
            function handle:Destroy()
                if stopped then return end; stopped=true
                if conn then conn:Disconnect() end; if visConn then visConn:Disconnect() end; if destroyConn then destroyConn:Disconnect() end
                if divider and divider.Parent then divider.Visible=dividerWasVisible end
                back:Destroy();front:Destroy();rim:Destroy();rimBase:Destroy()
            end
            updateVisibility()
            visConn=window:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(updateVisibility)
            destroyConn=window.Destroying:Connect(function() handle:Destroy() end)
            conn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                if stopped or not visible or handle.ReducedMotion or not window.Parent then acc=0; return end
                local ancestor=window.Parent
                while ancestor do
                    if (ancestor:IsA("GuiObject") and not ancestor.Visible) or (ancestor:IsA("ScreenGui") and not ancestor.Enabled) then acc=0; return end
                    ancestor=ancestor.Parent
                end
                acc=acc+math.min(dt,.1); if acc<1/30 then return end
                local step=acc; acc=0; elapsed=elapsed+step
                if handle.Snow then
                    for _,p in ipairs(flakes) do
                        local phase=elapsed*p.speed+p.phase
                        local x=p.x+(p.near and .009 or .025)*math.sin(phase)
                        local y=p.y+(p.near and .015 or .029)*math.sin(phase*.71+p.phase)
                        -- Bound rotated sprites inside the panel, including when resized.
                        local dim=window.AbsoluteSize
                        local mx=math.min(.49,(p.size*.72+3)/math.max(1,dim.X))
                        local my=math.min(.49,(p.size*.72+3)/math.max(1,dim.Y))
                        p.f.Position=UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(x,mx,1-mx),math.clamp(y,my,1-my))
                        p.f.Rotation=(p.rotation+elapsed*p.spin)%360
                        if p.f:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                            p.f.ImageTransparency=math.clamp(p.alpha+.14*math.sin(phase*1.5),0,1)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if handle.Lights and lights then
                    for i,b in ipairs(bulbs) do
                        local v=.5+.5*math.sin(elapsed*1.85+i*.74)
                        b.glow.BackgroundTransparency=.97-.06*v
                        b.inner.BackgroundTransparency=.88-.16*v
                        b.bulb.BackgroundTransparency=.05*(1-v)
                    end
                end
            end)
            return handle
        end
        return Theme.Attach
    end)()
    pvSession.addCleanup(function()
        if pvSession.christmasArt then pvSession.christmasArt:Destroy();pvSession.christmasArt=nil end
    end)
end

-- Appearance only: apply to this panel and its own FPS widget, never game UI.
do
    local pairsOfColors={
        {Color3.fromRGB(140,240,170),Color3.fromRGB(255,191,106),Color3.fromRGB(140,240,170)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),Color3.fromRGB(255,244,230),Color3.fromRGB(255,248,235)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(206,206,212),Color3.fromRGB(200,187,181),Color3.fromRGB(195,207,211)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(18,18,20),Color3.fromRGB(18,16,20),Color3.fromRGB(17,27,32)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(30,30,34),Color3.fromRGB(34,29,34),Color3.fromRGB(28,39,44)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(120,120,130),Color3.fromRGB(112,85,122),Color3.fromRGB(104,127,132)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,96,182),Color3.fromRGB(255,151,51),Color3.fromRGB(232,198,143)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(150,46,104),Color3.fromRGB(137,64,26),Color3.fromRGB(86,53,59)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(34,34,38),Color3.fromRGB(24,21,25),Color3.fromRGB(22,34,40)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(85,85,85),Color3.fromRGB(56,43,39),Color3.fromRGB(56,76,81)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20),Color3.fromRGB(12,13,20),Color3.fromRGB(10,16,23)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,110,190),Color3.fromRGB(255,173,80),Color3.fromRGB(246,218,172)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,140,205),Color3.fromRGB(255,206,128),Color3.fromRGB(230,208,174)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(226,60,150),Color3.fromRGB(255,145,52),Color3.fromRGB(211,180,143)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,120,200),Color3.fromRGB(255,151,51),Color3.fromRGB(240,211,162)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,190,230),Color3.fromRGB(247,225,176),Color3.fromRGB(226,216,198)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,225,245),Color3.fromRGB(255,242,224),Color3.fromRGB(248,244,235)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(30,28,34),Color3.fromRGB(41,35,48),Color3.fromRGB(31,44,49)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(236,64,160),Color3.fromRGB(157,61,17),Color3.fromRGB(113,35,49)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(150,150,158),Color3.fromRGB(255,165,68),Color3.fromRGB(206,179,137)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(20,20,22),Color3.fromRGB(25,21,26),Color3.fromRGB(21,32,38)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,100,188),Color3.fromRGB(255,165,68),Color3.fromRGB(232,197,147)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(194,181,175),Color3.fromRGB(194,181,175),Color3.fromRGB(166,187,193)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(34,29,34),Color3.fromRGB(34,29,34),Color3.fromRGB(29,41,46)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(12,13,20),Color3.fromRGB(12,13,20),Color3.fromRGB(11,19,25)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(14,14,16),Color3.fromRGB(14,14,16),Color3.fromRGB(14,23,30)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(38,32,45),Color3.fromRGB(38,32,45),Color3.fromRGB(26,38,44)},
        {Color3.fromRGB(255,166,64),Color3.fromRGB(255,166,64),Color3.fromRGB(243,215,169)},
    }
    -- Cache only theme-relevant properties; never scan the UI tree on a switch.
    local originalT={}
    local colorMap={}
    local function colorKey(c)
        return math.floor(c.R*255+0.5)*65536+math.floor(c.G*255+0.5)*256+math.floor(c.B*255+0.5)
    end
    for _,pair in ipairs(pairsOfColors) do
        -- First match wins, preserving the original palette's shared accents.
        for _,c in ipairs(pair) do
            local key=colorKey(c)
            if not colorMap[key] then colorMap[key]=pair end
        end
    end
    local function convert(color,halloween,christmas)
        local pair=colorMap[colorKey(color)]
        if pair and (color==pair[1] or color==pair[2] or color==pair[3]) then return pair[christmas and 3 or (halloween and 2 or 1)] end
        return color
    end
    for key,color in pairs(T) do originalT[key]=convert(color,false) end
    local entries={}
    local chrome={}
    local pageBuckets={}
    local registeredRoots={}
    local epoch=0
    local function bucketFor(inst)
        local parent=inst.Parent
        while parent and parent~=gui do
            if parent.Parent==pageHost then
                if not pageBuckets[parent] then pageBuckets[parent]={} end
                return pageBuckets[parent]
            end
            parent=parent.Parent
        end
        return chrome
    end
    local function write(inst,prop,value)
        if inst[prop]~=value then inst[prop]=value end
    end
    local function style(entry)
        local inst=entry.inst
        if not inst.Parent then return end
        local h=settings.uiTheme=="Halloween"
        local x=settings.uiTheme=="Christmas"
        for _,prop in ipairs(entry.props) do
            local value=inst[prop]
            local target=convert(value,h,x)
            if target~=value then inst[prop]=target end
        end
        if entry.decoration then write(inst,"Visible",h) end
        if entry.rim then
            local control=inst.Name=="HalloweenControlDepth"
            if control then inst.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1),x and Color3.fromRGB(204,215,219) or Color3.fromRGB(213,207,222)) end
            write(inst,"Enabled",h or (x and control))
        end
        if entry.header then
            write(inst,"Enabled",not h)
            local version=inst.Parent==verLbl
            write(inst,"Thickness",x and 0.75 or 1)
            write(inst,"Transparency",x and 0.65 or (version and 0.55 or 0.52))
        end
        if entry.surface then pvStyleWeaponSurface(inst) end
        if inst:GetAttribute("pvConfigRole") then inst.BackgroundColor3=pvConfigColor(inst) end
        if inst:GetAttribute("pvPlayerTargetSelected") then pvStylePlayerTarget(inst) end
    end
    local function unregister(inst)
        local entry=entries[inst]
        if not entry then return end
        local bucket,index=entry.bucket,entry.index
        local last=bucket[#bucket]
        bucket[index]=last;bucket[#bucket]=nil
        if last and last~=entry then last.index=index end
        entries[inst]=nil
    end
    local function register(inst)
        if entries[inst] or not inst.Parent then return end
        local art=inst
        while art and art~=gui do
            if art:GetAttribute("pvChristmasArt") then return end
            art=art.Parent
        end
        local props={}
        local function capture(prop)
            if colorMap[colorKey(inst[prop])] then props[#props+1]=prop end
        end
        if inst:IsA("GuiObject") then capture("BackgroundColor3") end
        if inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextBox") then capture("TextColor3") end
        if inst:IsA("TextBox") then capture("PlaceholderColor3") end
        if inst:IsA("UIStroke") then capture("Color") end
        if inst:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then capture("ScrollBarImageColor3") end
        local decoration=inst.Name=="HalloweenWeb" or inst.Name=="HalloweenMoon" or inst.Name=="HalloweenSpider"
        local rim=inst.Name=="HalloweenInnerRim" or inst.Name=="HalloweenBorderDepth" or inst.Name=="HalloweenControlDepth"
        local header=inst.Name=="pvHeaderTextOutline"
        local surface=inst:GetAttribute("pvWeaponSurface")~=nil
        if #props==0 and not decoration and not rim and not header and not surface then return end
        local bucket=bucketFor(inst)
        local entry={inst=inst,props=props,decoration=decoration,rim=rim,header=header,surface=surface,bucket=bucket,index=#bucket+1}
        entries[inst]=entry;bucket[#bucket+1]=entry
        style(entry)
    end
    function pvRegisterThemeRoot(root)
        if registeredRoots[root] then return end
        registeredRoots[root]=true
        local pending={}
        local queued=false
        local function queue(inst)
            pending[#pending+1]=inst
            if queued then return end
            queued=true
            task.defer(function()
                local index,count,started=1,0,os.clock()
                while index<=#pending and root.Parent and isCurrent() do
                    local item=pending[index];index=index+1
                    if item.Parent and item:IsDescendantOf(root) then register(item) end
                    count=count+1
                    if count>=64 or os.clock()-started>=0.001 then
                        task.wait();count=0;started=os.clock()
                    end
                end
                pending={};queued=false
            end)
        end
        local added=pvSession.connect(root.DescendantAdded,queue)
        local removed=pvSession.connect(root.DescendantRemoving,unregister)
        pvSession.connect(root.Destroying,function()
            added:Disconnect();removed:Disconnect();registeredRoots[root]=nil
            -- Drop references even if destruction suppresses descendant callbacks.
            for inst,entry in pairs(entries) do
                if inst:IsDescendantOf(root) then unregister(inst) end
            end
        end)
        -- Enumeration happens once when a root is registered, never per switch.
        for _,inst in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do queue(inst) end
    end
    function pvSetUITheme(name,persist)
        local requested=(name=="Pork UI" or name=="Halloween" or name=="Christmas" or name=="Custom") and name or "Pork UI"
        if epoch>0 and settings.uiTheme==requested then
            if pvRefreshCustomBackgroundVisibility then pvRefreshCustomBackgroundVisibility() end
            if pvRefreshChristmasBackgroundVisibility then pvRefreshChristmasBackgroundVisibility() end
            if type(pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme)=="function" then
                pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme()
            end
            if persist then saveCfg() end
            return
        end
        settings.uiTheme=requested
        if pvRefreshCustomBackgroundVisibility then pvRefreshCustomBackgroundVisibility() end
        if pvRefreshChristmasBackgroundVisibility then pvRefreshChristmasBackgroundVisibility() end
        epoch=epoch+1
        local token=epoch
        local h=requested=="Halloween"
        local x=requested=="Christmas"
        -- Match the version number and UI palette to the active theme.
        verLbl.TextColor3=convert(Color3.fromRGB(255,110,190),h,x)
        brandOutline.Enabled=true
        brandOutline.Thickness=x and 0.85 or 1
        brandOutline.Transparency=x and 0.60 or 0.5
        for key,color in pairs(originalT) do T[key]=convert(color,h,x) end
        PINK_OFF=convert(Color3.fromRGB(30,28,34),h,x)
        PINK_ON=convert(Color3.fromRGB(236,64,160),h,x)
        BTN_BG=PINK_OFF
        galaxy.Color=ColorSequence.new(x and Color3.fromRGB(27,48,47) or (h and Color3.fromRGB(39,25,43) or Color3.fromRGB(14,14,16)),x and Color3.fromRGB(11,17,24) or (h and Color3.fromRGB(12,13,20) or Color3.fromRGB(14,14,16)))
        winStroke.Enabled=not x
        if x and not pvSession.christmasArt then
            pvSession.christmasArt=pvSession.attachChristmas(win,{BackgroundZ=0,OrnamentZ=20})
        elseif not x and pvSession.christmasArt then
            pvSession.christmasArt:Destroy();pvSession.christmasArt=nil
        end
        if type(pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme)=="function" then
            pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme()
        end
        if persist then saveCfg() end
        task.spawn(function()
            local work={chrome}
            for page,bucket in pairs(pageBuckets) do if page.Parent and page.Visible then work[#work+1]=bucket end end
            for page,bucket in pairs(pageBuckets) do if page.Parent and not page.Visible then work[#work+1]=bucket end end
            local count,started=0,os.clock()
            for _,bucket in ipairs(work) do
                local index=1
                while index<=#bucket do
                    if token~=epoch or not gui.Parent or not isCurrent() then return end
                    style(bucket[index]);index=index+1;count=count+1
                    if count>=64 or os.clock()-started>=0.001 then
                        task.wait();count=0;started=os.clock()
                    end
                end
            end
            if token==epoch then
                for name,b in pairs(navBtns) do
                    local page=pages[name]
                    if page and b.Parent then
                        b.BackgroundColor3=page.Visible and (x and PINK_ON or T.pink) or T.black
                    end
                end
            end
            -- Player-card gradients are ColorSequences, not individual
            -- Color3 props registered by the main theme engine.
            -- Update existing cards directly without refreshing inventories.
            if token==epoch and type(pvSession.refreshPlayerPanelTheme)=="function" then
                pvSession.refreshPlayerPanelTheme()
            end
        end)
    end
    pvRegisterThemeRoot(gui)
    pvRegisterThemeRoot(togGui)
    pvSetUITheme(settings.uiTheme,false)
end

-- Smooth mouse-wheel scrolling for every Pork Hub ScrollingFrame, including
-- dropdowns and scroll panels created later. Native scrollbars, touch gestures,
-- layout spacing, and drag-to-scroll remain enabled and unchanged.
-- Kept in its own scope so it doesn't add long-lived Luau main-chunk locals.
do
    local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
    local tracked={}
    local lastWheel=-100

    local function track(sf)
        if not sf:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or tracked[sf]
            or sf:GetAttribute("pvNoSmoothScroll") == true then return end
        local state={shown=sf.CanvasPosition.Y,target=sf.CanvasPosition.Y,active=false,writing=false}
        tracked[sf]=state
        pvSession.connect(sf:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"),function()
            if state.writing or not isCurrent() then return end
            local raw=sf.CanvasPosition.Y
            -- Only ease wheel movement; normal scrollbar dragging, programmed
            -- scrolls, and touch scrolling keep their original behaviour.
            if os.clock()-lastWheel>0.28 or not sf.Visible then
                state.shown=raw
                state.target=raw
                state.active=false
                return
            end
            local limit=math.max(0,sf.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-sf.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
            if limit<=0 then
                state.shown=raw
                state.target=raw
                state.active=false
                return
            end
            local delta=raw-state.shown
            if math.abs(delta)<0.1 then return end
            state.target=math.clamp(state.target+delta,0,limit)
            state.writing=true
            sf.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(sf.CanvasPosition.X,state.shown)
            state.writing=false
            -- Discard leftover wheel momentum; the easing below replaces it.
            pcall(function() sf:ResetScrollVelocity() end)
            state.active=true
        end)
        pvSession.connect(sf.Destroying,function() tracked[sf]=nil end)
    end

    for _,desc in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if desc:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then track(desc) end
    end
    pvSession.connect(gui.DescendantAdded,function(desc)
        if desc:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then track(desc) end
    end)
    -- A scrollbar drag takes priority over a recent wheel gesture.
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
          or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            lastWheel=-100
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel or not win.Visible then return end
        local pos=UIS:GetMouseLocation()
        local at=win.AbsolutePosition
        local sz=win.AbsoluteSize
        if pos.X>=at.X and pos.X<=at.X+sz.X
          and pos.Y>=at.Y and pos.Y<=at.Y+sz.Y then
            lastWheel=os.clock()
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(RunService.RenderStepped,function(dt)
        if not isCurrent() then return end
        local blend=1-math.exp(-math.min(dt,0.1)*19)
        for sf,state in pairs(tracked) do
            if state.active then
                if not sf.Parent then
                    tracked[sf]=nil
                else
                    local limit=math.max(0,sf.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-sf.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
                    state.target=math.clamp(state.target,0,limit)
                    state.shown=state.shown+(state.target-state.shown)*blend
                    if math.abs(state.target-state.shown)<0.45 then
                        state.shown=state.target
                        state.active=false
                    end
                    state.writing=true
                    sf.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(sf.CanvasPosition.X,state.shown)
                    state.writing=false
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    pvSession.addCleanup(function() table.clear(tracked) end)
end

function pvSmoothButton(b)
    if not b or not b:IsA("GuiButton") or b:GetAttribute("pvSmoothButton") then return b end
    b:SetAttribute("pvSmoothButton",true)

    local sc=b:FindFirstChild("pvSmoothScale")
    if not sc then
        sc=Instance.new("UIScale")
        sc.Name="pvSmoothScale"
        sc.Scale=1
        sc.Parent=b
    end

    local glow=b:FindFirstChild("pvSmoothGlow")
    if not glow then
        glow=Instance.new("UIStroke")
        glow.Name="pvSmoothGlow"
        glow.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        glow.Color=T.pink
        glow.Thickness=1
        glow.Transparency=0.88
        glow.Parent=b
    end

    local hovered=false
    local pressed=false
    local scaleTween=nil
    local glowTween=nil
    local settleToken=0

    local function scaleTo(v,t,style,dir)
        if scaleTween then pcall(function() scaleTween:Cancel() end) end
        -- Keep native-size glyphs stable; glow still supplies hover/press feedback.
        sc.Scale=1
    end

    local function glowTo(tr,th,t)
        if glowTween then pcall(function() glowTween:Cancel() end) end
        glowTween=Tween:Create(
            glow,
            TweenInfo.new(t or 0.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Transparency=tr,Thickness=th}
        )
        glowTween:Play()
    end

    local function release()
        if not pressed then return end
        pressed=false
        settleToken=settleToken+1
        local my=settleToken


        local rest=hovered and 1.012 or 1
        scaleTo(1.022,0.075,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        glowTo(hovered and 0.42 or 0.80, hovered and 1.25 or 1, 0.11)

        task.delay(0.075,function()
            if my~=settleToken or pressed or not b.Parent then return end
            scaleTo(rest,0.115,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        end)
    end

    pvSession.connect(b.MouseEnter,function()
        hovered=true
        if not pressed then
            scaleTo(1.012,0.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            glowTo(0.42,1.25,0.14)
        end
    end)

    pvSession.connect(b.MouseLeave,function()
        hovered=false
        if not pressed then
            scaleTo(1,0.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            glowTo(0.88,1,0.16)
        end
    end)

    pvSession.connect(b.InputBegan,function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            pressed=true
            settleToken=settleToken+1
            scaleTo(0.958,0.055,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            glowTo(0.08,1.65,0.055)
        end
    end)

    pvSession.connect(b.InputEnded,function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            release()
        end
    end)


    pvSession.connect(b.MouseButton1Up,release)

    return b
end


function mcClick(b, fn)
    pcall(pvSmoothButton,b)
    local last=0
    local function go()
        local now=os.clock()
        if now-last < 0.25 then return end
        last=now
        fn(b)
    end
    pvSession.connect(b.MouseButton1Click,go)
    pvSession.connect(b.Activated,go)
    pcall(function() pvSession.connect(b.TouchTap,go) end)
    b.Active=true
    b.Selectable=true
    return b
end

local function btn(parent,text,cb)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
    b.BackgroundColor3=BTN_BG;b.BackgroundTransparency=BTN_TR
    b.Text=string.upper(text);b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.TextSize=px(9)+1
    b.TextColor3=T.txt;b.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    b.AutoButtonColor=false;b.Parent=parent
    corner(b,px(8))
    stroke(b,0.42,1,T.line)
    pvControlDepth(b)
    pvSession.connect(b.MouseEnter,function()
        if b:GetAttribute("pvPlayerTargetSelected") or b:GetAttribute("pvUpgradeTier") then return end

        Tween:Create(
            b,
            TweenInfo.new(0.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {BackgroundColor3=PINK_OFF:Lerp(PINK_ON,0.52),BackgroundTransparency=0}
        ):Play()
    end)
    pvSession.connect(b.MouseLeave,function()
        if b:GetAttribute("pvPlayerTargetSelected") or b:GetAttribute("pvUpgradeTier") then return end
        Tween:Create(
            b,
            TweenInfo.new(0.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {BackgroundColor3=PINK_OFF,BackgroundTransparency=BTN_TR}
        ):Play()
    end)

    mcClick(b, function() if cb then cb(b) end end)
    return b
end
local function lbl(parent,text,sz,col)
    local l=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    l.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(16));l.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    l.BackgroundTransparency=1;l.Text=text;l.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    l.TextSize=px(sz or 9);l.TextWrapped=true;l.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    l.TextColor3=col or T.sub;l.Parent=parent
    return l
end
local function box(parent,ph)
    local t=Instance.new("TextBox")
    t.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(28))
    t.BackgroundColor3=BTN_BG;t.BackgroundTransparency=BTN_TR
    t.PlaceholderText=ph;t.Text="";t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium;t.TextSize=px(10)
    t.TextColor3=T.txt;t.PlaceholderColor3=T.sub;t.ClearTextOnFocus=false
    t.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    t.Parent=parent
    corner(t,px(8));pad(t,px(8))
    local outline=stroke(t,0.82,1,T.line)
    pvSession.connect(t.Focused,function() Tween:Create(outline,TweenInfo.new(0.15),{Color=T.pink,Transparency=0.35}):Play() end)
    pvSession.connect(t.FocusLost,function() Tween:Create(outline,TweenInfo.new(0.15),{Color=T.line,Transparency=0.82}):Play() end)
    return t
end
pvSession.configRefresh={}
local function toggle(parent,label,init,cb)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
    b.BackgroundColor3=BTN_BG;b.BackgroundTransparency=BTN_TR
    b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.TextSize=px(8)+1;b.TextColor3=T.txt
    b.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    b.AutoButtonColor=false;b.Parent=parent
    corner(b,px(8))
    stroke(b,0.55,1,T.line)
    local st=init
    local function rf()
        b.Text=string.upper(label).."  "..(st and "ON" or "OFF")
        Tween:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(0.14),{
            BackgroundColor3=st and PINK_ON or BTN_BG,
            BackgroundTransparency=st and 0 or BTN_TR,
        }):Play()
        b.TextColor3=T.txt
    end
    mcClick(b, function() st=not st;rf();if cb then cb(st) end end)
    local settingKey=({["Auto Block After Trade"]="autoBlock",["ULTRA OPTIMIZER"]="ultraFpsBooster",
        ["Lock UI (freeze position)"]="uiLocked"})[label]
    if settingKey then
        pvSession.configRefresh[#pvSession.configRefresh+1]=function()
            st=settingKey=="autoBlock" and settings[settingKey]~=false or settings[settingKey]==true
            rf()
        end
    end
    rf();return b
end


function pvDropdown(parent,label,order,entries,onPick)
    local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30));holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
    holder.LayoutOrder=order or 0;holder.ClipsDescendants=false;holder.Parent=parent
    local bar=Instance.new("TextButton")
    bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(28))
    bar.BackgroundColor3=PINK_OFF;bar.BackgroundTransparency=0
    bar.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;bar.TextSize=px(9);bar.TextColor3=T.txt
    local curLabel=label
    local panel
    local function setBar() bar.Text=curLabel.."   "..(panel and panel.Visible and "\u{25B2}" or "\u{25BC}") end
    setBar()
    bar.AutoButtonColor=false;bar.Parent=holder
    corner(bar,px(8))
    local st=Instance.new("UIStroke");st.Color=T.pink;st.Thickness=px(1);st.Transparency=0.4;st.Parent=bar
    panel=Instance.new("Frame")
    panel.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(140));panel.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,px(30))
    panel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(16,14,20);panel.BackgroundTransparency=0
    panel.Visible=false;panel.Parent=holder
    corner(panel,px(8))
    local pst=Instance.new("UIStroke");pst.Color=T.pink;pst.Thickness=px(1);pst.Transparency=0.45;pst.Parent=panel
    local sb=Instance.new("TextBox")
    sb.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(8),0,px(22));sb.Position=UDim2.new(0,px(4),0,px(4))
    sb.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,28,34);sb.BackgroundTransparency=0
    sb.PlaceholderText="search...";sb.Text="";sb.ClearTextOnFocus=false
    sb.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;sb.TextSize=px(8);sb.TextColor3=T.txt
    sb.PlaceholderColor3=T.sub;sb.Parent=panel
    corner(sb,px(6))
    local sf=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    sf.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(8),1,-px(32));sf.Position=UDim2.new(0,px(4),0,px(29))
    sf.BackgroundTransparency=1;sf.BorderSizePixel=0
    sf.ScrollBarThickness=px(3);sf.ScrollBarImageColor3=PINK_ON
    sf.VerticalScrollBarInset=Enum.ScrollBarInset.Always
    sf.CanvasSize=UDim2.new();sf.Parent=panel
    local ll=Instance.new("UIListLayout");ll.Padding=UDim.new(0,px(2))
    ll.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;ll.Parent=sf
    local rows={}
    for i,e in ipairs(entries) do
        local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(4),0,px(22));b.LayoutOrder=i
        b.BackgroundColor3=PINK_OFF;b.BackgroundTransparency=0
        b.Text=e.label;b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;b.TextSize=px(8)
        b.TextColor3=T.txt;b.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        b.AutoButtonColor=false;b.Parent=sf
        corner(b,px(5))
        pvSession.connect(b.MouseEnter,function()
            Tween:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(0.14,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3=PINK_OFF:Lerp(PINK_ON,0.55)}):Play()
        end)
        pvSession.connect(b.MouseLeave,function()
            Tween:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(0.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {BackgroundColor3=PINK_OFF}):Play()
        end)
        mcClick(b,function()
            panel.Visible=false
            curLabel=label..":  "..e.label
            setBar()
            holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
            if onPick then onPick(e) end
        end)
        rows[#rows+1]={btn=b,nm=e.label:lower()}
    end
    sf.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,ll.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+px(4))
    sb:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        local q=sb.Text:lower()
        for _,r in ipairs(rows) do r.btn.Visible=(q=="" or r.nm:find(q,1,true)~=nil) end
        sf.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,ll.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+px(4))
    end)
    mcClick(bar,function()
        local open=not panel.Visible
        panel.Visible=open
        setBar()
        holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,open and px(172) or px(30))
    end)
    return holder
end
local function notify(msg)
    if not msg then return end
    local ok = pcall(function() return _pvNotify(msg) end)
    if not ok then pcall(print,"[porkVisuals] "..tostring(msg)) end
end
_toast, _toastTok = nil, 0
-- Slim panel-following notification; preserve the original 2.1s display + 0.25s exit.
do
    local activeTweens = {}
    -- Parent-relative placement inherits the panel's drag, resize and UIScale.
    -- Allow the attached strip to extend beyond the panel's bottom edge.
    win.ClipsDescendants = false
    local function placeToast()
        if not _toast or not _toast.Parent then return end
        local width=math.max(40,math.floor(win.AbsoluteSize.X)-20)
        local bounds=game:GetService("TextService"):GetTextSize(_toast.Message.Text,12,Enum.Font.GothamBold,Vector2.new(width,10000))
        _toast.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,math.max(32,math.ceil(bounds.Y)+14))
        _toast.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,5)
    end
    local function animate(obj, info, props)
        local tween = Tween:Create(obj, info, props)
        activeTweens[#activeTweens+1] = tween
        tween:Play()
    end
    -- Fade individual surfaces instead of rasterizing text in a CanvasGroup.
    local function fadeToast(t,alpha,seconds)
        local targets={
            {t,"BackgroundTransparency",alpha},
            {t.Message,"TextTransparency",alpha},
            {t.Outline,"Transparency",0.55+0.45*alpha},
            {t.TimerTrack,"BackgroundTransparency",alpha},
            {t.TimerTrack.Bar,"BackgroundTransparency",alpha},
        }
        for _,entry in ipairs(targets) do
            if seconds then animate(entry[1],TweenInfo.new(seconds),{[entry[2]]=entry[3]})
            else entry[1][entry[2]]=entry[3] end
        end
    end
    function _pvNotify(msg)
        for _, tween in ipairs(activeTweens) do tween:Cancel() end
        activeTweens = {}
        _toastTok = _toastTok + 1
        local tok = _toastTok
        if not _toast or _toast.Parent ~= win then
            local t = Instance.new("Frame")
            t.Name = "pvToast"
            t.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,0)
            t.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
            t.BackgroundColor3 = T.glass
            t.BorderSizePixel = 0
            t.ZIndex = 100
            t.Visible = false
            t.Parent = win
            corner(t,7)
            local outline = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            outline.Name = "Outline"
            outline.Color = T.pink
            outline.Transparency = 0.55
            outline.Thickness = 1
            outline.Parent = t
            local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            label.Name = "Message"
            label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,2)
            label.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-9)
            label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            label.TextSize = 12
            label.TextScaled = false
            label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            label.TextColor3 = T.txt
            label.TextWrapped = true
            label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
            label.ZIndex = 101
            label.Parent = t
            local track = Instance.new("Frame")
            track.Name = "TimerTrack"
            track.BorderSizePixel = 0
            track.BackgroundColor3 = T.pane
            track.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,1,-5)
            track.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,2)
            track.ZIndex = 101
            track.Parent = t
            corner(track,3)
            local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
            bar.Name = "Bar"
            bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
            bar.BackgroundColor3 = T.pink
            bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            bar.ZIndex = 102
            bar.Parent = track
            corner(bar,3)
            _toast = t
        end
        local t = _toast
        local bar = t.TimerTrack.Bar
        t.Message.Text = tostring(msg)
        fadeToast(t,1)
        bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        placeToast()
        t.Visible = true
        fadeToast(t,0,0.18)
        animate(bar,TweenInfo.new(2.1,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
            {Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)})
        task.delay(2.1,function()
            if tok ~= _toastTok or not t.Parent then return end
            fadeToast(t,1,0.25)
            task.wait(0.3)
            if tok == _toastTok and t.Parent then t.Visible=false end
        end)
    end
end

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")

local fpsFlakes = {}
do
    local atlas = pvSession.getChristmasSnowAtlas and pvSession.getChristmasSnowAtlas() or nil
    local rng = Random.new(1225)
    local function spawnFlake(size, alpha, x, y, spin, speed, phase, variant)
        local f = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        f.Name = "ChristmasSnowflake"
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)
        f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x,y)
        f.ZIndex = 2
        f.ImageTransparency = alpha
        if atlas then
            f.Image = atlas
            f.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(128*variant,0)
            f.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(128,128)
        end
        f.Parent = fpsSnowLayer
        fpsFlakes[#fpsFlakes+1] = {f=f,x=x,y=y,size=size,alpha=alpha,spin=spin,speed=speed,phase=phase,rotation=rng:NextNumber(0,360)}
    end
    -- A 28px-tall counter needs its own sparse, low-contrast snowflake field.
    -- Stagger across the upper and lower edges, clear of the close button.
    for i=1,6 do
        local size = (i%3==0) and 10 or 8
        local x = 0.085 + (i-1)*0.145
        local y = i%2==0 and 0.75 or 0.25
        spawnFlake(size, rng:NextNumber(0.70,0.83), x, y,
            rng:NextNumber(3,7) * ((i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1), rng:NextNumber(0.18,0.34), rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi*2), (i-1)%4)
    end
end

    local image = ""
    pcall(function()
        local src = sky and sky:FindFirstChild("pvChristmasBackgroundImage")
        if src and src:IsA("ImageLabel") then image = src.Image end
    end)
    fpsChristmasBG.Image = image
    fpsChristmasBG.Visible = christmas and image ~= ""
    fpsChristmasDim.Visible = christmas
    fpsSnowLayer.Visible = christmas
    panel.BackgroundTransparency = christmas and 0.08 or 0
end
refreshFPSChristmasVisual()

-- The counter has its own ScreenGui so hiding the main panel does not hide FPS.
local connections = {}
local function connect(signal, callback)
    connections[#connections+1] = signal:Connect(callback)
end
local dragging, dragStart, startPosition, touch
connect(panel.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = panel.Position
        touch = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
    end
end)
connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if (touch and input == touch) or (not touch and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale,startPosition.X.Offset+delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,startPosition.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
    end
end)
connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
    if input == touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = false
        touch = nil
    end
end)

-- Average rendered frames over a half-second window, not instantaneous 1/dt.
local frames, elapsed = 0, 0
local statsService = game:GetService("Stats")
local pingItem
local fpsAnimElapsed, fpsAnimAccum = 0, 0
local fpsThemeMarker = ""
local function readPingMs()
    local ok, value = pcall(function()
        if not pingItem or not pingItem.Parent then
            local network = statsService:FindFirstChild("Network")
            local serverStats = network and network:FindFirstChild("ServerStatsItem")
            pingItem = serverStats and serverStats:FindFirstChild("Data Ping")
        end
        return pingItem and pingItem:GetValue()
    end)
    if ok and type(value)=="number" and value==value and value>=0 and value<math.huge then
        return tostring(math.floor(value+0.5))
    end
    return "--"
end
connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
    if not isCurrent() then gui:Destroy(); return end
    local currentTheme = tostring(settings.uiTheme or "")
    if currentTheme ~= fpsThemeMarker then
        fpsThemeMarker = currentTheme
        refreshFPSChristmasVisual()
    end
    if fpsSnowLayer.Visible and gui.Enabled then
        fpsAnimAccum = fpsAnimAccum + math.min(dt,0.1)
        if fpsAnimAccum >= 1/30 then
            local step = fpsAnimAccum
            fpsAnimAccum = 0
            fpsAnimElapsed = fpsAnimElapsed + step
            for _,flake in ipairs(fpsFlakes) do
                local phase = fpsAnimElapsed*flake.speed + flake.phase
                local x = flake.x + 0.006*math.sin(phase)
                local y = flake.y + 0.018*math.sin(phase*0.78 + flake.phase)
                local dim = panel.AbsoluteSize
                local mx = math.min(0.46,(flake.size*0.72+2)/math.max(1,dim.X))
                local my = math.min(0.46,(flake.size*0.72+2)/math.max(1,dim.Y))
                flake.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(x,mx,1-mx), math.clamp(y,my,1-my))
                flake.f.Rotation = (flake.rotation + fpsAnimElapsed*flake.spin) % 360
                flake.f.ImageTransparency = math.clamp(flake.alpha + 0.045*math.sin(phase*1.5), 0, 1)
            end
        end
    end
    if not gui.Enabled then frames, elapsed = 0, 0; return end
    frames = frames + 1
    elapsed = elapsed + dt
    if elapsed >= 0.5 then
        local fps = math.floor(frames / elapsed + 0.5)
        label.Text = "FPS: " .. fps .. "  |  Ping: " .. readPingMs() .. " ms"
        label.TextColor3 = fps >= 50 and (settings.uiTheme=="Halloween" and Color3.fromRGB(255,191,106) or Color3.fromRGB(140,240,170))
            or fps >= 30 and Color3.fromRGB(255,210,110)
            or Color3.fromRGB(255,120,130)
        frames, elapsed = 0, 0
    end
end)
keyActions.restoreFPS = function()
    if not isCurrent() then return end
    gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled
    frames, elapsed = 0, 0
    notify(gui.Enabled and "FPS counter shown" or "FPS counter hidden")
end
connect(close.Activated, function()
    gui.Enabled = false
    local restoreKey = settings.keys and settings.keys.restoreFPS
    if type(restoreKey)=="string" and restoreKey~="" then
        notify("FPS counter removed, press "..restoreKey.." to restore")
    else
        notify("FPS counter removed, set keybind to restore")
    end
end)
pvSession.connect(gui.Destroying,function()
    for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(connections)
end)
