local RANK={
    Ancient=1, Godly=2, Unique=3,
    Legendary=4, Christmas=5, Halloween=5,
    Rare=6, Uncommon=7, Common=8,
    Classic=9, Vintage=9,
}
local items,seen={},{}
local _ItemService
local function _getIS()
    if _ItemService~=nil then return _ItemService end
    _ItemService=false
    for _,d in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ModuleScript") and d.Name=="ItemService" then
            local ok,m=pcall(require,d); if ok then _ItemService=m end; break
        end
    end
    return _ItemService
end
local function resolveImg(id,rawImg)
    local is=_getIS()
    if is then
        local ok,di=pcall(function() return is:GetDisplayInfo(id,"Weapons") end)
        if ok and di and di.Image and tostring(di.Image)~="" then return tostring(di.Image) end
    end
    local img=tostring(rawImg or "")
    if img~="" and img:match("^%d+$") then img="rbxassetid://"..img end
    return img
end


function pvFixImg(img)
    img=tostring(img or "")
    if img=="" then return "" end
    if img:match("^%d+$") then return "rbxassetid://"..img end
    if img:find("Thumbs/Asset",1,true) or img:find("thumbnail",1,true) then
        local aid=img:match("[Aa]ssetId=(%d+)") or img:match("[?&]id=(%d+)") or img:match("(%d+)%D*$")
        if aid then return "rbxthumb://type=Asset&w=150&h=150&id="..aid end
    end
    return img
end
local function addCat(catName,kind,tradable)
    local data=Sync[catName]
    if type(data)~="table" then return end
    for id,info in pairs(data) do
        local nm = type(info)=="table" and tostring(info.ItemName or info.Name or "") or ""
        if nm~="" and not nm:find("%?") then
            local rar=tostring(info.Rarity or "")


            local misc = (tostring(info.ItemType or "")=="Misc")


            local randomBox = nm:find("Random",1,true)~=nil


            local orange = (rar=="Unique" and nm~="Corrupt")
                           or nm=="Clown" or nm=="SharkSeeker" or nm=="Dartbringer"
            local flat = nm:lower():gsub("[^%a%d]","")


            local isNik = flat:find("niksscythe",1,true) or flat:find("nikscythe",1,true)
                          or flat:find("nikilis",1,true)


            local key=kind.."|"..tostring(id)
            if not (nm:find("Test") or nm=="Missing" or orange or misc or randomBox) and not seen[key] then
                seen[key]=true
                local img=(kind=="Weapon") and resolveImg(id,info.Image) or tostring(info.Image or "")
                img=pvFixImg(img)
                local isEvo = (info.EvoIndex~=nil) or (info.EvoBaseID~=nil)

                local yr = tostring(id):match("_(%d%d%d%d)$")
                table.insert(items,{
                    id=id,name=nm,kind=kind,cat=catName,
                    base=nm,
                    yr=yr,
                    type=tostring(info.ItemType or kind),
                    chroma=info.Chroma==true,rarity=rar,evo=isEvo,
                    fx=(info.FX==true) or (info.Effect~=nil) or (info.Particles~=nil),
                    img=img,tradable=tradable and not isEvo,
                    noSpawnAll=isNik or nil,
                })
            end
        end
    end
end
addCat("Weapons","Weapon",true)



table.sort(items,function(a,b)
    local ra = RANK[a.rarity] or 9
    local rb = RANK[b.rarity] or 9
    if ra ~= rb then return ra < rb end
    if a.name ~= b.name then return a.name < b.name end
    return a.id < b.id
end)
local byId={} for _,w in ipairs(items) do byId[w.id]=w end
local weapons={} for _,w in ipairs(items) do if w.kind=="Weapon" then weapons[#weapons+1]=w end end


pcall(function()
    local sw=Sync and Sync.Weapons
    if sw and ProfileData.Weapons and ProfileData.Weapons.Owned then
        local removed=false
        for id in pairs(ProfileData.Weapons.Owned) do
            local e=sw[id]
            local enm = e and tostring(e.ItemName or e.Name or "") or ""
            local rar = e and tostring(e.Rarity or "") or ""


            local orange   = (rar=="Unique" and enm~="Corrupt")
                             or enm=="Clown" or enm=="SharkSeeker" or enm=="Dartbringer"
            local junk      = e and (tostring(e.ItemType or "")=="Misc" or enm:find("Random",1,true))
            local aliasFake = (not byId[id]) and (type(savedSpawns)=="table" and savedSpawns[id]==true)
            if orange or junk or aliasFake then
                ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[id]=nil
                if type(savedSpawns)=="table" then savedSpawns[id]=nil end
                removed=true
            end
        end
        if removed then pcall(function() invChanged("Weapons") end) end
    end

    if type(settings.loadout)=="table" and type(settings.loadout.owned)=="table" then
        for id in pairs(settings.loadout.owned) do if not byId[id] then settings.loadout.owned[id]=nil end end
    end
    if type(savedSpawns)=="table" then
        for id in pairs(savedSpawns) do if not byId[id] then savedSpawns[id]=nil end end
    end
    pcall(saveCfg)
end)
local function isDefault(id)
    local w=byId[id]
    return id=="DefaultKnife" or id=="DefaultGun" or (w and (w.name=="Default Knife" or w.name=="Default Gun"))
end
local function spawnItem(id, amount, record, saveToConfig)
    if isDefault(id) then return end
    local w=byId[id]; local cat=(w and w.cat) or "Weapons"
    local pd=ProfileData[cat]; if not (pd and pd.Owned) then return end
    amount=math.clamp(math.floor(amount or 1),1,999)


    local total = (w and w.evo) and 1 or math.clamp((pd.Owned[id] or 0)+amount,1,999)
    pd.Owned[id]=total
    invChanged(cat,id,total)
    if record~=false and cat=="Weapons" then
        settings.loadout.owned[id]=total
        if saveToConfig ~= false then
            savedSpawns[id] = true
        end
        saveCfg()
    end
end
local function equipItem(id,record)
    local w=byId[id]; if not w or w.kind~="Weapon" then return end
    local slot=(w.type=="Gun") and "Gun" or "Knife"
    ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped[slot]=id
    pcall(function() EquipService.EquippedChanged:Fire(slot,id) end)
    if record~=false then
        if slot=="Knife" then settings.loadout.knife=id else settings.loadout.gun=id end
        pcall(saveCfg)
    end
end
local skinCache={}
pcall(function() if hasFile and isfileSafe(SKIN_PATH) then skinCache=HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SKIN_PATH)) or {} end end)
local skinDirty=false
local function saveSkins()
    if not hasFile then return end
    skinDirty=false
    pcall(function()
        if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
        writefile(SKIN_PATH,HttpService:JSONEncode(skinCache))
    end)
end
local function skinCount() local n=0 for _ in pairs(skinCache) do n+=1 end return n end
local function meshFromAsset(id)
    local ok,objs=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(id)) end)
    if not (ok and objs) then return nil end
    local m,t
    for _,o in ipairs(objs) do
        if o:IsA("MeshPart") and o.MeshId~="" then
            m,t=o.MeshId:match("%d+"),(o.TextureID or ""):match("%d+")
        end
        if not m then
            for _,d in ipairs(o:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("SpecialMesh") and d.MeshId~="" then
                    m,t=d.MeshId:match("%d+"),(d.TextureId or ""):match("%d+");break
                elseif d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.MeshId~="" then
                    m,t=d.MeshId:match("%d+"),(d.TextureID or ""):match("%d+")
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
        if m then break end
    end
    return m,t
end
local fetching={}
local function fetchSkin(name,cb)
    if skinCache[name] then if cb then cb(skinCache[name]) end return end
    if fetching[name] then return end
    fetching[name]=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local queries={
            "MM2 "..name,
            "Murder Mystery 2 "..name,
            name.." MM2 knife",
            name.." murder mystery",
        }


        local function norm(s) return tostring(s):lower():gsub("[^%a%d]","") end
        local target=norm(name)
        local function namesFor(ids)
            if #ids==0 then return {} end
            local res=httpGet("https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v1/items/details?assetIds="..table.concat(ids,","))
            local map={}
            if res then
                local okj,d=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res) end)
                if okj and d and d.data then
                    for _,v in ipairs(d.data) do
                        local a=v.asset or {}
                        if a.id then map[a.id]=tostring(a.name or "") end
                    end
                end
            end
            return map
        end
        local got
        for _,q in ipairs(queries) do
            local res=httpGet("https://apis.roblox.com/toolbox-service/v1/marketplace/10?keyword="..HttpService:UrlEncode(q).."&limit=12")
            if res then
                local okj,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res) end)
                if okj and data and data.data then
                    local ids={}
                    for _,v in ipairs(data.data) do
                        local aid=v.id or (v.asset and v.asset.id)
                        if aid then ids[#ids+1]=aid end
                    end
                    local nameMap=namesFor(ids)
                    for _,aid in ipairs(ids) do
                        local an=norm(nameMap[aid] or "")

                        if an~="" and an:find(target,1,true) then
                            local m,t=meshFromAsset(aid)


                            local mid = m and tostring(m):match("%d+")
                            if m and not (mid and _G.pvBadMesh and _G.pvBadMesh[mid]) then
                                got={mesh=m,tex=t or ""};break
                            end
                            task.wait(0.05)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if got then break end
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
        if got then skinCache[name]=got;skinDirty=true;saveSkins() end
        fetching[name]=nil
        if cb then cb(got) end
    end)
end
local function paintTool(tool,data)
    local h=tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not (h and data and data.mesh) then return false end
    pcall(function()
        if h:IsA("MeshPart") then
            h.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..data.mesh
            if data.tex and data.tex~="" then h.TextureID="rbxassetid://"..data.tex end
        else
            local m=h:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
            if not m then m=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");m.Parent=h end
            m.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            m.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..data.mesh
            if data.tex and data.tex~="" then m.TextureId="rbxassetid://"..data.tex end
        end
        h.Transparency=0
    end)
    return true
end
local function clearHolster()
    local c=LP.Character; if not c then return end
    for _,x in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
        if x.Name=="porkHolster" then pcall(function() x:Destroy() end) end
    end
end
local function holsterFromMesh(meshId, texId, base, cf)
    if not meshId then return end
    local m=Instance.new("Model");m.Name="porkHolster"
    local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name="Handle";p.Size=Vector3.new(0.3,0.3,1.4)
    p.Transparency=1;p.CanCollide=false;p.Massless=true;p.Parent=m
    local sm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");sm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
    sm.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..meshId
    if texId and texId~="" then sm.TextureId="rbxassetid://"..texId end
    sm.Scale=Vector3.new(0.55,0.55,0.55);sm.Parent=p
    m.PrimaryPart=p;m.Parent=LP.Character
    m:PivotTo(base.CFrame*cf)
    local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");w.Part0=base;w.Part1=p;w.Parent=p
end
function weaponDisplaySources()
    local ch=LP.Character
    local out={}
    if not ch then return out end
    for _,def in ipairs({{"DisplayRefKnife","Knife"},{"DisplayRefGun","Gun"}}) do
        local ov=ch:FindFirstChild(def[1])
        local src=ov and ov.Value
        if not src then
            local wd=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
            src = wd and wd:FindFirstChild(def[2].."Display")
        end
        if src then out[def[2]]=src end
    end
    return out
end
function cacheFromDisplay()
    local srcs=weaponDisplaySources()
    for slot,src in pairs(srcs) do
        local id=ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped[slot]
        local w=id and byId[id]
        if w then
            local mesh,tex
            if src:IsA("MeshPart") and src.MeshId~="" then
                mesh,tex=src.MeshId:match("%d+"),(src.TextureID or ""):match("%d+")
            else
                local sm=src:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                if sm and sm.MeshId~="" then mesh,tex=sm.MeshId:match("%d+"),(sm.TextureId or ""):match("%d+") end
            end
            if mesh then
                local cur=skinCache[w.name]
                if not (cur and cur.mesh==mesh) then
                    skinCache[w.name]={mesh=mesh,tex=tex or ""}
                    skinDirty=true;pcall(saveSkins)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
function showRealEquipped()
    local ch=LP.Character
    if not ch then return false,"no character" end
    local lower=ch:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not lower then return false,"no torso" end
    local srcs=weaponDisplaySources()
    if not (srcs.Knife or srcs.Gun) then return false,"no weapon displays" end
    pcall(clearHolster)
    for _,slot in ipairs({"Knife","Gun"}) do
        local src=srcs[slot]
        if src then
            local ok=pcall(function()
                local m=Instance.new("Model");m.Name="porkHolster"
                local p=src:Clone()
                p.Name="Handle";p.Anchored=false;p.CanCollide=false;p.Massless=true
                for _,d in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
                    if d:IsA("Weld") or d:IsA("WeldConstraint") or d:IsA("Motor6D") then d:Destroy() end
                end
                p.Parent=m
                m.PrimaryPart=p;m.Parent=ch
                local cf=(slot=="Knife")
                    and CFrame.new(0.75,-0.55,0.15)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180),0,math.rad(12))
                    or  CFrame.new(-0.75,-0.55,0.15)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180),0,math.rad(-12))
                m:PivotTo(lower.CFrame*cf)
                local wc=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");wc.Part0=lower;wc.Part1=p;wc.Parent=p
            end)
            if not ok then return false,"clone failed" end
        end
    end
    pcall(cacheFromDisplay)
    return true
end
bodyWorn={}
local function showOnBody(knifeW, gunW, onDone)


    if knifeW or gunW then settings.bodyCleared=false
    elseif settings.bodyCleared then if onDone then onDone(false,"cleared") end return end
    local char=LP.Character
    if not char then if onDone then onDone(false,"no character") end return end
    local lower=char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not lower then if onDone then onDone(false,"no torso") end return end
    if knifeW then bodyWorn.Knife=knifeW end
    if gunW   then bodyWorn.Gun=gunW   end
    local need,missing={},{}
    for _,def in ipairs({{bodyWorn.Knife,"Knife"},{bodyWorn.Gun,"Gun"}}) do
        if def[1] and not skinCache[def[1].name] then need[#need+1]=def[1] end
    end
    local function paintAllNow()
        pcall(clearHolster)
        for _,def in ipairs({{bodyWorn.Knife,"Knife"},{bodyWorn.Gun,"Gun"}}) do
            local w,slot=def[1],def[2]
            if w then
                local d=skinCache[w.name]
                if d and d.mesh then
                    local meshId=tostring(d.mesh):match("%d+")
                    local texId =d.tex and tostring(d.tex):match("%d+") or nil
                    if meshId then
                        local cf=(slot=="Knife")
                            and CFrame.new(0.75,-0.55,0.15)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180),0,math.rad(12))
                            or  CFrame.new(-0.75,-0.55,0.15)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180),0,math.rad(-12))
                        pcall(holsterFromMesh, meshId, texId, lower, cf)
                    end
                else
                    missing[#missing+1]=w.name
                end
            end
        end
        if onDone then onDone(true, (#missing>0) and ("no mesh: "..table.concat(missing,", ")) or nil) end
    end
    if #need==0 then paintAllNow() return end
    local left=#need
    for _,w in ipairs(need) do
        fetchSkin(w.name,function()
            left=left-1
            if left<=0 then paintAllNow() end
        end)
    end
end
pvSession.connect(LP.CharacterAdded,function()
    task.wait(1.5)
    if bodyWorn.Knife or bodyWorn.Gun then pcall(showOnBody,nil,nil) end
end)
local function applyBodySkins()
    if pvInventoryVisualSync then return end
    if settings.bodyCleared then return end
    if bodyWorn.Knife or bodyWorn.Gun then return end
    if not settings.bodySkins then return end
    local char=LP.Character; if not char then return end
    local kw=settings.loadout.knife and byId[settings.loadout.knife]
    local gw=settings.loadout.gun   and byId[settings.loadout.gun]
    clearHolster()
    local lower=char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not lower then return end
    for _,def in ipairs({{kw,"Knife"},{gw,"Gun"}}) do
        local w,slot=def[1],def[2]
        if w then
            local held = char:FindFirstChild(slot)
            if held then
                local h = held:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if h then
                    local meshId, texId
                    if h:IsA("MeshPart") then
                        meshId = h.MeshId:match("%d+")
                        texId = h.TextureID:match("%d+")
                    else
                        local sm = h:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                        if sm then
                            meshId = sm.MeshId:match("%d+")
                            texId = sm.TextureId:match("%d+")
                        end
                    end
                    if meshId then
                        local cf = (slot=="Knife")
                            and CFrame.new(0.75,-0.55,0.15)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180),0,math.rad(12))
                            or  CFrame.new(-0.75,-0.55,0.15)*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180),0,math.rad(-12))
                        holsterFromMesh(meshId, texId, lower, cf)
                        local d=skinCache[w.name]
                        if d then paintTool(held,d) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
task.spawn(function()
    while gui.Parent and isCurrent() do
        if settings.bodySkins then pcall(applyBodySkins) end
        task.wait(1.5)
    end
end)
pvSession.connect(LP.CharacterAdded,function() task.wait(1.5); if settings.bodySkins then pcall(applyBodySkins) end end)
local buildRunning=false
local function buildAllSkins(onProgress,onDone)
    if buildRunning then return end
    buildRunning=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local todo={}
        for _,w in ipairs(weapons) do if not skinCache[w.name] then todo[#todo+1]=w.name end end
        for i,nm in ipairs(todo) do
            if not buildRunning then break end
            local done=false
            fetchSkin(nm,function() done=true end)
            local t=0
            while not done and t<8 do task.wait(0.2);t+=0.2 end
            if onProgress then pcall(onProgress,i,#todo,skinCount()) end
        end
        buildRunning=false
        saveSkins()
        if onDone then pcall(onDone,skinCount()) end
    end)
end

PV_FORCE_MOBILE_TRADE = false
function pvIsMobileLayout()
    if PV_FORCE_MOBILE_TRADE then return true end


    local live = PG:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI")
    local it = live and live:FindFirstChild("Container") and live.Container:FindFirstChild("Items")
    if it then
        local mob = it:FindFirstChild("_mO")
        local main= it:FindFirstChild("Main")
        if mob and mob.Visible then return true end
        if main and main.Visible then return false end
    end


    return IS_TOUCH == true
end

function pvApplyLayout(tg)
    if not tg then return end
    local items = tg:FindFirstChild("Container") and tg.Container:FindFirstChild("Items")
    if not items then return end
    local main = items:FindFirstChild("Main")
    local mob  = items:FindFirstChild("_mO")
    if not (main and mob) then return end
    local m = pvIsMobileLayout()
    pcall(function() main.Visible = not m; mob.Visible = m end)
end
function pvFindTrade(parent)
    for _,n in ipairs(pvTradeNames()) do
        local g=parent:FindFirstChild(n)
        if g then return g,n end
    end
    return nil
end
local spoofGui = nil
local function tradeRoot()
    if _G.pvSpoofActive and tradeUsable(spoofGui) and spoofGui.Parent then return spoofGui end
    for _,n in ipairs(pvTradeNames()) do
        local d = PG:FindFirstChild(n)
        if tradeUsable(d) and d.Enabled then return d end
    end
    local mine = PG:FindFirstChild("pvTradeGUI")
    if tradeUsable(mine) then return mine end
    return nil
end
local function spoofSurface()


    local stale = PG:FindFirstChild("pvTradeGUI")
    if stale then pcall(function() stale:Destroy() end) end
    local mine = nil


    local tmpl = pvFindTrade(game:GetService("StarterGui"))
    if not tmpl then return nil end
    if mine then pcall(function() mine:Destroy() end) end
    local clone = tmpl:Clone()
    clone.Name = "pvTradeGUI"
    clone.ResetOnSpawn = false
    for _,d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("ModuleScript") or d:IsA("Script") then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        end
    end


    pcall(function()
        for _,d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if d.Name=="NewItem" then
                local nl=d:FindFirstChild("ItemName",true)
                nl=nl and nl:FindFirstChild("Label")
                local txt=nl and tostring(nl.Text):lower() or ""
                if txt:find("nik",1,true) then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end
    end)


    pcall(pvApplyLayout, clone)
    clone.Enabled = true
    clone:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
        if clone.Parent and not clone.Enabled and _G.pvSpoofActive then clone.Enabled=true end
    end)
    clone.Parent = PG
    if tradeUsable(clone) then spoofGui = clone; return clone end
    return nil
end

end)

local function nameToId(nm)
    for id in pairs(ProfileData.Weapons.Owned) do
        local w=Sync.Weapons[id]; if w and w.ItemName==nm then return id end
    end
    for _,w in ipairs(weapons) do if w.name==nm then return w.id end end
end
local RARITY_COL={
    Common    = Color3.fromHex("#6a6a6a"),
    Uncommon  = Color3.fromHex("#00ffff"),
    Rare      = Color3.fromHex("#00c800"),
    Legendary = Color3.fromHex("#dc0005"),
    Unique    = Color3.fromHex("#fa8c00"),
    Godly     = Color3.fromHex("#ff00b3"),
    Ancient   = Color3.fromHex("#640aff"),
    Classic   = Color3.fromHex("#e6c800"),
    Vintage   = Color3.fromHex("#e6c800"),
    Halloween = Color3.fromHex("#b44600"),
    Christmas = Color3.fromHex("#1ec3be"),
}
local GREY_SLOT=Color3.fromRGB(106,106,106)
local armCooldown=function() end
pcall(function()
    for rar,data in pairs(Sync.Rarities or {}) do
        local col = data.Color
        if typeof(col)~="Color3" and data.Hex then
            col = Color3.fromHex(tostring(data.Hex))
        end
        if typeof(col)=="Color3" then RARITY_COL[rar]=col end
    end
end)
local function offerColour(srcFrame,rid)
    if srcFrame then
        local nf=srcFrame:FindFirstChild("ItemName",true)
        if nf and nf:IsA("GuiObject") then return nf.BackgroundColor3 end
    end
    if rid then
        local ok,di=pcall(function() return _getIS():GetDisplayInfo(rid,"Weapons") end)
        if ok and di and typeof(di.Color)=="Color3" then return di.Color end
        local e=Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[rid]
        if e and e.Rarity and RARITY_COL[e.Rarity] then return RARITY_COL[e.Rarity] end
    end
    local w=rid and byId[rid]
    return (w and RARITY_COL[w.rarity]) or GREY_SLOT
end


local function pvOfferBadge(slot, id)
    local tags = slot:FindFirstChild("Tags", true)
    if not tags then return end
    local e = id and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]
    local isEvo = (e and ((e.EvoIndex~=nil) or (e.EvoBaseID~=nil))) or false
    local want = {
        Chroma=(e and e.Chroma==true) or false,
        FX=(e and e.FX==true) or false,
        Evo=isEvo,
        Christmas=false, Halloween=false, Unique=false,
    }
    local any=false
    for _,c in ipairs(tags:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("GuiObject") and want[c.Name]~=nil then
            c.Visible=want[c.Name]
            if want[c.Name] then any=true end
        end
    end
    tags.Visible=any
end
local function enforceOffer()
    local c=offerCont(); if not c then return end
    for i=1,4 do
        local s=c:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..i);local o=offered[i]
        if s then
            if o then
                local ic=s:FindFirstChild("Icon",true); if ic and ic.Image~=o.icon then ic.Image=o.icon end
                local nf=s:FindFirstChild("ItemName",true);local nl=nf and nf:FindFirstChild("Label")
                if nl and nl.Text~=o.name then nl.Text=o.name end
                if nf and o.col and nf.BackgroundColor3~=o.col then nf.BackgroundColor3=o.col end
                local am=s:FindFirstChild("Amount",true)
                if am and am:IsA("TextLabel") then
                    local want=(o.count and o.count>1) and ("x"..o.count) or ""
                    if am.Text~=want then am.Text=want end
                end

                pcall(pvOfferBadge, s, o.id)
                if not s.Visible then s.Visible=true end
            else
                if s.Visible then s.Visible=false end
                local tags=s:FindFirstChild("Tags",true)
                if tags and tags.Visible then tags.Visible=false end
                local ic=s:FindFirstChild("Icon",true); if ic and ic.Image~="" then ic.Image="" end
                local nf=s:FindFirstChild("ItemName",true)
                if nf and nf:IsA("GuiObject") and nf.BackgroundColor3~=GREY_SLOT then
                    nf.BackgroundColor3=GREY_SLOT
                end
                local am=s:FindFirstChild("Amount",true)
                if am and am:IsA("TextLabel") and am.Text~="" then am.Text="" end
            end
        end
    end
end
reserved = {}
local applyReserved = function() end
local _lastAdd={}
local function addOffer(nm,icon,id,srcFrame)
    if #nm==0 then return false,"no item" end


    if _G.pvOfferLocked then return false,"offer locked - both accepted" end
    local rid=id or nameToId(nm)
    if nm=="Default Knife" or nm=="Default Gun" or rid=="DefaultKnife" or rid=="DefaultGun" then
        return false,"can't offer defaults"
    end
    local w=rid and byId[rid]
    if w and w.kind=="Pet" then return false,"pets aren't tradable" end
    if w and w.evo then return false,"evos aren't tradable" end
    if srcFrame and srcFrame:GetAttribute("pvEvo") == true then
        return false,"evos aren't tradable"
    end
    if rid then
        local ent=Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[rid]
        if ent and (ent.EvoBaseID ~= nil or ent.EvoIndex ~= nil) then
            return false,"evos aren't tradable"
        end
    end


    local dkey = rid or nm
    local now=os.clock()
    if _lastAdd[dkey] and (now-_lastAdd[dkey])<0.1 then return false end
    _lastAdd[dkey]=now
    local owned = (rid and ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[rid]) or 0
    local held  = (rid and reserved[rid]) or 0
    for _,o in ipairs(offered) do


        if (rid and o.id==rid) or (not rid and not o.id and o.name==nm) then
            if rid and held >= owned then
                return false,"you only have "..owned
            end
            o.count=(o.count or 1)+1
            if rid then reserved[rid]=held+1 end
            pcall(enforceOffer);pcall(armCooldown);pcall(applyReserved,rid)
            return true
        end
    end
    if #offered>=4 then return false,"offer full (4 slots)" end
    if rid and held >= owned then return false,"you only have "..owned end
    table.insert(offered,{name=nm,icon=icon or "",id=rid,count=1,src=srcFrame,
                          col=offerColour(srcFrame,rid)})
    if rid then reserved[rid]=held+1 end
    pcall(enforceOffer);pcall(armCooldown);pcall(applyReserved,rid)


    if _G.pvSyncFake then task.defer(function() pcall(_G.pvSyncFake) end) end
    return true
end
local function consumeOffered()
    for _,o in ipairs(offered) do
        local id=o.id
        if id then
            local have=ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[id] or 0
            local n=have-(o.count or 1)
            if n>0 then ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[id]=n else ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[id]=nil end
            invChanged("Weapons",id,math.max(n,0))
        end
    end
    offered = {}
    _lastAdd = {}
    reserved = {}
    pcall(applyReserved)
    pcall(saveCfg)
end
local function rarityInfo(rar)
    local t=Sync and Sync.Rarities and Sync.Rarities[rar]
    if not t then return 999,nil end
    local col=t.Color
    if typeof(col)~="Color3" then
        col = t.Hex and Color3.fromHex(tostring(t.Hex)) or nil
    end
    return tonumber(t.Sort) or 999, col
end

pvTagsFrameProto = pvTagsFrameProto or nil


pvTagsByName = pvTagsByName or {}
function pvRealTagsFrame(want)
    want = want or "Chroma"
    local cached = pvTagsByName[want]
    if cached and cached.Parent==nil then return cached end
    local found
    pcall(function()

        local roots = {
            PG:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI"),
            PG:FindFirstChild("pvTradeGUI"),
            PG:FindFirstChild("MainGUI"),
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):FindFirstChild("TradeGUI"),
        }
        for _,src in ipairs(roots) do
            if src then
                for _,d in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d.Name=="Tags" and d:IsA("GuiObject") and d:FindFirstChild(want) then
                        found=d break
                    end
                end
            end
            if found then break end
        end
    end)
    if found then
        pvTagsByName[want] = found:Clone()
        return pvTagsByName[want]
    end
end


function pvTileTag(t, which, szX, szY, posX, posBottom)

    for _,d in ipairs(t:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("GuiObject") and (d.Name=="pvTags" or d.Name=="Chroma"
           or d.Name=="FX" or d.Name=="Evo" or (d.Name:sub(1,5)=="pvTag")) then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    if not which then return end
    local proto = pvRealTagsFrame(which)
    local src = proto and proto:FindFirstChild(which)
    if not src then return end
    local tag = src:Clone()
    tag.Name       = "pvTag"..which
    tag.Visible    = true
    tag.Size       = UDim2.fromOffset(szX or 56, szY or 17)
    tag.Position   = UDim2.new(0, posX or 4, 1, posBottom or -46)
    tag.AnchorPoint= Vector2.new(0,0)
    tag.ZIndex     = 30
    local bg  = tag:FindFirstChild("BG")
    local lbl = tag:FindFirstChild("TagName")


    local frameHasGradient = tag:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient") ~= nil
    if bg and not frameHasGradient then

        tag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        bg.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,0); bg.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
        bg.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); bg.ZIndex=30
        bg.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
        bg.BackgroundTransparency=1; bg.ImageTransparency=0
        if lbl then
            lbl.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,0); lbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
            lbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); lbl.ZIndex=31
            lbl.TextScaled=true; lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1
            local cons=lbl:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint") or Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
            cons.MinTextSize=8; cons.MaxTextSize=15; cons.Parent=lbl
            lbl.TextWrapped=false
            lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            lbl.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        end
    else


        local arc=tag:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
        if arc then arc:Destroy() end
        if lbl then
            lbl.TextScaled=true
            local cons=lbl:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint") or Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
            cons.MinTextSize=8; cons.MaxTextSize=15; cons.Parent=lbl
            lbl.TextWrapped=false
        end
    end
    tag.Parent = t
    return tag
end


NIK_THUMB = "2533350813"


local PREVIEW_ROOTS = {ItemShowcase=true, ItemOld=true, Preview=true, ItemPreview=true, Inspect=true}
local function pvHideCard(d)
    local a=d
    for i=1,9 do
        local par=a.Parent
        if not (par and par:IsA("GuiObject")) then break end
        a=par
        if PREVIEW_ROOTS[a.Name] then pcall(function() a.Visible=false end); return end
        local w=a.AbsoluteSize.X
        if w>=150 and w<=460 then pcall(function() a.Visible=false end); return end
    end
end
function pvKillNik(root)
    for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        local cls = d.ClassName
        if cls=="TextLabel" or cls=="TextButton" then
            local t=tostring(d.Text)
            if t:find("Nik") and t:find("Scythe") then
                pvHideCard(d)
                pcall(function() d.Text="" end)
            end
        elseif cls=="ImageLabel" or cls=="ImageButton" then
            if tostring(d.Image):find(NIK_THUMB,1,true) then
                pvHideCard(d)
                pcall(function() d.Image=""; d.ImageTransparency=1 end)
            end
        end
    end
end

_G.pvGaveTo = _G.pvGaveTo or {}

function pvActiveWeaponCont(vp)
    local root = vp.Main.Weapons.Items.Container
    for _,tab in ipairs({"Current","Classic","Holiday"}) do
        local sf = root:FindFirstChild(tab)
        if sf and sf.Visible then
            return sf:FindFirstChild("Container"), tab
        end
    end

    local cur = root:FindFirstChild("Current")
    return cur and cur:FindFirstChild("Container"), "Current"
end


function pvWeaponTab(e)
    local Event = e.Event
    if Event then
        if Event~="Christmas" and Event~="Halloween" then return "Current" end
        return Event
    elseif e.Season then
        return "Current"
    else
        return "Classic"
    end
end
function pvWeaponTabCont(vp, e)
    local root = vp.Main.Weapons.Items.Container
    local tab = pvWeaponTab(e)
    if tab=="Christmas" then
        local x=root.Holiday.Container:FindFirstChild("Christmas")
        return x and x:FindFirstChild("Container"), "Christmas"
    elseif tab=="Halloween" then
        local x=root.Holiday.Container:FindFirstChild("Halloween")
        return x and x:FindFirstChild("Container"), "Halloween"
    elseif tab=="Classic" then
        return root.Classic:FindFirstChild("Container"), "Classic"
    end
    return root.Current:FindFirstChild("Container"), "Current"
end


function pvEnforceTags(t, e)
    local tags = t:FindFirstChild("Tags", true)
    if not tags then return end
    local isEvo = (e.EvoIndex~=nil) or (e.EvoBaseID~=nil)


    local want = {
        Chroma    = (e.Chroma==true),
        FX        = (e.FX==true),
        Evo       = isEvo,
        Christmas = false,
        Halloween = false,
        Unique    = false,
    }
    for _,c in ipairs(tags:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("GuiObject") and want[c.Name]~=nil then
            pcall(function() c.Visible = want[c.Name] end)
        end
    end
end


function pvTileIs(t, e)
    local nf = t:FindFirstChild("ItemName", true)
    local nl = nf and (nf:FindFirstChild("Label") or (nf:IsA("TextLabel") and nf))
    if not (nl and nl:IsA("TextLabel")) then return false end
    if tostring(nl.Text) ~= tostring(e.ItemName) then return false end
    local tags = t:FindFirstChild("Tags", true)
    local ch = tags and tags:FindFirstChild("Chroma")
    local isChroma = (ch and ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch.Visible and tags.Visible) and true or false
    return isChroma == (e.Chroma == true)
end

function pvTileAmount(t)
    local am = t:FindFirstChild("Amount", true)
    local n = am and am:IsA("TextLabel") and tonumber(tostring(am.Text):match("(%d+)"))
    return (n and n > 0) and n or 1
end


function pvProfileExtras(vp, spoofed)
    pcall(function()
        local prof = vp.Main.Profile.Container.Profile
        for _, nm in ipairs({"Trophies", "Season1Stats"}) do
            local f = prof:FindFirstChild(nm)
            if f then
                if spoofed then
                    if f.Visible then f.Visible = false; f:SetAttribute("pvHidden", true) end
                elseif f:GetAttribute("pvHidden") then
                    f.Visible = true; f:SetAttribute("pvHidden", nil)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    if not spoofed then return end

    for _, cat in ipairs({"Pets", "Radios", "Emotes", "Perks", "Effects"}) do
        pcall(function()
            for _, d in ipairs(vp.Main[cat].Items.Container:GetDescendants()) do
                if d.Name == "NewItem" and d:IsA("GuiObject") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end)
    end
end


function pvInjectProfile(vp, forceName)
    local key
    if forceName then
        key = tostring(forceName):lower():gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
    else
        local ok,uname = pcall(function() return tostring(vp.Main.Profile.Container.Username.Text) end)
        if not ok then return end
        key = (uname or ""):lower():gsub("'s.*$",""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
    end


    pcall(function()
        local root=vp.Main.Weapons.Items.Container
        for _,path in ipairs({ root.Current.Container,
                               root.Classic.Container,
                               root.Holiday.Container.Christmas.Container,
                               root.Holiday.Container.Halloween.Container }) do
            for _,d in ipairs(path:GetChildren()) do
                if d:GetAttribute("pvGiven") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                elseif d:GetAttribute("pvMergedReal") then

                    pcall(function() d.Visible = true; d:SetAttribute("pvMergedReal", nil) end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    local gave = (key~="" and _G.pvGaveTo[key]) or {}
    if #gave == 0 and not forceName then return end
    local tmpl = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.InventoryModule:FindFirstChild("NewItem")
    if not tmpl then return end
    local Sync = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Database.Sync)

    local agg, order = {}, {}
    for i=#gave,1,-1 do
        local g = gave[i]
        if g.id then
            if not agg[g.id] then agg[g.id] = 0; order[#order+1] = g.id end
            agg[g.id] = agg[g.id] + (tonumber(g.count) or 1)
        end
    end

    if forceName then
        for _,d in ipairs({"DefaultKnife","DefaultGun"}) do
            if Sync.Weapons[d] and not agg[d] then agg[d] = 1; order[#order+1] = d end
        end
    end
    for n,id in ipairs(order) do
        local e = Sync.Weapons[id]
        if e then
            local cont = pvWeaponTabCont(vp, e)
            if cont then
                local amount = agg[id]

                for _,d in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
                    if d.Name=="NewItem" and not d:GetAttribute("pvGiven") and d.Visible and pvTileIs(d, e) then
                        amount = amount + pvTileAmount(d)
                        pcall(function() d.Visible = false; d:SetAttribute("pvMergedReal", true) end)
                        break
                    end
                end
                local g = {id = id, count = amount}
                local t = tmpl:Clone()
                t.Name = "NewItem"
                t:SetAttribute("pvGiven", true)
                t.LayoutOrder = -100 + n


                local data = {}; for k,v in pairs(e) do data[k]=v end
                data.Amount = g.count or 1; data.DataID = g.id
                t.Parent = cont
                pcall(function() _IMod().DisplayItem(t, data, nil, true) end)
                pcall(pvEnforceTags, t, e)
            end
        end
    end
end


function pvBotStats(name)
    _G.pvBotStatsCache = _G.pvBotStatsCache or {}
    local c = _G.pvBotStatsCache[name]
    if c then return c end
    local seed = 7
    for i = 1, #name do seed = (seed * 31 + name:byte(i)) % 2147483647 end
    local rng = Random.new(seed)
    local level = rng:NextInteger(15, 100)
    local prestige = (level >= 85 and rng:NextNumber() < 0.45) and rng:NextInteger(1, 3) or 0
    local rounds = rng:NextInteger(90, 900)
    c = {
        Level = level, Prestige = prestige,
        Eliminations = math.floor(rounds * rng:NextNumber(0.09, 0.15) * rng:NextNumber(1.6, 3.4)),
        Victories    = math.floor(rounds * rng:NextNumber(0.08, 0.13) * rng:NextNumber(0.25, 0.55)),
        Survivals    = math.floor(rounds * rng:NextNumber(0.30, 0.55)),
    }
    _G.pvBotStatsCache[name] = c
    return c
end


-- Visual-player stats are SIMULATED, not the real account's MM2 records.
-- There is no fixed murder/sheriff/innocent stat count per level. XP can
-- accumulate through different game modes and the Season 1 counters were reset.
-- Use stable username-based variation in playstyle and season participation,
-- rather than misleadingly fitting every level to a single player screenshot.
function pvVisualLevelStats(name, requestedLevel)
    local level=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(requestedLevel) or 1),1,100)
    local seed=37
    local normalized=tostring(name or "VisualPlayer"):lower()
    for i=1,#normalized do
        seed=(seed*131+normalized:byte(i))%2147483647
    end
    local rng=Random.new(seed)
    -- Players specialise differently: murderer, sheriff, survivor or balanced.
    -- These are illustrative proportions, not verified MM2 level formulas.
    local styles={
        {1.90,0.63,0.83}, -- murderer-leaning
        {0.67,2.10,0.95}, -- sheriff-leaning
        {0.59,0.71,1.65}, -- survival-leaning
        {1.00,1.00,1.00}, -- balanced
        {1.27,0.87,1.17}, -- mixed
    }
    local style=styles[rng:NextInteger(1,#styles)]
    local activity=rng:NextNumber(0.55,1.70)
    -- Different amounts of the player's history can fall after Season 1's
    -- reset. Some established characters show very low season counters.
    local resetFraction=(rng:NextNumber()<0.18)
        and rng:NextNumber(0.06,0.29) or rng:NextNumber(0.48,1.00)
    local progress=(level/78)^1.22
    local rounds=520*progress*activity*resetFraction
    return {
        Level=level,
        Prestige=0,
        Eliminations=math.max(0,math.floor(rounds*0.26*style[1]*rng:NextNumber(0.87,1.13)+0.5)),
        Victories=math.max(0,math.floor(rounds*0.078*style[2]*rng:NextNumber(0.86,1.14)+0.5)),
        Survivals=math.max(0,math.floor(rounds*0.47*style[3]*rng:NextNumber(0.90,1.10)+0.5)),
    }
end

function pvBotInventory(name)
    if not _G.pvInvSkeleton then
        pcall(function()
            _G.pvInvSkeleton = RS.Remotes.Extras.GetFullInventory:InvokeServer(LP.Name)
        end)
    end
    local base = _G.pvInvSkeleton or {}
    local data = {}
    for k, v in pairs(base) do data[k] = v end
    local owned = {DefaultKnife = 1, DefaultGun = 1}
    for _, g in ipairs(_G.pvGaveTo[tostring(name):lower()] or {}) do
        if g.id then owned[g.id] = (owned[g.id] or 0) + (tonumber(g.count) or 1) end
    end
    for _, cat in ipairs({"Weapons", "Effects", "Perks", "Emotes", "Radios", "Pets"}) do
        local src = type(base[cat]) == "table" and base[cat] or {}
        local t = {}
        for k, v in pairs(src) do t[k] = v end
        t.Owned = (cat == "Weapons") and owned or {}
        t.Equipped = (cat == "Weapons") and {Knife = "DefaultKnife", Gun = "DefaultGun"} or {}
        data[cat] = t
    end
    return data
end
function pvOpenBotProfile(name, overrideLevel, overrideStats)
    local vp = PG.MainGUI.Game.ViewProfile
    local VPM = require(RS.Modules.ViewProfileModule)
    local pc = (VPM.GUI and VPM.GUI.ProfileContainer) or vp.Main.Profile.Container
    local st = pvBotStats(name)
    if overrideLevel ~= nil then
        -- Only visual players receive estimated Season 1 profile stats;
        -- normal trade bots retain their own cached bot stats.
        st=pvVisualLevelStats(name,overrideLevel)
        -- Explicit user-entered overrides beat simulated values. Empty fields
        -- leave the respective statistic on its automatic estimate.
        if type(overrideStats)=="table" then
            for _,key in ipairs({"Eliminations","Victories","Survivals"}) do
                local v=tonumber(overrideStats[key])
                if v and v>=0 and v<=9999999 and v==math.floor(v) then
                    st[key]=v
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G.pvBotProfileName = name
    _G.pvSpoofProfileName = nil

    pcall(function()
        local u = pc:FindFirstChild("Username") or pc.Parent:FindFirstChild("Username")
        u.Text = name
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local lc = pc.Character.CharacterIcon.LevelFrame.LevelContainer
        lc.Icon.Level.Text = st.Level
        pcall(function() lc.Icon.Image = require(RS.RankIconsEmpty)[st.Level] end)
        lc.Prestige.Visible = st.Prestige > 0
        if st.Prestige > 0 then lc.Prestige.Text = ({"I","II","III","IV","V"})[st.Prestige] end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local ch = pc.Character
        for _, b in ipairs({"Elite","Builder","WeaponDesigner","MM2Creator","BetaTester","Clown"}) do
            local f = ch:FindFirstChild(b); if f then f.Visible = false end
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local sc = pc.Profile.Season1Stats
        sc.Visible = true
        sc.Container.Eliminations.Amount.Text = st.Eliminations
        sc.Container.Saves.Amount.Text = st.Victories
        sc.Container.Survivals.Amount.Text = st.Survivals
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local tr = pc.Profile.Trophies
        tr.Visible = true
        for _, v in ipairs(tr.Container:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("Frame") then v:Destroy() end end
    end)

    VPM.DisplayInventoryFromData(vp, name, pvBotInventory(name))

    local okW = pcall(function() require(RS.Modules.WindowService):ViewFrame("ViewProfile") end)
    if not okW then pcall(function() vp.Visible = true end) end

    task.spawn(function()


        local uid = pvUserIdOf(name)
        if not uid then
            local seed = 11
            for i = 1, #name do seed = (seed * 37 + name:byte(i)) % 2147483647 end
            uid = Random.new(seed):NextInteger(20000000, 3500000000)
        end
        local img = ""
        pcall(function()
            img = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(uid, Enum.ThumbnailType.AvatarBust, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size352x352)
        end)
        pcall(function() pc.Character.CharacterIcon.Image = img end)
        pcall(function() vp.Nav.Profile.Icon.Image = img end)
    end)
end


_G.pvUidCache = _G.pvUidCache or {}
function pvUserIdOf(name)
    local key=tostring(name):lower()
    if _G.pvUidCache[key]~=nil then return _G.pvUidCache[key] end

    for _,p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Name:lower()==key then _G.pvUidCache[key]=p.UserId; return p.UserId end
    end

    local uid
    pcall(function() uid = game:GetService("Players"):GetUserIdFromNameAsync(name) end)
    _G.pvUidCache[key] = uid or false
    return uid
end

function pvSpoofProfile(name)
    local PG=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
    local vp=PG.MainGUI.Game:FindFirstChild("ViewProfile")
    if not vp then return end
    _G.pvSpoofProfileName = name
    _G.pvLastProfileKey = nil
    pcall(function()
        for _,d in ipairs(vp:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name=="Username" then
                if tostring(d.Text):find("'s") then
                    d.Text = name.."'s"..(tostring(d.Text):match("'s(.*)") or "")
                else
                    d.Text = name
                end
            end
        end
    end)


    task.spawn(function()
        local uid = pvUserIdOf(name)
        if not uid then return end
        local thumb = ("rbxthumb://type=AvatarBust&id=%d&w=352&h=352"):format(uid)


        for _=1,10 do
            if _G.pvSpoofProfileName~=name then break end
            pcall(function()
                local charFrame = vp.Main.Profile.Container:FindFirstChild("Character")
                if charFrame then
                    for _,d in ipairs(charFrame:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then d.Image = thumb end
                    end
                end
                local nav = vp:FindFirstChild("Nav")
                local icon = nav and nav:FindFirstChild("Profile")
                icon = icon and icon:FindFirstChild("Icon")
                if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then icon.Image = thumb end

                for _,d in ipairs(vp:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("ImageLabel") and tostring(d.Image):find("AvatarBust",1,true) then d.Image=thumb end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
    end)


    pcall(function()
        local root=vp.Main.Weapons.Items.Container
        for _,path in ipairs({ root.Current.Container, root.Classic.Container,
                               root.Holiday.Container.Christmas.Container,
                               root.Holiday.Container.Halloween.Container }) do
            for _,d in ipairs(path:GetChildren()) do
                if d.Name=="NewItem" and not d:GetAttribute("pvGiven") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function() vp.Visible=true end)
    task.wait(0.1)
    pvProfileExtras(vp, true)
    pvInjectProfile(vp, name)
end

task.spawn(function()
    local myGen=_G.pvGen
    local PG=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
    while _G.pvGen==myGen do
        pcall(function()
            local vp = PG:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
            vp = vp and vp:FindFirstChild("Game")
            vp = vp and vp:FindFirstChild("ViewProfile")
            if vp and vp.Visible then


                local forceName = _G.pvSpoofProfileName
                if forceName then
                    local shown = ""
                    pcall(function() shown = tostring(vp.Main.Profile.Container.Username.Text):lower() end)
                    if not shown:find(tostring(forceName):lower(), 1, true) then
                        _G.pvSpoofProfileName = nil; forceName = nil
                    end
                end

                local k = forceName
                if not k then pcall(function() k = tostring(vp.Main.Profile.Container.Username.Text):gsub("'s.*$","") end) end
                k = tostring(k or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")

                if _G.pvBotProfileName and k == tostring(_G.pvBotProfileName):lower() then return end


                local havePv = false
                pcall(function()
                    local root=vp.Main.Weapons.Items.Container
                    for _,path in ipairs({ root.Current.Container, root.Classic.Container,
                                           root.Holiday.Container.Christmas.Container,
                                           root.Holiday.Container.Halloween.Container }) do
                        for _,d in ipairs(path:GetChildren()) do
                            if d:GetAttribute("pvGiven") then havePv=true end
                        end
                    end
                end)

                local g = _G.pvGaveTo[k]
                local want = (g and #g>0) and #g or 0
                if forceName then want = math.max(want, 1) end
                pcall(pvProfileExtras, vp, forceName ~= nil)


                if k ~= _G.pvLastProfileKey then
                    _G.pvLastProfileKey = k
                    pvInjectProfile(vp, forceName)
                elseif want>0 and not havePv then
                    pvInjectProfile(vp, forceName)
                end
            else
                _G.pvSpoofProfileName = nil
                _G.pvBotProfileName = nil
                _G.pvLastProfileKey = nil
            end
        end)
        pvTick("view-profile", 0.5)
    end
end)

pvTagProto = pvTagProto or {}
function pvRealTag(which)
    if pvTagProto[which] and pvTagProto[which].Parent==nil then return pvTagProto[which] end
    local found
    pcall(function()
        for _,src in ipairs({ game:GetService("StarterGui"):FindFirstChild("TradeGUI"),
                              PG:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI") }) do
            if src then
                for _,d in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d.Name==which and d.Parent and d.Parent.Name=="Tags" then found=d break end
                end
            end
            if found then break end
        end
    end)
    if found then
        local c=found:Clone(); c.Visible=true
        pvTagProto[which]=c
        return c
    end
end
local _fxProto=nil
local function realFXTag()
    if _fxProto and _fxProto.Parent==nil then return _fxProto end
    local ok,res=pcall(function()
        local slots=pvFindTrade(PG).Container.Trade.YourOffer.Container
        for i=1,4 do
            local ni=slots:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..i)
            local tg=ni and ni:FindFirstChild("Tags")
            local fx=tg and tg:FindFirstChild("FX")
            if fx then return fx end
        end
    end)
    if ok and res then
        _fxProto=res:Clone()
        _fxProto.Visible=true
        return _fxProto
    end
end
function _IM()
    if not _imCache then _imCache=require(RS.Modules.InventoryModule) end
    return _imCache
end
function _IMod()
    if not _imodCache then _imodCache=require(RS.Modules.ItemModule) end
    return _imodCache
end
function realTileTemplate()
    local f=RS.Modules.InventoryModule:FindFirstChild("NewItem")
    return f and f:Clone() or nil
end
tileTmplCache=nil
function gridCont(scroll)
    local c=scroll:FindFirstChild("Items")
    c=c and c:FindFirstChild("Container")
    c=c and c:FindFirstChild("Current")
    c=c and c:FindFirstChild("Container")
    return c
end


function pvGridScroll(catFrame)
    if not catFrame then return nil,nil end
    if catFrame:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
        return catFrame, gridCont(catFrame)
    end
    local cur=catFrame:FindFirstChild("Items")
    cur=cur and cur:FindFirstChild("Container")
    cur=cur and cur:FindFirstChild("Current")
    if not cur or not cur:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return nil,nil end
    return cur, cur:FindFirstChild("Container")
end
function tileTemplate(scroll,waitFor)
    if tileTmplCache and tileTmplCache.Parent==nil then return tileTmplCache end
    local real=realTileTemplate()
    if real then tileTmplCache=real; return real end
    local deadline=os.clock()+(waitFor or 0)
    repeat
        local cont=gridCont(scroll)
        if cont then
            for _,c in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
                if c.Name=="NewItem" then
                    tileTmplCache=c:Clone()
                    return tileTmplCache
                end
            end
        end
        if os.clock()<deadline then task.wait(0.1) end
    until os.clock()>=deadline
end
local function gridRarity(id,cat)
    local t=Sync and Sync[cat]
    local e=t and t[id]
    return e and tostring(e.Rarity or e.rarity or "") or ""
end
local function renderGrid(cat,scroll,cont,tmpl)


    cont = cont or (function() local ok,c=pcall(function() return scroll.Items.Container.Current.Container end); return ok and c or nil end)()
    if not cont then return 0 end
    for _,c in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
        if c.Name=="NewItem" then c:Destroy() end
    end
    local list={}
    do
        local ok,tbl = pcall(function() return _IM().GenerateInventoryTables(ProfileData,"Trading") end)
        if ok and tbl and tbl.Data then
            local ok2,sorted = pcall(function() return _IM().SortInventory(tbl) end)
            local src = (ok2 and sorted) or tbl
            for _,ids in pairs((src.Data or {})[cat] or {}) do
                for id,d in pairs(ids) do
                    local nm = tostring(d.ItemName or d.DataID or id)


                    local flat = nm:lower():gsub("[^%a%d]","")
                    local banned = flat:find("niksscythe",1,true) or flat:find("nikscythe",1,true)
                                   or flat:find("nikilis",1,true) or tostring(id):find("Nik",1,true)
                    if nm~="" and not nm:find("%?") and not banned then
                        list[#list+1]={ id=id, data=d, nm=nm,
                                        ct=tonumber(d.Amount) or 1,
                                        rk=tonumber(d.LayoutOrder) or 999 }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(list,function(a,b)
        if a.rk~=b.rk then return a.rk<b.rk end
        return a.nm<b.nm
    end)
    local CELLW, CELLH_RAW = 110, 140
    local PADX, PADY = 1, 3
    local CELLH = CELLH_RAW + PADY


    local function colCount()
        local w=cont.AbsoluteSize.X
        if w<=0 then w=scroll.AbsoluteSize.X end
        return math.max(1, math.floor((w + PADX) / (CELLW + PADX)))
    end
    local COLS = colCount()
    local gl=cont:FindFirstChild("ItemGridLayout")
    if gl then gl:Destroy() end
    scroll.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,math.ceil(#list/COLS)*CELLH+8)
    local tileItem = {}
    local pool, byIdMap = {}, {}
    local function tileFor(slot)
        local t=pool[slot]
        if t then return t end
        t=tmpl:Clone()
        t.Name="NewItem"
        t.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(CELLW,CELLH_RAW)
        t.Visible=false
        t.Parent=cont
        pool[slot]=t
        return t
    end
    local function fill(t,it,i)
        t:SetAttribute("pvIndex",i)
        t:SetAttribute("pvId",it.id)
        t:SetAttribute("pvCat",cat)
        local d=it.data or {}
        t:SetAttribute("pvEvo",(d.EvoBaseID~=nil) or (d.EvoIndex~=nil))
        tileItem[t]=it
        local left=(it.ct or 0)-((it.id and reserved[it.id]) or 0)
        local shown=d
        if left~=d.Amount then
            shown={}
            for k,v in pairs(d) do shown[k]=v end
            shown.Amount=left
        end
        pcall(function() _IMod().DisplayItem(t,shown,nil,true) end)


        pcall(function()
            local meta = it.id and byId[it.id]
            local d0 = it.data or {}
            local isEvo = (meta and meta.evo) or (d0.EvoBaseID~=nil) or (d0.EvoIndex~=nil)
            local isChroma = (meta and meta.chroma) or (d0.Chroma==true)
            local isFX = (meta and meta.fx) or (d0.FX==true)
            local which = isChroma and "Chroma" or (isFX and "FX" or (isEvo and "Evo" or nil))
            pvTileTag(t, which)
        end)
        local b=t:FindFirstChild("Button",true) or t:FindFirstChild("ActionButton",true)
        if b and b:IsA("GuiButton") and not b:GetAttribute("pvWired") then
            b:SetAttribute("pvWired",true)
            pvSession.connect(b.MouseButton1Click,function()
                local cur=tileItem[t]
                if not cur then return end
                local img=""
                local dd=cur.data or {}
                if dd.Image and tostring(dd.Image)~="" then
                    img=tostring(dd.Image)
                    if img:match("^%d+$") then img="rbxassetid://"..img end
                else
                    local ic=t:FindFirstChild("Icon",true)
                    if ic and ic.Image~="" then img=ic.Image end
                end
                local fine,ok2,err=pcall(addOffer,cur.nm,img,cur.id,t)
                if fine and not ok2 then notify(err or "can't offer that") end
            end)
        end
        t.Visible=true
    end
    local shown={}
    local function recompute()
        COLS = colCount()
        shown={}
        local owned=(ProfileData[cat] and ProfileData[cat].Owned) or {}
        for _,it in ipairs(list) do
            it.ct = owned[it.id] or 0
            local left = it.ct - ((it.id and reserved[it.id]) or 0)
            if it.matches~=false and left>0 then shown[#shown+1]=it end
        end
        scroll.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,math.ceil(#shown/COLS)*CELLH+8)
    end
    recompute()
    local function refresh()
        COLS = colCount()
        local top=scroll.CanvasPosition.Y
        local viewH=scroll.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y
        if viewH<=0 then viewH=scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y end
        if viewH<=0 then viewH=CELLH*6 end
        local firstRow=math.max(0,math.floor(top/CELLH)-1)
        local rows=math.ceil(viewH/CELLH)+2
        local slot=0
        for r=firstRow,firstRow+rows do
            for c=0,COLS-1 do
                local idx=r*COLS+c+1
                local it=shown[idx]
                if it then
                    slot=slot+1
                    local t=tileFor(slot)
                    t.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(c*(CELLW+PADX), r*CELLH)
                    fill(t,it,idx)
                end
            end
        end
        for s=slot+1,#pool do pool[s].Visible=false end
    end
    scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(refresh)


    local function reflow() pcall(recompute); pcall(refresh) end
    scroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(reflow)
    cont:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(reflow)
    refresh()
    task.defer(reflow)
    task.delay(0.2, reflow)
    gridState[cat]={scroll=scroll,cont=cont,list=list,byId=byIdMap,pool=pool,
                    refresh=refresh,recompute=recompute,builtFor=nil,
                    tiles=setmetatable({},{__index=function() return nil end})}
    return #list
end
applyReserved = function(_onlyId)
    for _,st in pairs(gridState) do
        if st.recompute then pcall(st.recompute) end
        if st.refresh   then pcall(st.refresh)   end
    end
end
local function showGridTab(cat)
    for c,st in pairs(gridState) do
        if st.scroll then st.scroll.Visible=(c==cat) end
    end
end
local function filterGrid(text)
    text=(text or ""):lower()
    for _,st in pairs(gridState) do
        for _,it in ipairs(st.list or {}) do
            it.matches = (text=="" or (it.nm or ""):lower():find(text,1,true)~=nil)
        end
    end
    pcall(applyReserved)
end
function buildTradeGrid(tg,IM)
    local items=tg.Container:FindFirstChild("Items")
    if not items then return "no Items" end
    local mo=items:FindFirstChild("_mO")
    local main=items:FindFirstChild("Main")
    if not mo then return "no _mO" end


    local mobile = (IS_TOUCH == true)
    local layout = (mobile and mo) or main or mo
    if main then main.Visible = (layout==main) end
    mo.Visible = (layout==mo)
    local wFrame=layout:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
    local pFrame=layout:FindFirstChild("Pets")
    if not wFrame then return "no Weapons frame" end
    local wScroll,wCont = pvGridScroll(wFrame)
    local pScroll,pCont = pvGridScroll(pFrame)
    if not wScroll then return "no Weapons scroll" end
    local tmpl=tileTemplate(wScroll,0)
    if not tmpl then
        pcall(function()
            IM.GenerateInventory(items,ProfileData,"Trading",layout)
        end)
        tmpl=tileTemplate(wScroll,3)
    end
    if not tmpl then return "no tile template" end
    local function invStamp()
        local n,sum=0,0
        for cat,_ in pairs({Weapons=1,Pets=1}) do
            local owned=(ProfileData[cat] and ProfileData[cat].Owned) or {}
            for _,v in pairs(owned) do n=n+1; sum=sum+(tonumber(v) or 0) end
        end
        return n.."/"..sum
    end
    local stamp=invStamp()
    local ws=gridState.Weapons


    if ws and ws.scroll==wScroll and ws.cont==wCont and ws.builtFor==stamp
       and ws.scroll and ws.scroll.Parent and ws.cont and ws.cont.Parent
       and ws.list and #ws.list>0 and ws.pool and ws.pool[1] and ws.pool[1].Parent then
        showGridTab("Weapons")
        reserved={}
        pcall(applyReserved)
        return ("reused w=%d"):format(#ws.list)
    end
    gridState={}
    local nw=renderGrid("Weapons",wScroll,wCont,tmpl)
    local np=pScroll and renderGrid("Pets",pScroll,pCont,tmpl) or 0
    for _,st in pairs(gridState) do st.builtFor=stamp end
    showGridTab("Weapons")
    local tabs=items:FindFirstChild("Tabs")
    if tabs then
        for _,cat in ipairs({"Weapons","Pets"}) do
            local tab=tabs:FindFirstChild(cat)
            local view=tab and tab:FindFirstChild("View")
            if view and view:IsA("GuiButton") and not view:GetAttribute("pvWired") then
                view:SetAttribute("pvWired",true)
                pvSession.connect(view.MouseButton1Click,function()
                    showGridTab(cat)
                    for _,other in ipairs({"Weapons","Pets"}) do
                        local ot=tabs:FindFirstChild(other)
                        local vb=ot and ot:FindFirstChild("ViewBorder")
                        local dv=ot and ot:FindFirstChild("DontView")
                        if vb then vb.Visible=(other==cat) end
                        if dv then dv.Visible=(other~=cat) end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        local sbox=tabs:FindFirstChild("Search")
        local tb=sbox and sbox:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextBox",true)
        if tb and not tb:GetAttribute("pvWired") then
            tb:SetAttribute("pvWired",true)
            tb:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                pcall(filterGrid,tb.Text)
            end)
        end
    end
    return ("ok w=%d p=%d"):format(nw or 0,np or 0)
end
local function clearOffer()
    offered={};_lastAdd={};reserved={}
    pcall(applyReserved)
    local c=offerCont()
    if c then for i=1,4 do
        local s=c:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..i)
        if s then
            s.Visible=false
            local ic=s:FindFirstChild("Icon",true); if ic then ic.Image="" end
            local am=s:FindFirstChild("Amount",true); if am and am:IsA("TextLabel") then am.Text="" end
        end
    end end
    saveCfg()
end
refreshSourceRows = function()
    for _,o in ipairs(offered) do
        if o.src then pcall(function() o.src.Visible = true end) end
    end
end
local spoofOpen = false
local function hookTradeItems()
    if not spoofOpen or not settings.tradeHook then return end
    local tg=tradeRoot(); if not tg then return end
    if tg.Name=="pvTradeGUI" then return end
    local it=tg:FindFirstChild("Container") and tg.Container:FindFirstChild("Items")
    if not it then return end
    if it:GetAttribute("pvHooked") then return end
    it:SetAttribute("pvHooked",true)
    for _,d in ipairs(it:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name=="ActionButton" and d:IsA("GuiButton") then
            local ni=d:FindFirstAncestor("NewItem")
            if ni then
                if getconnections then
                    pcall(function() for _,c in ipairs(getconnections(d.MouseButton1Click)) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end end)
                elseif d:GetAttribute("pH") then else d:SetAttribute("pH",true) end
                pvSession.connect(d.MouseButton1Click,function()
                    local il=ni:FindFirstChild("Icon",true)
                    local nf=ni:FindFirstChild("ItemName",true);local nl=nf and nf:FindFirstChild("Label")
                    local ok,err=addOffer(nl and nl.Text or "", il and il.Image or "", nil, ni)
                    if not ok and err then notify(err) end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end
local function hookOfferSlots()
    if not spoofOpen then return end
    local c=offerCont(); if not c then return end
    for i=1,4 do
        local s=c:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..i)
        local ab=s and s:FindFirstChild("ActionButton",true)
        if ab then
            if getconnections then
                pcall(function() for _,cc in ipairs(getconnections(ab.MouseButton1Click)) do pcall(function() cc:Disconnect() end) end end)
            elseif ab:GetAttribute("pR") then ab=nil else ab:SetAttribute("pR",true) end
            if ab then pvSession.connect(ab.MouseButton1Click,function()
                if _G.pvOfferLocked then return end
                local o=offered[i]
                if not o then return end
                if o.id and reserved[o.id] then
                    local r=reserved[o.id]-1
                    reserved[o.id] = (r>0) and r or nil
                end
                local changed=o.id
                if (o.count or 1)>1 then
                    o.count=o.count-1
                else
                    _lastAdd[o.name]=nil
                    table.remove(offered,i)
                end
                pcall(enforceOffer);pcall(armCooldown);pcall(applyReserved,changed)
            end) end
        end
    end
end
