local pvFriendNames = {}
task.spawn(function()
    local ok,pages = pcall(function() return Players:GetFriendsAsync(LP.UserId) end)
    if not ok or not pages then return end
    local guard=0
    while true do
        local okp = pcall(function()
            for _,f in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
                if f.Username then pvFriendNames[#pvFriendNames+1]=tostring(f.Username) end
            end
        end)
        guard=guard+1
        if not okp or pages.IsFinished or guard>=8 then break end
        pcall(function() pages:AdvanceToNextPageAsync() end)
    end
end)
local _lastPartnerPick=nil
function pvRandomPartner()
    local pool={}
    for _,pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if pl~=LP and not (_G.pvBlocked and _G.pvBlocked[pl.Name]) then pool[#pool+1]=pl.Name end
    end
    if #pool==0 then for _,n in ipairs(pvFriendNames) do pool[#pool+1]=n end end
    if #pool==0 then for _,n in ipairs(FAKE_NAMES) do pool[#pool+1]=n end end
    if #pool==0 then return "porkVisuals" end
    local pick=pool[math.random(1,#pool)]
    if #pool>1 and pick==_lastPartnerPick then
        for _=1,5 do local p=pool[math.random(1,#pool)]; if p~=_lastPartnerPick then pick=p break end end
    end
    _lastPartnerPick=pick
    return pick
end
function _G.pvTradeRequest(fromName, onAccept)
    fromName = fromName or FAKE_NAMES[math.random(1,#FAKE_NAMES)]
    local ok = pcall(function()
        local pg = LP.PlayerGui
        local rr = pg.MainGUI.Game.Leaderboard.Container.TradeRequest.ReceivingRequest
        _G.pvReqToken = (_G.pvReqToken or 0) + 1
        local myTok = _G.pvReqToken
        local old = pg:FindFirstChild("pvTradeReq")
        if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
        local holder = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        holder.Name = "pvTradeReq"
        pvSession.ownRoot(holder)
        holder.ResetOnSpawn = false
        holder.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        holder.DisplayOrder = 50
        holder.Parent = pg
        local clone = rr.Parent:Clone()
        clone.Visible = true
        clone.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(275,120)
        clone.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0)
        do
            local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
            local lb = pg.MainGUI.Game.Leaderboard
            local ap, as = lb.AbsolutePosition, lb.AbsoluteSize
            local rightX = ap.X + as.X
            local belowY = ap.Y + as.Y + 6
            if belowY + 120 > vp.Y - 10 then belowY = vp.Y - 140 end
            if belowY < 44 then belowY = 44 end
            clone.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rightX, belowY)
        end
        clone.Parent = holder
        local cr = clone:FindFirstChild("ReceivingRequest")
        local cs = clone:FindFirstChild("SendingRequest")
        if cs then cs.Visible = false end
        if not cr then pcall(function() holder:Destroy() end); return end
        cr.Visible = true
        local uname = cr:FindFirstChild("Username")
        if uname then uname.Text = fromName end
        local acc = cr:FindFirstChild("Accept")
        local dec = cr:FindFirstChild("Decline")
        local function finish(accepted)
            if _G.pvReqToken ~= myTok then return end
            _G.pvReqToken = _G.pvReqToken + 1
            pcall(function() holder:Destroy() end)
            if accepted and onAccept then task.spawn(function() pcall(onAccept, fromName) end) end
        end
        if acc then pvSession.connect(acc.MouseButton1Click,function() finish(true) end) end
        if dec then pvSession.connect(dec.MouseButton1Click,function() finish(false) end) end
        task.delay(20, function() finish(false) end)
    end)
    if not ok then notify("couldn't show request frame") end
    return fromName
end
function _G.pvShowClaim(itemName, category, count)
    category = category or "Weapons"
    count = count or 1
    pcall(function()
        local ips = require(RS.ClientServices.ItemPopupService)
        ips:AddNewItem(itemName, category, count)
    end)
end
-- USD bands apply to the complete incoming fake-upgrade offer.
-- The selected preset controls the next fake upgrade.
pvSession.upgradeTiers={
    poor={label="Poor",minimum=1,maximum=500},
    middle={label="Mid",minimum=1500,maximum=2999},
    rich={label="Rich",minimum=3000,maximum=50000},
}
pvSession.getUpgradeTier=function(key)
    key=key or settings.fakeUpgradeTier
    if not pvSession.upgradeTiers[key] then key="middle" end
    local default=pvSession.upgradeTiers[key]
    local minimum,maximum=default.minimum,default.maximum
    local ranges=type(settings.fakeUpgradeRanges)=="table" and settings.fakeUpgradeRanges or {}
    local saved=ranges[key]
    if type(saved)=="table" then
        local low,high=saved.minimum,saved.maximum
        local lowValid=type(low)=="number" and low==low and low>=0 and low<math.huge
        local highValid=type(high)=="number" and high==high and high>=0 and high<math.huge
        -- Older configs used false for an uncapped Rich maximum.
        if key=="rich" and high==false then high,highValid=default.maximum,true end
        if lowValid and highValid and low<=high then
            minimum=math.floor(low+0.5)
            maximum=high==math.huge and math.huge or math.floor(high+0.5)
        end
    end
    local range
    if maximum==math.huge then range=string.format("$%.2f+",minimum/100)
    else range=string.format("$%.2f – $%.2f",minimum/100,maximum/100) end
    return {key=key,label=default.label,range=range,minimum=minimum,maximum=maximum}
end
pvSession.selectedUpgradePreset=function()
    return pvSession.getUpgradeTier(settings.fakeUpgradeTier)
end
pvSession.recentUpgradeOffers={}
pvSession.rememberUpgradeOffer=function(tier,serial,offer)
    if #offer==0 then return end
    tier=tier or pvSession.getUpgradeTier()
    local key=tier.label or tier.key
    local history=pvSession.recentUpgradeOffers[key] or {}
    pvSession.recentUpgradeOffers[key]=history
    local names={}
    for _,weapon in ipairs(offer) do
        -- A Chroma and its regular version look similar enough to count as a repeat.
        names[tostring(weapon.name):lower():gsub("^chroma%s+","")]=true
    end
    if history[1] and history[1].serial==serial then table.remove(history,1) end
    table.insert(history,1,{serial=serial,names=names})
    if #history>6 then table.remove(history) end
end
pvSession.buildUpgradeOffer=function(wantCount,manualPicks,preset)
    local tier=preset or pvSession.getUpgradeTier()
    local rich=tier==pvSession.upgradeTiers.rich or tier.key=="rich"
    local mid=tier==pvSession.upgradeTiers.middle or tier.key=="middle"
    local candidates,byWeaponId,seen={},{},{}
    for _,weapon in ipairs(weapons) do
        local name=tostring(weapon.name or "")
        local base=name:gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s+","")
        local chroma=weapon.chroma==true or base~=name
        local prices
        if chroma then prices=PV_VALUES_CHROMA else prices=PV_VALUES end
        local value=prices and tonumber(prices[base])
        if weapon.tradable and not weapon.evo and not weapon.noSpawnAll
            and (weapon.rarity=="Godly" or weapon.rarity=="Ancient")
            and value and value>0 and value<math.huge then
            local cents=math.floor(value*100+0.5)
            local key=base:lower()..(chroma and "|c" or "|n")
            if cents>0 and cents<=tier.maximum then
                local record={weapon=weapon,cents=cents,family=base:lower()}
                byWeaponId[weapon.id]=record
                if not seen[key] then
                    seen[key]=true
                    table.insert(candidates,record)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function withinTier(cents)
        return cents>=tier.minimum and cents<=tier.maximum
    end
    -- Explicit picks are used only when their whole offer meets this tier.
    if type(manualPicks)=="table" and #manualPicks>0 and #manualPicks<=3 then
        local selected,used,total={},{},0
        for _,id in ipairs(manualPicks) do
            local record=byWeaponId[id]
            if not record or used[id] then break end
            if #manualPicks==2 and rich and record.cents<tier.minimum then break end
            used[id]=true
            total=total+record.cents
            table.insert(selected,record.weapon)
        end
        if #selected==#manualPicks and withinTier(total) then return selected,true end
    end
    table.sort(candidates,function(a,b)
        if a.cents~=b.cents then return a.cents<b.cents end
        return tostring(a.weapon.id)<tostring(b.weapon.id)
    end)
    local history=pvSession.recentUpgradeOffers[tier.label or tier.key] or {}
    local age={}
    for index,entry in ipairs(history) do
        for name in pairs(entry.names) do
            if not age[name] then age[name]=index end
        end
    end
    -- First try weapons absent from the last six offers in this tier. When
    -- the budget is tight, bring back one older trade at a time.
    local lastSize=0
    for cutoff=#history,0,-1 do
        local available={}
        for _,record in ipairs(candidates) do
            if not age[record.family] or age[record.family]>cutoff then
                table.insert(available,record)
            end
        end
        if #available>lastSize then
            lastSize=#available
            local chosen=pvSession.pickUpgradeWeapons(available,byWeaponId,tier,wantCount,rich,mid)
            if chosen then return chosen,false end
        end
    end
    return {},false
end
pvSession.pickUpgradeWeapons=function(candidates,byWeaponId,tier,wantCount,rich,mid)
    local function withinTier(cents)
        return cents>=tier.minimum and cents<=tier.maximum
    end
    -- Three-weapon offers may use smaller adds below the tier minimum.
    -- Find the third price in the sorted catalog without building a table of triples.
    local function lowerBound(cents,stop)
        local left,right=1,stop
        while left<right do
            local mid=math.floor((left+right)/2)
            if candidates[mid].cents<cents then left=mid+1 else right=mid end
        end
        return left
    end
    local function findTriple(twoMains)
        local n=#candidates
        if n<3 then return end
        local firstMain=math.max(3,lowerBound(math.ceil(tier.minimum/3),n+1))
        if firstMain>n then return end
        local startMain=math.random(firstMain,n)
        for step=0,n-firstMain do
            local i=firstMain+(startMain-firstMain+step)%(n-firstMain+1)
            local main=candidates[i]
            local startSecond=math.random(2,i-1)
            for offset=0,i-3 do
                local j=2+(startSecond-2+offset)%(i-2)
                local second=candidates[j]
                local subtotal=main.cents+second.cents
                local fitsShape=twoMains and second.cents*2>=main.cents
                    or not twoMains and second.cents*3<=main.cents
                if fitsShape and subtotal<tier.maximum then
                    local addLimit=twoMains and math.floor(second.cents/3) or second.cents
                    local low=lowerBound(tier.minimum-subtotal,j)
                    local high=lowerBound(math.min(addLimit,tier.maximum-subtotal)+1,j)-1
                    if low<=high then
                        local add=candidates[math.random(low,high)]
                        return {main.weapon,second.weapon,add.weapon}
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function pickTriple()
        local twoMains=math.random()<0.5
        return findTriple(twoMains) or findTriple(not twoMains)
    end
    local tryThree=wantCount==3 or (not wantCount and math.random()<(rich and 0.08 or 0.30))
    if tryThree then
        local triple=pickTriple()
        if triple then return triple end
    end
    local singles,pairsOfWeapons={},{}
    for i,a in ipairs(candidates) do
        if withinTier(a.cents) then table.insert(singles,{a.weapon}) end
        if not rich or a.cents>=tier.minimum then
            for j=i+1,#candidates do
                local b=candidates[j]
                local total=a.cents+b.cents
                if total>tier.maximum then break end
                -- Let two comparable Mid weapons share the budget.
                if withinTier(total) and (not mid or a.cents>=tier.minimum or a.cents*2>=b.cents) then
                    table.insert(pairsOfWeapons,{a.weapon,b.weapon})
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local pool
    if wantCount==1 then pool=singles
    elseif wantCount==2 then pool=pairsOfWeapons
    else pool=math.random()<0.62 and singles or pairsOfWeapons end
    if #pool==0 then pool=#singles>0 and singles or pairsOfWeapons end
    if #pool==0 then
        if not tryThree then
            local triple=pickTriple()
            if triple then return triple end
        end
        return nil
    end
    if rich then
        local chosen,totalWeight=nil,0
        for _,offer in ipairs(pool) do
            local total=byWeaponId[offer[1].id].cents+(offer[2] and byWeaponId[offer[2].id].cents or 0)
            local weight=1/total
            totalWeight=totalWeight+weight
            if math.random()*totalWeight<weight then chosen=offer end
        end
        return chosen
    end
    return pool[math.random(1,#pool)]
end

-- Each mock trade owns a serial so canceled/previous trades cannot finish a newer one.
local spoofTradeSerial = 0
local cleanupTradeSpoof
function pvSession.sameTradePartner(a, b)
    local function normalize(value)
        local name = tostring(value or ""):lower()
        name = name:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        name = name:gsub("^%(", ""):gsub("%)$", "")
        name = name:gsub("^@", "")
        return name
    end
    local left, right = normalize(a), normalize(b)
    return left ~= "" and right ~= "" and left == right
end

local function startTradeSpoof(partner, autoMode, noAdd, visualUpgradeTarget, upgradePreset)
    -- Resolve later Trade Spoof requests only to the accepted upgrade's avatar.
    if not visualUpgradeTarget then
        local target=pvSession.upgradePartner
        if target and target==_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget and target.Character
            and target.Character.Parent and pvSession.sameTradePartner(partner,target.Name) then
            visualUpgradeTarget=target
        end
    end


    if spoofBusy then return false,"busy" end
    -- Close any stale trade before cloning a new window and wiring its buttons.
    if spoofOpen and cleanupTradeSpoof then pcall(cleanupTradeSpoof) end
    local tg=spoofSurface(); if not tg then return false,"no trade gui" end
    if not tg:FindFirstChild("Container") then
        return false,"trade window not available here (open a real trade first)"
    end
    spoofBusy=true;task.delay(1.2,function() spoofBusy=false end)
    local okM,TM=pcall(function() return require(RS.Modules.TradeModule) end)
    local okI,IM=pcall(function() return require(RS.Modules.InventoryModule) end)
    if not (okM and okI) then spoofBusy=false;return false,"trade modules missing" end
    spoofTradeSerial = spoofTradeSerial + 1
    local thisTradeSerial = spoofTradeSerial
    -- Latch partner identity BEFORE callbacks can clear or replace session state.
    local isUpgradeReturnTrade = autoMode ~= true
        and pvSession.sameTradePartner(partner, pvSession.pendingUpgradeReturnName)
    local originalTradeInventory = TM.TradeInventory
    tradeModules = { TM = TM, IM = IM, originalInventory = originalTradeInventory }
    settings.tradeHook=true;offered={};spoofOpen=true;_G.pvSpoofActive=true
    pvSession.valueHelperAuto=autoMode==true
    theirOfferedRef=nil
    _G.pvOfferLocked=false
    gridState={}
    pcall(function() tg.Enabled=true end)
    pcall(function() buildTradeGrid(tg,IM) end)


    task.spawn(function()
        local function visibleWeaponsCont()
            local it=tg.Container and tg.Container:FindFirstChild("Items"); if not it then return end
            for _,lname in ipairs({"Main","_mO"}) do
                local L=it:FindFirstChild(lname)
                if L and L.Visible then
                    local wf=L:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
                    local c; if wf then pcall(function() c=wf.Items.Container.Current.Container end) end
                    return c
                end
            end
        end
        for _=1,20 do
            task.wait(0.15)
            if not spoofOpen or not tg.Parent then return end
            local cont=visibleWeaponsCont()
            local vis=0
            if cont then for _,t in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do if t.Name=="NewItem" and t.Visible then vis=vis+1 end end end
            if vis>0 then return end
            gridState={}
            pcall(function() buildTradeGrid(tg,IM) end)
        end
    end)


    _G.pvSpoofName = "("..(partner or "porkVisuals")..")"
    pcall(function() tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer.Username.Text=_G.pvSpoofName end)
    pcall(function()
        local toc=tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer.Container
        for i=1,4 do
            local s=toc:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..i)
            if s then s.Visible=false;local ic=s:FindFirstChild("Icon",true); if ic then ic.Image="" end end
        end
    end)
    task.wait(0.05)
    pcall(hookTradeItems);pcall(hookOfferSlots)
    pcall(function()
        local acts=tg:FindFirstChild("Container") and tg.Container:FindFirstChild("Trade")
                   and tg.Container.Trade:FindFirstChild("Actions")
        local dec=acts and acts:FindFirstChild("Decline")
        if not dec then return end
        -- Decline may itself be a GuiButton or contain an ActionButton.
        -- The cloned trade GUI has no running LocalScripts, so wire either shape.
        local declineTriggered=false
        local function wireDecline(b)
            if not b:IsA("GuiButton") or b:GetAttribute("pvDecline") then return end
            b:SetAttribute("pvDecline",true)
            local function onDecline()
                if declineTriggered then return end
                declineTriggered=true
                pcall(function() if cleanupTradeSpoof then cleanupTradeSpoof() end end)
                pcall(function()
                    local mine=PG:FindFirstChild("pvTradeGUI")
                    if mine then mine:Destroy() end
                end)
                pcall(notify,"Trade declined")
            end
            pvSession.connect(b.MouseButton1Click,onDecline)
            pvSession.connect(b.Activated,onDecline)
        end
        wireDecline(dec)
        for _,b in ipairs(dec:GetDescendants()) do wireDecline(b) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local acts=tg:FindFirstChild("Container") and tg.Container:FindFirstChild("Trade") and tg.Container.Trade:FindFirstChild("Actions")
        local acc=acts and acts:FindFirstChild("Accept")
        if not acc then return end
        local mainBtn = acc:FindFirstChild("ActionButton")
        local confirm = acc:FindFirstChild("Confirm")
        local cancel  = acc:FindFirstChild("Cancel")
        local cdFrame = acc:FindFirstChild("Cooldown")
        local addItem = acc:FindFirstChild("AddItem")
        if not (mainBtn and confirm and cancel) then return end
        local confBtn = confirm:FindFirstChild("ActionButton")
        local cancBtn = cancel:FindFirstChild("ActionButton")
        local myAcc    = tg.Container.Trade.YourOffer:FindFirstChild("Accepted")
        local theirAcc = tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer:FindFirstChild("Accepted")
        local GREEN=Color3.fromRGB(60,205,70)
        local GREY =Color3.fromRGB(120,120,124)
        local function dress(frame,text,col)
            if not frame then return end
            pcall(function() frame.BackgroundColor3=col end)
            for _,d in ipairs(frame:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("TextLabel") then pcall(function() d.Text=text end) end
                if d:IsA("ImageLabel") then pcall(function() d.BackgroundColor3=col end) end
            end
        end
        dress(confirm,"ARE YOU SURE?",GREEN)
        dress(cancel ,"CANCEL",       GREY)
        local COOLDOWN=5
        local coolTok=0
        local cdTitle=cdFrame and cdFrame:FindFirstChild("Title")
        local function coolingDown() return cdFrame~=nil and cdFrame.Visible end
        local function runCooldown()
            if not cdFrame then return end
            coolTok=coolTok+1
            local tok=coolTok
            pcall(function() cdFrame.Visible=true end)
            task.spawn(function()
                for n=COOLDOWN,1,-1 do
                    if tok~=coolTok then return end
                    pcall(function()
                        if cdTitle then cdTitle.Text=" Please wait ("..n..") before accepting." end
                    end)
                    task.wait(1)
                end
                if tok~=coolTok then return end
                pcall(function() cdFrame.Visible=false end)
            end)
        end
        armCooldown=runCooldown
        _G.pvCoolingDown = coolingDown
        local function reset()
            pcall(function()
                confirm.Visible=false
                cancel.Visible=false
                if myAcc then myAcc.Visible=false end
                if theirAcc then theirAcc.Visible=false end
                if addItem then addItem.Visible=false end
                if cdFrame then cdFrame.Visible=false end
            end)
        end
        reset()
        pcall(function() TM.ResetCooldown(true) end)
        _G.pvSuspended = _G.pvSuspended or {}
        local function drop(b)
            if b and getconnections then
                pcall(function()
                    for _,c in ipairs(getconnections(b.MouseButton1Click)) do
                        if c.Disable then
                            pcall(function() c:Disable() end)
                            _G.pvSuspended[#_G.pvSuspended+1] = c
                        else
                            pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        drop(mainBtn);drop(confBtn);drop(cancBtn)
        _G.pvRestoreMM2 = function()
            for _,c in ipairs(_G.pvSuspended or {}) do
                if c.Enable then pcall(function() c:Enable() end) end
            end
            _G.pvSuspended = {}
            pcall(function()
                local TM2 = require(RS.Modules.TradeModule)
                if TM2 and TM2.ConnectActions then TM2.ConnectActions() end
            end)
        end
        local function stage()
            if cancel.Visible  then return "accepted" end
            if confirm.Visible then return "confirm"  end
            return "idle"
        end
        local claimedOnce = false
        local confirmSerial = 0
        local mainBtnHandler = function()
            if coolingDown() then
                notify("Please wait for the cooldown to finish.")
                return
            end
            if stage() ~= "idle" then return end
            if #offered == 0 and not autoMode then
                notify("Put something up first"); return
            end
            pcall(function() confirm.Visible = true end)
        end
        tradeModules.mainBtnConnection = pvSession.connect(mainBtn.MouseButton1Click,mainBtnHandler)
        tradeModules.mainBtnActivatedConnection = pvSession.connect(mainBtn.Activated,mainBtnHandler)
        if confBtn then
            local confirmHandler = function()
                if coolingDown() or stage()~="confirm" then return end
                pcall(function()
                    confirm.Visible=false
                    cancel.Visible=true
                    if myAcc then myAcc.Visible=true end
                end)
                _G.pvOfferLocked = true
                if isUpgradeReturnTrade then
                    notify("Visual return accepted; finishing trade...")
                end
                confirmSerial = confirmSerial + 1
                local thisConfirm = confirmSerial
                -- Do not test cancel.Visible after a delay: the cloned MM2 UI can
                -- change its visual stage while a valid spoof trade is finishing.
                -- Instead, require the same still-active trade and no Cancel/Decline.
                task.delay(1.1,function()
                    if not isCurrent() or thisTradeSerial ~= spoofTradeSerial
                        or thisConfirm ~= confirmSerial or not spoofOpen then return end
                    pcall(function() if theirAcc then theirAcc.Visible=true end end)
                    task.delay(1.3,function()
                        if not isCurrent() or thisTradeSerial ~= spoofTradeSerial
                            or thisConfirm ~= confirmSerial or not spoofOpen then return end
                        -- Both confirmations are final and still belong to this trade.
                        if autoMode and upgradePreset then
                            pvSession.pendingUpgradeReturnName = partner
                            pvSession.upgradePartner = visualUpgradeTarget
                        elseif isUpgradeReturnTrade then
                            pvSession.clearUpgradePartnerInput(partner)
                            pvSession.pendingUpgradeReturnName = nil
                            pvSession.upgradePartner = nil
                        end
                        local received = {}
                        if autoMode and theirOfferedRef then
                            for _,o in ipairs(theirOfferedRef) do
                                received[#received+1] = {name=o.name, icon=o.icon, id=o.id,
                                                         count=o.count or 1}
                            end
                        end


                        if partner and partner~="" and #offered>0 then
                            _G.pvGaveTo = _G.pvGaveTo or {}
                            local key = tostring(partner):lower()
                            _G.pvGaveTo[key] = _G.pvGaveTo[key] or {}
                            for _,o in ipairs(offered) do
                                _G.pvGaveTo[key][#_G.pvGaveTo[key]+1] =
                                    {id=o.id, name=o.name, icon=o.icon, count=o.count or 1}
                            end


                            while #_G.pvGaveTo[key] > 24 do table.remove(_G.pvGaveTo[key], 1) end
                        end
                        -- Snapshot this trade's outgoing items; compare unit USD, not stacks.
                        local chosen={}
                        if visualUpgradeTarget and not claimedOnce
                            and visualUpgradeTarget==_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget
                            and visualUpgradeTarget.Character and visualUpgradeTarget.Character.Parent then
                            for _,o in ipairs(offered) do
                                local w=byId[o.id]
                                local e=Sync.Weapons[o.id]
                                local slot=(w and w.type) or (e and e.ItemType)
                                if slot=="Sword" then slot="Knife" end
                                if slot=="Knife" or slot=="Gun" then
                                    local name=tostring((e and e.ItemName) or (w and w.name) or o.name or o.id)
                                    local base=name:gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s+","")
                                    local chroma=(e and e.Chroma) or (w and w.chroma) or base~=name
                                    local value=(chroma and PV_VALUES_CHROMA and PV_VALUES_CHROMA[base])
                                        or (PV_VALUES and PV_VALUES[base])
                                    value=tonumber(value) or 0
                                    if not chosen[slot] or value>chosen[slot].value then
                                        chosen[slot]={id=o.id,value=value}
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        -- Only the weapons WE gave can qualify the helper for
                        -- success; items received from the visual player do not.
                        local sentForHelper={}
                        for _,o in ipairs(offered) do
                            sentForHelper[#sentForHelper+1]={
                                id=o.id,name=o.name,amount=o.count or 1
                            }
                        end
                        -- Inventory bookkeeping must never suppress the success
                        -- notification or partner reset if it throws.
                        local consumed,consumeError=pcall(consumeOffered)
                        if not consumed then warn("[pv visual trade] inventory: ",consumeError) end
                        _G.pvSpoofActive = false
                        pcall(function() tg.Enabled = false end)
                        pcall(reset)
                        notify(isUpgradeReturnTrade and "Visual return trade complete."
                            or "Trade complete.")
                        if type(pvSession.showUpgradeTradeSuccess)=="function" then
                            pcall(pvSession.showUpgradeTradeSuccess,"Visual trade",sentForHelper)
                        end
                        if next(chosen) then
                            task.delay(5,function()
                                -- Removed/replaced avatars and old script sessions cannot equip.
                                if not isCurrent() or visualUpgradeTarget~=_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget
                                    or not visualUpgradeTarget.Character
                                    or not visualUpgradeTarget.Character.Parent then return end
                                local equippedAny=false
                                local equipOrder={}
                                if chosen.Knife then equipOrder[#equipOrder+1]="Knife" end
                                if chosen.Gun then equipOrder[#equipOrder+1]="Gun" end
                                if #equipOrder==2 and math.random(1,2)==2 then
                                    equipOrder[1],equipOrder[2]=equipOrder[2],equipOrder[1]
                                end
                                for index,slot in ipairs(equipOrder) do
                                    if index>1 then task.wait(1) end
                                    -- Revalidate after waiting: never equip a replacement avatar.
                                    if not isCurrent() or visualUpgradeTarget~=_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget
                                        or not visualUpgradeTarget.Character
                                        or not visualUpgradeTarget.Character.Parent then return end
                                    local item=chosen[slot]
                                    local ok,shown,reason=pcall(pvSkinOther,visualUpgradeTarget,slot,item.id)
                                    warn("[AutoEquip]", "item:", tostring(item.id),
                                        "function:", type(pvSkinOther), "ok:", ok,
                                        "result:", tostring(shown), "reason:", tostring(reason))
                                    if ok and shown then
                                        equippedAny=true
                                        pcall(pvVisualDefaultVisibility,visualUpgradeTarget.Character,slot,false)
                                    else
                                        notify("Could not display "..tostring(item.id).." on the visual player")
                                    end
                                end
                                if equippedAny and type(pvSession.queueUpgradeMessage)=="function" then
                                    pvSession.queueUpgradeMessage(visualUpgradeTarget)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                        if not claimedOnce then
                            claimedOnce = true


                            local lastRid, lastAmt
                            for _,r in ipairs(received) do
                                local rid = r.id
                                local got = r.count or 1
                                if rid then
                                    local have = ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[rid] or 0
                                    ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[rid] = have + got
                                    lastRid, lastAmt = rid, have + got
                                end

                                if _G.pvShowClaim then
                                    pcall(_G.pvShowClaim, rid or r.name, "Weapons", got)
                                end
                            end


                            if lastRid then
                                _G.pvPendingInv = {lastRid, lastAmt}
                            end
                            pcall(saveCfg)
                        end
                        task.delay(0.15,function()
                            -- Never let a delayed cleanup close a different trade.
                            if thisTradeSerial == spoofTradeSerial and cleanupTradeSpoof then
                                pcall(cleanupTradeSpoof)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                end)
            end
            tradeModules.confBtnConnection = pvSession.connect(confBtn.MouseButton1Click,confirmHandler)
            tradeModules.confBtnActivatedConnection = pvSession.connect(confBtn.Activated,confirmHandler)
        end
        if cancBtn then
            local cancelHandler = function()
                confirmSerial = confirmSerial + 1 -- invalidate pending confirmation
                _G.pvOfferLocked=false
                reset();clearOffer()
            end
            tradeModules.cancBtnConnection = pvSession.connect(cancBtn.MouseButton1Click,cancelHandler)
            tradeModules.cancBtnActivatedConnection = pvSession.connect(cancBtn.Activated,cancelHandler)
        end
        if autoMode and not noAdd then
            local theirOffered = {}
            theirOfferedRef = theirOffered
            local taken={}
            local function put(w)

                if not w or taken[w.id] or #theirOffered>=3 then return end
                taken[w.id]=true
                table.insert(theirOffered,{name=w.name,icon=w.img,id=w.id,col=offerColour(nil,w.id)})
            end


            local enforceTheirOffer


            local manualOffer=false
            local function rollOffer(wantCount)
                for i=#theirOffered,1,-1 do
                    taken[theirOffered[i].id]=nil
                    table.remove(theirOffered,i)
                end
                local selection
                selection,manualOffer=pvSession.buildUpgradeOffer(wantCount,_G.pvFakePicks,upgradePreset)
                for _,weapon in ipairs(selection) do put(weapon) end
                if #selection==0 then
                    notify("No priced Godly/Ancient offer fits "..(upgradePreset or pvSession.getUpgradeTier()).label..".")
                end
            end
            local function rememberOffer()
                pvSession.rememberUpgradeOffer(upgradePreset,thisTradeSerial,theirOffered)
            end
            rollOffer(nil)
            rememberOffer()

            _G.pvForceFakeReroll = function()
                if not spoofOpen or thisTradeSerial~=spoofTradeSerial then return end
                rollOffer(nil)
                rememberOffer()
                for i=1,4 do pcall(enforceTheirOffer,i) end
            end
            _G.pvSyncFake = function()
                if not spoofOpen or thisTradeSerial~=spoofTradeSerial then return end

                if manualOffer then
                    for i=1,4 do pcall(enforceTheirOffer,i) end
                    return
                end
                local mine, myCount = {}, 0
                for _,o in ipairs(offered) do
                    myCount = myCount + 1
                    if o.id then mine[o.id]=true end
                    if o.name then mine[pvNorm(tostring(o.name):gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s*",""))]=true end
                end

                local want = #theirOffered>0 and #theirOffered or nil
                local clash=false
                for _,o in ipairs(theirOffered) do
                    if (o.id and mine[o.id]) or (o.name and mine[pvNorm(tostring(o.name):gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s*",""))]) then
                        clash=true break
                    end
                end
                if not clash then return end
                for attempt=1,12 do
                    rollOffer(want)
                    local bad=false
                    for _,o in ipairs(theirOffered) do
                        if (o.id and mine[o.id]) or (o.name and mine[pvNorm(tostring(o.name):gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s*",""))]) then
                            bad=true break
                        end
                    end
                    if not bad then break end
                end
                rememberOffer()
                for i=1,4 do pcall(enforceTheirOffer,i) end
            end
            enforceTheirOffer = function(index)
                local toc = tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer.Container
                if not toc then return end
                local s = toc:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..index)
                local o = theirOffered[index]
                if s and o then
                    local ic = s:FindFirstChild("Icon", true); if ic then ic.Image = o.icon end
                    local nf = s:FindFirstChild("ItemName", true); local nl = nf and nf:FindFirstChild("Label")
                    if nl then nl.Text = o.name end
                    if nf and o.col then nf.BackgroundColor3 = o.col end


                    local am = s:FindFirstChild("Amount", true)
                    if am and am:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        local want = (o.count and o.count > 1) and ("x"..o.count) or ""
                        if am.Text ~= want then am.Text = want end
                    end
                    pcall(pvOfferBadge, s, o.id)
                    if not s.Visible then s.Visible = true end
                elseif s then


                    local ic = s:FindFirstChild("Icon", true); if ic then ic.Image = "" end
                    local nf = s:FindFirstChild("ItemName", true)
                    local nl = nf and nf:FindFirstChild("Label")
                    if nl then nl.Text = "" end
                    if nf then nf.BackgroundColor3 = GREY_SLOT end
                    local am = s:FindFirstChild("Amount", true)
                    if am and am:IsA("TextLabel") and am.Text ~= "" then am.Text = "" end
                    s.Visible = false
                end
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.25 + math.random()*0.35)
                if not spoofOpen then return end


                for i=1,#theirOffered do
                    if not spoofOpen then return end
                    pcall(enforceTheirOffer,i)


                    pcall(armCooldown)
                    if i < #theirOffered then task.wait(0.85 + math.random()*0.4) end
                end
                for _=1,12 do
                    if not spoofOpen then return end
                    for i=1,4 do pcall(enforceTheirOffer,i) end
                    local shown=false
                    pcall(function()
                        local s=tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer.Container:FindFirstChild("NewItem1")
                        shown = s ~= nil and s.Visible
                    end)
                    if shown then break end
                    task.wait(0.1)
                end


                if _G.pvBotAcceptsFirst then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while spoofOpen and _G.pvSpoofActive do
                            local okEnabled,enabled=pcall(function() return tg.Enabled end)
                            if not (okEnabled and enabled) then break end
                            local cooling=false
                            pcall(function() cooling=_G.pvCoolingDown and _G.pvCoolingDown() end)
                            local ta
                            pcall(function() ta=tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer:FindFirstChild("Accepted") end)
                            if ta then
                                if cooling then
                                    if ta.Visible then pcall(function() ta.Visible=false end) end
                                elseif not ta.Visible then
                                    task.wait(0.3 + math.random()*0.3)
                                    local stillCool=false
                                    pcall(function() stillCool=_G.pvCoolingDown and _G.pvCoolingDown() end)
                                    if spoofOpen and _G.pvSpoofActive and not stillCool then
                                        pcall(function() ta.Visible=true end)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            task.wait(0.25)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    return true
end
_G.pvAutoSecondLeg = nil
function cleanupTradeSpoof()
    spoofTradeSerial = spoofTradeSerial + 1 -- cancel delayed callbacks from this trade
    spoofOpen = false;_G.pvSpoofActive=false
    spoofBusy = false
    _G.pvSpoofName = nil
    _G.pvOfferLocked=false
    pcall(clearOffer)
    if _G.pvRestoreMM2 then pcall(_G.pvRestoreMM2) end
    if tradeModules.mainBtnConnection then
        pcall(function() tradeModules.mainBtnConnection:Disconnect() end)
        tradeModules.mainBtnConnection = nil
    end
    if tradeModules.confBtnConnection then
        pcall(function() tradeModules.confBtnConnection:Disconnect() end)
        tradeModules.confBtnConnection = nil
    end
    if tradeModules.cancBtnConnection then
        pcall(function() tradeModules.cancBtnConnection:Disconnect() end)
        tradeModules.cancBtnConnection = nil
    end
    for _,key in ipairs({"mainBtnActivatedConnection", "confBtnActivatedConnection",
                         "cancBtnActivatedConnection"}) do
        if tradeModules[key] then
            pcall(function() tradeModules[key]:Disconnect() end)
            tradeModules[key] = nil
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        local mine = PG:FindFirstChild("pvTradeGUI")
        while mine do
            pcall(function() mine.Enabled = false end)
            pcall(function() mine:Destroy() end)
            mine = PG:FindFirstChild("pvTradeGUI")
        end
    end)
    if tradeModules.TM then
        pcall(function()
            tradeModules.TM.ResetCooldown(true)
            if tradeModules.originalInventory then
                tradeModules.TM.TradeInventory = tradeModules.originalInventory
            end
        end)
    end
    tradeModules = {}
end
pvSession.addCleanup(function() pcall(cleanupTradeSpoof) end)

keyActions.fakeUpgrade = function()
    local nm = _G.pvLastPartner
    if not nm or nm=="" then notify("No recent trade partner yet"); return end
    local ok,err = startTradeSpoof(nm,true,nil,nil,pvSession.selectedUpgradePreset())
    notify(ok and ("Upgrading "..nm) or (err or "failed"))
end
keyActions.tradeRecent = function()
    local nm=_G.pvLastPartner
    if not nm or nm=="" then notify("No recent trade partner yet"); return end
    local ok,err=startTradeSpoof(nm)
    notify(ok and ("Trading "..nm) or (err or "failed"))
end

keyActions.blockRecent = function()
    local nm = pvTradePartner or _G.pvLastPartner
    if not nm or nm=="" then notify("No recent trade partner yet"); return end
    local pl = Players:FindFirstChild(nm)
    if not pl then
        local want=tostring(nm):lower()
        for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Name:lower()==want or tostring(p.DisplayName):lower()==want then pl=p break end
        end
    end
    if not pl then notify(nm.." left the server"); return end
    local ok,msg = autoBlockPlayer(pl)
    notify(pvBlockNotice(ok,msg,pl.Name))
end

local function nextTradeName()
    local pool={}
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=Players.LocalPlayer and not (_G.pvBlocked and _G.pvBlocked[p.Name]) then pool[#pool+1]=p.Name end
    end
    for _,nm in ipairs(_G.pvNPCRoster) do pool[#pool+1]=nm end
    for _,nm in ipairs(realNames) do pool[#pool+1]=nm end
    if #pool==0 then return "trader" end
    _G.pvTradeIdx=(_G.pvTradeIdx % #pool)+1
    return pool[_G.pvTradeIdx]
end

    {id="Gingerscope", count=1},

local function addAutoItem(it)
    local sw=(Sync and Sync.Weapons) or {}
    local w=byId[it.id]
    local e=sw[it.id]
    local nm=(w and w.name) or (e and (e.ItemName or e.Name))
    local img=(w and w.img) or (e and e.Image) or ""
    if not nm then return nil end
    local isChroma=(w and w.chroma) or (e and e.Chroma) or false
    offered[#offered+1]={name=isChroma and ("Chroma "..nm) or nm,id=it.id,icon=img,count=1,
                         col=offerColour(nil,it.id)}
    pcall(enforceOffer)
    return #offered
end

local function invScroll()
    local tg=tradeRoot(); if not tg then return end


    local ok,sf=pcall(function() return tg.Container.Items._mO.Weapons end)
    if ok and sf and sf:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and sf.Visible and sf.Parent.Visible then return sf end
    local ok2,sf2=pcall(function() return tg.Container.Items.Main.Weapons.Items.Container.Current end)
    if ok2 and sf2 and sf2:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return sf2 end
    if ok and sf and sf:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return sf end
end

local function scrollSearch()
    local sf=invScroll(); if not sf then return end
    local maxY=math.max(0, sf.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - sf.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
    if maxY<=1 then return end
    local y=math.random(0,math.floor(maxY))
    pcall(function()
        Tween:Create(sf,TweenInfo.new(0.8,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
            {CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,y)}):Play()
    end)
end
keyActions.autoTrade = function()
    if _G.pvAutoTrade then notify("Auto-trade already running");return end
    _G.pvAutoTrade=true
    notify("Auto-trade ON -- cycling players")
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.pvAutoTrade and gui.Parent and isCurrent() do
            local nm=nextTradeName()
            notify("Auto-trade: "..nm)
            pcall(function() startTradeSpoof(nm, true, true) end)


            local D=math.clamp(tonumber(settings.autoTradeDelay) or 1.0, 0.25, 10)
            task.wait(1.0*D)
            offered={};reserved={}
            local added=0


            for _,it in ipairs(AUTO_OFFER) do
                if not _G.pvAutoTrade or not spoofOpen or added>=4 then break end
                pcall(scrollSearch)
                task.wait(0.6*D)
                local slot=addAutoItem(it)
                if slot then
                    added=added+1
                    for c=2,(it.count or 1) do
                        if not _G.pvAutoTrade or not spoofOpen then break end
                        task.wait(0.8*D)
                        if offered[slot] then offered[slot].count=c end
                        pcall(enforceOffer)
                    end
                end
            end


            while _G.pvAutoTrade and spoofOpen do
                task.wait(0.5)
                pcall(enforceOffer)
            end
            if _G.pvAutoTrade then task.wait(1.5*D) end
        end
        _G.pvAutoTrade=false
    end)
end
keyActions.autoTradeStop = function()
    _G.pvAutoTrade=false
    pcall(function() cleanupTradeSpoof() end)
    notify("Auto-trade stopped")
end
do
    local tr=RS:FindFirstChild("Trade")
    if tr then
        local ct=tr:FindFirstChild("CompleteTrade")
        if ct and ct:IsA("RemoteEvent") then pvSession.connect(ct.OnClientEvent,function()
            if spoofOpen then consumeOffered() end
        end) end
        local et=tr:FindFirstChild("EndTrade")
        if et and et:IsA("RemoteEvent") then pvSession.connect(et.OnClientEvent,function()
            task.wait(0.3); cleanupTradeSpoof()
        end) end
    end
end
task.spawn(function()
    local last=false
    while gui.Parent and isCurrent() do
        local tg = tradeRoot()
        local open = tg ~= nil and tg.Enabled == true
        if open and spoofOpen then
            if settings.tradeHook then pcall(hookTradeItems) end
            pcall(enforceOffer)


            if _G.pvSpoofName then
                pcall(function()
                    local u=tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer.Username
                    if u.Text~=_G.pvSpoofName then u.Text=_G.pvSpoofName end
                end)
            end


            pcall(function()
                local ownsAny=false
                for _ in pairs(ProfileData.Weapons.Owned or {}) do ownsAny=true break end
                if not ownsAny then return end
                local items=tg.Container and tg.Container:FindFirstChild("Items")
                if not items then return end
                local cont
                for _,lname in ipairs({"Main","_mO"}) do
                    local L=items:FindFirstChild(lname)
                    if L and L.Visible then
                        local wf=L:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
                        if wf then pcall(function() cont = wf.Items.Container.Current.Container end) end
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not cont then return end
                local vis=0
                for _,t in ipairs(cont:GetChildren()) do
                    if t.Name=="NewItem" and t.Visible then vis=vis+1 end
                end
                if vis==0 then
                    gridState={}
                    local IM=require(RS.Modules.InventoryModule)
                    buildTradeGrid(tg,IM)
                end
            end)
        end
        if not open and last then
            cleanupTradeSpoof()
        end
        last = open


        task.wait((open and spoofOpen) and 0.3 or 1.0)
    end
end)

    function rebuild()

        if cache and next(cache) then
            for _,entry in pairs(cache) do
                local w=entry.w
                local b=entry.b
                if b and b.Parent then
                    local pf
                    if filt=="All" then pf=true
                    elseif filt=="Chroma" then pf=(w.chroma or (w.name and w.name:lower():find("chroma")~=nil))
                    elseif filt=="Pet" then pf=(w.kind=="Pet")
                    else pf=(w.kind=="Weapon" and w.type==filt) end

                    if not w.disp then
                        local t=tostring(w.type or "")
                        if t=="Gun" and not w.name:lower():find("gun",1,true) then w.disp=w.name.." Gun"
                        else w.disp=w.name end
                    end
                    if not w.lname then
                        w.lname=string.lower(w.disp.." "..w.name.." "..tostring(w.type or ""))
                    end

                    local ps=(q=="") or string.find(w.lname,q,1,true)
                    local visible=(pf and ps) and true or false
                    b.Visible=visible
                    if visible then
                        shown=shown+1
                        b.LayoutOrder=shown
                    end
                end
            end

            grid.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,ll.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+px(8))
            pcall(function() pageTitle.Text=("Items   %d"):format(shown) end)
            return
        end


        for _,c in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end
        end
        for _,w in ipairs(items) do
            local pf
            if filt=="All" then pf=true
            elseif filt=="Chroma" then pf=(w.chroma or (w.name and w.name:lower():find("chroma")~=nil))
            elseif filt=="Pet" then pf=(w.kind=="Pet")
            else pf=(w.kind=="Weapon" and w.type==filt) end


            if not w.disp then
                local t=tostring(w.type or "")
                if t=="Gun" and not w.name:lower():find("gun",1,true) then w.disp=w.name.." Gun"
                else w.disp=w.name end
            end
            if not w.lname then w.lname=string.lower(w.disp.." "..w.name.." "..tostring(w.type or "")) end
            local ps=(q=="") or string.find(w.lname,q,1,true)
            if pf and ps then
                shown=shown+1


                if shown<=1200 then
                    local id=w.id
                    local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
                    b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(4),0,px(26));b.LayoutOrder=shown

                    nml.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    nml.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;nml.TextSize=px(11)
                    nml.TextColor3=T.txt;nml.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    nml.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

                    bl.HorizontalAlignment=Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right
                    bl.VerticalAlignment=Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
                    bl.Padding=UDim.new(0,px(2));bl.Parent=badge


                    local function mkBadge(which)
                        local proto = pvRealTagsFrame(which)
                        local src = proto and proto:FindFirstChild(which)
                        if not src then return end
                        local tag = src:Clone()
                        tag.Name       = "pvTag"..which
                        tag.Visible    = true
                        tag.Size       = UDim2.fromOffset(px(30),px(12))
                        tag.Position   = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
                        tag.AnchorPoint= Vector2.new(0,0)
                        tag.ZIndex     = 3

                            bg.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,0)
                            bg.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)

                    end

                    if w.evo    then mkBadge("Evo")    end
                    paintRow(b, sel[id]==true)

                    savedSpawns[id]=true
                    oneLastId, oneLastAmt = id, pd.Owned[id]
                    oneChanges[#oneChanges+1]={cat=w.cat,id=id,n=pd.Owned[id]}
                end
            end
        end
        local spawnedTab
        if oneLastId then


            pcall(function()
                pvSyncNormalInventoryItems(oneChanges,function(missing,fired,fallback)
                    if isCurrent() then
                        pcall(pvShowSpawnedWeapon,oneLastId,#ids==1)
                        if #ids==1 and fallback>0 then notify("MM2 cache fallback rendered "..tostring((byId[oneLastId] or {}).name or oneLastId)) end
                    end
                end)
            end)

            spawnedTab=select(2,pvWeaponTopTab(oneLastId))
        end
        pcall(saveCfg)
        local msg=(#ids==1 and ("Spawned "..(byId[ids[1]].name)) or ("Spawned "..#ids.." items")).."  (x"..cnt..")"
        if #ids==1 and spawnedTab then msg=msg.." -> "..spawnedTab end
        notify(msg)
    end)

    PV_NEVER_SPAWN = {"niksscythe","nikscythe","nikilis"}
    function pvIsUltraRare(name)
        local n=pvNorm(name or "")
        for _,pat in ipairs(PV_NEVER_SPAWN) do
            if n:find(pat,1,true) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    PV_OWN_CHANCE = {
        [1]=0.04,
        [2]=0.10,
        [3]=0.00,
        [4]=0.30,
        [5]=0.35,
        [6]=0.55,
        [7]=0.72,
        [8]=0.85,
        [9]=0.05,
    }
    do
        local realisticBtn=btn(act,"Realistic",function()
        local n,skipped,seenN=0,0,0
        local rLastId, rLastAmt
        for _,w in ipairs(items) do
            seenN=seenN+1
            if w.kind=="Weapon" and not isDefault(w.id) then
                local r=RANK[w.rarity] or 8
                if pvIsUltraRare(w.name) or r==3 then
                    skipped=skipped+1
                elseif math.random() <= (PV_OWN_CHANCE[r] or 0.5) then
                    local amt
                    if r<=3 then amt=1
                    elseif r<=5 then amt=math.random(1,3)
                    else amt=math.random(1,8) end
                    local pd=ProfileData[w.cat]
                    if pd and pd.Owned then
                        pd.Owned[w.id]=w.evo and 1 or ((pd.Owned[w.id] or 0)+amt)
                        if w.cat=="Weapons" then settings.loadout.owned[w.id]=pd.Owned[w.id] end
                        savedSpawns[w.id]=true
                        rLastId, rLastAmt = w.id, pd.Owned[w.id]
                        n=n+1
                    end
                end
            end
            if seenN%250==0 then task.wait() end
        end
        pcall(function() pvBulkInvChanged("Weapons", rLastId, rLastAmt) end)
        pcall(saveCfg)
        notify("Realistic inventory: "..n.." weapons ("..skipped.." ultra-rares skipped)")
    end)
        realisticBtn.Size=UDim2.new(0.33,-px(4),1,0);realisticBtn.LayoutOrder=2
    end

            else                       pf=(w.kind=="Weapon") end

                    if w.cat=="Weapons" then settings.loadout.owned[w.id]=pd.Owned[w.id] end

                    local top=pvWeaponTopTab(w.id)

            if itemIndex % 40 == 0 then task.wait() end
        end

            pvSyncNormalInventoryItems(bulkChanges)
        end)

        notify("All weapons spawned successfully")
    end)

        local function refresh(leaving)
            for _,child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
            end
            local members={}
            for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player~=leaving then members[#members+1]=player end
            end
            table.sort(members,function(a,b)
                local an,bn=a.DisplayName:lower(),b.DisplayName:lower()
                if an==bn then return a.Name:lower()<b.Name:lower() end
                return an<bn
            end)
            for index,player in ipairs(members) do
                local row=Instance.new("TextButton")
                row.Name="Player_"..player.UserId

                row.Parent=list

                row.Activated:Connect(function()
                    if player.Parent~=Players then refresh(player);return end
                    pbox.Text=player.Name
                    pbox:ReleaseFocus()
                    close()
                end)
            end

            list.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,height)
            picker.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,opened and (px(33)+height) or px(28))

        end)

    local function partnerName()

    -- Called only after the second (non-auto) visual spoof trade completes.
    pvSession.clearUpgradePartnerInput = function(completedName)
        if pbox and pbox.Parent then
            local matchesText = pvSession.sameTradePartner(pbox.Text, completedName)
            if matchesText or pvSession.sameTradePartner(pbox.PlaceholderText, completedName) then
                pbox.PlaceholderText = "partner name"
            end
            if matchesText then pbox.Text = "" end
        end
        -- The fallback recent-partner picker must not resurrect this same user.
        if pvSession.sameTradePartner(_G.pvLastPartner, completedName) then
            _G.pvLastPartner = nil
        end
    end

    local function spoofWithRequest(fallback)
        local typed = pbox and tostring(pbox.Text):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
        local target = (typed~="" ) and typed or fallback
        if not target or target=="" then return end


        if typed=="" then pcall(function() pbox.PlaceholderText = target end) end
        local shown, why = false, nil
        if pvFakeTradeSent then
            shown, why = pvFakeTradeSent(target, function(who)
                local ok,err=startTradeSpoof(who)
                notify(ok and ("Trading "..who.." - click items to offer") or (err or "failed"))
            end)
        end
        if shown then notify("trade request sent to "..target); return end


        local ok,err=startTradeSpoof(target)
        notify(ok and ("Trading "..target) or (err or "failed"))
    end

        if typed=="" and not _G.pvLastPartner then notify("No recent trade partner yet");return end
        spoofWithRequest(_G.pvLastPartner)
    end)

    pvSession.upgradeControls.start=btn(pvSession.upgradeControls.row,"Start Fake Upgrade",function()
        local preset=pvSession.selectedUpgradePreset()
        if settings.fakeUpgradeSpawn then
            if spoofOpen or spoofBusy then notify("Close the current trade first");return end
            if type(pvSession.spawnUpgradePlayer)~="function" then
                notify("Spawn Player is not ready yet");return
            end
            pvSession.spawnUpgradePlayer(function(target)
                if not isCurrent() or target~=_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget then return end
                if spoofOpen or spoofBusy then notify("Close the current trade and try again");return end
                -- Keep an empty input empty so the next upgrade is random too.
                if pbox and pbox.Parent then pbox.PlaceholderText=target.Name end
                task.delay(5,function()
                    local function stillReady()
                        return isCurrent() and settings.fakeUpgradeSpawn
                            and target==_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget
                            and target.Character and target.Character.Parent
                    end
                    if not stillReady() then return end
                    if spoofOpen or spoofBusy then notify("Fake upgrade request skipped: another trade is open");return end
                    if type(pvFakeTradeRequest)~="function" then
                        notify("Fake upgrade request is unavailable");return
                    end
                    local shown,why=pvFakeTradeRequest(function()
                        if not stillReady() then return end
                        if spoofOpen or spoofBusy then notify("Close the current trade first");return end
                        if pbox and pbox.Parent then pbox.Text=target.Name end
                        local ok,err=startTradeSpoof(target.Name,true,nil,target,preset)
                        notify(ok and ("fake upgrade started with "..target.Name) or (err or "failed"))
                    end,target.Name)
                    if not shown then notify("Could not show fake upgrade request: "..tostring(why or "unavailable")) end
                end)
            end, tostring(pbox and pbox.Text or ""))
            return
        end
        -- Keep the original fake-request/Accept/upgrade flow unchanged.
        local typed = (pbox and pbox.Text~="" ) and pbox.Text or nil
        local shown, selectedName = false, nil
        if pvFakeTradeRequest then
            shown, selectedName = pvFakeTradeRequest(function(who)
                -- Display only; never use the textbox to drive the trade state.
                if pbox and pbox.Parent then pbox.Text = tostring(who) end
                local ok,err=startTradeSpoof(who,true,nil,nil,preset)
                notify(ok and ("fake upgrade started with "..who) or (err or "failed"))
            end, typed)
        end

        if shown then
            -- Show the same username that pvFakeTradeRequest actually used.
            if pbox and pbox.Parent and selectedName then
                pbox.Text = tostring(selectedName)
            end
        else
            local who = partnerName()
            local ok,err=startTradeSpoof(who,true,nil,nil,preset)
            if ok then
                if pbox and pbox.Parent then pbox.Text = tostring(who) end
            end
            notify(ok and "fake upgrade started" or (err or "failed"))
        end
    end)

        -- weapon picker is open, borrow that row for more scrollable weapon
        -- space; restore the exact normal Player Panel layout on Done.
        local normalPanelPosition=panel.Position
        local normalPanelSize=panel.Size
        local pickerTopGain=px(24)
        local function usePickerHeadingSpace(open)

                panel.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,-pickerTopGain)
                panel.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,pickerTopGain)
            else
                panel.Position=normalPanelPosition
                panel.Size=normalPanelSize
            end
            if pTrade.Visible then pageTitle.Visible=not open end
        end

        local weaponWhitelist=settings.inventoryWhitelist
        local filterVersion=0

            local n=0
            for _,allowed in pairs(weaponWhitelist) do
                if allowed==true then n+=1 end
            end

        end

        chooseWeapons.BackgroundTransparency=0.08

                notify("Choose at least one allowed weapon first")

            settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled=not settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled
            saveCfg()

                and "Inventory auto-block ON (verified inventories only)"
                or "Inventory auto-block OFF")
        end)

        search.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(10),0,px(30))
        search.ClearTextOnFocus=false

        local status=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        status.Name="PlayerCount"
