        local roster=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        roster.Name="BlockPlayerRoster"
        roster.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(4),px(101))
        roster.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(8),1,-px(106))
        roster.BackgroundTransparency=1
        roster.BorderSizePixel=0
        roster.Active=true
        roster.ScrollingDirection=Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
        roster.ScrollBarThickness=px(3)
        roster.ScrollBarImageColor3=T.pink
        roster.CanvasSize=UDim2.new()
        roster.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        roster.Parent=panel

        local rosterPadding=Instance.new("UIPadding")
        rosterPadding.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,px(2))
        rosterPadding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,px(5))
        rosterPadding.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,px(2))
        rosterPadding.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,px(8))
        rosterPadding.Parent=roster

        local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,px(6))
        layout.Parent=roster

        local pendingUserId=nil
        local sendingTradeUserId=nil
        local tradeRequestSerial=0
        local lastTradeRequestAt=-math.huge
        local refresh

        -- Real per-player inventory only. A failed/missing remote is shown as
        -- unavailable: never infer another player's weapons from their avatar.
        -- The USD ranking uses the SAME PV_VALUES / PV_VALUES_CHROMA tables as
        -- the live-pulls logger later in this file.
        local weaponSnapshots={}
        -- Retain the last confirmed inventory only for this running session.
        -- A new Player object on rejoin must always fetch fresh server data.
        local lastKnownWeapons={}
        local lastKnownTotals={}
        local SNAPSHOT_SECONDS=180
        local FAILURE_RETRY_SECONDS=10
        -- First attempt starts immediately in a background task. When a player
        -- is still joining, retry on a short, bounded schedule without UI polling.
        -- Avoid repeated huge RemoteFunction replies during a player's join.
        -- Give MM2 time to replicate rather than rapid-fire seven retries.
        local INVENTORY_RETRY_DELAYS={0,2.5,5.0,8.0}
        -- Limit concurrent server calls so large lobbies do not send a burst.
        local INVENTORY_MAX_PARALLEL=1 -- isolate server responses; avoid join bursts
        local inventoryActive=0
        local inventoryNextRequestAt=0
        -- A single full-inventory reply may cause a Roblox-side decode spike.
        -- Space *all* initial and verification replies apart even if the
        -- request itself returns instantly.
        local INVENTORY_RESPONSE_GAP=2.25
        local lastPlayerJoinAt=-math.huge
        local inventoryRefreshQueued=false
        local function queueInventoryRefresh()
            if inventoryRefreshQueued or not panel.Visible or not pTrade.Visible then return end
            inventoryRefreshQueued=true
            -- Join scans and value changes are coalesced into one UI refresh.
            -- Longer delay while auto-block is active avoids a card redraw
            -- competing with an inventory response and a native block prompt.
            local delaySeconds=settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled and 0.85 or 0.35
            task.delay(delaySeconds,function()
                if not isCurrent() then inventoryRefreshQueued=false; return end
                while _G.pvBlockInProgress do
                    if not isCurrent() then inventoryRefreshQueued=false; return end
                    task.wait(0.20)
                end
                inventoryRefreshQueued=false
                if panel.Visible and pTrade.Visible and refresh then refresh() end
            end)
        end
        local function canLoad(player,snapshot)
            return isCurrent() and player.Parent==Players
                and weaponSnapshots[player.UserId]==snapshot
                and snapshot.state=="loading"
        end
        -- Share one server-request gate between initial inventory reads AND
        -- second-pass auto-block verification. They previously used different
        -- counters and could both receive huge payloads in one frame.
        local function invokeInventoryThrottled(player,stillValid)
            while inventoryActive>=INVENTORY_MAX_PARALLEL
                or os.clock()<inventoryNextRequestAt
                or _G.pvBlockInProgress do
                if not stillValid() then return false,nil end
                task.wait(0.12)
            end
            if not stillValid() then return false,nil end
            local remote=RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            remote=remote and remote:FindFirstChild("Extras")
            remote=remote and remote:FindFirstChild("GetFullInventory")
            if not (remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then return false,nil end
            inventoryActive+=1
            -- Stagger the start of expensive requests; don't hold the UI thread.
            inventoryNextRequestAt=os.clock()+INVENTORY_RESPONSE_GAP
            local ok,data=pcall(function() return remote:InvokeServer(player.Name) end)
            -- The critical separation is *after* decoding the previous
            -- response, not just between the InvokeServer start times.
            inventoryNextRequestAt=math.max(inventoryNextRequestAt,os.clock()+INVENTORY_RESPONSE_GAP)
            inventoryActive=math.max(0,inventoryActive-1)
            return ok,data
        end
        local function requestInventory(player,snapshot)
            return invokeInventoryThrottled(player,function()
                return canLoad(player,snapshot)
            end)
        end

        local function bestWeaponsFromInventory(data)
            local weaponsData=type(data)=="table" and data.Weapons
            local owned=type(weaponsData)=="table" and weaponsData.Owned
            if type(owned)~="table" then return nil end
            local top={}
            local ownedIds={}
            local totalUSD=0
            local catalog=Sync and Sync.Weapons
            local standard=type(PV_VALUES)=="table" and PV_VALUES or {}
            local chromas=type(PV_VALUES_CHROMA)=="table" and PV_VALUES_CHROMA or {}
            local processed=0
            for id,qty in pairs(owned) do
                processed+=1
                -- Inventory parsing runs in its own task. Yield every small batch
                -- so large joining inventories cannot stall rendering/UI input.
                if processed%8==0 then task.wait() end
                local amount=tonumber(qty)
                if type(qty)=="table" then amount=tonumber(qty.Amount or qty.Count) end
                if amount and amount>0 then
                    ownedIds[tostring(id)]=true
                    local info=catalog and (catalog[id] or catalog[tostring(id)])
                    if type(info)=="table" then
                        local shown=tostring(info.ItemName or id)
                        local base=shown:gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s+","")
                        local chroma=info.Chroma==true or shown~=base
                        local worth=(chroma and chromas[base]) or standard[base]
                        if type(worth)=="number" and worth>0 then
                            local ownedCount=math.floor(amount)
                            totalUSD+=worth*ownedCount
                            -- Keep just three best entries, avoiding a full sort
                            -- and hundreds of extra tables for large inventories.
                            local position=#top+1
                            for i=1,#top do
                                local candidate=top[i]
                                if worth>candidate.value or
                                    (worth==candidate.value and shown<candidate.name) then
                                    position=i
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                            if position<=3 then
                                table.insert(top,position,{
                                    id=tostring(id),name=shown,chroma=chroma,
                                    value=worth,amount=ownedCount,image=info.Image
                                })
                                if #top>3 then table.remove(top,4) end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return top,math.floor(totalUSD*100+0.5)/100,ownedIds
        end

        local function loadPlayerWeapons(player)
            local id=player.UserId
            local old=weaponSnapshots[id]
            if old and old.player==player then
                local cooldown=old.state=="ready" and SNAPSHOT_SECONDS or FAILURE_RETRY_SECONDS
                if old.state=="loading" or os.clock()-old.at<cooldown then
                    return old
                end
            end

            -- A rejoin creates a different Player instance even for the same UserId.
            -- Use previous confirmed items only as a labelled last-seen preview.
            local snapshot={
                player=player, state="loading", at=os.clock(),
                items=lastKnownWeapons[id],
                totalUSD=lastKnownTotals[id]
            }
            weaponSnapshots[id]=snapshot
            task.spawn(function()
                for attempt,delaySeconds in ipairs(INVENTORY_RETRY_DELAYS) do
                    if delaySeconds>0 then task.wait(delaySeconds) end
                    if not canLoad(player,snapshot) then return end

                    local ok,data=requestInventory(player,snapshot)
                    if not canLoad(player,snapshot) then return end

                    -- Built-in USD tables initialize later during startup.
                    if ok and type(data)=="table" then
                        local deadline=os.clock()+15
                        while canLoad(player,snapshot)
                            and not (type(PV_VALUES)=="table" and type(PV_VALUES_CHROMA)=="table")
                            and os.clock()<deadline do
                            task.wait(0.10)
                        end
                    end
                    if not canLoad(player,snapshot) then return end
                    local ranked,totalUSD,ownedIds
                    if ok and type(PV_VALUES)=="table"
                        and type(PV_VALUES_CHROMA)=="table" then
                        ranked,totalUSD,ownedIds=bestWeaponsFromInventory(data)
                    end
                    -- Inventory ranking is time-sliced, so re-check the player
                    -- and snapshot after it yields before publishing results.
                    if not canLoad(player,snapshot) then return end
                    if ranked then
                        -- Some sessions briefly return an empty inventory while
                        -- the player is loading. Verify again before caching it.
                        local owned=type(data.Weapons)=="table" and data.Weapons.Owned
                        local populated=type(owned)=="table" and next(owned)~=nil
                        if populated or attempt==#INVENTORY_RETRY_DELAYS then
                            snapshot.items=ranked
                            snapshot.totalUSD=totalUSD
                            snapshot.ownedIds=ownedIds
                            -- Empty/partially replicated inventories aren't safe to
                            -- use as evidence that a player lacks a weapon.
                            snapshot.freshOwned=populated==true
                            snapshot.state="ready"
                            snapshot.at=os.clock()
                            lastKnownWeapons[id]=ranked
                            lastKnownTotals[id]=totalUSD
                            queueInventoryRefresh()
                            if snapshot.freshOwned and onInventoryReady then
                                onInventoryReady(player,snapshot)
                            end
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not isCurrent() or weaponSnapshots[id]~=snapshot
                    or player.Parent~=Players then return end
                snapshot.state="unavailable"
                snapshot.at=os.clock()
                -- Preserve last-confirmed items; do not replace them with nil.
                queueInventoryRefresh()
            end)
            -- An unresponsive InvokeServer must not leave an endless spinner.
            task.delay(30,function()
                if not isCurrent() or weaponSnapshots[id]~=snapshot
                    or player.Parent~=Players then return end
                if snapshot.state=="loading" then
                    snapshot.state="unavailable"
                    snapshot.at=os.clock()
                    queueInventoryRefresh()
                end
            end)
            return snapshot
        end

        -- Pre-fetch all current players without showing or building any cards.
        -- Returned results are cached by UserId, including the last valid data
        -- when a player leaves and later rejoins.
        task.defer(function()
            for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if other~=LP and isCurrent() then
                    loadPlayerWeapons(other)
                    task.wait(0.24)
                end
            end
        end)

        local function addWeaponModel(preview,item)
            local function install(entry)
                if not isCurrent() or not preview.Parent or not entry or not entry.template then return end
                local cardPreview=preview:GetAttribute("pvCardWeaponPreview")==true
                local helperPreview=preview:GetAttribute("pvHelperWeaponPreview")==true
                -- Helper models are opt-in: avoid unexpected asset loads, and
                -- reject callbacks that return after 3D was switched off.
                if helperPreview then
                    if preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowHelper3D")~=true then return end
                    local ok,descendants=pcall(function() return entry.template:GetDescendants() end)
                    if not ok or #descendants>48 or preview:FindFirstChild("Weapon3D") then return end
                end
                -- Auto-block on: headshots, weapon icons and USD values remain;
                -- defer 3D cloning to avoid joining-inventory frame spikes.
                if cardPreview and (settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled
                    or not panel.Visible or preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowCard3D")~=true) then return end
                local selector=preview:FindFirstAncestor("InventoryWeaponPicker")
                if selector then
                    -- Picker 3D previews are strictly opt-in per visible tile.
                    -- A scroll or page change disables this flag immediately,
                    -- even for asynchronous callbacks from old model requests.
                    if not selector.Visible or preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowPicker3D")~=true then return end
                    local safe,descendants=pcall(function() return entry.template:GetDescendants() end)
                    if not safe or #descendants>65 then return end
                    if preview:FindFirstChild("Weapon3D") then return end
                elseif cardPreview then
                    local safe,descendants=pcall(function() return entry.template:GetDescendants() end)
                    if not safe or #descendants>55 or preview:FindFirstChild("Weapon3D") then return end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    local v=Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
                    v.Name="Weapon3D"
                    v.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    v.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    v.BorderSizePixel=0
                    v.Active=false -- touch/click should reach the weapon tile
                    v.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(205,196,210)
                    v.LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,231)
                    v.LightDirection=Vector3.new(-1,-1,-2)
                    v.Parent=preview
                    local world=Instance.new("WorldModel")
                    world.Parent=v
                    local model=Instance.new("Model")
                    model.Name="WeaponPreview"
                    model.Parent=world
                    local weapon=entry.template:Clone()
                    weapon.Parent=model
                    if (selector and preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowPicker3D")~=true)
                        or (cardPreview and (not panel.Visible
                            or preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowCard3D")~=true))
                        or (helperPreview and preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowHelper3D")~=true) then
                        v:Destroy()
                        return
                    end
                    local parts=0
                    for _,desc in ipairs(weapon:GetDescendants()) do
                        if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
                            desc.Anchored=true
                            desc.CanCollide=false
                            parts+=1
                        elseif desc:IsA("Script") or desc:IsA("LocalScript") then
                            desc:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                    if parts==0 then v:Destroy();return end
                    local bounds,dim=model:GetBoundingBox()
                    model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-bounds.Position)*model:GetPivot())
                    local radius=math.max(dim.X,dim.Y,dim.Z,0.5)
                    local camera=Instance.new("Camera")
                    camera.FieldOfView=40
                    camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(radius*1.5,radius*0.85,radius*2.15),Vector3.zero)
                    camera.Parent=v
                    v.CurrentCamera=camera
                    if (selector and preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowPicker3D")~=true)
                        or (cardPreview and (not panel.Visible
                            or preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowCard3D")~=true))
                        or (helperPreview and preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowHelper3D")~=true) then
                        v:Destroy()
                        return
                    end
                    local image=preview:FindFirstChild("WeaponIcon")
                    if image then image.Visible=false end
                end)
            end
            local cached=_G.pvHeldAssetCache
            if type(cached)=="table" and type(cached[item.id])=="table" then
                install(cached[item.id]);return
            end
            if type(pvLoadExactHeldGun)=="function" then
                pcall(pvLoadExactHeldGun,item.id,function(ok,entry)
                    if ok then install(entry) end
                end)
                -- Another screen may already be loading this asset; its
                -- original loader allows only one callback per weapon ID.
                task.spawn(function()
                    -- No per-frame scan: at most eight 1-second checks, and
                    -- stop as soon as the preview is gone or the model appears.
                    for _=1,8 do
                        task.wait(1)
                        if not isCurrent() or not preview.Parent
                            or (helperPreview and preview:GetAttribute("pvAllowHelper3D")~=true)
                            or preview:FindFirstChild("Weapon3D") then return end
                        local asset=_G.pvHeldAssetCache
                        if type(asset)=="table" and type(asset[item.id])=="table" then
                            install(asset[item.id]);return
                        end
                        if type(asset)=="table" and asset[item.id]==false then return end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        -- The upgrade helper uses this same renderer for its 46x38 previews.
        -- It lives outside the Player Panel, so it skips the roster/picker limits.
        pvSession.renderWeapon3D = addWeaponModel

        -- Lightweight player-card previews: the icon appears immediately.
        -- Only two *visible* 3D models may exist at once. Build after joins and
        -- scrolling settle; discard invisible models to avoid GPU spikes.
        local cardPreviewJobs=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
        local activeCardPreviews=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
        local cardPreviewWorkerRunning=false
        local lastCardScrollAt=-math.huge
        local MAX_VISIBLE_CARD_MODELS=2
        local function cardPreviewVisible(preview)
            if not preview.Parent or not preview:IsDescendantOf(roster) then return false end
            local y=preview.AbsolutePosition.Y
            local h=preview.AbsoluteSize.Y
            local top=roster.AbsolutePosition.Y
            local bottom=top+roster.AbsoluteSize.Y
            return y+h>top+px(6) and y<bottom-px(6)
        end
        local function ensureCardPreviewWorker()
            -- 3D is disabled only while the auto-block scanner is enabled;
            -- lightweight weapon images still render without delay.
            if settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled then return end
            if cardPreviewWorkerRunning then return end
            cardPreviewWorkerRunning=true
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(1.4)
                while isCurrent() do
                    if settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled then break end
                    local active=0
                    for preview,item in pairs(activeCardPreviews) do
                        if not preview.Parent or not panel.Visible or not pTrade.Visible
                            or not cardPreviewVisible(preview) then
                            if preview.Parent then
                                preview:SetAttribute("pvAllowCard3D",false)
                                local viewport=preview:FindFirstChild("Weapon3D")
                                if viewport then viewport:Destroy() end
                                local icon=preview:FindFirstChild("WeaponIcon")
                                if icon then icon.Visible=true end
                                cardPreviewJobs[preview]=item
                            end
                            activeCardPreviews[preview]=nil
                        else
                            active+=1
                        end
                    end
                    local pending=false
                    for preview in pairs(cardPreviewJobs) do
                        if not preview.Parent then
                            cardPreviewJobs[preview]=nil
                        else
                            pending=true
                        end
                    end
                    if not panel.Visible or not pTrade.Visible then
                        -- No UI work while viewing Settings/Items. Pending icons
                        -- are upgraded only after the Player Panel is reopened.
                        break
                    end
                    if not pending and active==0 then break end
                    local allowed=panel.Visible and pTrade.Visible
                        and not _G.pvBlockInProgress
                        and os.clock()-lastPlayerJoinAt>=8.0
                        and os.clock()-lastCardScrollAt>=0.8
                    if allowed and active<MAX_VISIBLE_CARD_MODELS then
                        local chosen,chosenItem
                        for preview,item in pairs(cardPreviewJobs) do
                            if cardPreviewVisible(preview) then
                                chosen,chosenItem=preview,item
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if chosen then
                            cardPreviewJobs[chosen]=nil
                            chosen:SetAttribute("pvAllowCard3D",true)
                            activeCardPreviews[chosen]=chosenItem
                            addWeaponModel(chosen,chosenItem)
                            -- Do not clone several meshes in the same frame.
                            task.wait(1.15)
                        else
                            task.wait(0.65)
                        end
                    else
                        task.wait(0.65)
                    end
                end
                cardPreviewWorkerRunning=false
            end)
        end
        local function scheduleWeaponModel(preview,item)
            preview:SetAttribute("pvCardWeaponPreview",true)
            cardPreviewJobs[preview]=item
            ensureCardPreviewWorker()
        end
        -- When auto-block turns on, release the few existing viewport models.
        -- Turning it off resumes the deferred 3D previews automatically.
        pvSession.connect(filterToggle.Activated,function()
            task.defer(function()
                if not isCurrent() then return end
                if settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled then
                    for preview,item in pairs(activeCardPreviews) do
                        if preview.Parent then
                            preview:SetAttribute("pvAllowCard3D",false)
                            local viewport=preview:FindFirstChild("Weapon3D")
                            if viewport then viewport:Destroy() end
                            local icon=preview:FindFirstChild("WeaponIcon")
                            if icon then icon.Visible=true end
                            cardPreviewJobs[preview]=item
                        end
                        activeCardPreviews[preview]=nil
                    end
                else
                    ensureCardPreviewWorker()
                end
            end)
        end)
        pvSession.connect(roster:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"),function()
            lastCardScrollAt=os.clock()
        end)
        pvSession.connect(panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function()
            if panel.Visible and pTrade.Visible and next(cardPreviewJobs)~=nil then
                ensureCardPreviewWorker()
            end
        end)
        pvSession.connect(pTrade:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function()
            if pTrade.Visible and panel.Visible then
                queueInventoryRefresh()
                if next(cardPreviewJobs)~=nil then ensureCardPreviewWorker() end
            end
        end)


        -- Player cards share the same tinted glass as the parent theme.
        -- Avoid the old near-black tile backgrounds, especially on Halloween
        -- and photo-based Custom UI. A small accent tint preserves contrast
        -- without making a solid rectangular plate inside the window.
        local function playerCardGlass()
            local theme=settings.uiTheme
            local halloween=theme=="Halloween"
            local custom=theme=="Custom"
            local tint=T.pane:Lerp(T.pinkDim,halloween and 0.10 or 0.08)
            return tint,halloween,custom
        end

        local function styleBlockPanelWeaponTile(tile)
            if not (tile and tile.Parent) then return end
            local tint,halloween,custom=playerCardGlass()
            -- Halloween weapon tiles use the same soft purple-charcoal
            -- surface as WEAPONS and AUTO: OFF (rather than darkening black).
            tile.BackgroundColor3=halloween and T.black or tint
            tile.BackgroundTransparency=halloween and 0.08 or (custom and 0.52 or 0.26)
            local tileStroke=tile:FindFirstChild("pvBlockPanelTileStroke")
            if not (tileStroke and tileStroke:IsA("UIStroke")) then
                tileStroke=stroke(tile,0.45,1,T.line)
                tileStroke.Name="pvBlockPanelTileStroke"
            end
            tileStroke.Color=T.line
            tileStroke.Transparency=custom and 0.55 or (halloween and 0.43 or 0.38)
            tileStroke.Thickness=1
        end

        local function styleBlockPanelCard(row)
            if not (row and row.Parent) then return end
            local tint,halloween,custom=playerCardGlass()
            -- Same Halloween background and opacity as the WEAPONS and
            -- AUTO: OFF toolbar buttons. Keep the orange outline for contrast.
            row.BackgroundColor3=halloween and T.black or tint
            row.BackgroundTransparency=halloween and 0.08 or (custom and 0.48 or 0.25)

            local cardStroke=row:FindFirstChild("pvBlockCardStroke")
            if not (cardStroke and cardStroke:IsA("UIStroke")) then
                cardStroke=stroke(row,0.35,1,T.pink)
                cardStroke.Name="pvBlockCardStroke"
            end
            cardStroke.Color=T.pink
            cardStroke.Transparency=custom and 0.46 or (halloween and 0.32 or 0.32)
            cardStroke.Thickness=1

            -- The old gradient ended at T.black, making a large black box.
            -- Keep a very faint tint-only gradient instead, so the window's
            -- Halloween/Custom background can show through the card.
            local depth=row:FindFirstChild("pvBlockCardDepth")
            if not (depth and depth:IsA("UIGradient")) then
                depth=Instance.new("UIGradient")
                depth.Name="pvBlockCardDepth"
                depth.Rotation=90
                depth.Parent=row
            end
            depth.Color=ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,tint:Lerp(T.pink,0.035)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,tint:Lerp(T.pane,0.12)),
            })
            depth.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.02),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.10),
            })
            -- Even a faint depth gradient makes Halloween cards look nearly
            -- solid black. The matching toolbar buttons have no gradient.
            depth.Enabled=not halloween

            local avatar=row:FindFirstChild("Avatar")
            if avatar then
                local avatarStroke=avatar:FindFirstChild("pvAvatarStroke")
                if not (avatarStroke and avatarStroke:IsA("UIStroke")) then
                    avatarStroke=stroke(avatar,0.22,1,T.pinkDim)
                    avatarStroke.Name="pvAvatarStroke"
                end
                avatarStroke.Color=T.pinkDim
                avatarStroke.Transparency=0.18
                avatarStroke.Thickness=1
            end

            local tradeButton=row:FindFirstChild("TradeUser")
            if tradeButton and tradeButton:IsA("TextButton") then
                tradeButton.BackgroundColor3=T.pane
                tradeButton.BackgroundTransparency=custom and 0.40 or (halloween and 0.30 or 0.24)
                tradeButton.TextColor3=T.txt
                local tradeStroke=tradeButton:FindFirstChild("pvTradeStroke")
                if not (tradeStroke and tradeStroke:IsA("UIStroke")) then
                    tradeStroke=stroke(tradeButton,0.35,1,T.line)
                    tradeStroke.Name="pvTradeStroke"
                end
                tradeStroke.Color=T.line
                tradeStroke.Transparency=0.30
                tradeStroke.Thickness=1
            end

            local blockButton=row:FindFirstChild("BlockUser")
            if blockButton and blockButton:IsA("TextButton") then
                local blocked=string.upper(tostring(blockButton.Text))=="BLOCKED"
                if blocked then
                    blockButton.BackgroundColor3=T.black
                    blockButton.BackgroundTransparency=0.20
                    blockButton.TextColor3=T.sub
                else
                    blockButton.BackgroundColor3=T.pinkDim
                    blockButton.BackgroundTransparency=0
                    blockButton.TextColor3=T.txt
                end
                local blockStroke=blockButton:FindFirstChild("pvBlockStroke")
                if not (blockStroke and blockStroke:IsA("UIStroke")) then
                    blockStroke=stroke(blockButton,0.22,1,T.pink)
                    blockStroke.Name="pvBlockStroke"
                end
                blockStroke.Color=blocked and T.line or T.pink
                blockStroke.Transparency=blocked and 0.34 or 0.18
                blockStroke.Thickness=1
            end
        end

        local function displayUSDTotal(number)
            local whole,cents=("%.2f"):format(math.max(0,number)):match("^(%d+)(%.%d+)$")
            whole=whole:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)","%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,","")
            return "$"..whole..cents
        end

        local function showTopWeapons(row,player)
            local summary=loadPlayerWeapons(player)
            local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")

                and "TOP WEAPONS  /  LAST SEEN"

            -- the server is refreshing that player's real inventory.
            if type(summary.totalUSD)=="number" then

                totalLabel.Parent=row

            local items=summary and summary.items

                msg.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(9),px(110))

                icon.BackgroundTransparency=1

                name.Name="WeaponName"

            local function clearPicker3D()
                -- Only visit the small active set, not the entire weapon list.
                -- Static thumbnails remain visible while the scroll moves.
                for preview in pairs(activePicker3D) do
                    activePicker3D[preview]=nil
                    if preview.Parent then
                        preview:SetAttribute("pvAllowPicker3D",false)
                        local model=preview:FindFirstChild("Weapon3D")
                        if model then model:Destroy() end
                        local icon=preview:FindFirstChild("WeaponIcon")
                        if icon then icon.Visible=true end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- The weapons catalog is assembled in small batches on a worker.
            -- Opening the panel therefore never waits for all MM2 items to be
            -- scanned and sorted on the UI thread.
            local function catalog()
                if entries then return entries end
                if not catalogBusy then
                    catalogBusy=true
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local found={}
                        local n=0
                        for id,info in pairs(Sync.Weapons or {}) do
                            if not isCurrent() then return end
                            if type(info)=="table" then
                                local typ=tostring(info.ItemType or "")
                                if typ=="Knife" or typ=="Gun" then
                                    local name=tostring(info.ItemName or id)
                                    -- The game includes unrevealed gun records
                                    -- named "???" with silhouette thumbnails.
                                    -- Normal Pork Hub Items already skips those
                                    -- records; the whitelist picker should too.
                                    -- They cannot be reliably identified as a
                                    -- selectable, owned weapon until revealed.
                                    if name=="" or name:find("?",1,true) then
                                        -- Also discard a previously selected
                                        -- placeholder so it cannot silently
                                        -- keep triggering auto-block checks.
                                        local unknownId=tostring(id)
                                        if weaponWhitelist[unknownId]==true then
                                            weaponWhitelist[unknownId]=nil
                                            dirty=true
                                            filterVersion+=1
                                        end
                                    else
                                        local r=tostring(info.Rarity or "Other")
                                        local base=name:gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s+","")
                                        local chroma=info.Chroma==true or base~=name
                                        local price=(chroma and type(PV_VALUES_CHROMA)=="table"
                                            and PV_VALUES_CHROMA[base])
                                            or (type(PV_VALUES)=="table" and PV_VALUES[base])
                                        found[#found+1]={
                                            id=tostring(id),name=name,rarity=r,
                                            searchName=name:lower(),
                                            value=type(price)=="number" and price or nil,
                                            image=info.Image
                                        }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            n+=1
                            if n%48==0 then task.wait() end
                        end
                        local rank={Ancient=1,Godly=2,Unique=3,Vintage=4,
                            Legendary=5,Rare=6,Uncommon=7,Common=8,Other=9}
                        table.sort(found,function(a,b)
                            local x,y=rank[a.rarity] or 9,rank[b.rarity] or 9
                            if x~=y then return x<y end
                            if a.name~=b.name then return a.name<b.name end
                            return a.id<b.id
                        end)
                        if not isCurrent() then return end
                        entries=found
                        catalogBusy=false
                        if picker.Visible then
                            buildRarityTabs()
                            rebuild()
                        end
                    end)
                end
                return nil
            end

            local function updateChip(chip,nm)
                local selected=(nm==rarity)
                chip.BackgroundColor3=selected and T.pinkDim or T.pane
                chip.BackgroundTransparency=selected and 0.04 or 0.22
                chip.TextColor3=selected and T.txt or T.sub
                local edge=chip:FindFirstChild("RarityChipOutline")
                if edge then
                    edge.Color=selected and T.pink or T.line
                    edge.Transparency=selected and 0.34 or 0.82
                end
            end
            buildRarityTabs=function()
                for _,child in ipairs(rarities:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
                end
                -- Hide Vintage as a separate picker filter. Vintage items
                -- remain available under ALL and still count for whitelist checks.
                local names={"ALL","Ancient","Godly","Unique",
                    "Legendary","Rare","Uncommon","Common"}
                local known={Vintage=true}
                for _,nm in ipairs(names) do known[nm]=true end
                for _,entry in ipairs(entries or {}) do
                    if not known[entry.rarity] then
                        known[entry.rarity]=true
                        names[#names+1]=entry.rarity
                    end
                end
                -- 3 columns keeps LEGENDARY and UNCOMMON readable at
                -- the same size as the shorter rarity labels.
                local columns=3
                local rows=math.ceil(#names/columns)
                chipsLayout.FillDirectionMaxCells=columns
                chipsLayout.CellSize=UDim2.new(1/columns,-px(6),0,px(24))
                local rarityHeight=rows*28+px(1)
                rarities.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(10),0,px(rarityHeight))
                local bulkTop=69+rarityHeight+5
                bulkBar.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(5),px(bulkTop))
                -- Reserve a real row for these actions so they never overlap
                -- or crop the rarity chips, weapon tiles, or bottom pagination.
                local gridTop=bulkTop+24+7
                grid.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(7),px(gridTop))
                -- Leave a slightly smaller reserve for the footer so the
                -- second row is less cropped while still clearing pagination.
                grid.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(14),1,-px(gridTop+54))
                task.defer(function()
                    if grid.Parent then sizePickerTiles();updatePickerCanvas() end
                end)
                for i,nm in ipairs(names) do
                    local chip=Instance.new("TextButton")
                    chip.Name="Rarity_"..nm
                    chip.LayoutOrder=i
                    chip.BackgroundColor3=T.black
                    chip.BorderSizePixel=0
                    chip.Text=string.upper(nm)
                    chip.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    chip.TextScaled=false
                    chip.TextSize=px(8)
                    chip.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    chip.AutoButtonColor=false
                    chip.Parent=rarities
                    corner(chip,px(7))
                    local chipEdge=stroke(chip,0.82,1,T.line)
                    chipEdge.Name="RarityChipOutline"
                    updateChip(chip,nm)
                    chip.Activated:Connect(function()
                        rarity=nm
                        currentPage=1
                        activeBulkAction=nil
                        updateBulkButtons()
                        -- Don't recreate the whole row of tabs on each click.
                        for _,child in ipairs(rarities:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                                updateChip(child,child.Name:sub(#"Rarity_"+1))
                            end
                        end
                        rebuild()
                    end)
                end
            end

            -- 3D previews are expensive to clone/render on low-end clients.
            -- Show lightweight icons while moving the list, then upgrade only
            -- TWO tiles actually visible after scrolling has settled.
            local loadPickerPreviews
            local function visibleTile(preview)
                if not preview or not preview.Parent or not preview:IsDescendantOf(grid) then return false end
                local tile=preview.Parent
                local top=tile.AbsolutePosition.Y
                local bottom=top+tile.AbsoluteSize.Y
                local viewTop=grid.AbsolutePosition.Y
                local viewBottom=viewTop+grid.AbsoluteSize.Y
                return bottom>viewTop+px(6) and top<viewBottom-px(6)
            end

            loadPickerPreviews=function(jobs)
                previewGeneration+=1
                local token=previewGeneration
                task.spawn(function()
                    -- Never clone model geometry while a wheel/touch scroll is active.
                    task.wait(3.0)
                    if not isCurrent() or not picker.Visible
                        or token~=previewGeneration or _G.pvBlockInProgress
                        or os.clock()-lastScrollAt<2.6
                        or os.clock()-lastPickerTap<2.6 then return end
                    local upgraded=0
                    for _,job in ipairs(jobs) do
                        if not isCurrent() or not picker.Visible
                            or token~=previewGeneration or _G.pvBlockInProgress
                            or os.clock()-lastPickerTap<2.6 then return end
                        if visibleTile(job.preview) then
                            job.preview:SetAttribute("pvAllowPicker3D",true)
                            activePicker3D[job.preview]=true
                            -- Existing cached models load instantly. Missing
                            -- models use the existing async loader, never the
                            -- frame-by-frame scrolling path.
                            addWeaponModel(job.preview,job.entry)
                            upgraded+=1
                            if upgraded>=1 then break end
                            task.wait(0.30)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            local function notePickerScroll()
                if not picker.Visible then return end
                lastScrollAt=os.clock()
                -- The shared smooth-scroll controller adjusts CanvasPosition
                -- every frame. Drop expensive 3D previews ONCE at the start of
                -- a gesture, not again on each eased movement/update.
                if not pickerScrollActive then
                    pickerScrollActive=true
                    previewGeneration+=1
                    clearPicker3D()
                end
                if idleScrollWorker then return end
                idleScrollWorker=true
                -- Coalesce scroll updates into one idle worker. Model loading
                -- never runs during motion and doesn't slow down wheel easing.
                task.spawn(function()
                    while isCurrent() and picker.Visible do
                        local remaining=0.70-(os.clock()-lastScrollAt)
                        if remaining<=0 then break end
                        task.wait(math.clamp(remaining,0.08,0.25))
                    end
                    idleScrollWorker=false
                    pickerScrollActive=false
                    if isCurrent() and picker.Visible and #currentPreviewJobs>0 then
                        loadPickerPreviews(currentPreviewJobs)
                    end
                end)
            end
            pvSession.connect(grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"),notePickerScroll)
            pvSession.connect(grid.InputChanged,function(input)
                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel
                    or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    notePickerScroll()
                end
            end)
            pvSession.connect(grid.InputBegan,function(input)
                if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    notePickerScroll()
                end
            end)

            rebuild=function()
                -- Invalidate old 3D loads before destroying any grid tiles.
                previewGeneration+=1
                clearPicker3D()
                currentPreviewJobs={}
                for _,child in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("GuiObject") then child:Destroy() end
                end
                local all=catalog()
                if not all then
                    local loading=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    loading.Name="LoadingWeapons"
                    loading.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    loading.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(12),0,px(52))
                    loading.Text="Loading weapon list..."
                    loading.TextColor3=T.sub
                    loading.TextSize=px(10)
                    loading.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                    loading.Parent=grid
                    task.defer(updatePickerCanvas)
                    pageStatus.Text=("Loading · %d selected"):format(selectedWeaponCount())
                    previous.Active=false
                    nextPage.Active=false
                    return
                end
                local q=tostring(pickerSearch.Text or ""):lower()
                local filtered={}
                for _,entry in ipairs(all) do
                    if (rarity=="ALL" or entry.rarity==rarity)
                        and (q=="" or entry.searchName:find(q,1,true)) then
                        filtered[#filtered+1]=entry
                    end
                end
                local pages=math.max(1,math.ceil(#filtered/PAGE_SIZE))
                currentPage=math.clamp(currentPage,1,pages)
                pageStatus.Text=("%d / %d · %d selected"):format(
                    currentPage,pages,selectedWeaponCount())
                previous.Active=currentPage>1
                nextPage.Active=currentPage<pages
                previous.TextColor3=previous.Active and T.txt or T.sub
                nextPage.TextColor3=nextPage.Active and T.txt or T.sub
                previous.BackgroundTransparency=previous.Active and 0 or 0.45
                nextPage.BackgroundTransparency=nextPage.Active and 0 or 0.45
                grid.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
                if #filtered==0 then
                    local empty=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    empty.Name="NoMatchingWeapons"
                    empty.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(12),0,px(50))
                    empty.Text="No matching weapons"
                    empty.TextSize=px(10)
                    empty.TextColor3=T.sub
                    empty.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    empty.Parent=grid
                    task.defer(updatePickerCanvas)
                    return
                end
                local previewJobs={}
                for i=(currentPage-1)*PAGE_SIZE+1,math.min(#filtered,currentPage*PAGE_SIZE) do
                    local entry=filtered[i]
                    local tile=Instance.new("TextButton")
                    tile.Name="Pick_"..entry.id
                    tile.LayoutOrder=i
                    -- Subtle glass-style cards echo the Items rows; no
                    -- solid grey blocks sitting on a dark picker rectangle.
                    tile.BackgroundColor3=weaponWhitelist[entry.id]==true and T.pinkDim or T.pane
                    tile.BackgroundTransparency=weaponWhitelist[entry.id]==true and 0.18 or 0.45
                    tile.BorderSizePixel=0
                    tile.Text=""
                    -- The visible card is presentation only; a dedicated
                    -- topmost hitbox receives clicks even over a ViewportFrame.
                    tile.Active=false
                    tile.Selectable=false
                    tile.AutoButtonColor=false
                    -- Build off-tree to avoid UI layout work for every label.
                    corner(tile,px(8))
                    local outline=stroke(tile,0.40,1,weaponWhitelist[entry.id]==true and T.pink or T.line)

                    local imageHolder=Instance.new("Frame")
                    imageHolder.Name="WeaponPreview"
                    imageHolder.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-px(22),0,px(2))
                    imageHolder.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(44),px(37))
                    imageHolder.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    imageHolder.ClipsDescendants=true
                    imageHolder.Active=false
                    imageHolder.Parent=tile
                    local image=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
                    image.Name="WeaponIcon"
                    image.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    image.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    image.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
                    image.Active=false
                    image.Parent=imageHolder
                    -- Do not call resolveImg() here: its first call may
                    -- require ItemService and scan ReplicatedStorage, causing
                    -- a long freeze when opening the weapon selector.
                    -- Use the catalog's image directly; the 3D model upgrades
                    -- it later without blocking the UI.
                    image.Image=pvFixImg(entry.image)
                    previewJobs[#previewJobs+1]={preview=imageHolder,entry=entry}

                    local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    title.Name="WeaponName"
                    title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(4),px(39))
                    title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(8),0,px(13))
                    title.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    title.Active=false
                    title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    title.TextSize=px(8)
                    title.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    title.TextColor3=T.txt
                    title.Text=entry.name
                    title.Parent=tile
                    local price=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    price.Name="RarityAndUSD"
                    price.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(4),px(53))
                    price.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(8),0,px(11))
                    price.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    price.Active=false
                    price.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
                    price.TextSize=px(7)
                    price.TextColor3=T.sub
                    price.Text=entry.rarity..(entry.value and (" · $%.2f"):format(entry.value) or "")
                    price.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                    price.Parent=tile
                    local selected=Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    selected.Name="SelectedStatus"
                    selected.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(4),px(67))
                    selected.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(8),0,px(11))
                    selected.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    selected.Active=false
                    selected.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    selected.TextSize=px(7)
                    selected.TextColor3=weaponWhitelist[entry.id]==true and T.pink or T.sub
                    selected.Text=weaponWhitelist[entry.id]==true and "TAP TO REMOVE" or "TAP TO SELECT"
                    selected.Parent=tile

                    -- A loaded 3D ViewportFrame can cover the card and swallow
                    -- its second tap. Keep exactly ONE interactive button over
                    -- the entire card (including its image, text and 3D model).
                    local hitbox=Instance.new("TextButton")
                    hitbox.Name="WeaponSelectHitbox"
                    hitbox.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,0)
                    hitbox.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
                    hitbox.BackgroundTransparency=1
                    hitbox.BorderSizePixel=0
                    hitbox.Text=""
                    hitbox.AutoButtonColor=false
                    hitbox.Active=true
                    hitbox.ZIndex=tile.ZIndex+8
                    hitbox.Parent=tile

                    local weaponId=entry.id
                    local lastToggle=-math.huge
                    hitbox.Activated:Connect(function()
                        if not isCurrent() or not picker.Visible then return end
                        -- Guard against a duplicated click dispatch, but allow
                        -- a real second click to deselect the same weapon.
                        local now=os.clock()
                        if now-lastToggle<0.10 then return end
                        lastToggle=now
                        if weaponWhitelist[weaponId]==true then
                            weaponWhitelist[weaponId]=nil
                        else
                            weaponWhitelist[weaponId]=true
                        end
                        dirty=true
                        filterVersion+=1
                        lastPickerTap=os.clock()
                        activeBulkAction=nil
                        updateBulkButtons()
                        local on=weaponWhitelist[weaponId]==true
                        -- Always restore the SAME original tile colours when
                        -- deselected, not just the status text.
                        tile.BackgroundColor3=on and T.pinkDim or T.pane
                        tile.BackgroundTransparency=on and 0.18 or 0.45
                        outline.Color=on and T.pink or T.line
                        selected.Text=on and "TAP TO REMOVE" or "TAP TO SELECT"
                        selected.TextColor3=on and T.pink or T.sub
                        pageStatus.Text=("%d / %d · %d selected"):format(
                            currentPage,pages,selectedWeaponCount())
                        updateFilterToolbar()
                        -- The entire grid is NOT rebuilt, and there are NO
                        -- disk writes/JSON encoding on weapon taps. Save once
                        -- when the user leaves the weapon selector instead.
                        -- Cancel pending model clones until taps have stopped.
                        loadPickerPreviews(currentPreviewJobs)
                    end)
                    -- Commit the fully assembled tile only once.
                    tile.Parent=grid
                end
                currentPreviewJobs=previewJobs
                task.defer(updatePickerCanvas)
                loadPickerPreviews(previewJobs)
            end

            -- Bulk actions update the existing (at most eight) visible card
            -- colours in place, with no tile/model rebuild or disk writes.
            -- Save and recheck player inventories only after DONE, just like
            -- single-weapon selection.
            local function applyRarityBulk(makeSelected)
                if not isCurrent() or not picker.Visible then return end
                local all=catalog()
                if not all then return end
                local changed=false
                for _,entry in ipairs(all) do
                    if rarity=="ALL" or entry.rarity==rarity then
                        local wasSelected=weaponWhitelist[entry.id]==true
                        if wasSelected~=makeSelected then
                            weaponWhitelist[entry.id]=makeSelected and true or nil
                            changed=true
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not changed then return true end
                dirty=true
                filterVersion+=1
                lastPickerTap=os.clock()
                -- Do not rebuild the grid: restyle only tiles on this page.
                for _,tile in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do
                    if tile:IsA("TextButton") and tile.Name:sub(1,5)=="Pick_" then
                        local on=weaponWhitelist[tile.Name:sub(6)]==true
                        tile.BackgroundColor3=on and T.pinkDim or T.pane
                        tile.BackgroundTransparency=on and 0.18 or 0.45
                        local border=tile:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIStroke")
                        if border then border.Color=on and T.pink or T.line end
                        local label=tile:FindFirstChild("SelectedStatus")
                        if label then
                            label.Text=on and "TAP TO REMOVE" or "TAP TO SELECT"
                            label.TextColor3=on and T.pink or T.sub
                        end
                    end
                end
                pageStatus.Text=pageStatus.Text:gsub("%d+ selected",
                    tostring(selectedWeaponCount()).." selected")
                updateFilterToolbar()
                -- Defer any 3D upgrades until interaction has gone idle.
                loadPickerPreviews(currentPreviewJobs)
                return true
            end
            pvSession.connect(bulkSelect.Activated,function()
                if activeBulkAction=="select" then
                    -- Tap Select All again to undo that bulk selection.
                    if applyRarityBulk(false) then activeBulkAction=nil end
                else
                    if applyRarityBulk(true) then activeBulkAction="select" end
                end
                updateBulkButtons()
            end)
            -- Deselect All is valid only when at least one weapon in the
            -- CURRENT rarity is selected (ALL checks the full catalog).
            -- Check the cached catalog, not the UI's eight visible cards, so
            -- selections on another page are counted with no extra UI work.
            local function hasSelectedWeaponInRarity()
                if not entries then return false end
                for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
                    if (rarity=="ALL" or entry.rarity==rarity)
                        and weaponWhitelist[entry.id]==true then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            pvSession.connect(bulkDeselect.Activated,function()
                -- No weapon selected in this rarity: don't clear the existing
                -- highlight, refresh the UI, or touch the saved whitelist.
                if not isCurrent() or not picker.Visible
                    or not hasSelectedWeaponInRarity() then return end
                if applyRarityBulk(false) then
                    activeBulkAction="deselect"
                    updateBulkButtons()
                end
            end)

            local function closePicker()
                previewGeneration+=1 -- cancel outstanding 3D work
                pickerScrollActive=false
                clearPicker3D()
                currentPreviewJobs={}
                picker.Visible=false
                pickerOpen=false
                usePickerHeadingSpace(false)
                filterToolbar.Visible=true
                search.Visible=true
                status.Visible=true
                roster.Visible=true
                local hadEdits=dirty
                dirty=false
                if hadEdits and selectedWeaponCount()==0 and settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled then
                    settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled=false
                end
                if hadEdits then saveCfg() end
                updateFilterToolbar()
                -- Editing pauses all auto-block work. Recheck only once when
                -- the picker closes, even if no selections were changed.
                if recheckAllPlayers and (hadEdits or settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled) then
                    recheckAllPlayers()
                end
                if refresh then refresh() end
            end
            pvSession.connect(done.Activated,closePicker)
            pvSession.connect(previous.Activated,function()
                if currentPage>1 then currentPage-=1; rebuild() end
            end)
            pvSession.connect(nextPage.Activated,function()
                currentPage+=1; rebuild()
            end)
            local searchSerial=0
            pvSession.connect(pickerSearch:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function()
                searchSerial+=1
                local token=searchSerial
                currentPage=1
                task.delay(0.13,function()
                    if isCurrent() and picker.Visible and token==searchSerial then
                        rebuild()
                    end
                end)
            end)

            openWeaponPicker=function()
                if not isCurrent() then return end
                pickerOpen=true
                filterVersion+=1 -- pause checks until Done is pressed
                usePickerHeadingSpace(true)
                picker.Visible=true
                filterToolbar.Visible=false
                search.Visible=false
                status.Visible=false
                roster.Visible=false
                rarity="ALL"
                currentPage=1
                activeBulkAction=nil
                updateBulkButtons()
                -- The first open is nonblocking; catalog construction and 3D
                -- previews run in background tasks after the panel appears.
                buildRarityTabs()
                rebuild()
            end
            pvSession.connect(navBtns.Trade.Activated,function()
                -- When already on Player Panel, Trade returns to the normal
                -- Trade page; don't leave the selector overlay orphaned.
                if pickerOpen then closePicker() end
            end)
        end)()

        -- The old _G.pvBlocked table records past script actions, not current
        -- Roblox account blocks. Never use it to decide the button label.
        -- Read the live Roblox blocked-user list, keyed by UserId, and also
        -- listen for native Block/Unblock events when they are available.
        local verifiedBlockedIds=nil
        local blockStatusSerial=0
        -- A native Block/Unblock notification is newer than GetCore's cached
        -- list. In particular, GetCore can keep reporting a just-unblocked
        -- account as blocked when that player leaves and rejoins. Remember
        -- native changes by UserId for this hub session, not by Player object.
        local nativeBlockChanges={}
        local function nativeBlockChangeFor(id)
            local change=nativeBlockChanges[id]
            if not change then return nil end
            if change.expires and os.clock()>change.expires then
                nativeBlockChanges[id]=nil
                return nil
            end
            return change.blocked
        end
        local function applyNativeBlockChange(userId,isBlocked)
            local id=tonumber(userId)
            if not id or id<=0 then return end
            blockStatusSerial+=1 -- invalidate any older in-flight snapshot
            -- Keep explicit unblocks until another native event. A newly
            -- confirmed block needs only a brief override while Core catches
            -- up; it must not conceal a later external unblock indefinitely.
            nativeBlockChanges[id]=isBlocked
                and {blocked=true,expires=os.clock()+6}
                or {blocked=false}
            verifiedBlockedIds=verifiedBlockedIds or {}
            verifiedBlockedIds[id]=isBlocked and true or nil
            if type(_G.pvBlocked)=="table" then
                for _,pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if pl.UserId==id then
                        _G.pvBlocked[pl.Name]=isBlocked and true or nil
                    end
                end
            end
            if panel.Visible then queueInventoryRefresh() end
        end
        local function requestNativeBlockStatus()
            blockStatusSerial+=1
            local serial=blockStatusSerial
            task.spawn(function()
                -- GetCore may yield and can be unavailable early in startup.
                local ok,ids=pcall(function()
                    return game:GetService("StarterGui"):GetCore("GetBlockedUserIds")
                end)
                if not isCurrent() or serial~=blockStatusSerial then return end
                local changed=(verifiedBlockedIds==nil)
                if ok and type(ids)=="table" then
                    local current={}
                    for key,value in pairs(ids) do
                        local id=tonumber(value==true and key or value)
                        if id and id>0 then current[id]=true end
                    end
                    -- Native events are authoritative for the remainder of
                    -- this client session. Never let a delayed cached GetCore
                    -- read put BLOCKED back after an explicit unblock.
                    for id in pairs(nativeBlockChanges) do
                        local override=nativeBlockChangeFor(id)
                        if override~=nil then
                            current[id]=override and true or nil
                        end
                    end
                    if verifiedBlockedIds then
                        for _,pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if pl~=LP and (not not verifiedBlockedIds[pl.UserId])~=(not not current[pl.UserId]) then
                                changed=true;break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    verifiedBlockedIds=current
                    if type(_G.pvBlocked)=="table" then
                        for _,pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if pl~=LP then
                                _G.pvBlocked[pl.Name]=current[pl.UserId] and true or nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    -- Don't display stale BLOCKED badges after a failed read.
                    changed=verifiedBlockedIds~=nil
                    verifiedBlockedIds=nil
                end
                if changed then queueInventoryRefresh() end
            end)
        end
        local function currentlyBlocked(player)
            local nativeChange=nativeBlockChangeFor(player.UserId)
            if nativeChange~=nil then return nativeChange end
            return verifiedBlockedIds~=nil
                and verifiedBlockedIds[player.UserId]==true
        end

        -- Opt-in, conservative inventory filter: ANY selected item allows the
        -- player. Never block from cached/last-seen results, pending data, or
        -- an empty inventory response. Re-fetch after a delay to confirm.
        local autoBlockWorking=false
        local autoQueued=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
        local autoAttempted=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
        local function allowedByWhitelist(owned)
            for id,selected in pairs(weaponWhitelist) do
                if selected==true and owned[tostring(id)]==true then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function liveFilterCandidate(player,snapshot,version)
            return isCurrent() and settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled==true
                and not pickerOpen
                and selectedWeaponCount()>0 and version==filterVersion
                and player~=LP and player.Parent==Players
                and weaponSnapshots[player.UserId]==snapshot
                and snapshot.player==player and snapshot.state=="ready"
                and snapshot.freshOwned==true
                and type(snapshot.ownedIds)=="table"
                -- Blocking an already-blocked account is unnecessary and
                -- must not trigger a second enormous inventory response.
                and not currentlyBlocked(player)
                and not allowedByWhitelist(snapshot.ownedIds)
        end
        scheduleFilterCheck=function(player,snapshot)
            local version=filterVersion
            if not liveFilterCandidate(player,snapshot,version) then return end
            if autoQueued[player]==version or autoAttempted[player]==version then return end
            autoQueued[player]=version
            task.spawn(function()
                local function stillValid()
                    return liveFilterCandidate(player,snapshot,version)
                end
                task.wait(5.0) -- let join replication and rendering settle
                if not stillValid() then return end
                -- Second independent server read, serialized in the SAME
                -- request lane as the normal ranking scan (no overlapping
                -- full-inventory replies when multiple users join).
                local ok,data=invokeInventoryThrottled(player,stillValid)
                if not ok or not stillValid() then return end
                local weapons=type(data)=="table" and data.Weapons
                local owned=type(weapons)=="table" and weapons.Owned
                if type(owned)~="table" or next(owned)==nil then return end
                -- Parse in tiny slices rather than locking up the game when
                -- a large inventory arrives. Stop instantly if the player
                -- leaves or the selected whitelist changes.
                local liveOwned={}
                local confirmedCount=0
                local scanned=0
                for id,amount in pairs(owned) do
                    scanned+=1
                    if scanned%8==0 then
                        task.wait()
                        if not stillValid() then return end
                    end
                    local count=type(amount)=="table" and tonumber(amount.Amount or amount.Count)
                        or tonumber(amount)
                    if count and count>0 then
                        liveOwned[tostring(id)]=true
                        confirmedCount+=1
                    end
                end
                if confirmedCount==0 or allowedByWhitelist(liveOwned) then return end
                local originalCount=0
                for _ in pairs(snapshot.ownedIds) do originalCount+=1 end
                if confirmedCount<originalCount then return end
                if verifiedBlockedIds==nil then
                    requestNativeBlockStatus()
                    task.wait(0.6)
                end
                if not stillValid() or verifiedBlockedIds==nil or currentlyBlocked(player) then return end
                -- One block at a time: no overlapping native confirmation UI.
                local busyDeadline=os.clock()+12
                while autoBlockWorking or _G.pvBlockInProgress or pendingUserId do
                    if not stillValid() or os.clock()>busyDeadline then return end
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
                if not stillValid() or currentlyBlocked(player) then return end
                -- autoBlockPlayer is defined later in the original hub; it may
                -- not yet be ready if MM2 returns an inventory unusually fast.
                local deadline=os.clock()+8
                while type(autoBlockPlayer)~="function" and os.clock()<deadline do
                    if not stillValid() then return end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
                if type(autoBlockPlayer)~="function" or not stillValid() then return end
                autoBlockWorking=true
                autoAttempted[player]=version
                local ran,didBlock,reason=pcall(autoBlockPlayer,player)
                autoBlockWorking=false
                if not isCurrent() then return end
                if ran and didBlock==true then
                    applyNativeBlockChange(player.UserId,true)
                    notify("Auto-blocked "..player.Name.." (no selected weapons)")
                elseif not ran then
                    warn("[Player Panel] Auto-block failed for "..player.Name..": "..tostring(didBlock))
                else
                    -- A native prompt may need a manual confirmation; never
                    -- claim it was blocked unless the existing helper verifies.
                    warn("[Player Panel] Block wasn't verified: "..tostring(reason))
                end
                requestNativeBlockStatus()
            end)
        end
        onInventoryReady=scheduleFilterCheck
        recheckAllPlayers=function()
            filterVersion+=1 -- invalidate old pending tasks on any change
            if not settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled or selectedWeaponCount()==0 then return end
            requestNativeBlockStatus()
            for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player~=LP then
                    local snapshot=loadPlayerWeapons(player)
                    if snapshot.state=="ready" then
                        scheduleFilterCheck(player,snapshot)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        task.defer(function()
            if isCurrent() and settings.inventoryAutoBlockEnabled
                and selectedWeaponCount()>0 then
                recheckAllPlayers()
            end
        end)
        local function watchNativeBlockEvent(coreName,blocked)
            local sg=game:GetService("StarterGui")
            for attempt=1,16 do
                if not isCurrent() then return end
                local ok,event=pcall(function() return sg:GetCore(coreName) end)
                if ok and event then
                    local signal
                    if typeof(event)=="Instance" and event:IsA("BindableEvent") then
                        signal=event.Event
                    elseif typeof(event)=="RBXScriptSignal" then
                        signal=event
                    end
                    if signal then
                        pvSession.connect(signal,function(target)
                            local id=(typeof(target)=="Instance" and target:IsA("Player"))
                                and target.UserId or tonumber(target)
                            if id then applyNativeBlockChange(id,blocked) end
                            -- Read back Roblox's account state after the event.
                            task.delay(0.3,function()
                                if isCurrent() then requestNativeBlockStatus() end
                            end)
                        end)
                        return
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
        task.spawn(watchNativeBlockEvent,"PlayerBlockedEvent",true)
        task.spawn(watchNativeBlockEvent,"PlayerUnblockedEvent",false)
        -- Some Roblox clients expose the utility's status-changed event but
        -- not the StarterGui Core event. Listen to it as a second source so
        -- unblocks done through the native player menu repaint immediately.
        task.spawn(function()
            if not isCurrent() then return end
            local util=pvBlockUtil
            for _=1,25 do
                if not isCurrent() then return end
                if type(util)=="table" then break end
                task.wait(0.2)
                util=pvBlockUtil
            end
            if type(util)~="table" or type(util.GetBlockedStatusChangedEvent)~="function" then return end
            local ok,event=pcall(function() return util:GetBlockedStatusChangedEvent() end)
            if not ok or not event then return end
            local signal=event
            if typeof(event)=="Instance" and event:IsA("BindableEvent") then
                signal=event.Event
            end
            if typeof(signal)=="RBXScriptSignal" then
                pvSession.connect(signal,function(userId,blocked)
                    if typeof(blocked)=="boolean" then
                        applyNativeBlockChange(userId,blocked)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
