                if not isCurrent() or visual.model~=model or not model.Parent or not head.Parent then
                    cleanup()
                    return
                end
                local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
                local visible=false
                if camera then
                    local point,onScreen=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                    local root=LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local viewerPosition=root and root.Position or camera.CFrame.Position
                    if onScreen and point.Z>0 and (head.Position-viewerPosition).Magnitude<=100 then
                        visible=clearView(camera)
                    end
                end
                if visible~=lastVisible then
                    lastVisible=visible
                    humanoid.DisplayDistanceType=visible and Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.Subject
                        or Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                    if visible then
                        if currentViewer then allowNativeName(currentViewer) end
                    else
                        restoreViewer(currentViewer)
                    end
                end
            end
            connections[#connections+1]=LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
            connections[#connections+1]=model.Destroying:Connect(cleanup)
            allowNativeName(humanoid)
            watchCharacter(LP.Character)
            updateVisibility()
            connections[#connections+1]=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateVisibility)
        end


        -- Match MM2's REAL worn-weapon mounting rather than guessing rotations.
        -- MM2 displays use WeaponDisplays/{Knife,Gun}Display with a RigidConstraint
        -- pointing to an Attachment on a live character. Their Part1 attachment
        -- determines the orientation of the weapon mesh. Read BOTH attachments
        -- and use that exact torso-local transform for the preview's weld.
        -- The weapon looks are still the normal DefaultKnife / DefaultGun.
        local function addVisualDefaultBackWeapons(model)
            if not model or not model.Parent then return false end
            local defs={
                {slot="Knife", name="pvVisualBackDefaultKnife", torso="UpperTorso", anchor="KnifeBack",
                 id="121944778", texture="121944805", size=Vector3.new(0.4,3,0.7), scale=Vector3.new(1,1,1)},
                {slot="Gun", name="pvVisualBackDefaultGun", torso="LowerTorso", anchor="GunBelt",
                 id="79401392", texture="91723031", size=Vector3.new(0.2,1.83,1.03), scale=Vector3.new(1.6,1.6,1.6)},
            }
            local displays=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
            local fullNative=0
            for _,def in ipairs(defs) do
                local best, bestScore=nil, -1
                -- Prefer a genuine default item being worn by a REAL player.
                -- (Our locally created visual is not a Players entry.)
                if displays then
                    for _,d in ipairs(displays:GetChildren()) do
                        if d.Name==def.slot.."Display" and d:IsA("BasePart")
                            and not d:GetAttribute("pvMade") then
                            local rc=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
                            local a0=rc and rc.Attachment0
                            local a1=rc and rc.Attachment1
                            local ownerChar=a0 and a0.Parent and a0.Parent.Parent
                            local owner=ownerChar and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(ownerChar)
                            if owner and a0 and a1 and a0:IsA("Attachment")
                                and a1:IsA("Attachment") and a0.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                                local mesh=d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.MeshId
                                    or (d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                                        and d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh").MeshId)
                                local currentMesh=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                                local texture=d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.TextureID
                                    or (currentMesh and currentMesh.TextureId)
                                local meshNumber=mesh and tostring(mesh):match("%d+")
                                local textureNumber=texture and tostring(texture):match("%d+")
                                -- Base meshes are reused across several MM2 skins,
                                -- so only clone a native appearance if BOTH the
                                -- mesh and texture match the actual default item.
                                local exactDefault=meshNumber==def.id
                                    and textureNumber==def.texture
                                local onNativeAnchor=(a0.Name==def.anchor)
                                local score=(exactDefault and 100 or 0)
                                    +(onNativeAnchor and 20 or 0)
                                    +(owner~=LP and 5 or 0)
                                if score>bestScore then
                                    best={src=d, a0=a0, a1=a1, owner=owner,
                                          exact=exactDefault, torsoName=a0.Parent.Name}
                                    bestScore=score
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                local nativeScore=best and bestScore or 0
                local scoreName="pvBackNativeScore"..def.slot
                -- A later real-player reference may be better than the one
                -- available on spawn. Only rebuild if the reference improves.
                local previous=model:GetAttribute(scoreName)
                if previous==nil or nativeScore>previous then
                    local ok=pcall(function()
                        local torso=model:FindFirstChild(best and best.torsoName or def.torso)
                            or model:FindFirstChild(def.torso) or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                        if not (torso and torso:IsA("BasePart")) then return end

                        local localPose
                        if best then
                            -- Same mounting equation used by RigidConstraint:
                            -- World(Attachment0) == World(Attachment1).
                            -- The weld uses this result as its Part0->Part1 C0.
                            localPose=best.a0.CFrame * best.a1.CFrame:Inverse()
                        else
                            -- No real worn weapon in this server yet. Use a
                            -- temporary mount; retry for a native sample below.
                            local nativeAnchor=torso:FindFirstChild(def.anchor)
                            if nativeAnchor and nativeAnchor:IsA("Attachment") then
                                localPose=nativeAnchor.CFrame
                            elseif def.slot=="Knife" then
                                localPose=CFrame.new(0,-0.05,0.58)
                                    * CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-75))
                            else
                                -- In normal MM2 the default gun is at the belt,
                                -- NOT on the shoulder next to the knife.
                                localPose=CFrame.new(0.73,-0.27,0.12)
                                    * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90),0,0)
                            end
                        end

                        local part
                        if best and best.exact then
                            -- Copy the source part's actual MM2 scaling and
                            -- mesh appearance; no hand-calibrated sizes.
                            part=best.src:Clone()
                            for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                                if not obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")
                                   and not obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                                    obj:Destroy()
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            -- If nobody is wearing a default, use its REAL
                            -- default mesh while still copying the live mount.
                            part=Instance.new("Part")
                            part.Size=def.size
                            part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            part.Color=Color3.fromRGB(163,162,165)
                            local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
                            mesh.Name="Mesh"
                            mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
                            mesh.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..def.id
                            mesh.TextureId="rbxassetid://"..def.texture
                            mesh.Scale=def.scale
                            mesh.Parent=part
                        end
                        part.Name=def.name
                        part.Transparency=0
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
                        part.Anchored=false
                        part.CanCollide=false
                        part.CanTouch=false
                        part.CanQuery=false
                        part.Massless=true
                        part.CastShadow=false
                        part.CFrame=torso.CFrame*localPose

                        local weld=Instance.new("Weld")
                        weld.Name="pvNativeBackWeaponWeld"
                        weld.Part0=torso
                        weld.Part1=part
                        weld.C0=localPose
                        weld.C1=CFrame.new()
                        weld.Parent=part
                        part.Parent=model
                        -- Weapon Equipping can replace the default preview weapon.
                        -- Keep it hidden if a higher-quality native placement
                        -- sample arrives after the visual weapon was equipped.
                        if model:GetAttribute("pvVisualHideDefault"..def.slot) then
                            part.Transparency=1
                            part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
                        end
                        -- New part gets the same name; destroy old only after
                        -- successful replacement to avoid flickering on retry.
                        for _,child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                            if child~=part and child.Name==def.name then
                                child:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                        model:SetAttribute(scoreName,nativeScore)
                    end)
                end
                if model:GetAttribute(scoreName) and model:GetAttribute(scoreName)>=100 then
                    fullNative=fullNative+1
                end
            end
            model:SetAttribute("pvDefaultBackWeapons",model:FindFirstChild("pvVisualBackDefaultKnife")~=nil
                and model:FindFirstChild("pvVisualBackDefaultGun")~=nil)
            -- Wait for the game's WeaponDisplays if they appear after spawn.
            -- Stop retrying once both exact default references have been found.
            return fullNative==2
        end

        -- SPAWN LOGGER IMPORT: 188 painted Lobby tiles (floor heights, not avatar-root heights).
        -- Absolute and map-relative coordinates are preserved from the user's exported log.

        visual.lastLoggedSpawnIndex=nil
        visual.pickLoggedFloor=function()
            for _,map in ipairs(visual.spawnMapLog.maps or {}) do
                -- The logger recorded this exact top-level map Model in Workspace.
                local anchorName=tostring(map.anchorPath or ""):match("^Workspace%.([^%.]+)$")
                local anchor=anchorName and workspace:FindFirstChild(anchorName)
                if anchor and anchor:IsA("Model") then
                    local spots=map.points or {}
                    if #spots>0 then
                        local ignored={}
                        for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                            if player.Character then ignored[#ignored+1]=player.Character end
                        end
                        local cast=RaycastParams.new()
                        cast.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        cast.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored
                        cast.IgnoreWater=true
                        cast.RespectCanCollide=true
                        local overlap=OverlapParams.new()
                        overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                        overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignored
                        overlap.MaxParts=60
                        local first=math.random(1,#spots)
                        -- Try each logged square if necessary, starting randomly each spawn.
                        for step=0,#spots-1 do
                            local i=(first+step-1)%#spots+1
                            if #spots==1 or i~=visual.lastLoggedSpawnIndex then
                                local point=spots[i]
                                local floor=Vector3.new(point.x,point.y,point.z)
                                if point.relative then
                                    local rel=point.relative
                                    floor=anchor:GetPivot():PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(rel.x,rel.y,rel.z))
                                end
                                -- Recheck the *logged floor*, not a ceiling or floor below it.
                                local hit=workspace:Raycast(floor+Vector3.new(0,4,0),
                                    Vector3.new(0,-10,0),cast)
                                if hit and hit.Normal.Y>=0.72
                                    and math.abs(hit.Position.Y-floor.Y)<=1.5
                                    and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(anchor) then
                                    local clear=true
                                    -- This box starts just above the logged surface.
                                    local around=workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(
                                        CFrame.new(floor.X,hit.Position.Y+3,floor.Z),
                                        Vector3.new(1.5,4.7,1.5),overlap)
                                    for _,part in ipairs(around) do
                                        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                                            clear=false
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if clear then
                                        visual.lastLoggedSpawnIndex=i
                                        return Vector3.new(floor.X,hit.Position.Y,floor.Z),map.mapName
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function createAvatar(username, userId, description)
            local account=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
            local source=account and account.Character
            local sourceHumanoid=source and source:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local reference=sourceHumanoid
                or (LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            local rigType=reference and reference.RigType or Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
            -- Preserve the account's supplied body proportions. The previous
            -- version applied universe avatar settings on top and could stretch it.
            -- A present target can supply its actual in-game description.
            if sourceHumanoid then
                local ok,current=pcall(function() return sourceHumanoid:GetAppliedDescription() end)
                if ok and current then description=current end
            end
            pcall(function() description.UseAvatarSettings=false end)
            local ok,model=pcall(function()
                return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description,rigType)
            end)
            if not ok or not model then
                ok,model=pcall(function()
                    return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(description,rigType)
                end)
            end
            if not ok or not model then return nil,"Roblox could not load this avatar" end
            local built,why=pcall(function()
                -- Use the account's exact username as the model name, just like
                -- a regular Roblox character (including original capitalization).
                model.Name=username
                model:SetAttribute("pvClientVisualPlayer",true)
                model:SetAttribute("pvPreviewUserId",userId)
                for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        -- Anchored parts were the cause of the frozen robot pose.
                        part.Anchored=false
                        part.CanCollide=false
                        part.CanTouch=false
                        part.CanQuery=false
                        part.Massless=true
                    elseif part:IsA("Script") or part:IsA("LocalScript") then
                        part:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                local humanoid=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not humanoid then error("Avatar has no Humanoid") end
                local rootPart=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not rootPart then error("Avatar has no HumanoidRootPart") end
                -- This is a visual-only avatar. Move its anchored root using
                -- PivotTo so client NPC physics cannot freeze it in place.
                rootPart.CanCollide=false
                rootPart.CanQuery=false
                rootPart.Anchored=true
                rootPart.Massless=false
                model.PrimaryPart=rootPart
                humanoid.AutoRotate=false
                humanoid.PlatformStand=false
                if reference then
                    for _,property in ipairs({"WalkSpeed","UseJumpPower","JumpPower","JumpHeight"}) do
                        pcall(function() humanoid[property]=reference[property] end)
                    end
                end
                local character=LP.Character
                local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
                local origin=root and root.CFrame or (camera and camera.CFrame) or CFrame.new(0,8,0)
                -- Place the visual on a randomly selected logged floor square.
                -- The 3.5-stud offset is temporary; alignGround adjusts the feet exactly.
                local loggedFloor,loggedMap=visual.pickLoggedFloor()
                local oldTarget=(origin*CFrame.new(5,0,-4)).Position
                local oldPosition=Vector3.new(oldTarget.X,oldTarget.Y,oldTarget.Z)
                local oldLook=Vector3.new(origin.Position.X,oldTarget.Y,origin.Position.Z)
                if (oldLook-oldPosition).Magnitude<0.1 then
                    oldLook=oldPosition+Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
                end
                local originalNearbyCFrame=CFrame.lookAt(oldPosition,oldLook)
                if loggedFloor then
                    local position=loggedFloor+Vector3.new(0,3.5,0)
                    local yaw=math.random()*math.pi*2
                    model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position)*CFrame.Angles(0,yaw,0))
                    model:SetAttribute("pvLoggedSpawnMap",loggedMap)
                    model:SetAttribute("pvLoggedFloor",loggedFloor)
                else
                    -- Other MM2 maps are not included in this Lobby-only log.
                    model:PivotTo(originalNearbyCFrame)
                end
                -- Require the avatar's actual Head as the overhead label anchor.
                local head=model:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if not (head and head:IsA("BasePart")) then
                    error("Avatar has no direct Head part for its username label")
                end
                model.Parent=workspace
                if not visual.alignGround(model) then
                    if loggedFloor then
                        -- If the map changed while the avatar was loading, fall back
                        -- to the old nearby placement rather than leave it in mid-air.
                        model:PivotTo(originalNearbyCFrame)
                        model:SetAttribute("pvLoggedSpawnMap",nil)
                        model:SetAttribute("pvLoggedFloor",nil)
                    end
                    if not visual.alignGround(model) then
                        error("No floor found at a logged or nearby spawn position")
                    end
                end
                -- Match real MM2 weapon poses when the game has native displays.
                -- Does not equip tools, edit inventories or send trade remotes.
                pcall(addVisualDefaultBackWeapons,model)
                task.spawn(function()
                    -- Some servers stream character weapon displays in late.
                    -- Upgrade the temporary mounts to native poses if found.
                    for _=1,12 do
                        if not isCurrent() or not model.Parent then return end
                        local ok,matched=pcall(addVisualDefaultBackWeapons,model)
                        if ok and matched then return end
                        task.wait(1.5)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            if not built then
                pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
                return nil,tostring(why)
            end
            return model,nil,description
        end

        local section=Instance.new("Frame")
        section.Name="pvVisualPlayerDropdown"
        section.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
        section.BackgroundTransparency=1
        section.BorderSizePixel=0
        section.LayoutOrder=2
        section.Visible=false
        section.Parent=pvSession.upgradeControls.holder
        local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,px(6))
        layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        layout.Parent=section
        local function resizeSection()
            section.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,section.Visible and (layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+px(6)) or 0)
        end
        -- Keep the automatic simulated profile stats; no manual stats UI.
        visual.getManualProfileStats=function() return {},true end
        local toggleButton=btn(pvSession.upgradeControls.row,"▼",function()
            section.Visible=not section.Visible
            resizeSection()
        end)
        toggleButton.Name="pvFakeUpgradeDropdownToggle"
        toggleButton.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(30),px(30))
        toggleButton.Position=UDim2.new(1,-px(30),0,0)
        pvSession.connect(section:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),function()
            toggleButton.Text=section.Visible and "▲" or "▼"
        end)
        pvSession.connect(layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"),resizeSection)
        visual.valueHelperToggle=toggle(section,"Upgrade Value Helper",settings.upgradeValueHelper==true,function(v)
            settings.upgradeValueHelper=v
            pcall(saveCfg)
        end)
        visual.valueHelperToggle.LayoutOrder=-1
        do
            local row=Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Name="pvUpgradeTierButtons"
            row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
            row.BackgroundTransparency=1
            row.LayoutOrder=0
            row.Parent=section
            local buttons={}
            local function refreshSelection()
                local selected=pvSession.selectedUpgradePreset()
                for key,button in pairs(buttons) do
                    local active=key==selected.key
                    button.BackgroundColor3=active and PINK_ON or BTN_BG
                    button.BackgroundTransparency=active and 0 or BTN_TR
                end
            end
            local gap=px(6)
            for index,key in ipairs({"poor","middle","rich"}) do
                local preset=pvSession.upgradeTiers[key]
                local button=btn(row,preset.label,function()
                    if settings.fakeUpgradeTier==key then return end
                    settings.fakeUpgradeTier=key
                    refreshSelection()
                    pcall(saveCfg)
                end)
                button:SetAttribute("pvUpgradeTier",key)
                buttons[key]=button
                local anchor=(index-1)/2
                button.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(anchor,0)
                button.Position=UDim2.fromScale(anchor,0)
                button.Size=UDim2.new(1/3,-math.ceil(2*gap/3),1,0)
            end
            refreshSelection()
            table.insert(pvSession.configRefresh,refreshSelection)
        end
        -- One Fake Player section, using the same button-and-arrow row as
        -- Start Fake Upgrade. Keep the arrow outside the padded title button.
        local fakePlayerControls=(function()
            local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
            holder.Name="pvUpgradeFakePlayerGroup"
            holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
            holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
            holder.LayoutOrder=1
            holder.Parent=section
            local row=Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Name="Header"
            row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
            row.BackgroundTransparency=1
            row.Parent=holder
            local body=Instance.new("Frame")
            body.Name="Controls"
            body.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(12),0,0)
            body.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(6),px(36))
            body.BackgroundTransparency=1
            body.Visible=false
            body.Parent=holder
            local contentLayout=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            contentLayout.Padding=UDim.new(0,px(6))
            contentLayout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
            contentLayout.Parent=body
            local arrow
            local function refresh()
                local height=body.Visible and contentLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y or 0
                body.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(12),0,height)
                holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30)+(body.Visible and height+px(12) or 0))
                arrow.Text=body.Visible and "▲" or "▼"
            end
            local function togglePlayerControls()
                body.Visible=not body.Visible
                refresh()
                resizeSection()
            end
            local header=btn(row,"Fake Player",togglePlayerControls)
            header.Name="SectionToggle"
            header.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(36),0,px(30))
            header.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            pad(header,px(10))
            arrow=btn(row,"▼",togglePlayerControls)
            arrow.Name="pvFakePlayerDropdownToggle"
            arrow.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(30),px(30))
            arrow.Position=UDim2.new(1,-px(30),0,0)
            pvSession.connect(contentLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"),refresh)
            refresh()
            return body
        end)()
        visual.upgradeSpawnToggle=toggle(fakePlayerControls,"Spawn Player on Upgrade",settings.fakeUpgradeSpawn==true,function(v)
            settings.fakeUpgradeSpawn=v
            pcall(saveCfg)
        end)
        visual.upgradeSpawnToggle.LayoutOrder=0
        local usernameBox=box(fakePlayerControls,"Roblox username (not display name)")
        usernameBox.Name="pvVisualPlayerUsername"
        local levelBox=box(fakePlayerControls,"Visual level (1-100)")
        levelBox.Name="pvVisualPlayerLevel"
        -- Leave this EMPTY: the user chooses their own level.
        levelBox.Text=""
        levelBox.ClearTextOnFocus=false
        -- Update the visual leaderboard level immediately as the user types.
        -- Empty/incomplete/invalid text leaves the last valid level unchanged.
        pvSession.connect(levelBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),function()
            local typed=tostring(levelBox.Text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
            if typed:match("^%d+$") then
                local value=tonumber(typed)
                if value and value>=1 and value<=100 then
                    setVisualLevel(value)
                end
            end
        end)
        -- Empty/invalid text remains untouched: never auto-fill a level.
        -- Spawn validates the field before creating the visual character.
        visual.spawn=function(onReady, upgradeUsername)
            -- nil means manual Spawn Player; an empty upgrade input means random.
            local typed=tostring(upgradeUsername~=nil and upgradeUsername or usernameBox.Text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
            local randomUpgrade=upgradeUsername~=nil and typed==""
            if not randomUpgrade and (#typed<3 or #typed>20 or not typed:match("^[%w_]+$")) then
                status("Enter a valid Roblox username (3-20 letters, digits or _)")
                notify("Enter a valid Roblox username")
                return
            end
            -- Auto-fill only an empty upgrade level; preserve explicit choices.
            local levelText=tostring(levelBox.Text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
            if upgradeUsername~=nil and levelText=="" then
                levelText=tostring(math.random(1,100))
                levelBox.Text=levelText
            end
            local typedLevel=tonumber(levelText)
            if not levelText:match("^%d+$") or not typedLevel
                or typedLevel<1 or typedLevel>100 then
                notify("Enter a visual level from 1 to 100 first")
                return
            end
            setVisualLevel(typedLevel)
            removeVisual(true)
            local token=visual.token
            status(randomUpgrade and "Finding a random Roblox account ..." or ("Looking up @"..typed.." ..."))
            task.spawn(function()
                if randomUpgrade then
                    -- A successful ID lookup supplies a real registered username.
                    -- Bound retries and cancel immediately when this spawn is replaced.
                    for attempt=1,12 do
                        if not valid(token) then return end
                        local candidateId=math.random(1,1000000000)
                        local okName,candidate=pcall(function()
                            return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(candidateId)
                        end)
                        if not valid(token) then return end
                        if okName and type(candidate)=="string" and candidate~=""
                            and candidateId~=LP.UserId and candidate~=visual.lastUpgradeName then
                            typed=candidate
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait(0.15)
                    end
                    if typed=="" then
                        status("Could not resolve a random account. Try again or enter a username above.")
                        notify("Random username lookup failed; try again or enter a username")
                        return
                    end
                end
                local okId,userId=pcall(function() return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(typed) end)
                if not valid(token) then return end
                if not okId or type(userId)~="number" or userId<=0 then
                    status("Username not found: @"..typed)
                    notify("Roblox username not found: "..typed)
                    return
                end
                local okDesc,desc=pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(userId) end)
                if not okDesc then
                    okDesc,desc=pcall(function() return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(userId) end)
                end
                if not valid(token) then return end
                if not okDesc or not desc then
                    status("Could not fetch @"..typed.."'s avatar")
                    notify("Avatar loading failed for "..typed)
                    return
                end
                -- Resolve the exact registered Roblox username from the user ID,
                -- so the overhead tag and leaderboard preserve the real casing.
                local realName=typed
                local okName,name=pcall(function()
                    return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
                end)
                if not valid(token) then return end
                if okName and type(name)=="string" and name~="" then
                    realName=name
                end
                if usernameBox.Text==typed then usernameBox.Text=realName end
                status("Loading avatar for @"..realName.." ...")
                local model,why,appliedDescription=createAvatar(realName,userId,desc)
                if not valid(token) then
                    if model then pcall(function() model:Destroy() end) end
                    return
                end
                if not model then
                    status("Avatar load failed: "..tostring(why))
                    notify("Avatar load failed for "..realName)
                    return
                end
                visual.model=model
                visual.username=realName
                if upgradeUsername~=nil then visual.lastUpgradeName=realName end
                visual.spawnCFrame=model:GetPivot()
                configureVisualUsername(model,realName)
                animateAvatar(model,appliedDescription or desc)
                -- Expose this client-only avatar in Weapon Equipping's player
                -- selector, without adding a real Players entry.
                _G.pvVisualWeaponTarget={
                    pvIsVisual=true, Name=realName, UserId=-2147000001,
                    Character=model, Parent=model
                }
                if type(_G.pvRefreshWeapWhoList)=="function" then
                    pcall(_G.pvRefreshWeapWhoList)
                end
                -- Visual-only Roblox-style "joined you" banner; does not add a
                -- real friend, send a Roblox chat event, or affect other clients.
                visual.showJoinToast(realName,userId)
                visual.showJoinChat(realName)
                -- Spawned player stands idle until Jump is pressed.
                for _=1,12 do
                    if not valid(token) then return end
                    local okRow,row=pcall(makeLeaderboardRow,realName)
                    if okRow and row then visual.row=row break end
                    task.wait(0.25)
                end
                if not valid(token) then return end
                if visual.row then
                    status("@"..realName.." ready - use Jump to hop in place (local only)")
                    -- Don't overlap the new top join banner with another popup.
                else
                    status("Avatar spawned, but leaderboard is unavailable")
                    notify("Avatar spawned; leaderboard could not be updated")
                end
                -- Schedule the upgrade only after the normal visual join is complete.
                if type(onReady)=="function" then
                    local ok,err=pcall(onReady,_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget)
                    if not ok then notify("Fake upgrade failed: "..tostring(err)) end
                end
            end)
        end
        pvSession.spawnUpgradePlayer=visual.spawn
        pvSession.addCleanup(function() pvSession.spawnUpgradePlayer=nil end)
        local spawnButton=btn(fakePlayerControls,"Spawn Visual Player",function() visual.spawn() end)
        spawnButton.Name="pvSpawnVisualPlayer"
        local playerActions=Instance.new("Frame")
        playerActions.Name="pvVisualPlayerActions"
        playerActions.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
        playerActions.BackgroundTransparency=1
        playerActions.LayoutOrder=4
        playerActions.Parent=fakePlayerControls
        local jumpButton=btn(playerActions,"Jump",queueVisualJump)
        jumpButton.Name="pvVisualJumpButton"
        jumpButton.Size=UDim2.new(0.3,-px(3),0,px(30))
        -- The overhead username has its own visible, model-owned label.
        -- A local chat composer for this *already spawned* preview avatar.
        local fakeChatBox=box(fakePlayerControls,"What should the visual player say?")
        fakeChatBox.Name="pvVisualFakeChatInput"
        fakeChatBox.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        fakeChatBox.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
        fakeChatBox.Text=tostring(settings.visualAutoMessageText or "")
        visual.autoMessageSerial=0
        visual.autoMessageToggle=toggle(fakePlayerControls,"Auto Message After Equip",settings.visualAutoMessage==true,function(v)
            settings.visualAutoMessage=v
            visual.autoMessageSerial=visual.autoMessageSerial+1
            pcall(saveCfg)
        end)
        visual.autoMessageToggle.LayoutOrder=6
        pvSession.queueUpgradeMessage=function(target)
            if not settings.visualAutoMessage then return end
            local token=visual.token
            local serial=visual.autoMessageSerial
            task.delay(2,function()
                if not valid(token) or serial~=visual.autoMessageSerial
                    or not settings.visualAutoMessage or target~=_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget
                    or target.Character~=visual.model or not visual.model or not visual.model.Parent
                    or not fakeChatBox.Parent then return end
                local message=tostring(fakeChatBox.Text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
                if message~="" then sayAsVisual(message) end
            end)
        end
        pvSession.addCleanup(function() pvSession.queueUpgradeMessage=nil end)
        local sayButton=btn(fakePlayerControls,"Say Message",function()
            if sayAsVisual(fakeChatBox.Text) and not settings.visualAutoMessage then
                fakeChatBox.Text=""
            end
        end)
        sayButton.Name="pvVisualSayMessage"
        -- Enter on a desktop keyboard acts like pressing the Say button.
        pvSession.connect(fakeChatBox.FocusLost,function(enterPressed)
            if enterPressed and sayAsVisual(fakeChatBox.Text) and not settings.visualAutoMessage then
                fakeChatBox.Text=""
            end
            settings.visualAutoMessageText=fakeChatBox.Text
            pcall(saveCfg)
        end)
        local removeButton=btn(playerActions,"Remove Player",function()
            removeVisual(true)
            status("Removed. No real player was joined or traded.")
            notify("Visual player removed")
        end)
        removeButton.Name="pvRemoveVisualPlayer"
        removeButton.Size=UDim2.new(0.7,-px(3),0,px(30))
        removeButton.Position=UDim2.new(0.3,px(3),0,0)
        usernameBox.LayoutOrder=1
        levelBox.LayoutOrder=2
        spawnButton.LayoutOrder=3
        fakeChatBox.LayoutOrder=5
        sayButton.LayoutOrder=7
        task.defer(resizeSection)
        end)()
    end

end

local meshDB = {}


PV_CAPTURED = nil
pcall(function()
    if type(isfile)=="function" and isfile("pvCapture.json") then
        PV_CAPTURED = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile("pvCapture.json"))
    end
end)
pcall(function()
    if hasFile and isfileSafe(MESH_PATH) then
        meshDB = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(MESH_PATH)) or {}
    end
end)


wdbCount=0
pcall(function()


    local raw
    if hasFile and isfileSafe(WDB_PATH) then
        raw=HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(WDB_PATH))
    elseif PV_WDB_JSON and #PV_WDB_JSON>2 then
        raw=HttpService:JSONDecode(PV_WDB_JSON)
    end
    do
        if type(raw)=="table" then
            for id,e in pairs(raw) do
                if type(e)=="table" and e.m then
                    meshDB[id]={
                        mesh  = e.m,
                        tex   = e.t,
                        scale = (e.sx and {e.sx, e.sy, e.sz}) or nil,
                        color = e.c,
                        mat   = e.mat,
                        typ   = e.typ,
                        mp    = e.mp,
                        ov    = e.ov,
                        off   = e.off,
                    }
                    wdbCount=wdbCount+1
                end
            end
        end


        if type(PV_CAPTURED)=="table" then
            local n=0
            for id,r in pairs(PV_CAPTURED) do
                if type(r)=="table" and r.m and r.m~="" then
                    meshDB[id]={
                        mesh  = r.m,
                        tex   = (r.t~="" ) and r.t or nil,
                        scale = r.sc,
                        color = r.col,
                        mat   = r.mat,
                        typ   = r.typ,
                        mp    = (r.cls=="MeshPart") or nil,


                        size  = r.sz,
                        off   = r.of and r.of[2] or nil,
                        dec   = r.dec,
                        att   = r.att,
                        real  = true,
                    }


                    if r.att and #r.att>=12 then
                        PV_CAP_MOUNTS = PV_CAP_MOUNTS or {}
                        PV_CAP_MOUNTS[id] = r.att
                    end
                    n=n+1
                end
            end
            _G.pvCapturedLoaded = n
        end
    end
end)


do
    local useCount={}
    for _,rec in pairs(meshDB) do
        local m = rec and rec.mesh and tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+")
        if m then useCount[m]=(useCount[m] or 0)+1 end
    end


    local badMesh={}
    for m,c in pairs(useCount) do if c>6 then badMesh[m]=true end end
    local dropped=0
    for k,rec in pairs(meshDB) do
        local m = rec and rec.mesh and tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+")

    local skinDropped=0
    if type(skinCache)=="table" then
        for k,rec in pairs(skinCache) do
            local m = rec and rec.mesh and tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+")
            if m and badMesh[m] then skinCache[k]=nil; skinDropped=skinDropped+1 end
        end
        if skinDropped>0 then skinDirty=true; pcall(saveSkins) end
    end
    _G.pvMeshPurged = dropped
    _G.pvSkinPurged = skinDropped
    _G.pvBadMesh = badMesh
end

pvNameKey = {}
pvNameKeyT = {Gun={}, Knife={}}
function pvNorm(s) return tostring(s):lower():gsub("[^%a%d]","") end


pvNameKeyTC = {Gun={}, Knife={}}
for k,rec in pairs(meshDB) do
    local n=pvNorm(k); if n~="" and not pvNameKey[n] then pvNameKey[n]=k end


    local t=rec.typ
    if n~="" and (t=="Gun" or t=="Knife") then

        local base, isChroma
        if k:match("Chroma$") then base, isChroma = k:gsub("Chroma$",""), true
        elseif k:match("^Chroma") then base, isChroma = k:gsub("^Chroma",""), true
        else base, isChroma = k, false end


        local aliases = { pvNorm(base) }
        local stripped = base:gsub("Knife$",""):gsub("Gun$",""):gsub("_[GK]_%d+$","")
        if stripped~="" and stripped~=base then aliases[#aliases+1]=pvNorm(stripped) end
        local idx = isChroma and pvNameKeyTC[t] or pvNameKeyT[t]
        if not idx[n] then idx[n]=k end
        for _,al in ipairs(aliases) do
            if al~="" and not idx[al] then idx[al]=k end
        end
    end
end


for k,rec in pairs(meshDB) do
    if not rec.tex then
        local base=k:gsub("Chroma$",""):gsub("_%a_%d+$","")
        local bk=pvNameKey[pvNorm(base)]
        local b=bk and meshDB[bk]
        if b and b.tex and bk~=k then rec.tex=b.tex end
    end
end
function pvResolveKey(w)
    if not w then return nil end


    if not w.name then return nil end
    local n=pvNorm(w.name)
    do


        local t2=(w.type=="Gun") and "Gun" or "Knife"

        local n2 = n
        if w.chroma and n2:sub(1,6)=="chroma" then n2 = n2:sub(7) end
        if w.chroma then
            local hit = pvNameKeyTC[t2][n2] or pvNameKeyTC[t2][n]
            if hit then return hit end
        else
            local hit = pvNameKeyT[t2][n]
            if hit then return hit end
        end
    end
    local t=(w.type=="Gun") and "Gun" or "Knife"
    return pvNameKeyT[t][n] or nil
end


pvGameAng = {}
pcall(function()
    local Sync = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Database.Sync)
    local GW = Sync and Sync.Weapons
    if not GW then return end
    for gk,e in pairs(GW) do
        if type(e)=="table" and e.Angles then
            local A={e.Angles.X or 0, e.Angles.Y or 0, e.Angles.Z or 0}
            pvGameAng[gk]=A
            if e.ItemName then pvGameAng["n:"..pvNorm(e.ItemName)]=A end
        end
    end


end)
function pvEquippedAngles(slot)
    local nm = (slot=="Gun") and LP:GetAttribute("EquippedGun") or LP:GetAttribute("EquippedKnife")
    if not nm then return {0,0,0} end
    return pvGameAng[nm] or pvGameAng["n:"..pvNorm(nm)] or {0,0,0}
end


pvBase = {
    Gun   = CFrame.new(0.130, 0, 0.075) * CFrame.fromOrientation(0, math.rad(-60), math.rad(90)),
    Knife = CFrame.new(),
}
function pvCaptureBase(slot, disp)
    if pvBase[slot] then return end
    local rc=disp:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
    local att=(rc and rc.Attachment1) or disp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
    if not att then return end
    local eq=pvEquippedAngles(slot)
    pvBase[slot]=att.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(eq[1],eq[2],eq[3]):inverse()
end
local meshDirty=false
local function meshCount() local n=0 for _ in pairs(meshDB) do n=n+1 end return n end
local function saveMeshes()
    if not (hasFile and meshDirty) then return end
    meshDirty=false
    pcall(function()
        if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
        writefile(MESH_PATH, HttpService:JSONEncode(meshDB))
    end)
end
local nameToWeapon={}
for _,w in ipairs(items) do


    if w.kind=="Weapon" then
        local b=(w.base or w.name):lower()
        if not nameToWeapon[b] then nameToWeapon[b]=w end
        nameToWeapon[w.name:lower()]=w
    end
end
local function grabMesh(root)
    local stack={root}
    while #stack>0 do
        local x=table.remove(stack)
        if x:IsA("MeshPart") and x.MeshId~="" then
            return {mesh=x.MeshId, tex=(x.TextureID~="" and x.TextureID or nil),
                    size={x.Size.X,x.Size.Y,x.Size.Z}}
        end
        if x:IsA("SpecialMesh") and x.MeshId~="" then
            return {mesh=x.MeshId, tex=(x.TextureId~="" and x.TextureId or nil),
                    scale={x.Scale.X,x.Scale.Y,x.Scale.Z}}
        end
        for _,c in ipairs(x:GetChildren()) do stack[#stack+1]=c end
    end
end
local function harvestFrom(container)
    for _,obj in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Tool") or obj:IsA("Model") then
            local w=nameToWeapon[obj.Name:lower()]
            if w and not meshDB[w.id] then
                local m=grabMesh(obj)
                if m then
                    meshDB[w.id]=m; meshDirty=true
                    saveMeshes()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function displayPart(slot)
    local ch=LP.Character; if not ch then return nil end
    local ov=ch:FindFirstChild((slot=="Gun") and "DisplayRefGun" or "DisplayRefKnife")
    return (ov and ov.Value) or ch:FindFirstChild(slot.."Display")
end


function pvEnsureDisplay(slot)
    local ch=LP.Character; if not ch then return nil end
    local refName=(slot=="Gun") and "DisplayRefGun" or "DisplayRefKnife"
    local ov=ch:FindFirstChild(refName)
    if ov and ov.Value and ov.Value.Parent then return ov.Value end
    local torso, anchorName
    if slot=="Gun" then torso=ch:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso"); anchorName="GunBelt"
    else torso=ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso"); anchorName="KnifeBack" end
    local anchor=torso and torso:FindFirstChild(anchorName)
    if not anchor then return nil end
    local wd=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
    if not wd then wd=Instance.new("Folder");wd.Name="WeaponDisplays";wd.Parent=workspace end


    local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name=(slot=="Gun") and "GunDisplay" or "KnifeDisplay"
    p:SetAttribute("pvMade", true)
    p.Size=Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2);p.Transparency=0;p.CanCollide=false;p.Massless=true;p.Anchored=false
    pcall(function() p.CanQuery=false;p.CanTouch=false end)
    local sm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");sm.Name="Mesh";sm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh;sm.Parent=p
    local att=Instance.new("Attachment");att.Name="Attachment";att.Parent=p
    p.Parent=wd
    local rc=Instance.new("RigidConstraint");rc.Attachment0=anchor;rc.Attachment1=att;rc.Parent=p
    if ov then ov.Value=p
    else local nov=Instance.new("ObjectValue");nov.Name=refName;nov.Value=p;nov.Parent=ch end
    return p
end

pvNativeDirty = false
pcall(function()
    if hasFile and isfileSafe(NATIVE_PATH) then
        local raw=HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(NATIVE_PATH))
        if type(raw)=="table" then
            for k,v in pairs(raw) do
                local id=tonumber(k)
                if id and type(v)=="table" and #v>=3 then
                    pvNativeCache[id]=Vector3.new(v[1],v[2],v[3])
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
function pvSaveNative()
    if not (hasFile and pvNativeDirty) then return end
    pvNativeDirty=false
    pcall(function()
        local out={}
        for id,v in pairs(pvNativeCache) do out[tostring(id)]={v.X,v.Y,v.Z} end
        if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
        writefile(NATIVE_PATH, HttpService:JSONEncode(out))
    end)
end
function nativeSize(mesh)
    local mid=tonumber(tostring(mesh):match("%d+")); if not mid then return nil end
    if pvNativeCache[mid] then return pvNativeCache[mid] end
    if not (Content and Content.fromAssetId) then return nil end
    local content=Content.fromAssetId(mid)
    local ok,mp=pcall(function() return game:GetService("AssetService"):CreateMeshPartAsync(content) end)
    if ok and mp then
        local s=mp.Size; pcall(function() mp:Destroy() end)
        pvNativeCache[mid]=s; pvNativeDirty=true
        task.delay(2,pvSaveNative)
        return s
    end
end


PV_TARGET = {Gun=1.96, Knife=3.9}


PV_MESH_SCALE = {}
pcall(function()
    local raw = HttpService:JSONDecode(PV_WDB_JSON)
    local acc = {}
    for _,e in pairs(raw) do
        local m = e.m and tostring(e.m):match("%d+")
        if m and e.sx and tonumber(e.sx) then
            acc[m] = acc[m] or {}
            table.insert(acc[m], tonumber(e.sx))
        end
    end
    for m,list in pairs(acc) do
        table.sort(list)
        PV_MESH_SCALE[m] = list[math.ceil(#list/2)]
    end
end)


PV_BUCKET_SCALE = {Gun={}, Knife={}}
pcall(function()
    local function bucket(nat)
        if nat < 10 then return "s" elseif nat < 45 then return "m"
        elseif nat < 55 then return "l" elseif nat < 80 then return "xl" else return "xxl" end
    end
    local raw = HttpService:JSONDecode(PV_WDB_JSON)
    local acc = {Gun={}, Knife={}}
    for _,e in pairs(raw) do
        if e.sx and tonumber(e.sx) then
            local N = nativeSize(e.m)
            if N then
                local slot = (e.typ=="Gun") and "Gun" or "Knife"
                local b = bucket(math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z))
                acc[slot][b] = acc[slot][b] or {}
                table.insert(acc[slot][b], tonumber(e.sx))
            end
        end
    end
    for slot,tbl in pairs(acc) do
        for b,list in pairs(tbl) do
            if #list >= 3 then
                table.sort(list)
                PV_BUCKET_SCALE[slot][b] = list[math.ceil(#list/2)]
            end
        end
    end
    PV_BUCKET_OF = bucket
end)


PV_REAL_LEN = { Knife={3.00, 4.05}, Gun={1.83, 1.96} }


function pvFitSize(mesh, slot)
    local N=nativeSize(mesh)
    if not N then return nil end
    local L=math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z)
    local t=PV_TARGET[slot] or 2.5
    local f=(L>0.001) and (t/L) or 1
    return N*f
end


PV_SIZE_MULT = {

    Gingerscope = 1.45,
    TreeGun2023 = 0.85, TreeGun2023Chroma = 0.85,
    TreeKnife2023 = 0.85, TreeKnife2023Chroma = 0.85,


}
function pvRenderScale(rec, slot, id)

    if rec.real then
        if rec.scale and rec.scale[1] then
            return Vector3.new(rec.scale[1], rec.scale[2] or rec.scale[1], rec.scale[3] or rec.scale[1])
        end


        if rec.size then
            local Nc = nativeSize(rec.mesh)
            local want = math.max(rec.size[1] or 0, rec.size[2] or 0, rec.size[3] or 0)
            local nat  = Nc and math.max(Nc.X, Nc.Y, Nc.Z) or 0
            if want > 0.01 and nat > 0.001 then
                local f = want / nat
                return Vector3.new(f, f, f)
            end
        end
    end
    local N=nativeSize(rec.mesh)
    local mult=(tonumber(rec.ov) or 1)*((id and PV_SIZE_MULT[id]) or 1)
    local sc
    if rec.scale and rec.scale[1] then
        sc=Vector3.new(rec.scale[1], rec.scale[2] or rec.scale[1], rec.scale[3] or rec.scale[1])
    elseif rec.mp then
        sc=Vector3.new(1,1,1)
    end
    if sc and N then


        local L=math.max(N.X*sc.X, N.Y*sc.Y, N.Z*sc.Z)


        local lo = (slot=="Gun") and 1.50 or 0.5
        local hi = (slot=="Gun") and 4.60 or 6.0
        if L < lo or L > hi then sc=nil end
    end
    if sc then return sc*mult end


    local mid = rec.mesh and tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+")
    local sib = (slot=="Gun") and mid and PV_MESH_SCALE[mid] or nil
    if sib and N then


        local v = sib * (mult or 1)
        local L = math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z) * v
        if L >= 0.5 and L <= 6.0 then return Vector3.new(v, v, v) end
    end

    if slot=="Gun" and N and PV_BUCKET_OF and PV_BUCKET_SCALE[slot] then
        local b = PV_BUCKET_SCALE[slot][PV_BUCKET_OF(math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z))]
        if b then
            local v = b * (mult or 1)
            local L = math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z) * v
            if L >= 0.5 and L <= 6.0 then return Vector3.new(v,v,v) end
        end
    end
    local fit = pvFitScale(rec.mesh, slot)
    if mult and mult > 1 and N then
        local MAXLEN = (slot=="Gun") and 3.2 or 4.6
        local base   = math.max(N.X*fit.X, N.Y*fit.Y, N.Z*fit.Z)
        local want   = base * mult
        if want > MAXLEN then mult = MAXLEN / base end
        return fit * mult
    end
    return fit
end

function pvNormId(u) local n=tostring(u or ""):match("%d+"); return n and ("rbxassetid://"..n) or "" end
function pvHarvest()
    local wd=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays"); if not wd then return 0 end

    local mine={}
    local ch=LP.Character
    if ch then for _,rn in ipairs({"DisplayRefGun","DisplayRefKnife"}) do
        local ov=ch:FindFirstChild(rn); if ov and ov.Value then mine[ov.Value]=true end
    end end
    local got=0
    for _,d in ipairs(wd:GetChildren()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") and not mine[d]
           and not tostring(d.Name):find("pvWorn") and not tostring(d.Name):find("pvClone") then
            local sm=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
            local mesh = d:IsA("MeshPart") and tostring(d.MeshId):match("%d+")
                         or (sm and tostring(sm.MeshId):match("%d+"))
            if mesh and not pvDisp[mesh] then
                local e={ form=(d:IsA("MeshPart") and "MP" or "SM"),
                          sz={d.Size.X,d.Size.Y,d.Size.Z} }
                if sm then
                    e.sc={sm.Scale.X,sm.Scale.Y,sm.Scale.Z}
                    e.of={sm.Offset.X,sm.Offset.Y,sm.Offset.Z}
                end
                local rc=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
                local att=(rc and rc.Attachment1) or d:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                if att then e.att={att.CFrame:GetComponents()} end
                local tex = d:IsA("MeshPart") and tostring(d.TextureID) or (sm and tostring(sm.TextureId))
                if tex and tex~="" then e.tx=tex end
                e.co={d.Color.R,d.Color.G,d.Color.B}
                e.mt=tostring(d.Material):gsub("Enum%.Material%.","")
                pvDisp[mesh]=e; pvDispDirty=true; got=got+1
            end
        end
    end
    if got>0 then pvSaveDisp() end
    return got
end


pvDisp = {}


function pvClearClone(slot)
    local wd=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays"); if not wd then return end
    for _,d in ipairs(wd:GetChildren()) do
        if d.Name=="pvClone"..slot then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
    end
end
function pvHarvested(id)
    local rec=meshDB[id]; if not rec then return nil end
    local mid=tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+")
    return mid and pvDisp[mid], mid
end


_G.pvRealTried = _G.pvRealTried or {}
function pvRealAssetId(wid)
    local e = Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[wid]
    if not e then return nil end
    local function asset(value)
        return tonumber(value) or tonumber(tostring(value or ""):match("%d+"))
    end
    return asset(e.DisplayID) or asset(e.ItemID)
end
function pvLoadRealMesh(wid, cb)
    if not wid then if cb then cb(false) end return end
    if _G.pvRealTried[wid] and meshDB[wid] then if cb then cb(true) end return end
    local aid = pvRealAssetId(wid)
    if not aid or type(game.GetObjects)~="function" then if cb then cb(false) end return end
    _G.pvRealTried[wid]=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,objs = pcall(function() return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..aid) end)
        if not ok or type(objs)~="table" or not objs[1] then if cb then cb(false) end return end
        local root=objs[1]
        local mesh,tex,size,scale

        local stack,best={root},nil
        while #stack>0 do
            local d=table.remove(stack)
            if d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.MeshId~="" then
                if not best or d.Name=="Handle" then
                    best={mesh=d.MeshId, tex=(d.TextureID~="" and d.TextureID or nil),
                          size={d.Size.X,d.Size.Y,d.Size.Z}}
                    if d.Name=="Handle" then break end
                end
            elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") and d.MeshId~="" then
                if not best then
                    best={mesh=d.MeshId, tex=(d.TextureId~="" and d.TextureId or nil),
                          scale={d.Scale.X,d.Scale.Y,d.Scale.Z}}
                end
            end
            for _,c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do stack[#stack+1]=c end
        end
        pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
        if best then
            mesh,tex,size,scale = best.mesh,best.tex,best.size,best.scale
            meshDB[wid]={mesh=mesh, tex=tex, size=size, scale=scale, mp=(size~=nil) or nil, real=true, typ=Sync.Weapons[wid].ItemType}
            meshDirty=true
            pcall(saveMeshes)
        end
        if cb then cb(best~=nil) end
    end)
end


function pvMPSize(id, slot)
    local rec=meshDB[id]; if not rec then return nil end
    local H=pvHarvested(id)
    if H and H.sz then return Vector3.new(H.sz[1],H.sz[2],H.sz[3]) end
    local N=nativeSize(rec.mesh)
    if N then
        local L=math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z)
        local target=(slot=="Gun") and 2.7 or 3.4
        local f=(L>0.001) and (target/L) or 1
        return N*f
    end
end


function pvSMScale(id, slot)
    local H=pvHarvested(id); local rec=meshDB[id]
    if H and H.sc then return Vector3.new(H.sc[1],H.sc[2],H.sc[3]) end
    if rec and rec.scale then return Vector3.new(rec.scale[1],rec.scale[2],rec.scale[3]) end

    local N=rec and nativeSize(rec.mesh)
    if N then local L=math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z); local t=(slot=="Gun") and 2.7 or 3.4
        local f=(L>0.001) and (t/L) or 1; return Vector3.new(f,f,f) end
    return Vector3.new(1,1,1)
end


function pvRawWantCF(id, rec, H, slot)
    if H and H.att then
        local ok,cf=pcall(function() return CFrame.new(table.unpack(H.att)) end)
        if ok then return cf end
    end


    local corr = pvFixCF[pvNorm(id)]
    if corr then return corr end


    return PV_MOUNT[slot] or CFrame.new()
end


function pvBodyMountTune(slot, cf)
    if not cf then return cf end


    local mode=settings.visualPositions and settings.visualPositions[slot]
    if mode~="Side" then return cf end


    if slot=="Gun" then
        return cf * CFrame.fromOrientation(math.rad(17), 0, 0)
    elseif slot=="Knife" then
        return cf * CFrame.fromOrientation(math.rad(7), 0, 0)
    end
    return cf
end

function pvWantCF(id, rec, H, slot)
    return pvBodyMountTune(slot, pvRawWantCF(id, rec, H, slot))
end


function pvHeldGunDefaultPose(id, rec)


    local meshNum = rec and rec.mesh and tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+") or ""
    if meshNum=="79401392" then
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)
end


PV_FX_KIND = {}
pcall(function()
    local Sync = require(RS.Database.Sync)
    for id,e in pairs(Sync.Weapons) do
        if type(e)=="table" and e.FX then
            local n = tostring(id):lower()
            if     n:find("tree")   then PV_FX_KIND[id] = "lights"
            elseif n:find("synth")  then PV_FX_KIND[id] = "glow"
            elseif n:find("sunset") then PV_FX_KIND[id] = "sun"
            -- Gingerscope must stay clean: no movement trail on the gun.
            elseif n=="gingerscope" then PV_FX_KIND[id] = nil
            elseif n:find("ginger") then PV_FX_KIND[id] = "trail"
            else                         PV_FX_KIND[id] = "glow" end
        end
    end
end)
function pvClearFX(part)
    if not part then return end
    for _,c in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if c:GetAttribute("pvFX") then pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end
    end
end
function pvApplyFX(part, id)
    if not part then return end
    pvClearFX(part)
    -- Also clear any old Pork Hub trail when this gun is reapplied or re-equipped.
    if pvNorm(id)=="gingerscope" then return end
    local kind = PV_FX_KIND[id]
    if not kind then return end
    local function tag(o) o:SetAttribute("pvFX", true); o.Parent = part; return o end
    if kind == "lights" then

        local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
        l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120,255,140); l.Brightness = 2.2; l.Range = 9
        tag(l)
        local a = tag(Instance.new("Attachment"))
        local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        p.Texture = "rbxassetid://241876428"
        p.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(150,255,170), Color3.fromRGB(255,240,150))
        p.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.22)
        p.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.15),
                                             NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5,0.9); p.Rate = 14
        p.Speed = NumberRange.new(0); p.LightEmission = 1
        p.Parent = a; p:SetAttribute("pvFX", true)
    elseif kind == "glow" then

        pcall(function() part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon end)
        local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
        l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,90,220); l.Brightness = 3; l.Range = 11
        tag(l)
    elseif kind == "sun" then

        local l = Instance.new("PointLight")
        l.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,168,80); l.Brightness = 2.6; l.Range = 10
        tag(l)
    elseif kind == "trail" then

        local a0 = tag(Instance.new("Attachment")); a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)
        local a1 = tag(Instance.new("Attachment")); a1.Position = Vector3.new(0,-0.35, 0)
        local t = Instance.new("Trail")
        t.Attachment0 = a0; t.Attachment1 = a1
        t.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,190,120), Color3.fromRGB(255,110,60))
        t.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.25),
                                             NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        t.Lifetime = 0.45; t.LightEmission = 0.8; t.WidthScale = NumberSequence.new(1)
        t.Enabled = true; t.MinLength = 0.02; t.FaceCamera = true
        tag(t)
    end
end

function pvFindDisplayMesh(part)
    return part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") or part:FindFirstChildOfClass("FileMesh")
end
function pvSurface(disp, slot)
    if not disp:IsA("MeshPart") then

        pcall(function() disp.Transparency=0; disp.LocalTransparencyModifier=0 end)
        return disp
    end
    local name="pvWorn"..slot
    for _,c in ipairs(disp:GetChildren()) do
        if c.Name==name then pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end
    end
    pcall(function() disp.Transparency=1; disp.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end)
    local p=Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name=name; p.Size=Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)
    p.Transparency=0; p.CanCollide=false; p.Massless=true; p.Anchored=false
    pcall(function() p.CanQuery=false; p.CanTouch=false end)
    local sm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh"); sm.Name="Mesh"
    sm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh; sm.Parent=p
    p.CFrame=disp.CFrame
    p.Parent=disp
    local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); w.Part0=p; w.Part1=disp; w.Parent=p
    return p
end


PV_VisualMounts = setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
function pvVisualMountAnchor(ch,slot)
    if not ch then return nil end
    local mode=settings.visualPositions and settings.visualPositions[slot]
    if mode~="Side" and mode~="Back" then mode=slot=="Gun" and "Side" or "Back" end
    local torso=ch:FindFirstChild(mode=="Back" and "UpperTorso" or "LowerTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not torso then return nil end
    local anchorName=slot..(mode=="Back" and "Back" or "Belt")
    if ch~=LP.Character then
        -- Copy our mount's local transform, rather than their native holster pose.
        local source=pvVisualMountAnchor(LP.Character,slot)
        local anchor=torso:FindFirstChild("pvOtherMount"..slot)
        if not anchor then
            anchor=Instance.new("Attachment");anchor.Name="pvOtherMount"..slot
            anchor.Parent=torso;pvSession.ownRoot(anchor)
        end
        anchor.CFrame=source and source.CFrame or (mode=="Back" and CFrame.new(slot=="Gun" and 0.35 or -0.35,0,0.55)
            or CFrame.new(slot=="Gun" and 0.85 or -0.85,-0.35,0.15))
        return anchor,torso
    end
    local anchor=torso:FindFirstChild(anchorName) or torso:FindFirstChild("pvMount"..anchorName)
    if not anchor then
        anchor=Instance.new("Attachment");anchor.Name="pvMount"..anchorName
        anchor.CFrame=mode=="Back" and CFrame.new(slot=="Gun" and 0.35 or -0.35,0,0.55)
            or CFrame.new(slot=="Gun" and 0.85 or -0.85,-0.35,0.15)
        anchor.Parent=torso
    end
    return anchor,torso
end
function pvApplyVisualMount(disp, slot, character)
    local ch=character or LP.Character
    local anchor,torso=pvVisualMountAnchor(ch,slot)
    if not anchor then return end
    local rc=disp:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
    if rc then
        if ch==LP.Character and not PV_VisualMounts[rc] then
            PV_VisualMounts[rc]={anchor=rc.Attachment0, att=rc.Attachment1,
                cf=rc.Attachment1 and rc.Attachment1.CFrame}
        end
        rc.Attachment0=anchor
        return
    end

    for _,joint in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Weld") and joint.Part1==disp then
            if ch==LP.Character and not PV_VisualMounts[joint] then
                PV_VisualMounts[joint]={part=joint.Part0,c0=joint.C0,c1=joint.C1}
            end
            joint.Part0=torso
            joint.C0=anchor.CFrame
            joint.C1=CFrame.new()
            return
        end
    end
end
function pvRestoreVisualMounts()
    for joint,old in pairs(PV_VisualMounts) do
        pcall(function()
            if joint:IsA("RigidConstraint") then
                joint.Attachment0=old.anchor
                if old.att and old.cf then old.att.CFrame=old.cf end
            else joint.Part0=old.part; joint.C0=old.c0; joint.C1=old.c1 end
        end)
    end
    table.clear(PV_VisualMounts)
end

PV_StudioOriginal=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
PV_StudioHidden=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
PV_StudioMaterials={}
;(function()
    for _,material in ipairs(Enum.Material:GetEnumItems()) do PV_StudioMaterials[material.Value]=material end
end)()
function pvStudioOwned(object,root)
    while object and object~=root do


        if object:GetAttribute("pvStudioOwned") or object:GetAttribute("pvFX")
           or object.Name:match("^pvWorn") or object.Name=="pvHeld" then return true end
        object=object.Parent
    end
    return false
end
function pvHideStudioOriginal(disp)
    for _,object in ipairs(disp:GetDescendants()) do
        if not pvStudioOwned(object,disp) then
            local property
            if object:IsA("BasePart") then property="LocalTransparencyModifier"
            elseif object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then property="Transparency"
            elseif object:IsA("Beam") or object:IsA("Trail") or object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then property="Enabled" end
            if property then
                if not PV_StudioHidden[object] then
                    PV_StudioHidden[object]={property=property,value=object[property],root=disp}
                end
                if property=="Enabled" then object[property]=false else object[property]=1 end
            end
        end
    end
end
function pvClearStudioDetails(root)
    if not root then return end
    for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:GetAttribute("pvStudioOwned") then object:Destroy() end
    end
    root:SetAttribute("pvStudioKey",nil)
end
function pvRestoreStudioDetails(root)
    for object,old in pairs(PV_StudioHidden) do
        if not root or old.root==root then
            pcall(function() object[old.property]=old.value end)
            PV_StudioHidden[object]=nil
        end
    end
    for surf,old in pairs(PV_StudioOriginal) do
        if not root or surf==root or surf:IsDescendantOf(root) then
            pcall(function()
                pvClearStudioDetails(surf)
                surf.Size=old.size;surf.Transparency=old.transparency;surf.Reflectance=old.reflectance
                local sm=pvFindDisplayMesh(surf)
                if sm and old.vertex then sm.VertexColor=old.vertex end
            end)
            PV_StudioOriginal[surf]=nil
        end
    end
end
function pvStudioPaint(part,record)
    if record.size then part.Size=Vector3.new(table.unpack(record.size)) end
    if record.color then part.Color=Color3.new(table.unpack(record.color)) end
    part.Material=PV_StudioMaterials[record.material] or Enum.Material.Plastic
    part.Transparency=record.transparency or 0
    part.Reflectance=record.reflectance or 0
end
function pvStudioDecals(part,record)
    for _,data in ipairs(record.decals or {}) do
        local decal=Instance.new(data.class=="Texture" and "Texture" or "Decal")
        decal.Name="pvStudioDecal";decal:SetAttribute("pvStudioOwned",true)
        decal.Texture=data.texture;decal.Face=Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()[1]
        for _,face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do if face.Value==data.face then decal.Face=face;break end end
        decal.Transparency=data.transparency or 0
        if data.color then decal.Color3=Color3.new(table.unpack(data.color)) end
        if decal:IsA("Texture") then decal.StudsPerTileU=data.u;decal.StudsPerTileV=data.v end
        decal.Parent=part
    end
end
function pvApplyStudioDetails(surf,record,id)
    if not record.studio then pvClearStudioDetails(surf);return end
    if not PV_StudioOriginal[surf] then
        local sm=pvFindDisplayMesh(surf)
        PV_StudioOriginal[surf]={size=surf.Size,transparency=surf.Transparency,reflectance=surf.Reflectance,vertex=sm and sm.VertexColor}
    end
    pvStudioPaint(surf,record)
    local mainMesh=pvFindDisplayMesh(surf)
    if mainMesh then
        mainMesh.Offset=record.offset and Vector3.new(table.unpack(record.offset)) or Vector3.new()
        mainMesh.VertexColor=record.vertex and Vector3.new(table.unpack(record.vertex)) or Vector3.new(1,1,1)
    end
    if surf:GetAttribute("pvStudioKey")==id and surf:FindFirstChild("pvStudioDetails") then return end
    pvClearStudioDetails(surf)
    local folder=Instance.new("Folder");folder.Name="pvStudioDetails";folder:SetAttribute("pvStudioOwned",true);folder.Parent=surf
    pvStudioDecals(surf,record)
    for _,data in ipairs(record.parts or {}) do
        local class=data.primitive
        if class~="WedgePart" and class~="CornerWedgePart" then class="Part" end
        local p=Instance.new(class);p.Name=data.name or "Detail"
        p:SetAttribute("pvStudioOwned",true)
        p.Anchored=false;p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false;p.Massless=true
        pvStudioPaint(p,data)
        if data.mesh and data.mesh~="" then
            local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            mesh.MeshId=pvNormId(data.mesh);mesh.TextureId=pvNormId(data.tex)
            mesh.Scale=Vector3.new(table.unpack(data.scale or {1,1,1}))
            mesh.Offset=Vector3.new(table.unpack(data.offset or {0,0,0}))
            mesh.VertexColor=Vector3.new(table.unpack(data.vertex or {1,1,1}))
            mesh.Parent=p
        elseif p:IsA("Part") then
            for _,shape in ipairs(Enum.PartType:GetEnumItems()) do if shape.Value==data.shape then p.Shape=shape;break end end
        end
        p.CFrame=surf.CFrame*CFrame.new(table.unpack(data.cf))
        p.Parent=folder
        pvStudioDecals(p,data)
        local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint");weld.Part0=surf;weld.Part1=p;weld.Parent=p
    end
    surf:SetAttribute("pvStudioKey",id)
end
local function wearMesh(id, slot, fast)
    local rec=meshDB[id]
    local disp=displayPart(slot) or pvEnsureDisplay(slot)
    if not (rec and disp) then return false end


    local H=nil
    local tex=rec.tex

    pvApplyVisualMount(disp, slot)
    if rec.studio then pvHideStudioOriginal(disp) end
    local surf=pvSurface(disp, slot)
    local sm=pvFindDisplayMesh(surf)
    if not sm then sm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");sm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh;sm.Parent=surf end


    _G.pvOrigMesh = _G.pvOrigMesh or {}
    if _G.pvOrigMesh[sm]==nil then
        _G.pvOrigMesh[sm] = {
            sm  = sm,
            mid = sm.MeshId, tex = sm.TextureId,
            sc  = sm.Scale,  of  = sm.Offset,
            col = surf.Color, mat = surf.Material, surf = surf,
        }
    end
    pcall(function() sm.MeshId=pvNormId(rec.mesh) end)
    pcall(function() sm.TextureId=pvNormId(tex) end)
    local sc
    if H and H.sc then
        sc=Vector3.new(H.sc[1],H.sc[2],H.sc[3])
    elseif H and H.sz then
        local N=nativeSize(rec.mesh)
        if N then
            local L=math.max(N.X,N.Y,N.Z)
            local T=math.max(H.sz[1],H.sz[2],H.sz[3])
            local f=(L>0.001) and (T/L) or 1
            sc=Vector3.new(f,f,f)
        end
    end
    pcall(function() sm.Scale = sc or pvRenderScale(rec, slot, id) end)
    pcall(function() sm.Offset=(H and H.of) and Vector3.new(H.of[1],H.of[2],H.of[3]) or Vector3.new(0,0,0) end)


    do
        local rc = disp:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
        local att = (rc and rc.Attachment1) or disp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
        if att then
            local want = pvWantCF(id, rec, H, slot)
            if want then pcall(function() att.CFrame=want end) end
        end
    end
    if rec.color then
        pcall(function() surf.Color=Color3.new(rec.color[1],rec.color[2],rec.color[3]) end)
    elseif (not tex) or tex=="" then


        pcall(function() surf.Color = PV_GREY end)
    end
    if rec.mat then pcall(function() surf.Material=Enum.Material[rec.mat] end) end
    if not fast then pcall(pvApplyFX, surf, id) end


    do
        _G.pvChromaOn = _G.pvChromaOn or {}
        _G.pvChromaOn[slot] = nil
        for _,c in ipairs(surf:GetChildren()) do
            if c:GetAttribute("pvDecal") then pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end
        end
        pcall(function()
            local m2 = pvFindDisplayMesh(surf)
            if m2 then m2.VertexColor = Vector3.new(1,1,1) end
        end)
    end
    if not fast then pvApplyStudioDetails(surf,rec,id) end
    wornSlots[slot]=id


    if not fast then pcall(pvCleanDuplicateDisplays) end
    return true
end

pvInventoryVisualSync=true
PV_VisualSaved={Knife=settings.loadout.wornKnife, Gun=settings.loadout.wornGun}
PV_VisualSavedIDs={Knife=settings.loadout.knife, Gun=settings.loadout.gun}
PV_VisualRequest={}
PV_VisualPending={}
function pvRefreshVisualInventory()
    if PV_VisualUpdating then return end
    PV_VisualUpdating=true
    for slot,selection in pairs(PV_VisualSelection or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped[slot]=selection.id
            EquipService.EquippedChanged:Fire(slot,selection.id)
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        local m=require(RS.Modules.InventoryModule)
        if m.GUI and m.GUI.MyInventory and m.MyInventory and m.MyInventory.Data then
            m.UpdateMyEquip()
        end
    end)
    PV_VisualUpdating=false
end
PV_VisualSelection={}
PV_VisualSeen={}
PV_VisualUpdating=false
_G.pvEquipIdleToken = _G.pvEquipIdleToken or {Knife=0,Gun=0}
_G.pvSaveDebounce = _G.pvSaveDebounce or 0

function pvScheduleEquipFinalize(slot,key,itemID,token)

    task.delay(0.24,function()
        if not (_G.pvEquipIdleToken and _G.pvEquipIdleToken[slot]==token) then return end
        local sel=PV_VisualSelection and PV_VisualSelection[slot]
        if not (sel and sel.key==key and sel.id==itemID) then return end


        pcall(wearMesh,key,slot,false)


        pcall(pvRefreshVisualInventory)


        _G.pvSaveDebounce=(_G.pvSaveDebounce or 0)+1
        local saveToken=_G.pvSaveDebounce
        task.delay(0.08,function()
