            if _G.pvSaveDebounce==saveToken then pcall(saveCfg) end
        end)
    end)
end

function pvEquipVisualKey(key, slot, itemID)
    local rec=meshDB[key]
    if not rec then return false end
    slot=(slot=="Gun") and "Gun" or "Knife"
    itemID=itemID or key

    PV_VisualRequest[slot]=(PV_VisualRequest[slot] or 0)+1
    PV_VisualPending[slot]=nil
    PV_VisualSelection[slot]={key=key,id=itemID}
    PV_VisualSeen[slot]=itemID
    settings.bodyCleared=false
    wornSlots[slot]=key
    bodyWorn={}


    pcall(clearHolster)

    if slot=="Knife" then
        settings.loadout.wornKnife=key
        settings.loadout.knife=itemID
    else
        settings.loadout.wornGun=key
        settings.loadout.gun=itemID
    end


    pcall(function()
        ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped[slot]=itemID
    end)


    local shown=wearMesh(key,slot,true)


    pcall(pvReskinHeld,slot)

    _G.pvEquipIdleToken[slot]=(_G.pvEquipIdleToken[slot] or 0)+1
    pvScheduleEquipFinalize(slot,key,itemID,_G.pvEquipIdleToken[slot])

    return shown
end

function pvSyncInventorySlot(slot,id)
    if slot~="Knife" and slot~="Gun" then return false end
    if type(id)~="string" or id=="" then id="Default"..slot end
    local key=meshDB[id] and id or nil
    local w=byId[id]
    if key and meshDB[key] then return pvEquipVisualKey(key,slot,id) end

    PV_VisualRequest[slot]=(PV_VisualRequest[slot] or 0)+1
    local request=PV_VisualRequest[slot]
    local generation=_G.pvGen
    PV_VisualSeen[slot]=id
    PV_VisualSelection[slot]=nil
    wornSlots[slot]=nil
    if slot=="Knife" then settings.loadout.wornKnife=nil
    else settings.loadout.wornGun=nil end
    local disp=displayPart(slot)
    if disp then
        pvRestoreStudioDetails(disp)
        local stand=disp:FindFirstChild("pvWorn"..slot)
        if stand then stand:Destroy() end
        for sm,old in pairs(_G.pvOrigMesh or {}) do
            if old.surf==disp then
                pcall(function()
                    sm.MeshId=old.mid; sm.TextureId=old.tex
                    sm.Scale=old.sc; sm.Offset=old.of
                    disp.Color=old.col; disp.Material=old.mat
                end)
                _G.pvOrigMesh[sm]=nil
            end
        end
        pcall(function() disp.Transparency=0;disp.LocalTransparencyModifier=0 end)
    end
    pcall(saveCfg)
    if pvRealAssetId(id) then
        PV_VisualPending[slot]=id
        pcall(notify,"Loading visual: "..((w and w.name) or id))
        pvLoadRealMesh(id,function(got)
            if generation~=_G.pvGen or PV_VisualRequest[slot]~=request then return end
            PV_VisualPending[slot]=nil
            if got and meshDB[id] then
                pcall(pvEquipVisualKey,id,slot,id)
            else
                pcall(notify,((w and w.name) or id)..": visual model unavailable")
            end
        end)
    else
        pcall(notify,((w and w.name) or id)..": no supported visual model")
    end
    return false
end


local function scrubDisplays(keepWorn)
    local wd=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays"); if not wd then return end
    for _,d in ipairs(wd:GetChildren()) do
        local nm=tostring(d.Name)
        if nm:find("pvClone") or nm:find("pvDisp") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        else for _,c in ipairs(d:GetChildren()) do
            local cn=tostring(c.Name)
            local isWorn = cn:find("pvWorn")

            local slot = isWorn and cn:gsub("pvWorn","") or nil
            local keep = keepWorn and slot and wornSlots and wornSlots[slot]~=nil
            if (isWorn and not keep) or cn:find("pvClone") or cn:find("pvDisp") then
                pcall(function() c:Destroy() end)
            end
        end end
    end
end
local function clearWorn(slot)
    local slots = slot and {slot} or {"Gun","Knife"}
    for _,s in ipairs(slots) do wornSlots[s]=nil end
    scrubDisplays()
    local ch=LP.Character
    if ch then local h=ch:FindFirstChild(PV_HOLDER); if h then pcall(function() h:Destroy() end) end end
end


function pvCleanDuplicateDisplays()
    local wd=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays"); if not wd then return 0 end
    local ch=LP.Character
    local keep={}
    if ch then
        for _,rn in ipairs({"DisplayRefGun","DisplayRefKnife"}) do
            local ov=ch:FindFirstChild(rn)
            if ov and ov.Value then keep[ov.Value]=true end
        end
    end


    local killed=0
    for _,d in ipairs(wd:GetChildren()) do
        local isDisp = (d.Name=="KnifeDisplay" or d.Name=="GunDisplay")
        -- Only remove displays positively identified as belonging to us.
        -- Other players' native displays share this folder and these names.
        local rc=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
        local anchor=rc and rc.Attachment0
        local localOwned=ch and anchor and anchor:IsDescendantOf(ch)
        if not keep[d] and localOwned and (isDisp or d:GetAttribute("pvMade")) then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end); killed=killed+1
        end
    end
    return killed
end

function killLegacyHolder()
    local ch=LP.Character
    if ch then local h=ch:FindFirstChild(PV_HOLDER); if h then pcall(function() h:Destroy() end) end end
    scrubDisplays()
end
pcall(killLegacyHolder)
pcall(pvCleanDuplicateDisplays)
pvSession.connect(LP.CharacterAdded,function()
    task.wait(1.4)
    pcall(killLegacyHolder)
    pcall(pvCleanDuplicateDisplays)
    for slot,id in pairs(wornSlots) do pcall(wearMesh,id,slot) end
end)


_G.pvHotbarWanted   = _G.pvHotbarWanted   or {}
_G.pvHotbarTargets  = _G.pvHotbarTargets  or {Knife={},Gun={}}
_G.pvHotbarMatch    = _G.pvHotbarMatch    or {}
_G.pvHotbarScanning = _G.pvHotbarScanning or {}
_G.pvHotbarWatching = _G.pvHotbarWatching or {}

function pvHotbarAid(v)
    return tostring(v or ""):match("%d+") or ""
end

function pvHotbarish(obj)
    local p=obj
    for _=1,7 do
        p=p and p.Parent
        if not p then break end
        local n=tostring(p.Name):lower()
        if n:find("hotbar",1,true) or n=="backpack" or n:find("backpack",1,true) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function pvRememberHotbarTarget(slot,g)
    if not (g and g.Parent and (g:IsA("ImageLabel") or g:IsA("ImageButton"))) then return end
    _G.pvHotbarTargets[slot]=_G.pvHotbarTargets[slot] or {}

    for _,x in ipairs(_G.pvHotbarTargets[slot]) do
        if x==g then
            local icon=_G.pvHotbarWanted[slot]
            if icon and icon~="" then pcall(function() g.Image=icon end) end
            return
        end
    end

    table.insert(_G.pvHotbarTargets[slot],g)
    local icon=_G.pvHotbarWanted[slot]
    if icon and icon~="" then pcall(function() g.Image=icon end) end


    local busy=false
    pcall(function()
        g:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function()
            if busy or not g.Parent then return end
            local want=_G.pvHotbarWanted[slot]
            if not want or want=="" or g.Image==want then return end
            local m=_G.pvHotbarMatch[slot]
            local cur=pvHotbarAid(g.Image)
            if m and (cur==m.def or cur==m.old or cur==m.prev or cur==m.want) then
                busy=true
                pcall(function() g.Image=want end)
                busy=false
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function pvPatchCachedHotbar(slot)
    local arr=_G.pvHotbarTargets[slot] or {}
    local alive={}
    local icon=_G.pvHotbarWanted[slot]
    for _,g in ipairs(arr) do
        if g and g.Parent and (g:IsA("ImageLabel") or g:IsA("ImageButton")) then
            alive[#alive+1]=g
            if icon and icon~="" and g.Image~=icon then pcall(function() g.Image=icon end) end
        end
    end
    _G.pvHotbarTargets[slot]=alive
    return #alive
end

function pvTryHotbarCandidate(g)
    if not (g and (g:IsA("ImageLabel") or g:IsA("ImageButton")) and pvHotbarish(g)) then return end
    local cur=pvHotbarAid(g.Image)
    if cur=="" then return end
    for _,slot in ipairs({"Knife","Gun"}) do
        local m=_G.pvHotbarMatch[slot]
        if m and (cur==m.want or cur==m.old or cur==m.prev or cur==m.def) then
            pvRememberHotbarTarget(slot,g)
        end
    end
end


function pvInstallHotbarWatcher(root,key)
    if not root or _G.pvHotbarWatching[key] then return end
    _G.pvHotbarWatching[key]=true
    pcall(function()
        pvSession.connect(root.DescendantAdded,function(obj)
            if _G.pvGen~=MY_GEN then return end
            if obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                task.defer(function()
                    if _G.pvGen==MY_GEN and obj and obj.Parent then
                        pcall(pvTryHotbarCandidate,obj)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end)
end
pcall(function() pvInstallHotbarWatcher(game:GetService("CoreGui"),"CoreGui") end)
pcall(function() pvInstallHotbarWatcher(LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"),"PlayerGui") end)

function pvPatchRoundHotbarIcon(tool, slot, visualId, newIcon, oldIcon, previousVisualIcon)
    if not (tool and newIcon and newIcon~="") then return 0 end
    local want=pvHotbarAid(newIcon); if want=="" then return 0 end

    _G.pvHotbarWanted[slot]=newIcon

    local defIcon=""
    pcall(function()
        local did="Default"..tostring(slot)
        local w=byId and byId[did]
        defIcon=w and w.img or ""
        if defIcon=="" then
            local e=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[did]
            if e then defIcon=resolveImg(did,e.Image) end
        end
        defIcon=pvFixImg(defIcon)
    end)


    _G.pvHotbarMatch[slot]={
        want=want,
        old=pvHotbarAid(oldIcon),
        prev=pvHotbarAid(previousVisualIcon),
        def=pvHotbarAid(defIcon),
    }


    local n=pvPatchCachedHotbar(slot)
    if n>0 then return n end


    if _G.pvHotbarScanning[slot] then return 0 end
    _G.pvHotbarScanning[slot]=true

    task.defer(function()
        if _G.pvGen~=MY_GEN then _G.pvHotbarScanning[slot]=nil return end

        local function scan(root)
            if not root then return end
            local all=root:GetDescendants()

            for i,g in ipairs(all) do
                if g:IsA("ImageLabel") or g:IsA("ImageButton") then
                    pcall(pvTryHotbarCandidate,g)
                end
                if i%120==0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end

        pcall(function() scan(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        pcall(function() scan(LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")) end)
        _G.pvHotbarScanning[slot]=nil
        pvPatchCachedHotbar(slot)
    end)

    return 0
end


_G.pvHeldAssetCache   = _G.pvHeldAssetCache   or {}
_G.pvHeldAssetLoading = _G.pvHeldAssetLoading or {}
_G.pvHeldAssetCb      = _G.pvHeldAssetCb      or {}
_G.pvHeldAssetPending = _G.pvHeldAssetPending or {}
_G.pvOrigRoundGrip    = _G.pvOrigRoundGrip    or setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})

function pvHeldSyncKey(visualKey, slot)
    local sid=visualKey
    pcall(function()
        local s=PV_VisualSelection and PV_VisualSelection[slot]
        if s and s.id and Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[s.id] then sid=s.id end
    end)
    if Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[sid] then return sid end
    if Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[visualKey] then return visualKey end

    local target
    pcall(function()
        local w=byId and (byId[sid] or byId[visualKey])
        target=w and (w.base or w.name)
    end)
    if target and Sync and Sync.Weapons then
        local n=pvNorm(target)
        for k,e in pairs(Sync.Weapons) do
            if type(e)=="table" and e.ItemType=="Gun" and e.ItemName and pvNorm(e.ItemName)==n then
                return k
            end
        end
    end
    return sid
end

function pvHeldGripFromData(data)
    if type(data)~="table" or #data<12 then return nil end
    local ok,cf=pcall(function() return CFrame.new(table.unpack(data)) end)
    return ok and cf or nil
end

function pvSanitizeHeldTool(tool)
    if not tool then return end
    pcall(function()
        tool.CanBeDropped=false
        tool.RequiresHandle=false
    end)
    for _,d in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                d.Anchored=false
                d.CanCollide=false
                d.Massless=true
                d.CanTouch=false
                d.CanQuery=false
                d.CastShadow=false
            end)
        elseif d:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
            pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end

function pvLoadExactHeldGun(syncId, cb)
    if not syncId then if cb then cb(false) end return end
    local cached=_G.pvHeldAssetCache[syncId]
    if cached~=nil then
        if cb then cb(cached~=false,cached~=false and cached or nil) end
        return
    end
    if _G.pvHeldAssetLoading[syncId] then
        if cb and not _G.pvHeldAssetCb[syncId] then _G.pvHeldAssetCb[syncId]=cb end
        return
    end

    _G.pvHeldAssetLoading[syncId]=true
    if cb then _G.pvHeldAssetCb[syncId]=cb end

    task.spawn(function()
        local result=nil
        pcall(function()
            local e=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[syncId]
            if not e then return end
            local function asset(v)
                return tonumber(v) or tonumber(tostring(v or ""):match("%d+"))
            end
            local aid=asset(e.ItemID) or asset(e.DisplayID)
            if not aid or type(game.GetObjects)~="function" then return end

            local objs=game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..aid)
            local root=type(objs)=="table" and objs[1] or nil
            if not root then return end

            local sourceTool=nil
            if root:IsA("Tool") and root:FindFirstChild("Handle",true) then
                sourceTool=root
            else
                for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if d:IsA("Tool") and d:FindFirstChild("Handle",true) then
                        sourceTool=d
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if not sourceTool then
                pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
                return
            end

            local template=sourceTool:Clone()
            pvSanitizeHeldTool(template)
            local th=template:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
            if not (th and th:IsA("BasePart")) then
                pcall(function() template:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
                return
            end

            local g=sourceTool.Grip
            result={template=template,grip={g:GetComponents()},assetId=aid}
            pcall(function() root:Destroy() end)
        end)

        _G.pvHeldAssetLoading[syncId]=nil
        _G.pvHeldAssetCache[syncId]=result or false

        local f=_G.pvHeldAssetCb[syncId]
        _G.pvHeldAssetCb[syncId]=nil
        if f then pcall(f,result~=nil,result) end
    end)
end

function pvQueueHeldGunLoad(syncId, visualId, handle)
    if not syncId or _G.pvHeldAssetCache[syncId]~=nil
       or _G.pvHeldAssetLoading[syncId] or _G.pvHeldAssetPending[syncId] then return end

    _G.pvHeldAssetPending[syncId]=true
    local gen=_G.pvGen


    task.delay(0.30,function()
        _G.pvHeldAssetPending[syncId]=nil
        if _G.pvGen~=gen or not handle or not handle.Parent then return end
        if not (wornSlots and wornSlots.Gun==visualId) then return end
        if pvHeldSyncKey(visualId,"Gun")~=syncId then return end

        pvLoadExactHeldGun(syncId,function(ok)
            if _G.pvGen==gen and ok and handle and handle.Parent
               and wornSlots and wornSlots.Gun==visualId then
                pcall(function() handle:SetAttribute("pvHeldPose",nil) end)
                task.defer(function() pcall(pvReskinHeld,"Gun") end)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

function pvClearHeldGunVisual(handle)
    if not handle then return end
    for _,nm in ipairs({
        "pvHeld","pvHeldGunV18","pvHeldGunV19","pvHeldGunV20",
        "pvHeldRealGunV21","pvHeldRealGunV22"
    }) do
        local x=handle:FindFirstChild(nm)
        if x then pcall(function() x:Destroy() end) end
    end
end

function pvBuildExactHeldGun(roundTool,roundHandle,id,syncId,entry)
    if not (roundTool and roundHandle and entry and entry.template) then return false end
    local targetGrip=pvHeldGripFromData(entry.grip)
    if not targetGrip then return false end

    local defaultGrip=CFrame.new()
    if roundTool:IsA("Tool") then
        if not _G.pvOrigRoundGrip[roundTool] then
            _G.pvOrigRoundGrip[roundTool]=roundTool.Grip
        end
        defaultGrip=_G.pvOrigRoundGrip[roundTool]
    end


    local correction=defaultGrip:Inverse()*targetGrip

    pvClearHeldGunVisual(roundHandle)

    local visualTool=entry.template:Clone()
    visualTool.Name="pvHeldRealGunV22"
    pvSanitizeHeldTool(visualTool)
    local visualHandle=visualTool:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
    if not (visualHandle and visualHandle:IsA("BasePart")) then
        pcall(function() visualTool:Destroy() end)
        return false
    end


    local parts={}
    for _,d in ipairs(visualTool:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts[#parts+1]=d end
    end
    local sourceHandleCF=visualHandle.CFrame
    local rel={}
    for _,p in ipairs(parts) do
        rel[p]=sourceHandleCF:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
    end

    visualTool.Parent=roundHandle
    pcall(function() roundHandle.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end)

    local targetCF=roundHandle.CFrame*correction
    for _,p in ipairs(parts) do
        pcall(function() p.CFrame=targetCF*rel[p] end)
        if p~=visualHandle and not p:FindFirstChild("pvRigidV22") then
            local wc=Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            wc.Name="pvRigidV22"
            wc.Part0=visualHandle
            wc.Part1=p
            wc.Parent=p
        end
    end

    local weld=Instance.new("Weld")
    weld.Name="pvHeldRealGunWeldV22"
    weld.Part0=roundHandle
    weld.Part1=visualHandle
    weld.C0=correction
    weld.C1=CFrame.new()
    weld.Parent=visualHandle

    pcall(function()
        visualTool:SetAttribute("pvHeldVisualId",tostring(id))
        visualTool:SetAttribute("pvHeldSyncId",tostring(syncId))
    end)
    return true
end

-- Both local and other-player held guns use exactly the same mesh and pose.
function pvRenderHeldGun(h,id,rec)
    if not (h and rec and rec.mesh) then return false end
    local meshNum=tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+")
    if not meshNum then return false end
    local texNum=rec.tex and tostring(rec.tex):match("%d+") or nil


        local poseTag=tostring(id)..":Gun:v50:familyangle"
        if h:GetAttribute("pvHeldSkin")~=id or h:GetAttribute("pvHeldPose")~=poseTag or not h:FindFirstChild("pvHeldFastGunV24") then
            pcall(function() h.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end)


            for _,nm in ipairs({
                "pvHeld","pvHeldGunV18","pvHeldGunV19","pvHeldGunV20",
                "pvHeldRealGunV21","pvHeldRealGunV22"
            }) do
                local old=h:FindFirstChild(nm)
                if old then pcall(function() old:Destroy() end) end
            end

            local disp=h:FindFirstChild("pvHeldFastGunV24")
            if not disp then
                disp=Instance.new("Part")
                disp.Name="pvHeldFastGunV24"
                disp.Size=Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)
                disp.Transparency=0
                disp.CanCollide=false
                disp.Massless=true
                pcall(function()
                    disp.CanQuery=false
                    disp.CanTouch=false
                    disp.CastShadow=false
                end)
                local m=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
                m.Name="Mesh"
                m.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
                m.Parent=disp
                disp.Parent=h

                local weld=Instance.new("Weld")
                weld.Name="pvHeldFastGunWeldV24"
                weld.Part0=h
                weld.Part1=disp
                weld.C0=CFrame.new()
                weld.C1=CFrame.new()
                weld.Parent=disp
            end

            local m=pvFindDisplayMesh(disp)
            local heldScale=pvRenderScale(rec,"Gun",id)
            if m then
                pcall(function()
                    m.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..meshNum
                    m.TextureId=texNum and ("rbxassetid://"..texNum) or ""
                    m.Scale=heldScale or Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
                    if rec.offset then
                        m.Offset=Vector3.new(rec.offset[1] or 0,rec.offset[2] or 0,rec.offset[3] or 0)
                    else
                        m.Offset=Vector3.new()
                    end
                    m.VertexColor=Vector3.new(1,1,1)
                end)
            end

            local weld=disp:FindFirstChild("pvHeldFastGunWeldV24")
            if weld and weld:IsA("Weld") then


                local heldCF=pvHeldGunDefaultPose(id,rec)
                pcall(function()
                    weld.Part0=h
                    weld.Part1=disp
                    weld.C0=heldCF
                    weld.C1=CFrame.new()
                    disp.CFrame=h.CFrame*heldCF
                end)
            end


            pcall(function()
                h:SetAttribute("pvHeldSkin",id)
                h:SetAttribute("pvHeldPose",poseTag)
            end)
        end
        return true
end

function pvReskinHeld(slot)
    if settings.bodyCleared then return end
    local ch=LP.Character; if not ch then return end

    local id=wornSlots and wornSlots[slot]


    if not id and slot=="Gun" then
        id="DefaultGun"
    end

    if not id then return end
    local rec=meshDB[id]; if not (rec and rec.mesh) then return end

    local meshNum=tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+"); if not meshNum then return end
    local texNum=rec.tex and tostring(rec.tex):match("%d+") or nil

    local bp=LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    local tool=ch:FindFirstChild(slot) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(slot))
    if not (tool and (tool:IsA("Tool") or tool:IsA("Model"))) then return end
    if slot=="Knife" then _G.pvLastRoundKnifeSeen=os.clock() end


    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
        local w=byId and byId[id]
        local icon=w and w.img or ""
        if icon=="" then
            local e=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]
            if e then icon=resolveImg(id,e.Image) end
        end
        icon=pvFixImg(icon)
        if icon~="" then
            local oldIcon=tool:GetAttribute("pvOrigRoundIcon")
            if oldIcon==nil then
                oldIcon=tostring(tool.TextureId or "")
                pcall(function() tool:SetAttribute("pvOrigRoundIcon",oldIcon) end)
            end
            local previousVisualId=tool:GetAttribute("pvHotbarVisualId")
            local first=(previousVisualId~=tostring(id))
            local previousVisualIcon=""
            if first and previousVisualId and tostring(previousVisualId)~="" then
                pcall(function()
                    local pw=byId and byId[tostring(previousVisualId)]
                    previousVisualIcon=pw and pw.img or ""
                    if previousVisualIcon=="" then
                        local pe=Sync and Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[tostring(previousVisualId)]
                        if pe then previousVisualIcon=resolveImg(tostring(previousVisualId),pe.Image) end
                    end
                    previousVisualIcon=pvFixImg(previousVisualIcon)
                end)
            end

            local parentKey=(tool.Parent==ch) and "char" or ((bp and tool.Parent==bp) and "backpack" or tostring(tool.Parent))
            local lastParent=tostring(tool:GetAttribute("pvHotbarParent") or "")
            local texNow=tostring(tool.TextureId or ""):match("%d+") or ""
            local texWant=tostring(icon):match("%d+") or ""
            local needPatch=first or lastParent~=parentKey or texNow~=texWant

            if texNow~=texWant then pcall(function() tool.TextureId=icon end) end
            if needPatch then
                pcall(pvPatchRoundHotbarIcon,tool,slot,id,icon,oldIcon,previousVisualIcon)
                pcall(function()
                    tool:SetAttribute("pvHotbarVisualId",tostring(id))
                    tool:SetAttribute("pvHotbarParent",parentKey)
                end)


                task.delay(0.12,function()
                    if tool.Parent then pcall(pvPatchRoundHotbarIcon,tool,slot,id,icon,oldIcon,previousVisualIcon) end
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local h=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") or tool:FindFirstChild("Handle",true)
    if not h then return end

    if slot=="Gun" then
        pvRenderHeldGun(h,id,rec)
        return
    end

    local heldScale=pvRenderScale(rec,slot,id)
    local poseTag=tostring(id)..":"..tostring(slot)..":v23"
    if h:GetAttribute("pvHeldSkin")==id and h:GetAttribute("pvHeldPose")==poseTag then return end

    if rec.studio then pvHideStudioOriginal(h) end
    local sm=pvFindDisplayMesh(h)
    if sm then
        pcall(function()
            sm.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..meshNum
            sm.TextureId=texNum and ("rbxassetid://"..texNum) or ""
            if heldScale then sm.Scale=heldScale end
        end)
    elseif h:IsA("MeshPart") then
        pcall(function() h.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end)
        local disp=h:FindFirstChild("pvHeld")
        if not disp then
            disp=Instance.new("Part")
            disp.Name="pvHeld"
            disp.Size=Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)
            disp.CanCollide=false
            disp.Massless=true
            pcall(function() disp.CanQuery=false; disp.CanTouch=false end)
            local m=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            m.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            m.Name="Mesh"
            m.Parent=disp
            local wc=Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            wc.Part0=h
            wc.Part1=disp
            wc.Parent=disp
            disp.Parent=h
        end
        pcall(function() disp.CFrame=h.CFrame end)
        local m=pvFindDisplayMesh(disp)
        if m then pcall(function()
            m.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..meshNum
            m.TextureId=texNum and ("rbxassetid://"..texNum) or ""
            m.Scale=heldScale or Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
        end) end
    end

    local heldSurf=h:FindFirstChild("pvHeld") or h
    pcall(pvApplyStudioDetails,heldSurf,rec,id)
    pcall(pvApplyFX,heldSurf,id)
    pcall(function()
        h:SetAttribute("pvHeldSkin",id)
        h:SetAttribute("pvHeldPose",poseTag)
    end)
end


pcall(function()
    local function hookHeldContainer(container)
        if not container or container:GetAttribute("pvHeldWatcher") then return end
        container:SetAttribute("pvHeldWatcher",true)
        pvSession.connect(container.ChildAdded,function(child)
            if child.Name=="Gun" or child.Name=="Knife" then


                if child.Name=="Knife" and child:IsA("Tool") and not child:GetAttribute("pvThrowHook") then
                    child:SetAttribute("pvThrowHook",true)
                    pvSession.connect(child.Activated,function()
                        _G.pvThrowActiveUntil=os.clock()+2.8
                    end)
                end
                task.defer(function() pcall(pvReskinHeld,child.Name) end)
            end
        end)
    end
    hookHeldContainer(LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
    hookHeldContainer(LP.Character)
    pvSession.connect(LP.CharacterAdded,function(ch)
        hookHeldContainer(ch)
        task.defer(function()
            pcall(pvReskinHeld,"Gun")
            pcall(pvReskinHeld,"Knife")
        end)
    end)
    pcall(pvReskinHeld,"Gun")
    pcall(pvReskinHeld,"Knife")
end)


_G.pvThrowActiveUntil = _G.pvThrowActiveUntil or 0
_G.pvThrowCandidatePart = nil
_G.pvThrowFollowerV17 = _G.pvThrowFollowerV17 or nil

function pvThrowMeshId(v)
    return tostring(v or ""):match("%d+") or ""
end

function pvThrowPartMesh(part)
    if not (part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then return "" end
    local m=""
    pcall(function()
        if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
            m=pvThrowMeshId(part.MeshId)
        else
            local sm=pvFindDisplayMesh(part)
            m=sm and pvThrowMeshId(sm.MeshId) or ""
        end
    end)
    return m
end

function pvThrowStrictPart(obj, allowVisual)
    if not obj then return nil end
    if obj:IsA("SpecialMesh") then obj=obj.Parent end
    if not (obj and obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Parent) then return nil end


    if obj:GetAttribute("pvThrowCandidateV17")==true then return obj end


    if obj.Anchored then return nil end

    local ch=LP.Character
    if ch and obj:IsDescendantOf(ch) then return nil end
    local bp=LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    if bp and obj:IsDescendantOf(bp) then return nil end

    local p=obj
    for _=1,10 do
        if not p or p==workspace then break end
        if p:IsA("Tool") then return nil end
        if p:IsA("Model") and p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return nil end
        if p.Name=="WeaponDisplays" then return nil end
        p=p.Parent
    end


    local s=obj.Size
    if math.max(s.X,s.Y,s.Z) > 7 or (s.X*s.Y*s.Z) > 22 then return nil end


    local hrp=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp and (obj.Position-hrp.Position).Magnitude > 140 then return nil end

    local def=""
    pcall(function()
        local r=meshDB and meshDB.DefaultKnife
        def=r and pvThrowMeshId(r.mesh) or ""
    end)

    local selected=""
    pcall(function()
        local id=wornSlots and wornSlots.Knife
        local r=id and meshDB and meshDB[id]
        selected=r and pvThrowMeshId(r.mesh) or ""
    end)

    local cur=pvThrowPartMesh(obj)
    if cur=="" then return nil end
    if def~="" and cur==def then return obj end
    if allowVisual and selected~="" and cur==selected and os.clock()<=((_G.pvThrowActiveUntil) or 0) then
        return obj
    end
    return nil
end

function pvThrowDestroyFollower()
    local f=_G.pvThrowFollowerV17
    if type(f)=="table" then
        pcall(function() if f.conn then f.conn:Disconnect() end end)
        pcall(function() if f.visual and f.visual.Parent then f.visual:Destroy() end end)
    end
    _G.pvThrowFollowerV17=nil
end
pvSession.addCleanup(function() pcall(pvThrowDestroyFollower) end)

function pvThrowMakeVisual(part,id,rec)
    if not (part and part.Parent and rec and rec.mesh) then return nil end


    local disp=part:FindFirstChild("pvThrowVisualV17")
    if not disp then
        disp=Instance.new("Part")
        disp.Name="pvThrowVisualV17"
        disp.Size=Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2)
        disp.Anchored=true
        disp.Transparency=0
        disp.CanCollide=false
        disp.Massless=true
        pcall(function()
            disp.CanTouch=false
            disp.CanQuery=false
            disp.CastShadow=false
        end)
        local m=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        m.Name="Mesh"
        m.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        m.Parent=disp


        disp.Parent=workspace
    end

    local meshNum=pvThrowMeshId(rec.mesh)
    local texNum=pvThrowMeshId(rec.tex)
    local sc=pvRenderScale(rec,"Knife",id) or Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
    local m=pvFindDisplayMesh(disp)
    if m then
        pcall(function()
            m.MeshId="rbxassetid://"..meshNum
            m.TextureId=(texNum~="") and ("rbxassetid://"..texNum) or ""
            m.Scale=sc
            if rec.offset then
                m.Offset=Vector3.new(rec.offset[1] or 0,rec.offset[2] or 0,rec.offset[3] or 0)
            end
        end)
    end

    if disp:GetAttribute("pvVisualId")~=tostring(id) then
        pcall(pvApplyStudioDetails,disp,rec,id)
        pcall(pvApplyFX,disp,id)
        pcall(function() disp:SetAttribute("pvVisualId",tostring(id)) end)
    end
    return disp
end

function pvThrowStartFollower(part)
    part=pvThrowStrictPart(part,true)
    if not part then return false end

    local id=wornSlots and wornSlots.Knife
    local rec=id and meshDB and meshDB[id]
    if not (id and rec and rec.mesh) then return false end

    pcall(function() part:SetAttribute("pvThrowCandidateV17",true) end)
    _G.pvThrowCandidatePart=part


    pvThrowDestroyFollower()

    local disp=pvThrowMakeVisual(part,id,rec)
    if not disp then return false end


    pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end)

    local state={
        part=part,
        visual=disp,
        lift=0,
        lastGroundCheck=0,
        started=os.clock(),
        conn=nil,
    }
    _G.pvThrowFollowerV17=state

    local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
    state.conn=pvSession.connect(RunService.RenderStepped,function()
        if _G.pvThrowFollowerV17~=state or _G.pvGen~=MY_GEN
           or not part.Parent or not disp.Parent then
            pvThrowDestroyFollower()
            return
        end


        if os.clock()-state.started > 6.0 then
            pvThrowDestroyFollower()
            return
        end

        local speed=999
        pcall(function() speed=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude end)


        if speed<3.0 and os.clock()-state.lastGroundCheck>0.10 then
            state.lastGroundCheck=os.clock()
            state.lift=0
            pcall(function()
                local rp=RaycastParams.new()
                rp.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                local ex={part,disp}
                local ch=LP.Character
                if ch then ex[#ex+1]=ch end
                rp.FilterDescendantsInstances=ex


                local hit=workspace:Raycast(
                    part.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0),
                    Vector3.new(0,-3.0,0),
                    rp
                )
                if hit then
                    local need=hit.Position.Y-part.Position.Y+0.18
                    if need>0.04 then state.lift=math.clamp(need,0.06,0.75) end
                end
            end)
        elseif speed>=3.0 then
            state.lift=0
        end


        pcall(function()
            disp.CFrame=part.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,state.lift,0)
        end)
    end)

    return true
end

pcall(function()
    local myGen=_G.pvGen
    local watched=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})

    local function watchPart(part)
        if _G.pvGen~=myGen or not part or not part.Parent then return end
        part=pvThrowStrictPart(part,true)
        if not part then return end
        if watched[part] then
            if _G.pvThrowCandidatePart~=part then pcall(pvThrowStartFollower,part) end
            return
        end
        watched[part]=true
        pcall(function() part:SetAttribute("pvThrowCandidateV17",true) end)


        pcall(pvThrowStartFollower,part)
        for _,d in ipairs({0.06,0.16,0.32,0.60,1.0}) do
            task.delay(d,function()
                if _G.pvGen==myGen and part.Parent and _G.pvThrowCandidatePart~=part then
                    pcall(pvThrowStartFollower,part)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function armThrow()
        if _G.pvGen~=myGen or not (wornSlots and wornSlots.Knife) then return end
        _G.pvThrowActiveUntil=os.clock()+5

        local ch=LP.Character
        local tool=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        local h=tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if h and h:IsA("BasePart") and not h:GetAttribute("pvThrowHandleWatchV17") then
            h:SetAttribute("pvThrowHandleWatchV17",true)
            pvSession.connect(h.AncestryChanged,function()
                if _G.pvGen~=myGen then return end
                if h.Parent and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
                   and not (LP.Character and h:IsDescendantOf(LP.Character)) then
                    task.defer(watchPart,h)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function hookKnife(tool)
        if not (tool and tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name=="Knife") then return end
        if tool:GetAttribute("pvThrowHookV17") then return end
        tool:SetAttribute("pvThrowHookV17",true)
        pvSession.connect(tool.Activated,armThrow)
    end

    local function hookContainer(c)
        if not c then return end
        for _,x in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do hookKnife(x) end
        pvSession.connect(c.ChildAdded,hookKnife)
    end

    hookContainer(LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
    hookContainer(LP.Character)
    pvSession.connect(LP.CharacterAdded,function(ch)
        pvThrowDestroyFollower()
        hookContainer(ch)
        task.defer(function()
            hookContainer(LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
        end)
    end)

    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
        if processed or _G.pvGen~=myGen then return end
        local ch=LP.Character
        local knife=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        if not (knife and knife:IsA("Tool") and wornSlots and wornSlots.Knife) then return end
        if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.E
           or input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Q
           or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
            armThrow()
        end
    end)


    pvSession.connect(workspace.DescendantAdded,function(obj)
        if _G.pvGen~=myGen or os.clock()>((_G.pvThrowActiveUntil) or 0) then return end
        if not (obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")) then return end
        local part=pvThrowStrictPart(obj,true)
        if part then task.defer(watchPart,part) end
    end)
end)


_G.pvOtherSkins = _G.pvOtherSkins or {}
PV_OtherOriginal=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
function pvRememberOtherPart(p,userId,slot)
    if PV_OtherOriginal[p] then return end
    local mesh=pvFindDisplayMesh(p)
    local rc=p:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
    local att=(rc and rc.Attachment1) or p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
    local joint
    local plr=userId and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
    local ch=plr and plr.Character
    if not rc and ch then
        for _,item in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
            if item:IsA("Weld") and item.Part1==p then joint=item;break end
        end
    end
    local children={}
    for _,child in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do children[child]=true end
    PV_OtherOriginal[p]={userId=userId,slot=slot,transparency=p.Transparency,localTransparency=p.LocalTransparencyModifier,
        mesh=mesh,meshId=mesh and mesh.MeshId,texture=mesh and mesh.TextureId,
        scale=mesh and mesh.Scale,offset=mesh and mesh.Offset,
        attachment=att,attachmentCF=att and att.CFrame,rigid=rc,anchor=rc and rc.Attachment0,
        joint=joint,jointPart=joint and joint.Part0,jointC0=joint and joint.C0,jointC1=joint and joint.C1,children=children,heldSkin=p:GetAttribute("pvHeldSkin"),heldPose=p:GetAttribute("pvHeldPose"),skin=p:GetAttribute("pvOtherSkin")}
end
function pvRestoreOtherPlayer(plr)
    if not plr then return 0,0 end
    _G.pvOtherSkins[plr.UserId]=nil
    local restored,failed=0,0
    -- Recover marked displays from earlier script versions with no snapshot.
    local ch=plr.Character
    if ch then
        for _,slot in ipairs({"Knife","Gun"}) do
            local ref=ch:FindFirstChild(slot=="Gun" and "DisplayRefGun" or "DisplayRefKnife")
            local disp=ref and ref:IsA("ObjectValue") and ref.Value or ch:FindFirstChild(slot.."Display",true)
            local tool=ch:FindFirstChild(slot)
            local handle=tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            for _,part in pairs({display=disp,held=handle}) do
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("pvOtherSkin") and not PV_OtherOriginal[part] then
                    pvRememberOtherPart(part,plr.UserId,slot)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for part,old in pairs(PV_OtherOriginal) do
        if old.userId==plr.UserId then
            local ok,reason=pcall(function()
                if not part.Parent then return end
                if part.Name=="pvOtherDisplayKnife" or part.Name=="pvOtherDisplayGun" then
                    part:Destroy();restored=restored+1;return
                end
                -- A pre-existing skin marker means the snapshot was taken after
                -- an older version had already changed the native weapon.
                local contaminated=old.skin~=nil
                local actualKey
                if contaminated and not part:IsA("MeshPart") then
                    local actual=plr:GetAttribute(old.slot=="Gun" and "EquippedGun" or "EquippedKnife")
                    actual=actual and tostring(actual)
                    if actual and meshDB[actual] then actualKey=actual end
                    if not actualKey then error("Original weapon data unavailable; respawn or rejoin to reset this older visual") end
                end
                for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    if (child.Name=="pvOther" or child:GetAttribute("pvFX") or child:GetAttribute("pvOtherHeld"))
                        or (not old.children[child] and child:IsA("SpecialMesh")) then child:Destroy() end
                end
                if actualKey then
                    local rec=meshDB[actualKey]
                    local mesh=pvFindDisplayMesh(part)
                    if not mesh then mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh;mesh.Parent=part end
                    mesh.MeshId=pvNormId(rec.mesh);mesh.TextureId=pvNormId(rec.tex)
                    mesh.Scale=pvRenderScale(rec,old.slot,actualKey)
                    mesh.Offset=rec.offset and Vector3.new(table.unpack(rec.offset)) or Vector3.new()
                    if old.attachment and old.attachment.Parent then
                        old.attachment.CFrame=pvWantCF(actualKey,rec,nil,old.slot) or old.attachmentCF
                    end
                else
                    if old.mesh and old.mesh.Parent then
                        old.mesh.MeshId=old.meshId;old.mesh.TextureId=old.texture
                        old.mesh.Scale=old.scale;old.mesh.Offset=old.offset
                    end
                    if old.attachment and old.attachment.Parent then old.attachment.CFrame=old.attachmentCF end
                end
                if old.rigid and old.rigid.Parent then old.rigid.Attachment0=old.anchor end
                if old.joint and old.joint.Parent then
                    old.joint.Part0=old.jointPart;old.joint.C0=old.jointC0;old.joint.C1=old.jointC1
                end
                part.Transparency=contaminated and 0 or old.transparency
                part.LocalTransparencyModifier=contaminated and 0 or old.localTransparency
                part:SetAttribute("pvOtherSkin",nil)
                part:SetAttribute("pvHeldSkin",old.heldSkin)
                part:SetAttribute("pvHeldPose",old.heldPose)
                restored=restored+1
            end)
            if ok then PV_OtherOriginal[part]=nil
            else failed=failed+1;warn("porkVisuals restore: "..tostring(reason)) end
        end
    end
    if ch then
        for _,inst in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst.Name=="pvOtherDisplayKnife" or inst.Name=="pvOtherDisplayGun" then
                inst:Destroy();restored=restored+1
            elseif inst.Name=="pvOtherMountKnife" or inst.Name=="pvOtherMountGun" then inst:Destroy() end
        end
    end
    return restored,failed
end
function pvOtherClearNotice(restored,failed)
    if failed>0 then return "Cleared "..restored.." weapon display(s). Couldn't recover "..failed.." older visual(s); respawn or rejoin, then try again." end
    if restored==0 then return "No changed weapon displays found to clear." end
    return "Cleared "..restored.." weapon display(s); original weapons restored."
end
pvSession.addCleanup(function()
    for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do pcall(pvRestoreOtherPlayer,plr) end
end)
-- Leave the real players' weapon code unchanged. This helper only hides the
-- preview default knife/gun while a visual weapon skin is equipped.
function pvVisualDefaultVisibility(model,slot,show)
    if not (model and model.Parent) or (slot~="Knife" and slot~="Gun") then return end
    model:SetAttribute("pvVisualHideDefault"..slot,not show)
    local p=model:FindFirstChild("pvVisualBackDefault"..slot)
    if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
        p.Transparency=show and 0 or 1
        p.LocalTransparencyModifier=show and 0 or 1
    end
end
function pvSkinPart(p, key, slot, userId)
    if not (p and p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Parent) then return false end
    local rec = meshDB[key]; if not (rec and rec.mesh) then return false end
    local meshNum = tostring(rec.mesh):match("%d+"); if not meshNum then return false end
    local texNum = rec.tex and tostring(rec.tex):match("%d+") or nil
    pvRememberOtherPart(p,userId,slot)
    local sc = pvRenderScale(rec, slot, key)
    local sm = pvFindDisplayMesh(p)
    if not sm and not p:IsA("MeshPart") then
        sm=Instance.new("SpecialMesh");sm.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.FileMesh;sm.Parent=p
    end
    if sm then
        p.Transparency=0;p.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
        do
            sm.MeshId = "rbxassetid://"..meshNum
            sm.TextureId = texNum and ("rbxassetid://"..texNum) or ""
            if sc then sm.Scale = sc end
        end
    elseif p:IsA("MeshPart") then

        pcall(function() p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
        local disp = p:FindFirstChild("pvOther")
        if not disp then
            disp = Instance.new("Part"); disp.Name = "pvOther"
            disp.Size = Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2); disp.CanCollide = false; disp.Massless = true
            pcall(function() disp.CanQuery = false; disp.CanTouch = false end)
            local m = Instance.new("SpecialMesh"); m.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh; m.Parent = disp
            local wc = Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); wc.Part0 = p; wc.Part1 = disp; wc.Parent = disp
            pcall(function() disp.CFrame = p.CFrame end)
            disp.Parent = p
        end
        disp.Transparency=0;disp.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
        local m = pvFindDisplayMesh(disp)
        if m then
            m.MeshId = "rbxassetid://"..meshNum
            m.TextureId = texNum and ("rbxassetid://"..texNum) or ""
            m.Scale = sc or Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
        end
    end

    if p:GetAttribute("pvOtherSkin")~=tostring(key) then
        pcall(pvApplyFX, p:FindFirstChild("pvOther") or p, key)
    end

    pcall(function()
        local rc = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
        local att = (rc and rc.Attachment1) or p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
        local want = att and pvWantCF(key, rec, nil, slot)
        if want then att.CFrame = want end
    end)
    pcall(function() p:SetAttribute("pvOtherSkin", tostring(key)) end)
    return true
end
-- Other characters may not expose DisplayRefKnife/DisplayRefGun locally.
-- Create a client-only body display when neither a display nor held tool exists.
function pvEnsureOtherDisplay(ch,slot,key)
    local name="pvOtherDisplay"..slot
    local existing=ch:FindFirstChild(name)
    if existing and existing:IsA("BasePart") then return existing end
    local anchor=pvVisualMountAnchor(ch,slot)
    if not anchor then return nil end
    local p=Instance.new("Part");p.Name=name
    p.Size=Vector3.new(0.2,0.2,0.2);p.Anchored=false;p.Massless=true
    p.CanCollide=false;p.CanTouch=false;p.CanQuery=false
    local att=Instance.new("Attachment");att.Parent=p
    att.CFrame=pvWantCF(key,meshDB[key],nil,slot) or CFrame.new()
    p.CFrame=anchor.WorldCFrame*att.CFrame:Inverse()
    local rc=Instance.new("RigidConstraint");rc.Attachment0=anchor;rc.Attachment1=att;rc.Parent=p
    p.Parent=ch;pvSession.ownRoot(p)
    return p
end
function pvClearOtherDisplays()
    local restored,failed=0,0
    for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local count,errors=pvRestoreOtherPlayer(plr)
        restored=restored+count;failed=failed+errors
    end
    return restored,failed
end
function pvApplyOther(plr)
    local want=plr and _G.pvOtherSkins[plr.UserId]
    local ch=plr and plr.Character
    if not (want and ch and ch.Parent) then return false end
    local shown=false
    for slot,key in pairs(want) do
        local ov=ch:FindFirstChild(slot=="Gun" and "DisplayRefGun" or "DisplayRefKnife")
        local disp=ov and ov:IsA("ObjectValue") and ov.Value
        if not (disp and disp:IsA("BasePart") and disp.Parent) then
            disp=ch:FindFirstChild(slot.."Display",true)
        end
        if not (disp and disp:IsA("BasePart") and disp.Parent) then disp=nil end
        local tool=ch:FindFirstChild(slot)
        local handle=tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if not (handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then handle=nil end
        local fallback=ch:FindFirstChild("pvOtherDisplay"..slot)
        if disp or handle then
            if fallback then fallback:Destroy() end
        else
            disp=pvEnsureOtherDisplay(ch,slot,key)
        end
        if disp then
            pvRememberOtherPart(disp,plr.UserId,slot)
            pvApplyVisualMount(disp,slot,ch)
            shown=pvSkinPart(disp,key,slot,plr.UserId) or shown
        end
        if handle then
            if slot=="Gun" then
                pvRememberOtherPart(handle,plr.UserId,slot)
                local legacy=handle:FindFirstChild("pvOther")
                if legacy then legacy:Destroy() end
                shown=pvRenderHeldGun(handle,key,meshDB[key]) or shown
                local visual=handle:FindFirstChild("pvHeldFastGunV24")
                if visual then visual:SetAttribute("pvOtherHeld",true) end
                handle:SetAttribute("pvOtherSkin",tostring(key))
            else
                shown=pvSkinPart(handle,key,slot,plr.UserId) or shown
            end
        end
    end
    return shown
end
function pvSkinOther(plr,slot,key)
    if not (plr and plr.Parent and meshDB[key] and (slot=="Knife" or slot=="Gun")) then return false,"invalid" end
    _G.pvOtherSkins[plr.UserId]=_G.pvOtherSkins[plr.UserId] or {}
    _G.pvOtherSkins[plr.UserId][slot]=key
    local ok,shown=pcall(pvApplyOther,plr)
    if not ok then warn("porkVisuals other-player equip: "..tostring(shown));return false,"error" end
    return shown,shown and "shown" or "pending"
end

task.spawn(function()
    local myGen = _G.pvGen
    while _G.pvGen == myGen do
        pvTick("other-skins", 1)
        if next(_G.pvOtherSkins) ~= nil then
            for uid in pairs(_G.pvOtherSkins) do
                local fake=_G.pvVisualWeaponTarget
                local plr=(fake and fake.UserId==uid and fake.Character and fake.Character.Parent) and fake
                    or Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid)
                if plr then pcall(pvApplyOther, plr) else _G.pvOtherSkins[uid] = nil end
            end
        end
    end
end)


task.spawn(function()
    local myGen=_G.pvGen


    local miss={}
    local dupTick=0
    while _G.pvGen==myGen do
        pvTick("weapon-keeper", 0.6)


        dupTick = dupTick + 1
        if dupTick >= 10 then dupTick = 0; pcall(pvCleanDuplicateDisplays) end
        if next(wornSlots)==nil then continue end
        pcall(scrubDisplays, true)
        for slot in pairs(wornSlots) do pcall(pvReskinHeld, slot) end
        for slot,id in pairs(wornSlots) do
            local rec=meshDB[id]; local disp=displayPart(slot) or pvEnsureDisplay(slot)
            if rec and disp then
                pcall(pvApplyVisualMount,disp,slot)
                if rec.studio then pcall(pvHideStudioOriginal,disp) end


                local cur,curTex
                local stand=disp:FindFirstChild("pvWorn"..slot)
                if stand then
                    local sm=pvFindDisplayMesh(stand)
                    cur=sm and sm.MeshId; curTex=sm and sm.TextureId
                    disp.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
                elseif disp:IsA("MeshPart") then cur=disp.MeshId;curTex=disp.TextureID
                else
                    local sm=pvFindDisplayMesh(disp)
                    cur=sm and sm.MeshId;curTex=sm and sm.TextureId
                end

                if pvNormId(cur)~=pvNormId(rec.mesh) or pvNormId(curTex)~=pvNormId(rec.tex) then
                    miss[slot]=(miss[slot] or 0)+1
                    if miss[slot]>=2 then pcall(wearMesh,id,slot); miss[slot]=0 end
                else
                    miss[slot]=0


                    pcall(function()
                        local rc=disp:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
                        local att=(rc and rc.Attachment1) or disp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                        if not att then return end
                        local want=pvWantCF(id, rec, nil, slot)
                        if not want then return end

                        local a={att.CFrame:GetComponents()}
                        local b={want:GetComponents()}
                        for i=1,12 do
                            if math.abs(a[i]-b[i]) > 0.001 then att.CFrame=want; return end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)


function pvRestoreReal()
    table.clear(PV_VisualSelection)
    for _,slot in ipairs({"Knife","Gun"}) do
        PV_VisualRequest[slot]=(PV_VisualRequest[slot] or 0)+1
        PV_VisualPending[slot]=nil
    end
    pvRestoreStudioDetails()
    pvRestoreVisualMounts()
    wornSlots.Gun, wornSlots.Knife = nil, nil
    settings.loadout.wornKnife, settings.loadout.wornGun = nil, nil
    settings.bodyCleared = true
    pcall(saveCfg)
    pcall(clearHolster); pcall(killLegacyHolder); bodyWorn={}
    for _,slot in ipairs({"Gun","Knife"}) do
        local disp = displayPart(slot)
        if disp then
            for _,c in ipairs(disp:GetChildren()) do
                local n=tostring(c.Name)
                if n:find("pvWorn") or n:find("pvClone") or n:find("pvDisp") then pcall(function() c:Destroy() end) end
            end
            pcall(function() disp.Transparency=0; disp.LocalTransparencyModifier=0 end)
        end
    end
    if _G.pvOrigMesh then
        for _,o in pairs(_G.pvOrigMesh) do
            pcall(function()
                if o.sm and o.sm.Parent then o.sm.MeshId=o.mid; o.sm.TextureId=o.tex; o.sm.Scale=o.sc; o.sm.Offset=o.of end
                if o.surf and o.surf.Parent then o.surf.Color=o.col; o.surf.Material=o.mat end
            end)
        end
        _G.pvOrigMesh=nil
    end
    pcall(scrubDisplays)
end


;(function()
    local s=scroll(pWeap)
    local target=nil


    _G.pvWeapScroll=s
    lbl(s,"WEAPON POSITION",10,T.pink)


    local function themeOf(nm)
        local first=nm:match("^(%a+)")
        if not first then return nil end

                             "Bat","Log","Gem","Laser","Green","Blue","Red","Purple",
                             "Pumpkin","Frost","Shark","Eternal","Virtual","Sakura"}) do
            if nm:sub(1,#pre)==pre then return pre end
        end
        return first
    end
    local sets={}
    for _,w in ipairs(items) do
        if w.kind=="Weapon" and not w.evo then
            local th=themeOf(w.name)
            if th then
                sets[th]=sets[th] or {}
                local slot=(w.type=="Gun") and "gun" or "knife"
                local cur=sets[th][slot]
                if (not cur) or ((RANK[w.rarity] or 99) < (RANK[cur.rarity] or 99)) then
                    sets[th][slot]=w
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local setNames={}
    for th,v in pairs(sets) do
        if v.knife and v.gun then setNames[#setNames+1]=th end
    end
    table.sort(setNames)
    _G.pvServerOwned = _G.pvServerOwned or nil
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,inv=pcall(function()
            local f=RS.Remotes.Extras:FindFirstChild("GetFullInventory")
            return f and f:InvokeServer(LP.Name)
        end)
        if ok and inv and inv.Weapons and inv.Weapons.Owned then
            _G.pvServerOwned=inv.Weapons.Owned
        end
    end)
    local function serverOwns(id)
        local t=_G.pvServerOwned
        if not t then return nil end
        return t[id]~=nil
    end
    local function equipSlot(w)
        if not w then return false end
        local slot=(w.type=="Gun") and "Gun" or "Knife"
        pcall(function()
            local owned=ProfileData.Weapons.Owned
            owned[w.id]=math.max(owned[w.id] or 0,1)
        end)
        local realType=slot
        pcall(function()
            local info=_getIS():GetItemInfo(w.id,"Weapons")

    end

    function pvSession.makeSettingsPanel(name, title)
