    end

    -- Local display filter for Roblox's built-in ExperienceChat.
    ;(function()
        local panel = pvSession.makeSettingsPanel("ChatKeywordPanel", "Hidden Chat Keywords")
        local editor = box(panel, "Word or phrase")
        editor.Size = UDim2.new(1, -px(70), 0, px(30))
        editor.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(4), px(39))
        local status = lbl(panel, "", 10)
        status.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(5), px(75))
        status.Size = UDim2.new(1, -px(10), 0, px(30))
        local list = scroll(panel)
        list.Name = "KeywordList"
        list.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, px(110))
        list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -px(110))
        local rows = {}
        local entries = {}
        local stopWatching

        -- The small triangle is also generated by Roblox's native bubble
        -- renderer, independently of the message GUI. Hiding a message row
        -- or even searching for its Caret can leave that triangle on screen.
        -- TailVisible is the native switch: while keyword filtering is on,
        -- keep all tails off but leave unmatched message bodies visible.
        -- Restore the user's prior value when filtering is disabled/unloaded.
        local tailConfig, originalTailVisible, tailChangedConnection
        local tailFilterActive = false
        local function setNativeTailHidden(shouldHide)
            tailFilterActive = shouldHide
            if not shouldHide then
                if tailChangedConnection then
                    tailChangedConnection:Disconnect()
                    tailChangedConnection = nil
                end
                if tailConfig and tailConfig.Parent and originalTailVisible ~= nil then
                    pcall(function() tailConfig.TailVisible = originalTailVisible end)
                end
                tailConfig, originalTailVisible = nil, nil
                return
            end

            local ok, config = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("TextChatService"):FindFirstChildOfClass("BubbleChatConfiguration")
            end)
            if not ok or not config then return end
            if tailConfig ~= config then
                if tailChangedConnection then tailChangedConnection:Disconnect() end
                if tailConfig and tailConfig.Parent and originalTailVisible ~= nil then
                    pcall(function() tailConfig.TailVisible = originalTailVisible end)
                end
                tailConfig = config
                local readOk, original = pcall(function() return config.TailVisible end)
                originalTailVisible = readOk and original or nil
                -- Some chat versions reapply their configured appearance.
                -- Preserve the filter's tail-less state while it is active.
                tailChangedConnection = config:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TailVisible"):Connect(function()
                    if tailFilterActive and tailConfig == config then
                        pcall(function()
                            if config.TailVisible then config.TailVisible = false end
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            pcall(function() config.TailVisible = false end)
        end
    
        local function words(value)
            local result, seen = {}, {}
            for entry in value:gmatch("[^,\r\n]+") do
                local term = entry:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                local key = term:lower()
                if term ~= "" and not seen[key] then
                    seen[key] = true
                    result[#result + 1] = term
                end
            end
            return result
        end
    
        -- Pre-render keyword filter: hiding ExperienceChat GUI nodes only
        -- happens AFTER Roblox has begun constructing/animating a bubble.
        -- OnBubbleAdded runs before the bubble is rendered. It hides the
        -- message contents, but the engine can still create an exit shell.
        -- The GUI watchers below remain as a fallback for existing bubbles,
        -- legacy clients, and any ExperienceChat implementation variations.
        local bubbleChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
        local invisibleBubbleText = utf8.char(0x200B, 0x2060, 0x200B)
        local activeBubbleTerms = {}
        local bindings = {}
        local nativeTextReady, nativeBubbleReady = false, false
        local function filterStatus(guiState)
            if nativeTextReady then
                status.Text = "Keyword filter ready for new messages."
            elseif nativeBubbleReady then
                status.Text = "Bubble filter ready. " .. guiState
            else
                status.Text = guiState
            end
        end

        -- Remember a filtered message by MessageId as well as by text. Roblox
        -- can call OnBubbleAdded twice for a locally sent message; the second
        -- copy may already have filtered text (###) instead of the keyword.
        local filteredMessageIds = {}
        local function bubbleMessageKey(message)
            local ok, key = pcall(function() return message.MessageId end)
            return (ok and type(key) == "string" and key ~= "") and key or nil
        end

        -- Pre-render appearance overrides cannot CANCEL a bubble. On some
        -- ExperienceChat builds the exit transition makes a fresh default
        -- shell AFTER the message TextLabel has been removed. Keep the owning
        -- speaker's *BillboardGui* disabled through the full bubble lifetime.
        -- If a normal message from the same speaker arrives, release that
        -- speaker's guard immediately so their new message can display.
        local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local speakerActivity = {} -- [UserId] = {hiddenUntil, visibleUntil}
        local shieldedBillboards = {} -- [BillboardGui] = {wasEnabled, connection}
        local shieldRoots = {} -- [root] = connection
        local shieldEnabled, shieldAccumulator = false, 0

        local function getBubbleDurationWithExit()
            local duration = 15
            pcall(function()
                local cfg = bubbleChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("BubbleChatConfiguration")
                if cfg then duration = tonumber(cfg.BubbleDuration) or duration end
            end)
            return math.clamp(duration, 1, 90) + 4
        end

        local function getSenderId(message)
            local ok, id = pcall(function()
                local source = message.TextSource
                return source and source.UserId
            end)
            return (ok and type(id) == "number" and id > 0) and id or nil
        end

        local function rememberBubbleSpeaker(message, filtered)
            local id = getSenderId(message)
            if not id then return end
            local now = os.clock()
            local untilTime = now + getBubbleDurationWithExit()
            local state = speakerActivity[id]
            if not state then
                state = {hiddenUntil = 0, visibleUntil = 0}
                speakerActivity[id] = state
            end
            if filtered then
                state.hiddenUntil = math.max(state.hiddenUntil, untilTime)
            else
                -- A real message must be allowed to appear even if this
                -- speaker previously sent a keyword-filtered message.
                state.visibleUntil = math.max(state.visibleUntil, untilTime)
            end
        end

        local function shouldShieldSpeaker(id, now)
            local state = speakerActivity[id]
            return state and state.hiddenUntil > now and state.visibleUntil <= now
        end

        local function billboardOwnerId(billboard)
            local ok, adornee = pcall(function() return billboard.Adornee end)
            if not ok then adornee = nil end
            -- The native renderer normally sets Adornee to a body part. Some
            -- legacy layouts instead parent the billboard to the character.
            local parent = billboard.Parent
            for id, state in pairs(speakerActivity) do
                local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
                local character = plr and plr.Character
                if character then
                    local matches = false
                    pcall(function()
                        matches = (adornee and (adornee == character or adornee:IsDescendantOf(character)))
                            or (parent and (parent == character or parent:IsDescendantOf(character)))
                    end)
                    if matches then return id end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end

        local function releaseShield(billboard)
            local shield = shieldedBillboards[billboard]
            if not shield then return end
            shieldedBillboards[billboard] = nil
            if shield.connection then shield.connection:Disconnect() end
            if billboard.Parent and shield.wasEnabled then
                pcall(function() billboard.Enabled = true end)
            end
        end

        local function shieldBillboard(billboard)
            local shield = shieldedBillboards[billboard]
            if not shield then
                shield = {wasEnabled = billboard.Enabled}
                shieldedBillboards[billboard] = shield
                shield.connection = billboard:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                    if shieldedBillboards[billboard] == shield and billboard.Enabled then
                        billboard.Enabled = false
                    end
                end)
            end
            if billboard.Enabled then billboard.Enabled = false end
        end

        local function scanFadeShields()
            if not shieldEnabled then return end
            local now = os.clock()
            local hasActive = false
            for id, state in pairs(speakerActivity) do
                if state.hiddenUntil <= now and state.visibleUntil <= now then
                    speakerActivity[id] = nil
                elseif shouldShieldSpeaker(id, now) then
                    hasActive = true
                end
            end
            for billboard in pairs(shieldedBillboards) do
                local id = billboard.Parent and billboardOwnerId(billboard)
                if not id or not shouldShieldSpeaker(id, now) then
                    releaseShield(billboard)
                else
                    if billboard.Enabled then billboard.Enabled = false end
                end
            end
            if not hasActive then return end
            local rootsToInspect = {}
            -- New ExperienceChat is normally under CoreGui; some clients use
            -- PlayerGui/BubbleChat instead. Do not scan unrelated game UI.
            local function collect(holder)
                for _, name in ipairs({"ExperienceChat", "BubbleChat"}) do
                    local root = holder:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if root then rootsToInspect[#rootsToInspect + 1] = root end
                end
            end
            pcall(collect, PG)
            pcall(function() collect(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
            for _, root in ipairs(rootsToInspect) do
                if not shieldRoots[root] then
                    shieldRoots[root] = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(node)
                        if not shieldEnabled then return end
                        if node:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                            local id = billboardOwnerId(node)
                            if id and shouldShieldSpeaker(id, os.clock()) then
                                shieldBillboard(node)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
                for _, node in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if node:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        local id = billboardOwnerId(node)
                        if id and shouldShieldSpeaker(id, now) then
                            shieldBillboard(node)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function clearFadeShields()
            shieldEnabled = false
            table.clear(speakerActivity)
            table.clear(filteredMessageIds)
            for billboard in pairs(shieldedBillboards) do releaseShield(billboard) end
            for root, connection in pairs(shieldRoots) do
                connection:Disconnect()
                shieldRoots[root] = nil
            end
        end

        pvSession.connect(runService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
            if not shieldEnabled then return end
            -- Existing shields are reasserted every rendered frame, including
            -- when Roblox writes Enabled=true as its exit tween completes.
            for billboard in pairs(shieldedBillboards) do
                if billboard.Parent and billboard.Enabled then billboard.Enabled = false end
            end
            shieldAccumulator = shieldAccumulator + dt
            if shieldAccumulator >= 0.075 then
                shieldAccumulator = 0
                pcall(scanFadeShields)
            end
        end)

        local function matchesChatMessage(message)
            if #activeBubbleTerms == 0 then return false end
            local ok, body = pcall(function() return message.Text end)
            if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" then return false end
            if body == invisibleBubbleText then return true end
            body = body:lower()
            local hasTranslation, translation = pcall(function() return message.Translation end)
            local translated = hasTranslation and type(translation) == "string" and translation:lower() or ""
            local key = bubbleMessageKey(message)
            if key and filteredMessageIds[key] then return true end
            for _, term in ipairs(activeBubbleTerms) do
                if body:find(term, 1, true) or translated:find(term, 1, true) then
                    if key then filteredMessageIds[key] = true end
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function readCallback(name)
            local ok, callback = pcall(function() return bubbleChatService[name] end)
            if not ok and type(getcallbackvalue) == "function" then
                ok, callback = pcall(getcallbackvalue, bubbleChatService, name)
            end
            return ok and (callback == nil or type(callback) == "function"), callback
        end

        local function installFilter(name, apply)
            local readable, prior = readCallback(name)
            local binding = bindings[name]
            if not readable then return false end
            if binding and prior == binding.callback then return true end
            local callback = function(message, ...)
                local previous
                if prior then
                    local ok, result = pcall(prior, message, ...)
                    if ok then previous = result end
                end
                if not isCurrent() or #activeBubbleTerms == 0 then return previous end
                return apply(message, previous)
            end
            local ok = pcall(function() bubbleChatService[name] = callback end)
            if ok then bindings[name] = {callback=callback, prior=prior} end
            return ok
        end

        local function hideMessageText(message, previous)
            if not matchesChatMessage(message) then return previous end
            local props = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
            props.Text = invisibleBubbleText
            props.PrefixText = invisibleBubbleText
            props.Translation = invisibleBubbleText
            return props
        end

        local function hideBubble(message, previous)
            local filtered = matchesChatMessage(message)
            rememberBubbleSpeaker(message, filtered)
            if not filtered then return previous end
            pcall(scanFadeShields)
            local props = Instance.new("BubbleChatMessageProperties")
            props.Text = invisibleBubbleText
            props.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            props.TailVisible = false
            return props
        end

        local function uninstallFilters()
            activeBubbleTerms = {}
            nativeTextReady, nativeBubbleReady = false, false
            for name, binding in pairs(bindings) do
                local readable, current = readCallback(name)
                if readable and current == binding.callback then
                    pcall(function() bubbleChatService[name] = binding.prior end)
                end
                bindings[name] = nil
            end
        end

        -- Identify the *whole* message widget. The visible background and
        -- Caret/tail may be siblings of the TextLabel (not its descendants).
        -- Never hide the player's BillboardGui or the shared bubble stack:
        -- doing that would also remove unrelated messages from that player.
        local function isBubbleTail(obj)
            local name = obj.Name:lower()
            return name == "caret" or name == "tail" or name == "bubbletail"
                or name == "chatbubbletail" or name == "bubblechattail"
                or name == "chatbubbletailframe" or name == "bubbletailframe"
                or name == "bubblecaret" or name == "carettail"
        end

        local function hasOwnTail(frame)
            for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
                if isBubbleTail(child) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function hasAnotherMessage(frame, label)
            -- A shared bubble stack can contain several messages with the
            -- same label name. Do not hide that stack, even if it has a caret.
            for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetDescendants()) do
                if child ~= label and child.Name == label.Name
                    and (child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton")) then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end

        local function isSharedBubbleStack(node, bubbles)
            if node == bubbles or node.Name == "BillboardFrame"
                or node.Name == "BubbleChatList" or node.Name == "bubbleChat" then
                return true
            end
            -- A UIListLayout usually arranges several different message cells.
            return node:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") ~= nil
        end

        local function target(label, root)
            -- Regular chat history: each message owns one list row.
            local list = label:FindFirstAncestor("RCTScrollContentView")
            if list and label.Name == "TextMessage" then
                local row = label
                while row.Parent and row.Parent ~= list do row = row.Parent end
                if row.Parent == list and row:IsA("GuiObject") and row.Name:match("^[1-9]%d*%-") then
                    return row, true
                end
            end

            local bubbles = label:FindFirstAncestor("bubbleChat")
            if not bubbles or not bubbles:IsDescendantOf(root) then return end

            local node = label
            local fallback
            while node and node ~= bubbles and not node:IsA("BillboardGui") do
                if node:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    local parent = node.Parent
                    -- A Caret alongside the bubble body belongs to the same
                    -- message wrapper; hiding just the body leaves the tail.
                    if parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject") and hasOwnTail(parent)
                        and not isSharedBubbleStack(parent, bubbles)
                        and not hasAnotherMessage(parent, label) then
                        return parent, false
                    end
                    -- Some renderers put the caret *inside* the bubble shell.
                    if hasOwnTail(node) and not isSharedBubbleStack(node, bubbles)
                        and not hasAnotherMessage(node, label) then
                        return node, false
                    end
                    -- The list's direct child is the complete message cell,
                    -- including all its decorative children.
                    if node ~= label and parent and parent:IsA("GuiObject")
                        and parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout") then
                        return node, false
                    end
                    if node.Name == "ChatBubble" or node.Name == "Bubble"
                        or node.Name == "BubbleChatImage" or node.Name == "ChatBubbleFrame"
                        or node.Name == "BubbleFrame" then
                        if not hasAnotherMessage(node, label) then fallback = node end
                    end
                end
                node = node.Parent
            end
            return fallback, false
        end
    
        local function start(terms)
            local roots, watched = {}, {}
            local connections = {}

            -- Roblox's ExperienceChat can render the triangular Caret beside
            -- (rather than inside) the actual message cell. Hiding the cell
            -- therefore leaves an orphaned arrow. Handle these separately,
            -- scoped to one player's billboard / bubble list, NOT all chat.
            local hiddenCarets = {}
            local hiddenBillboards = {}
            local refreshQueued = false
            local stopping = false

            local function inVisibleBranch(node, limit)
                while node and node ~= limit do
                    if node:IsA("GuiObject") and not node.Visible then return false end
                    node = node.Parent
                end
                return node == limit
            end

            local function caretScope(label, row)
                -- Prefer a per-speaker billboard; the broader ExperienceChat
                -- and bubbleChat nodes may contain other players' messages.
                local billboard = label:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
                if billboard then return billboard end
                local list = label:FindFirstAncestor("BubbleChatList")
                if list then return list end
                return row and row.Parent
            end

            local function otherVisibleBubble(scope, label)
                -- A caret belonging to a still-visible message must stay.
                -- Other message text nodes in this scope share the label name.
                for _, child in ipairs(scope:GetDescendants()) do
                    if child ~= label and child.Name == label.Name
                        and (child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton"))
                        and inVisibleBranch(child, scope) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

            local function releaseCaret(caret)
                local state = hiddenCarets[caret]
                if not state then return end
                hiddenCarets[caret] = nil
                if state.connection then state.connection:Disconnect() end
                if caret.Parent and (state.wasVisible or state.rendererShowed) then
                    pcall(function() caret.Visible = true end)
                end
            end

            local function releaseBillboard(billboard)
                local state = hiddenBillboards[billboard]
                if not state then return end
                hiddenBillboards[billboard] = nil
                if state.connection then state.connection:Disconnect() end
                if billboard.Parent and state.wasEnabled then
                    pcall(function() billboard.Enabled = true end)
                end
            end

            local function hasUnfilteredBubble(billboard)
                -- Only resume a disabled billboard early if a real, visible,
                -- unfiltered bubble needs it; not for the outgoing fade frame.
                for label, record in pairs(watched) do
                    if not record.prefixed and not record.hidden and record.row.Parent
                        and caretScope(label, record.row) == billboard
                        and inVisibleBranch(label, billboard) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

            local function refreshCarets()
                local needed = {}
                local neededBillboards = {}
                for label, record in pairs(watched) do
                    if record.hidden and not record.prefixed and record.row.Parent then
                        local scope = caretScope(label, record.row)
                        if scope and not otherVisibleBubble(scope, label) then
                            -- When no unfiltered bubble is visible above this
                            -- speaker, disable its entire BillboardGui too.
                            -- This catches already-rendered tail triangles even
                            -- if Roblox doesn't update TailVisible mid-animation.
                            if scope:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                                neededBillboards[scope] = true
                            end
                            for _, child in ipairs(scope:GetDescendants()) do
                                -- The message cell is already hidden. Only
                                -- separately rendered tails need explicit care.
                                if child:IsA("GuiObject") and isBubbleTail(child)
                                    and not child:IsDescendantOf(record.row) then
                                    needed[child] = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for caret in pairs(hiddenCarets) do
                    if not needed[caret] then
                        local billboard = caret:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BillboardGui")
                        -- Don't show an orphaned tail during the engine's fade
                        -- transition just because its text label was deleted.
                        if not caret.Parent or (billboard and hasUnfilteredBubble(billboard)) then
                            releaseCaret(caret)
                        end
                    end
                end
                for caret in pairs(needed) do
                    if not hiddenCarets[caret] then
                        local state = {wasVisible = caret.Visible}
                        hiddenCarets[caret] = state
                        -- The built-in renderer may toggle Caret.Visible again
                        -- during animation. Keep it hidden while it's orphaned.
                        state.connection = caret:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
                            if hiddenCarets[caret] and caret.Visible then
                                state.rendererShowed = true
                                caret.Visible = false
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    if caret.Visible then caret.Visible = false end
                end
                for billboard, state in pairs(hiddenBillboards) do
                    if not neededBillboards[billboard] then
                        if not billboard.Parent or hasUnfilteredBubble(billboard) then
                            releaseBillboard(billboard)
                        elseif os.clock() >= (state.holdUntil or 0) then
                            releaseBillboard(billboard)
                        elseif not state.releaseQueued then
                            -- Roblox can destroy a TextLabel before the 0.5s
                            -- exit tween ends. Do not immediately re-enable
                            -- its billboard (which reveals that final fade).
                            state.releaseQueued = true
                            task.delay(math.max(0.02, state.holdUntil-os.clock()), function()
                                if stopping then return end
                                if hiddenBillboards[billboard] == state then
                                    state.releaseQueued = false
                                    pcall(refreshCarets)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
                for billboard in pairs(neededBillboards) do
                    if not hiddenBillboards[billboard] then
                        local state = {
                            wasEnabled = billboard.Enabled,
                            holdUntil = os.clock() + getBubbleDurationWithExit(),
                        }
                        hiddenBillboards[billboard] = state
                        state.connection = billboard:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
                            if hiddenBillboards[billboard] and billboard.Enabled then
                                billboard.Enabled = false
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    -- Do not restart this timer every time a descendant
                    -- changes. It starts when the filtered cell is first seen
                    -- and outlasts the complete native expiry/exit transition.
                    if billboard.Enabled then billboard.Enabled = false end
                end
            end

            local function queueCaretRefresh()
                if stopping or refreshQueued then return end
                refreshQueued = true
                task.defer(function()
                    refreshQueued = false
                    if not stopping then pcall(refreshCarets) end
                end)
            end

            local function drop(label, beingRemoved)
                local record = watched[label]
                if not record then return end
                watched[label] = nil
                for _, connection in ipairs(record.connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
                if record.visibilityConnection then record.visibilityConnection:Disconnect() end
                -- When Roblox removes the message, restoring Visible=true
                -- exposes its last fade-out frames. Restore only when we're
                -- intentionally disabling the filter on a live message.
                if record.hidden and record.row.Parent and not beingRemoved then
                    record.row.Visible = true
                end
                queueCaretRefresh()
            end
    
            local function watch(label, root)
                if watched[label] or not (label:IsA("TextLabel") or label:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
                local row, prefixed = target(label, root)
                if not row then return end
                local record = {row = row, root = root, prefixed = prefixed, connections = {}}
                watched[label] = record
                filterStatus("Watching chat messages.")

                local function update()
                    if watched[label] ~= record or not record.row.Parent then return end
                    local body = label.ContentText
                    if record.prefixed then
                        -- Stock chat history prefixes the message with sender: .
                        body = body:match("^[^:]*:%s*(.*)$") or body
                    end
                    body = body:lower()
                    -- OnBubbleAdded may replace the rendered Text with our
                    -- invisible marker, so recognise that too in the GUI
                    -- fallback instead of waiting for a text keyword.
                    local matched = body:find(invisibleBubbleText, 1, true) ~= nil
                        or label.Text:find(invisibleBubbleText, 1, true) ~= nil
                    if not matched then
                        for _, term in ipairs(terms) do
                            if body:find(term, 1, true) then matched = true; break end
                        end
                    end
                    if matched then
                        record.hidden = true
                        -- This is the complete message container, not just text.
                        -- Reapply if Roblox tries to make it visible again.
                        if record.row.Visible then record.row.Visible = false end
                    elseif record.hidden then
                        record.hidden = false
                        record.row.Visible = true
                    end
                    if matched and not record.prefixed then
                        -- Hide the owning billboard in this same callback,
                        -- not on the next deferred frame of the animation.
                        pcall(refreshCarets)
                    end
                    queueCaretRefresh()
                end

                local function connectVisibility()
                    if record.visibilityConnection then record.visibilityConnection:Disconnect() end
                    record.visibilityConnection = record.row:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(update)
                end

                record.retarget = function()
                    if watched[label] ~= record or not label.Parent then return end
                    local nextRow = target(label, root)
                    if not nextRow or nextRow == record.row then return end
                    local oldRow, wasHidden = record.row, record.hidden
                    record.row = nextRow
                    connectVisibility()
                    update() -- hide new full wrapper before restoring its child
                    if wasHidden and oldRow.Parent and oldRow ~= nextRow
                        and oldRow:IsDescendantOf(nextRow) then
                        -- Never reveal an outgoing bubble that may be fading.
                        oldRow.Visible = true
                    end
                    queueCaretRefresh()
                end

                record.connections[1] = label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ContentText"):Connect(update)
                connectVisibility()
                update()
            end
    
            local function detach(root)
                local events = roots[root]
                if not events then return end
                roots[root] = nil
                for _, event in ipairs(events) do event:Disconnect() end
                for label, record in pairs(watched) do
                    if record.root == root then drop(label) end
                end
            end
            local function attach(root)
                if root.Name ~= "ExperienceChat" or roots[root] then return end
                local children = root:GetDescendants()
                roots[root] = {
                    root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
                        if child:IsA("UIListLayout") and child:FindFirstAncestor("bubbleChat") then
                            for _, item in ipairs(child.Parent:GetDescendants()) do watch(item, root) end
                        else
                            watch(child, root)
                            -- Bubble GUI subtrees may be assembled off-screen
                            -- and parented after their TextLabels are created.
                            -- Walk those descendants *synchronously* so the
                            -- wrapper is hidden before its first drawn frame.
                            if child:IsA("GuiObject") or child:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                                for _, item in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                                    if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") then
                                        watch(item, root)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        -- Roblox sometimes adds the caret after the text label.
                        -- Re-evaluate affected message wrappers so the new tail
                        -- is hidden too, without affecting other chat bubbles.
                        if (isBubbleTail(child) or child.Name == "BubbleChatImage"
                            or child.Name == "ChatBubble" or child.Name == "Bubble")
                            and child:FindFirstAncestor("bubbleChat") then
                            task.defer(function()
                                if not roots[root] then return end
                                for label, record in pairs(watched) do
                                    if record.root == root and not record.prefixed and record.retarget then
                                        record.retarget()
                                    end
                                end
                                queueCaretRefresh()
                            end)
                        end
                    end),
                    root.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(child)
                        drop(child, true)
                        if isBubbleTail(child) or child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                            queueCaretRefresh()
                        end
                    end),
                }
                filterStatus("Waiting for a supported chat message.")
                for _, child in ipairs(children) do pcall(watch, child, root) end
            end
            stopWatching = function()
                stopping = true
                for _, event in ipairs(connections) do event:Disconnect() end
                for root in pairs(roots) do detach(root) end
                for caret in pairs(hiddenCarets) do releaseCaret(caret) end
                for billboard in pairs(hiddenBillboards) do releaseBillboard(billboard) end
            end
            local function tryAttach(root)
                if not pcall(attach, root) and not next(watched) then
                    filterStatus("Chat window unavailable.")
                end
            end
            local function watchHolder(holder)
                table.insert(connections, holder.ChildAdded:Connect(tryAttach))
                table.insert(connections, holder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(root)
                    if roots[root] then
                        detach(root)
                        if not next(roots) then filterStatus("Waiting for the chat window.") end
                    end
                end))
                local root = holder:FindFirstChild("ExperienceChat")
                if root then tryAttach(root) end
            end
            filterStatus("Waiting for the chat window.")
            local playerOK = pcall(watchHolder, PG)
            local coreOK = pcall(function() watchHolder(game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
            if not coreOK and not next(roots) then
                filterStatus(playerOK and "No readable chat window yet." or "Chat window unavailable.")
            end
        end
    
        local function saveEntries(updated)
            settings.hiddenChatKeywords = table.concat(updated, ", ")
            pvSession.refreshChatKeywords()
            saveCfg()
        end

        local function makeKeywordRow(term)
            local row = Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, px(32))
            row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            row.BackgroundColor3 = BTN_BG
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            row.Parent = list
            corner(row, px(8))
            local label = lbl(row, term, 10, T.txt)
            label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -px(80), 0, px(24))
            label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px(8), px(4))

            local remove = Instance.new("TextButton")
            remove.Text = "Remove"
            remove.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            remove.TextSize = px(10)
            remove.TextColor3 = T.txt
            remove.BackgroundColor3 = T.black
            remove.BorderSizePixel = 0
            remove.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px(60), px(26))
            remove.Position = UDim2.new(1, -px(64), 0, px(3))
            remove.Parent = row
            corner(remove, px(6))
            -- Destroying the row also disconnects this button's listener.
            remove.Activated:Connect(function()
                local index = table.find(entries, term)
                if index then
                    table.remove(entries, index)
                    saveEntries(entries)
                end
            end)
            return row
        end

        local function refresh()
            if stopWatching then stopWatching(); stopWatching = nil end
            entries = words(settings.hiddenChatKeywords)
            local terms, present = {}, {}
            for i, term in ipairs(entries) do
                terms[i] = term:lower()
                present[term] = true
                if not rows[term] then rows[term] = makeKeywordRow(term) end
                rows[term].LayoutOrder = i
            end
            for term, row in pairs(rows) do
                if not present[term] then
                    row:Destroy()
                    rows[term] = nil
                end
            end
            activeBubbleTerms = terms
            -- Changing keywords resets old speaker locks; matched messages
            -- from the new keyword list will register immediately.
            clearFadeShields()
            shieldEnabled = #terms > 0
            if #terms == 0 then
                uninstallFilters()
                setNativeTailHidden(false)
                status.Text = "Off. Add a word or phrase to hide matching chat on your screen."
                return
            end
            nativeTextReady = installFilter("OnIncomingMessage", hideMessageText)
            nativeBubbleReady = installFilter("OnBubbleAdded", hideBubble)
            pcall(setNativeTailHidden, true)
            if not pcall(start, terms) then
                if stopWatching then stopWatching(); stopWatching = nil end
                filterStatus("Chat window unavailable.")
            end
        end
        pvSession.refreshChatKeywords = refresh
        local function addKeywords()
            if #words(editor.Text) == 0 then return end
            local updated = words(settings.hiddenChatKeywords .. "," .. editor.Text)
            editor.Text = ""
            if #updated == #entries then
                notify("Already in the keyword list")
                return
            end
            saveEntries(updated)
        end
        local add = btn(panel, "Add", addKeywords)
        add.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px(56), px(30))
        add.Position = UDim2.new(1, -px(62), 0, px(39))
        -- Match the original editor: tapping away also commits the draft.
        -- Add and FocusLost can both fire on one tap; clearing the draft makes it idempotent.
        pvSession.connect(editor.FocusLost, addKeywords)
        pvSession.addCleanup(function()
            if stopWatching then stopWatching() end
            uninstallFilters()
            clearFadeShields()
            setNativeTailHidden(false)
        end)
        refresh()
    end)()
    lbl(s,"UI THEME:",10,T.pink)
    -- Four theme buttons; Custom controls expand inside the settings list only when opened.
    do
        local choices={}
        local names={["Pork UI"]="PORK",["Halloween"]="HALLOWEEN",["Christmas"]="CHRISTMAS",["Custom"]="CUSTOM"}
        local customExpanded=settings.uiTheme=="Custom"
        local customHolder

        local function refreshChoices()
            for theme,b in pairs(choices) do
                local selected=settings.uiTheme==theme
                b.Text=names[theme]..(selected and "  ✓" or "")
                local outline=b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if outline then
                    outline.Color=selected and T.pink or T.line
                    outline.Transparency=selected and 0.12 or 0.60
                end
            end
            if customHolder then
                customHolder.Visible=customExpanded
                customHolder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,customExpanded and px(155) or 0)
            end
        end
        choices["Pork UI"]=btn(s,"PORK",function()
            customExpanded=false
            pvSetUITheme("Pork UI",true)
            refreshChoices()
        end)
        choices["Halloween"]=btn(s,"HALLOWEEN",function()
            customExpanded=false
            pvSetUITheme("Halloween",true)
            refreshChoices()
        end)
        choices["Christmas"]=btn(s,"CHRISTMAS",function()
            customExpanded=false
            pvSetUITheme("Christmas",true)
            refreshChoices()
        end)
        choices["Custom"]=btn(s,"CUSTOM",function()
            local alreadySelected=settings.uiTheme=="Custom"
            pvSetUITheme("Custom",true)
            customExpanded=(not alreadySelected) or (not customExpanded)
            refreshChoices()
        end)

        customHolder=Instance.new("Frame")
        customHolder.Name="pvCustomThemeDropdown"
        customHolder.BackgroundTransparency=1
        customHolder.BorderSizePixel=0
        customHolder.ClipsDescendants=false
        customHolder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
        customHolder.Parent=s
        local stack=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        stack.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        stack.Padding=UDim.new(0,px(7))
        stack.Parent=customHolder

        local description=lbl(customHolder,"Paste PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, video:RobloxID, or a local file path.",8,T.sub)
        description.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(38))
        -- Clip long pasted links to the input area, without deleting any text.
        -- The wrapper clips the TextBox's rendered text even while it is focused
        -- and Roblox scrolls the caret horizontally.
        local inputClip=Instance.new("Frame")
        inputClip.Name="CustomBackgroundInputClip"
        inputClip.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(28))
        inputClip.BackgroundTransparency=1
        inputClip.BorderSizePixel=0
        inputClip.ClipsDescendants=true
        inputClip.Parent=customHolder
        corner(inputClip,px(8))

        local bgInput=box(inputClip,"Image/GIF link, video:ID or file path")
        bgInput.Name="CustomBackgroundInput"
        bgInput.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        bgInput.ClipsDescendants=true
        bgInput.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        bgInput.TextWrapped=false
        -- Important: TextTruncate.AtEnd freezes long URLs into an ellipsis.
        -- None leaves the complete URL editable; Roblox scrolls the caret
        -- horizontally while the containing inputClip masks overflow.
        bgInput.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.None
        bgInput.Text=settings.customBackground or ""

        btn(customHolder,"APPLY CUSTOM BG",function()
            local value=bgInput.Text
            if value:match("^%s*$") then
                notify("Paste an image, GIF or Roblox video ID first")
                return
            end
            notify("Loading custom background / animation...")
            pvSetCustomBackground(value,true,function(ok,msg)
                -- This callback fires only after the custom background has been

                notify(ok and "Custom BG loaded" or msg)
            end)
        end)

            bgInput.Text=""
            pvSetCustomBackground("",true,function(ok,msg) notify(msg) end)
        end)

                editors[other].Visible=visible
                arrows[other].Text=visible and "▲" or "▼"
            end
        end
        local function amountField(parent,title,order)
            local row=Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(28))
            row.BackgroundTransparency=1

            return input
        end
        local function readCents(text)
            local amount=text:match("^%s*%$?%s*(%d*%.?%d*)%s*$")
            if not amount or not amount:match("%d") or amount:match("%.%d%d%d") then return end
            local whole,fraction=amount:match("^(%d*)%.?(%d*)$")
            local cents=(tonumber(whole) or 0)*100+tonumber((fraction.."00"):sub(1,2))
            if cents<=9007199254740991 then return cents end
        end
        local refreshing=false
        for index,key in ipairs(keys) do
            local name=pvSession.upgradeTiers[key].label

            arrows[key]=arrow
            local summary=lbl(button,"",9,T.sub)
            summary.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None
            summary.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
            summary.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

            summary.Size=UDim2.new(0.76,-px(20),1,0)
            local function showSummary()
                summary.Text=pvSession.getUpgradeTier(key).range
            end
            local editor=stack(tiers,index*2+1,8)
            editors[key]=editor
            editor.Visible=false
            local low=amountField(editor,"Minimum ($)",1)
            local high=amountField(editor,"Maximum ($)",2)
            local errorLabel=lbl(editor,"",9,T.sub)
            errorLabel.LayoutOrder=3
            errorLabel.Visible=false
            local revision=0
            local function saveRange(showError)
                local minimum,maximum=readCents(low.Text),readCents(high.Text)
                local message
                if not minimum or not maximum or maximum==0 then
                    message="Enter dollar amounts with up to two decimals and a positive maximum."
                elseif minimum>maximum then
                    message="Minimum must be at or below maximum."
                end
                errorLabel.Visible=showError and message~=nil
                if message then
                    if showError then errorLabel.Text=message end
                    return false
                end
                local current=pvSession.getUpgradeTier(key)
                if current.minimum~=minimum or current.maximum~=maximum then
                    if type(settings.fakeUpgradeRanges)~="table" then settings.fakeUpgradeRanges={} end
                    settings.fakeUpgradeRanges[key]={minimum=minimum,maximum=maximum}
                    showSummary()
                    saveCfg()
                end
                return true
            end
            local function edited()
                if refreshing then return end
                revision=revision+1
                local pending=revision
                errorLabel.Visible=false
                task.delay(0.4,function()
                    if pending==revision and isCurrent() then saveRange(false) end
                end)
            end
            for _,input in ipairs({low,high}) do
                pvSession.connect(input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"),edited)
                pvSession.connect(input.FocusLost,function()
                    revision=revision+1
                    if saveRange(true) then
                        refreshing=true
                        input.Text=string.format("%.2f",readCents(input.Text)/100)
                        refreshing=false
                    end
                end)
            end
            fields[key]=function()
                revision=revision+1
                local tier=pvSession.getUpgradeTier(key)
                low.Text=string.format("%.2f",tier.minimum/100)
                high.Text=string.format("%.2f",tier.maximum/100)
                showSummary()
                errorLabel.Visible=false
            end
        end
        local function refreshFields()
            refreshing=true
            for _,key in ipairs(keys) do fields[key]() end
            refreshing=false
        end
        refreshFields()
        table.insert(pvSession.configRefresh,refreshFields)
    end

    lbl(s,"FAKE LEADERBOARD BOTS",10,T.pink)

do
    settingsScroll = settingsScroll or scroll(pSet)
    local s=settingsScroll
    lbl(s,"SERVER",10,T.txt)
    -- Server hopping: paginate public servers and use ONLY joinable slots.
    -- High Pop targets 9+ current players, preferring 10/12 or 9/12 over
    -- the single remaining slot in 11/12 (which fills very quickly).
    local pvHopBusy=false
    local function hop(mode,b,label)
        if pvHopBusy then notify("Already searching for a server") return end
        pvHopBusy=true
        b.Text="Searching servers..."
        pcall(pvSaveConfigToDisk)

        task.spawn(function()
            local pid=game.PlaceId
            local order=(mode=="fewest") and "Asc" or "Desc"
            local minPlayers=(mode=="high") and 9 or 0
            local maxPages=(mode=="high") and 25 or 8
            local found,seen={},{}
            local pageCount=0
            local cursor=nil
            local fetchError=nil
            local requestLimit=100
            local usedCursors={}

            local function fetchPage(pageCursor)
                local url="https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"..tostring(pid)
                    .."/servers/Public?sortOrder="..order
                    .."&excludeFullGames=true&limit="..requestLimit
                if pageCursor and pageCursor~="" then
                    url=url.."&cursor="..HttpService:UrlEncode(pageCursor)
                end

                -- Different executors support different HTTP methods. Try the
                -- request API first; fall back to the existing game:HttpGet helper.
                local body=nil
                local reason=nil
                if pvAPI and type(pvAPI.request)=="function" then
                    local ok,res=pcall(pvAPI.request,{Url=url,Method="GET"})
                    if ok and type(res)=="table" then
                        local status=tonumber(res.StatusCode or res.Status)
                        if type(res.Body)=="string" and (status==200 or (status==nil and res.Success==true)) then
                            body=res.Body
                        elseif status==429 then
                            return nil,"Roblox server list is rate-limited (429)"
                        elseif status then
                            reason="Server list HTTP "..tostring(status)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not body then body=httpGet(url) end
                if type(body)~="string" then
                    return nil,reason or "Could not fetch public servers (HTTP access blocked)"
                end
                local ok,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
                if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.data)~="table" then
                    return nil,"Roblox returned invalid server-list data"
                end
                return data,nil
            end

            local function addCandidate(server)
                if type(server)~="table" then return end
                local id=server.id
                local count=tonumber(server.playing)
                local capacity=tonumber(server.maxPlayers)
                if type(id)~="string" or id=="" or id==game.JobId or seen[id] then return end
                -- Full servers must NEVER be selected. The count is a snapshot;
                -- TeleportInitFailed below handles a server filling meanwhile.
                if not count or not capacity or capacity<=0 or count<minPlayers or count>=capacity then return end
                seen[id]=true
                found[#found+1]={id=id,playing=count,maxPlayers=capacity,free=capacity-count}
            end

            for page=1,maxPages do
                if not isCurrent() then pvHopBusy=false return end
                b.Text="Scanning servers ("..page.."/"..maxPages..")"
                local data,err=fetchPage(cursor)
                if not data then fetchError=err break end
                -- Some Roblox API responses unexpectedly return an empty
                -- 100-size first page. Retry at 50 before declaring none.
                if page==1 and #data.data==0 then
                    requestLimit=50
                    data,err=fetchPage(nil)
                    if not data then fetchError=err break end
                end
                pageCount=pageCount+1
                for _,server in ipairs(data.data) do addCandidate(server) end

                if mode=="high" then
                    -- Keep looking past packed 12/12 servers until we find
                    -- several 9+/12 servers with at least TWO open slots.
                    local roomy=0
                    for _,server in ipairs(found) do
                        if server.free>=2 then roomy=roomy+1 end
                    end
                    if roomy>=8 then break end
                elseif #found>=12 then
                    break
                end
                cursor=data.nextPageCursor
                if not cursor or cursor=="" or #data.data==0 or usedCursors[cursor] then break end
                usedCursors[cursor]=true
                task.wait(0.16) -- avoid hammering the public list API
            end

            if not isCurrent() then pvHopBusy=false return end
            if #found==0 then
                b.Text=label
                pvHopBusy=false
                if fetchError then
                    notify("Server Hop: "..fetchError)
                elseif mode=="high" then
                    notify("No joinable 9+ player server in "..pageCount.." pages. Try again shortly.")
                else
                    notify("No other joinable public server found")
                end
                return -- do NOT redirect to a random/low-pop server
            end

            if mode=="high" then
                table.sort(found,function(a,c)
                    -- 10/12 then 9/12 beat an 11/12 because the last
                    -- remaining slot is especially likely to disappear.
                    local ar=a.free>=2 and 1 or 0
                    local cr=c.free>=2 and 1 or 0
                    if ar~=cr then return ar>cr end
                    if a.playing~=c.playing then return a.playing>c.playing end
                    return a.free>c.free
                end)
            else
                table.sort(found,function(a,c)
                    if a.playing~=c.playing then return a.playing<c.playing end
                    return a.free>c.free
                end)
            end

            local attempt=0
            local maxAttempts=math.min(#found,10)
            local failedConn=nil
            local finished=false
            local function finish(message)
                if finished then return end
                finished=true
                pvHopBusy=false
                b.Text=label
                if failedConn then failedConn:Disconnect();failedConn=nil end
                if message then notify(message) end
            end

            local tryNext
            tryNext=function(expectedAttempt)
                if finished or not isCurrent() then return end
                if expectedAttempt and expectedAttempt~=attempt then return end
                if attempt>=maxAttempts then
                    finish("Couldn't join the available servers (they may have filled up). Try again.")
                    return
                end
                attempt=attempt+1
                local myAttempt=attempt
                local server=found[myAttempt]
                b.Text="Joining "..server.playing.."/"..server.maxPlayers.."..."
                notify("Joining "..server.playing.."/"..server.maxPlayers
                    .." server (attempt "..myAttempt.."/"..maxAttempts..")")
                local ok,err=pcall(function()
                    Teleport:TeleportToPlaceInstance(pid,server.id,LP)
                end)
                if not ok then
                    -- An immediate error means this instance is not joinable.
                    task.defer(function() tryNext(myAttempt) end)
                    return
                end
                -- pcall success means Roblox accepted the REQUEST, not that
                -- the join succeeded. If still here, try another server.
                task.delay(12,function()
                    if not finished and isCurrent() and attempt==myAttempt then
                        tryNext(myAttempt)
                    end
                end)
            end

            failedConn=pvSession.connect(Teleport.TeleportInitFailed,function(player,result,errorMessage,placeId,options)
                if finished or not isCurrent() or player~=LP or placeId~=pid then return end
                local current=found[attempt]
                if not current then return end
                local targetId=nil
                pcall(function() targetId=options and options.ServerInstanceId end)
                if targetId and targetId~="" and targetId~=current.id then return end
                local expected=attempt
                task.defer(function() tryNext(expected) end)
            end)
            tryNext()
        end)
    end
    btn(s,"Server Hop   Fewest Players",function(b) hop("fewest",b,"Server Hop   Fewest Players") end)
    btn(s,"Server Hop   High Pop",function(b) hop("high",b,"Server Hop   High Pop") end)
    btn(s,"Rejoin",function()
        local hasFake = type(settings.loadout)=="table" and type(settings.loadout.owned)=="table"
                        and next(settings.loadout.owned)~=nil
                        and type(savedSpawns)=="table" and next(savedSpawns)~=nil
        pcall(pvSaveConfigToDisk)
        notify("Rejoining...")
        pcall(function() Teleport:Teleport(game.PlaceId,LP) end)
    end)


end

    local s=scroll(pBots)
    lbl(s,"KEYBINDS",11,T.pink)


    local ROWS={
        {"restoreFPS", "Toggle FPS counter"},
        {"blockRecent","Block recent player"},
        {"clearOffer", "Clear my offer"},
        {"tradeRecent","Trade recent player"},
        {"spoofer",    "Trade spoofer"},
        {"fakeUpgrade","Fake upgrade (recent)"},
        {"spawnAll",   "Spawn all (current filter)"},
        {"spawnRandom","Spawn all weapons"},
        {"autoTrade",  "Auto-trade everyone (start)"},
        {"autoTradeStop","Stop auto-trade"},
        {"toggleUI",   "Show / hide menu"},
        {"streamerMode","Streamer Mode (hide all UI)"},
        {"panic",      "Panic   hide instantly"},
    }
    local repaint={}
    local function paintAll() for _,f in ipairs(repaint) do f() end end
    pvSession.configRefresh[#pvSession.configRefresh+1]=paintAll
    for _,row in ipairs(ROWS) do
        local act,title=row[1],row[2]
        -- One full-width scrolling-list item with separate bind and clear buttons.
        local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.Name="Keybind_"..act
        holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,px(30))
        holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
        holder.BorderSizePixel=0
        holder.Parent=s

        local b,clearBtn
        local function paintRow()
            local k=settings.keys[act]
            local bound=(k~=nil and k~="")
            b.Text=title.."   "..(bound and tostring(k) or "UNBOUND")
            clearBtn.TextColor3=bound and Color3.fromRGB(255,166,64) or T.sub
            clearBtn.TextTransparency=bound and 0 or 0.55
        end
        b=btn(holder,"",function()
            if keyCapture then return end
            b.Text=title.."   PRESS A KEY..."
            keyCapture=function(kn)
                if kn=="Escape" then paintRow();return end
                if kn=="Backspace" or kn=="Delete" then
                    settings.keys[act]="";saveCfg();paintAll();notify(title.." unbound");return
                end
                for other,k in pairs(settings.keys) do
                    if other~=act and k==kn then settings.keys[other]="" end
                end
                settings.keys[act]=kn;saveCfg();paintAll()
                notify(title.." = "..kn)
            end
        end)
        b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(36),0,px(30))

        clearBtn=btn(holder,"X",function()
            -- Clearing must work with no keyboard and even during rebind capture.
            keyCapture=nil
            if settings.keys[act]==nil or settings.keys[act]=="" then
                paintAll(); return
            end
            settings.keys[act]=""
            saveCfg()
            paintAll()
            notify(title.." unbound")
        end)
        clearBtn.Name="ClearKeybind"
        clearBtn.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(30),px(30))
        clearBtn.Position=UDim2.new(1,-px(30),0,0)
        clearBtn.TextSize=px(11)
        clearBtn.Text="X"

        repaint[#repaint+1]=paintRow
        paintRow()
    end
end


_G.pvUltraState = _G.pvUltraState or nil
_G.pvUltraEpoch = _G.pvUltraEpoch or 0

function pvUltraProtected(x)
    local p=x
    while p and p~=workspace do

        if p:IsA("Model") and p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
        if p:IsA("Tool") or p:IsA("Accessory") then return true end
        local n=tostring(p.Name):lower()
        if n=="weapondisplays" or n:find("pvheld",1,true) or n:find("pvthrow",1,true) then
            return true
        end
        p=p.Parent
    end
    return false
end

function pvUltraApplyOne(d,S)
    if not S or not S.active or not d or not d.Parent then return end
    if pvUltraProtected(d) then return end

    if d:IsA("BasePart") then
        if not S.parts[d] then
            local mv=""
            pcall(function() mv=d.MaterialVariant end)
            S.parts[d]={
                mat=d.Material,
                cast=d.CastShadow,
                refl=d.Reflectance,
                variant=mv
            }
        end
        pcall(function() d.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end)
        pcall(function() d.MaterialVariant="" end)
        pcall(function() d.CastShadow=false end)
        pcall(function() d.Reflectance=0 end)

        if d:IsA("MeshPart") and not S.meshparts[d] then
            local tex=""
            pcall(function() tex=d.TextureID end)
            S.meshparts[d]=tex
            pcall(function() d.TextureID="" end)
        end

    elseif d:IsA("Decal") or d:IsA("Texture") then
        if S.textures[d]==nil then S.textures[d]=d.Transparency end
        pcall(function() d.Transparency=1 end)

    elseif d:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
        if S.special[d]==nil then
            local tex=""
            pcall(function() tex=d.TextureId end)
            S.special[d]=tex
        end
        pcall(function() d.TextureId="" end)

    elseif d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
        if S.surface[d]==nil then
            S.surface[d]=d.Parent
        end

        pcall(function() d.Parent=nil end)

    elseif d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") or d:IsA("SurfaceLight")
        or d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam")
        or d:IsA("Smoke") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Sparkles") then
        if S.fx[d]==nil then
            local enabled=false
            pcall(function() enabled=d.Enabled end)
            S.fx[d]=enabled
        end
        pcall(function() d.Enabled=false end)
    end
end

function pvUltraFpsBooster(on)
    if on then
        if _G.pvUltraState and _G.pvUltraState.active then return end

        _G.pvUltraEpoch=(_G.pvUltraEpoch or 0)+1
        local epoch=_G.pvUltraEpoch
        local S={
            active=true,
            parts={},
            textures={},
            meshparts={},
            special={},
            surface={},
            fx={},
            conn=nil
        }
        _G.pvUltraState=S


        pcall(function()
            S.conn=pvSession.connect(workspace.DescendantAdded,function(d)
                if not S.active or _G.pvUltraEpoch~=epoch then return end
                task.defer(function()
                    if S.active and _G.pvUltraEpoch==epoch then
                        pcall(pvUltraApplyOne,d,S)
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end)


        task.spawn(function()
            local all=workspace:GetDescendants()
            for i,d in ipairs(all) do
                if not S.active or _G.pvUltraEpoch~=epoch then return end
                pcall(pvUltraApplyOne,d,S)
                if i%250==0 then task.wait() end
            end
        end)
    else
        local S=_G.pvUltraState
        if not S then return end

        _G.pvUltraEpoch=(_G.pvUltraEpoch or 0)+1
        S.active=false
        _G.pvUltraState=nil

        if S.conn then pcall(function() S.conn:Disconnect() end) end


        for d,v in pairs(S.parts or {}) do
            if d and d.Parent then
                pcall(function() d.Material=v.mat end)
                pcall(function() d.CastShadow=v.cast end)
                pcall(function() d.Reflectance=v.refl end)
                pcall(function() d.MaterialVariant=v.variant or "" end)
            end
        end

        for d,v in pairs(S.textures or {}) do
            if d then pcall(function() d.Transparency=v end) end
        end

        for d,v in pairs(S.meshparts or {}) do
            if d and d.Parent then pcall(function() d.TextureID=v or "" end) end
        end

        for d,v in pairs(S.special or {}) do
            if d and d.Parent then pcall(function() d.TextureId=v or "" end) end
        end


        for d,parent in pairs(S.surface or {}) do
            if d and parent and parent.Parent then pcall(function() d.Parent=parent end) end
        end

        for d,v in pairs(S.fx or {}) do
            if d and d.Parent then pcall(function() d.Enabled=v end) end
        end
    end
end
pvSession.addCleanup(function() pcall(pvUltraFpsBooster,false) end)

local pvStretchOn=false
local pvStretchFov=nil
local PV_STRETCH_FOV=45
function pvStretchRes(on, w, h)
    w = w or 1080; h = h or 1080
    local function winFn()
        for _,n in ipairs({"setwindowsize","set_window_size","resizewindow","setresolution","setgamewindowsize"}) do
            local f=(getgenv and rawget(getgenv(),n)) or rawget(_G,n)
            if type(f)=="function" then return f end
        end
    end
    local f=winFn()
    if on then
        pvStretchOn=true
        if f then pcall(f,w,h); return "window" end


        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            pvStretchFov = pvStretchFov or cam.FieldOfView
            pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView=PV_STRETCH_FOV end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while pvStretchOn do
                    local c=workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if c and math.abs(c.FieldOfView-PV_STRETCH_FOV)>1 then pcall(function() c.FieldOfView=PV_STRETCH_FOV end) end
                    task.wait(0.4)
                end
            end)
        end
        return "zoom"
    else
        pvStretchOn=false
        if f then pcall(f,0,0) end
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam and pvStretchFov then pcall(function() cam.FieldOfView=pvStretchFov end) end
        pvStretchFov=nil
        return "off"
    end
end
pvSession.addCleanup(function() pcall(pvStretchRes,false) end)
