    pvSession.connect(LP.Idled,function()
        if settings.antiAfk==false then return end
        pcall(function()
            VU:CaptureController()
            VU:ClickButton2(Vector2.new(0,0))
        end)
    end)
end)


function pvSaveConfigToDisk()
    if not hasFile then notify("no file access on this executor"); return end


    if type(settings.loadout)~="table" then settings.loadout={owned={},knife=nil,gun=nil} end
    if type(settings.loadout.owned)~="table" then settings.loadout.owned={} end
    for id in pairs(settings.loadout.owned) do
        if type(savedSpawns)~="table" or savedSpawns[id]~=true then
            settings.loadout.owned[id]=nil
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
        writefile(CFG_PATH, HttpService:JSONEncode(settings))
        writefile(SPAWN_PATH, HttpService:JSONEncode(savedSpawns or {}))
    end)
    notify("config saved")
end
-- Capture live UI geometry at export time, rather than waiting for a drag save.
function pvCaptureConfigUI()
    local function pack(u) return {u.X.Scale,u.X.Offset,u.Y.Scale,u.Y.Offset} end
    settings.winPos={win.Position.X.Offset,win.Position.Y.Offset}
    settings.winSize={win.Size.X.Offset,win.Size.Y.Offset}
    pvSaveTabOrder()
    local state={windowPosition=pack(win.Position),windowSize=pack(win.Size),launcher=pack(tog.Position)}
    for name,page in pairs(pages) do if page.Visible then state.page=name end end
    local fps=HOST:FindFirstChild("PorkVisualsFPSCounter")
    local panel=fps and fps:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
    if panel then state.fpsPosition=pack(panel.Position);state.fpsVisible=fps.Enabled end
    settings.uiSnapshot=state
end
function pvApplyConfigUI()
    local state=type(settings.uiSnapshot)=="table" and settings.uiSnapshot or {}
    local function unpackUDim(v)
        if type(v)~="table" then return nil end
        for i=1,4 do if type(v[i])~="number" then return nil end end
        return UDim2.new(v[1],v[2],v[3],v[4])
    end
    if _G.pvUiTweenWin then _G.pvUiTweenWin:Cancel() end
    if _G.pvUiTweenSettle then _G.pvUiTweenSettle:Cancel() end
    uiScale.Scale=1
    local size=unpackUDim(state.windowSize)
    if not size and type(settings.winSize)=="table" then
        size=UDim2.fromOffset(tonumber(settings.winSize[1]) or W,tonumber(settings.winSize[2]) or H)
    end
    if size then win.Size=size end
    local position=unpackUDim(state.windowPosition)
    if not position and type(settings.winPos)=="table" then
        position=UDim2.fromOffset(tonumber(settings.winPos[1]) or px(14),tonumber(settings.winPos[2]) or px(84))
    end
    if position then win.Position=position;pvSavedWinPos=position end
    local launcher=unpackUDim(state.launcher)
    if launcher then tog.Position=launcher end
    local fps=HOST:FindFirstChild("PorkVisualsFPSCounter")
    local panel=fps and fps:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame")
    local fpsPosition=unpackUDim(state.fpsPosition)
    if panel and fpsPosition then panel.Position=fpsPosition end
    if fps and type(state.fpsVisible)=="boolean" then fps.Enabled=state.fpsVisible end
    pvApplyTabOrder()
    if type(state.page)=="string" and pages[state.page] then
        showPage(state.page)
    else
        for name,page in pairs(pages) do if page.Visible then showPage(name);break end end
    end
    for _,refresh in ipairs(pvSession.configRefresh) do pcall(refresh) end
end
-- Clipboard export is explicit; background and server-transition saves stay on disk.
function pvSaveConfig()
    local captured,captureError=pcall(pvCaptureConfigUI)
    if not captured then
        notify("Config save failed: "..tostring(captureError):sub(1,160))
        return false
    end
    local encoded,blob=pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONEncode({
            format="porkVisuals-config",version=1,
            settings=settings,savedSpawns=savedSpawns or {},
        })
    end)
    if not encoded or type(blob)~="string" then
        notify("Could not encode config: "..tostring(blob):sub(1,120));return false
    end
    -- Commit the loadable snapshot BEFORE any optional executor operations.
    pvSession.lastExportConfig=blob
    pcall(function() _G.pvLastSavedConfig=blob end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(getgenv)=="function" then getgenv().__porkVisualsSavedConfig=blob end
    end)
    if pvAPI.writefile then
        pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) and type(makefolder)=="function" then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
            pvAPI.writefile(CFG_DIR.."/pv_saved_config.json",blob)
        end)
    end
    local copied,result=false,nil
    if pvAPI.setclipboard then copied,result=pcall(pvAPI.setclipboard,blob) end
    if copied and result~=false then
        notify("Config saved to clipboard")
    else
        notify("Config saved. Clipboard copy unavailable; Load Config will use the saved copy.")
    end
    return true
end

function pvImportConfig(blob,source)
    if type(blob)~="string" then notify("No config text supplied"); return false end
    if blob:match("^%s*$") then notify("Clipboard is empty"); return false end
    if #blob>4*1024*1024 then notify("Clipboard config is too large"); return false end
    local decoded,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(blob) end)
    if not decoded or type(data)~="table" or data.format~="porkVisuals-config"
       or data.version~=1 or type(data.settings)~="table" or type(data.savedSpawns)~="table" then
        notify("Clipboard does not contain a valid PorkVisuals config"); return false
    end
    local t,spawns=data.settings,data.savedSpawns
    if t.hiddenChatKeywords == nil then t.hiddenChatKeywords = "" end
    if t.fakeUpgradeRanges==nil then t.fakeUpgradeRanges={} end
    local richRange=type(t.fakeUpgradeRanges)=="table" and t.fakeUpgradeRanges.rich
    if type(richRange)=="table" and richRange.maximum==false then
        richRange.maximum=pvSession.upgradeTiers.rich.maximum
    end
    -- Validate first so malformed clipboard data cannot partly overwrite settings.
    local function valid(value,reference,depth)
        if depth>16 then return false end
        local kind=type(value)
        if reference~=nil and kind~=type(reference) then return false end
        if kind=="number" then return value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
        if kind=="string" or kind=="boolean" then return true end
        if kind~="table" then return false end
        for k,v in pairs(value) do
            if type(k)~="string" and type(k)~="number" then return false end
            if not valid(v,type(reference)=="table" and reference[k] or nil,depth+1) then return false end
        end
        return true
    end
    local validConfig=valid(t,settings,0) and type(t.loadout)=="table"
        and type(t.loadout.owned)=="table" and type(t.keys)=="table"
    if validConfig then
        for id,amount in pairs(t.loadout.owned) do
            if type(id)~="string" or type(amount)~="number" or amount<0 or amount%1~=0 then
                validConfig=false;break
            end
        end
        for id,flag in pairs(spawns) do
            if type(id)~="string" or type(flag)~="boolean" then validConfig=false;break end
        end
        for _,key in pairs(t.keys) do
            if type(key)~="string" then validConfig=false;break end
        end
    end
    if not validConfig then notify("Clipboard config has invalid settings"); return false end
    local previousTheme=settings.uiTheme
    local previousOptimizer=settings.ultraFpsBooster
    for k,v in pairs(t) do settings[k]=v end
    pvSession.refreshChatKeywords()
    savedSpawns=spawns
    for id in pairs(settings.loadout.owned) do
        if savedSpawns[id]~=true then settings.loadout.owned[id]=nil end
    end
    local n=0
    for id,amt in pairs(settings.loadout.owned) do
        local w=byId[id]
        if w and ProfileData[w.cat] and ProfileData[w.cat].Owned then
            ProfileData[w.cat].Owned[id]=w.evo and 1 or amt
            n=n+1
        end
    end
    local loadedTheme=settings.uiTheme
    settings.uiTheme=previousTheme
    pvSetUITheme(loadedTheme,false)
    pvApplyConfigUI()
    if type(settings.customBackground)=="string" and settings.customBackground~="" then
        pvSetCustomBackground(settings.customBackground,false,function(ok)
            if ok then notify("Custom BG loaded") end
        end)
    else
        pvSetCustomBackground("",false)
    end
    if pvHasBundledChristmasBackground then task.defer(function() pcall(pvHasBundledChristmasBackground) end) end
    PV_BLOCK_AFTER_TRADE=settings.autoBlock~=false
    if previousOptimizer~=settings.ultraFpsBooster then pcall(pvUltraFpsBooster,settings.ultraFpsBooster==true) end
    pcall(pvForceInventoryRefresh)
    saveCfg()
    notify("Config loaded from "..(source or "pasted text").." ("..n.." items restored)")
    return true
end


-- One-click import. A saved copy is not represented as a live clipboard read.
function pvLoadConfig()
    -- Prefer our explicit saved snapshot for reliable one-click Save -> Load.
    local blob=pvSession.lastExportConfig
    if type(blob)~="string" then pcall(function() blob=_G.pvLastSavedConfig end) end
    if type(blob)~="string" then
        pcall(function()
            if type(getgenv)=="function" then blob=getgenv().__porkVisualsSavedConfig end
        end)
    end
    if type(blob)~="string" and pvAPI.readfile then
        local ok,saved=pcall(pvAPI.readfile,CFG_DIR.."/pv_saved_config.json")
        if ok and type(saved)=="string" and saved~="" then blob=saved end
    end
    if type(blob)=="string" and blob~="" then return pvImportConfig(blob,"saved copy") end
    if pvAPI.getclipboard then
        local ok,text=pcall(pvAPI.getclipboard)
        if ok and type(text)=="string" and not text:match("^%s*$") then
            return pvImportConfig(text,"clipboard")
        end
    end
    -- Migrate configs saved by versions that only wrote pv_config.json.
    if pvAPI.readfile then
        local ok,legacy=pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(pvAPI.readfile(CFG_PATH))
        end)
        if ok and type(legacy)=="table" and type(legacy.loadout)=="table" then
            local spawns={}
            local readOK,stored=pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(pvAPI.readfile(SPAWN_PATH))
            end)
            if readOK and type(stored)=="table" then spawns=stored end
            local encoded,migrated=pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONEncode({format="porkVisuals-config",version=1,settings=legacy,savedSpawns=spawns})
            end)
            if encoded and pvImportConfig(migrated,"previous config file") then
                pvSession.lastExportConfig=migrated
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
    end
    notify("No saved copy found. Click Save Config and check its confirmation.")
    return false
end


task.defer(function()
    if type(settings.loadout)~="table" or type(settings.loadout.owned)~="table" then return end
    local n=0
    for id,amt in pairs(settings.loadout.owned) do
        local w=byId[id]
        if w and ProfileData[w.cat] and ProfileData[w.cat].Owned then
            ProfileData[w.cat].Owned[id] = w.evo and 1 or amt
            n=n+1
        end
    end
    if n>0 then pcall(pvForceInventoryRefresh) end
end)


do
    local RS_ = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local function tradeOpen()
        if _G.pvSpoofActive then return true end
        local tg = PG and PG:FindFirstChild("TradeGUI")
        return (tg and tg.Enabled) or false
    end
    local function reassert()
        if type(settings.loadout)~="table" or type(settings.loadout.owned)~="table" then return end
        local changed=false
        for id,amt in pairs(settings.loadout.owned) do
            local w=byId[id]
            if w and ProfileData[w.cat] and ProfileData[w.cat].Owned then
                local want   = w.evo and 1 or amt
                local cur    = ProfileData[w.cat].Owned[id] or 0
                local target = math.max(cur, want)
                if ProfileData[w.cat].Owned[id]~=target then
                    ProfileData[w.cat].Owned[id]=target; changed=true
                end
            end
        end


        if changed then
            if tradeOpen() then
                _G.pvInvDirty=true
            else


                local anyId
                for id in pairs(settings.loadout.owned) do anyId=id break end
                _G.pvPendingInv = {anyId, anyId and ProfileData.Weapons.Owned[anyId] or nil}
            end
        end
    end
    _G.pvInvRepinGen = (_G.pvInvRepinGen or 0) + 1
    do
        local myGen=_G.pvInvRepinGen
        task.spawn(function()
            local wasOpen=false
            while _G.pvInvRepinGen==myGen do
                local open=tradeOpen()
                if wasOpen and not open and _G.pvInvDirty then
                    _G.pvInvDirty=false
                    pcall(reassert)
                end
                wasOpen=open
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    end


    local pending=false
    local function schedule()
        if pending then return end
        pending=true
        task.delay(0.35, function() pending=false; reassert() end)
    end
    for _,name in ipairs({"UpdateData","UpdateData2","UpdateData3"}) do
        local rem=RS_:FindFirstChild(name)
        if rem and rem:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
            pvSession.connect(rem.OnClientEvent,schedule)
        end
    end
end


function pvRealRequestUp()
    local lb = PG and PG:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Game")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Leaderboard")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Container")
    local tr = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("TradeRequest")
    if not tr or not tr.Visible then return false end

    if _G.pvFakeReqName or _G.pvSentReqName then return false end
    return true
end
function pvPickRequester(preferName)
    if preferName and preferName~="" then return preferName end
    _G.pvReqRecent = _G.pvReqRecent or {}
    local function recent(n)
        for _,v in ipairs(_G.pvReqRecent) do if v==n then return true end end
        return false
    end
    local who
    for _=1,25 do
        local c = (pvRandomPartner and pvRandomPartner()) or "Player"
        if not recent(c) then who=c break end
        who = who or c
    end
    who = who or "Player"
    table.insert(_G.pvReqRecent, 1, who)
    while #_G.pvReqRecent > 8 do table.remove(_G.pvReqRecent) end
    return who
end
function pvFakeTradeRequest(onAccept, preferName)
    local lb = PG and PG:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Game")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Leaderboard")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Container")
    local tr = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("TradeRequest")
    local rr = tr and tr:FindFirstChild("ReceivingRequest")
    if not (tr and rr) then return false, "unavailable" end


    if tr.Visible then return false, "busy" end

    local nameLbl = rr:FindFirstChild("Username")
    local acc     = rr:FindFirstChild("Accept")
    local dec     = rr:FindFirstChild("Decline")
    if not (nameLbl and acc and dec) then return false, "unavailable" end

    local who = pvPickRequester(preferName)
    local sr  = tr:FindFirstChild("SendingRequest")
    local savedName, savedTR, savedRR = nameLbl.Text, tr.Visible, rr.Visible
    local savedSR = sr and sr.Visible or nil

    nameLbl.Text = who
    if sr then pcall(function() sr.Visible=false end) end
    rr.Visible = true
    tr.Visible = true
    _G.pvFakeReqName = who

    local done, conns = false, {}
    local function cleanup()
        if done then return end
        done = true
        for _,c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        pcall(function()
            nameLbl.Text = savedName
            rr.Visible   = savedRR
            tr.Visible   = savedTR
            if sr and savedSR~=nil then sr.Visible = savedSR end
        end)
        _G.pvFakeReqName = nil
    end
    conns[#conns+1] = pvSession.connect(acc.MouseButton1Click,function()
        cleanup()
        if onAccept then pcall(onAccept, who) end
    end)
    conns[#conns+1] = pvSession.connect(dec.MouseButton1Click,cleanup)
    task.delay(25, cleanup)
    -- Also return the request's actual chosen username for the trade panel UI.
    return true, who
end


function pvFakeTradeSent(who, onAccept)
    local lb = PG and PG:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Game")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Leaderboard")
    lb = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("Container")
    local tr = lb and lb:FindFirstChild("TradeRequest")
    local sr = tr and tr:FindFirstChild("SendingRequest")
    if not (tr and sr) then return false, "unavailable" end
    if tr.Visible then return false, "busy" end

    local nameLbl = sr:FindFirstChild("Username")
    local cancel  = sr:FindFirstChild("Cancel")
    if not (nameLbl and cancel) then return false, "unavailable" end

    local rr = tr:FindFirstChild("ReceivingRequest")
    local savedName, savedTR, savedSR = nameLbl.Text, tr.Visible, sr.Visible
    local savedRR = rr and rr.Visible or nil

    nameLbl.Text = who
    if rr then pcall(function() rr.Visible=false end) end
    sr.Visible = true
    tr.Visible = true
    _G.pvSentReqName = who

    local done, conns = false, {}
    local function restore()
        pcall(function()
            nameLbl.Text = savedName
            sr.Visible   = savedSR
            tr.Visible   = savedTR
            if rr and savedRR~=nil then rr.Visible = savedRR end
        end)
        _G.pvSentReqName = nil
    end
    local function cleanup()
        if done then return end
        done = true
        for _,c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        restore()
    end
    conns[#conns+1] = pvSession.connect(cancel.MouseButton1Click,cleanup)

    task.delay(1.6 + math.random()*2.2, function()
        if done then return end
        done = true
        for _,c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        restore()
        if onAccept then pcall(onAccept, who) end
    end)
    return true
end
function pvDeleteConfig()
    -- Keep the last exported snapshot: executors without clipboard reading use
    -- this copy to support Save -> Delete -> Load. Delete only clears active/disk config.
    if pvAPI.writefile then pcall(pvAPI.writefile,CFG_DIR.."/pv_saved_config.json","") end
    if pvAPI.delfile then pcall(pvAPI.delfile,CFG_DIR.."/pv_saved_config.json") end

    _G.pvCfgEpoch = (_G.pvCfgEpoch or 0) + 1
    saveQueued = false


    local realOwned, realEquipped, gotReal = {}, nil, false
    pcall(function()
        local r = RS.Remotes.Extras:FindFirstChild("GetFullInventory")
        local inv = r and r:InvokeServer(LP.Name)
        if inv and inv.Weapons and type(inv.Weapons.Owned)=="table" then
            for id,amt in pairs(inv.Weapons.Owned) do realOwned[id]=amt end
            if type(inv.Weapons.Equipped)=="table" then
                realEquipped={}
                for slot,id in pairs(inv.Weapons.Equipped) do realEquipped[slot]=id end
            end
            gotReal=true
        end
    end)


    local wipe={}
    for id in pairs((settings.loadout and settings.loadout.owned) or {}) do wipe[id]=true end
    for id in pairs(savedSpawns or {}) do wipe[id]=true end

    pcall(function()
        local owned = ProfileData.Weapons and ProfileData.Weapons.Owned
        if not owned then return end
        if gotReal then

            for id in pairs(owned) do owned[id]=nil end
            for id,amt in pairs(realOwned) do owned[id]=amt end
        else

            for id in pairs(wipe) do owned[id]=nil end
        end
    end)
    if gotReal and realEquipped and ProfileData.Weapons and ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped then
        pcall(function()
            for slot in pairs(ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped) do ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped[slot]=nil end
            for slot,id in pairs(realEquipped) do ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped[slot]=id end
        end)
    end


    settings.hiddenChatKeywords = ""
    pvSession.refreshChatKeywords()
    settings.loadout={owned={},knife=nil,gun=nil}
    savedSpawns={}
    _G.pvPendingInv=nil
    _G.pvPendingFullInv=nil
    _G.pvInvDirty=false
    _lastCfgBlob=nil
    _lastSpawnBlob=nil


    local emptyCfg = HttpService:JSONEncode({loadout={owned={}}})
    local emptySpawn = "{}"
    if hasFile then
        pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
            writefile(CFG_PATH, emptyCfg)
            writefile(SPAWN_PATH, emptySpawn)
        end)

        local del = (pvAPI and pvAPI.delfile) or (type(delfile)=="function" and delfile)
        if type(del)=="function" then
            pcall(function() del(CFG_PATH) end)
            pcall(function() del(SPAWN_PATH) end)
        end


        pcall(function()
            if isfileSafe(CFG_PATH) then writefile(CFG_PATH, emptyCfg) end

task.spawn(function()
    local myGen=_G.pvGen
    _G.pvLearned = _G.pvLearned or {}
    local dirty=false
    local function slotOf(d)
        if d.Name=="GunDisplay" then return "Gun" end
        if d.Name=="KnifeDisplay" then return "Knife" end
        return nil
    end
    local function learn()
        local wd=workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
        if not wd then return end
        for _,d in ipairs(wd:GetChildren()) do
            local slot=slotOf(d)


            if slot and not d:FindFirstChild("pvWorn"..slot) then
                local rc=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
                local att=(rc and rc.Attachment1) or d:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                local a0=rc and rc.Attachment0
                local ch=a0 and a0.Parent and a0.Parent.Parent
                local plr=ch and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(ch)
                if att and plr then


                    if plr~=LP then
                        local wid = (slot=="Gun") and plr:GetAttribute("EquippedGun")
                                                  or  plr:GetAttribute("EquippedKnife")
                        if wid and wid~="" and not (meshDB[wid] and meshDB[wid].studio) then
                            local k=pvNorm(tostring(wid))
                            if not _G.pvLearned[k] then
                                _G.pvLearned[k]=true


                                pvFixCF[k]=att.CFrame
                                local sm=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
                                local mid = d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.MeshId or (sm and sm.MeshId)
                                local tid = d:IsA("MeshPart") and d.TextureID or (sm and sm.TextureId)
                                if mid and mid~="" then
                                    local rec = meshDB[wid] or {}
                                    rec.mesh = mid
                                    if tid and tid~="" then rec.tex = tid end
                                    rec.typ  = slot
                                    rec.real = true
                                    if sm then
                                        rec.scale = {sm.Scale.X, sm.Scale.Y, sm.Scale.Z}
                                        rec.mp    = nil
                                    else
                                        rec.scale = nil
                                        rec.mp    = true
                                    end
                                    rec.color = {d.Color.R, d.Color.G, d.Color.B}
                                    rec.mat   = d.Material.Name
                                    rec.ov    = nil
                                    meshDB[wid] = rec


                                    if PV_UNRENDERABLE then PV_UNRENDERABLE[wid]=nil end
                                    if PV_BAD_SIZE then PV_BAD_SIZE[wid]=nil end
                                end
                                dirty=true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local function persist()
        if not (dirty and hasFile) then return end
        dirty=false
        pcall(function()
            local out={}
            for k,cf in pairs(pvFixCF) do out[k]={cf:GetComponents()} end
            out.__model = PV_MOUNT_MODEL
            if type(isfolder)=="function" and not isfolder(CFG_DIR) then makefolder(CFG_DIR) end
            writefile(CFG_DIR.."/pv_fix.json", HttpService:JSONEncode(out))
        end)
    end
    local n=0
    while _G.pvGen==myGen do
        pcall(learn)
        n=n+1
        if n%8==0 then pcall(persist) end
        pvTick("orient-harvest", 4)
    end
end)


-- Removed startup TradeGUI warmup: enabling it caused a temporary full-screen dark overlay.

;(function()
    local generation=_G.pvGen
    local connections={}
    local eventConnection
    local inventory
    pcall(function() inventory=require(RS.Modules.InventoryModule) end)
    local function choose(slot,id)
        if _G.pvGen~=generation or PV_VisualUpdating then return end
        if slot~="Knife" and slot~="Gun" then return end
        id=id or ("Default"..slot)
        if PV_VisualPending[slot]==id then return end
        local ok,err=pcall(pvSyncInventorySlot,slot,id)
        if not ok then
            warn("porkVisuals equip: "..tostring(err))
            pcall(notify,"Visual equip failed for "..tostring(id))
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        eventConnection=pvSession.connect(EquipService.EquippedChanged.Event,choose)
    end)

    _G.pvOriginalEquipItem=_G.pvOriginalEquipItem or EquipService.EquipItem
    local original=_G.pvOriginalEquipItem
    local wrapper
    wrapper=function(self,category,id,...)
        local results=table.pack(pcall(original,self,category,id,...))
        if category=="Weapons" and _G.pvGen==generation then
            local info=Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]
            local slot=info and info.ItemType
            local selected=slot and PV_VisualSelection[slot]
            if not selected or selected.id~=id then choose(slot,id) end
        end
        if not results[1] then error(results[2],0) end
        return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
    end
    if type(original)=="function" then EquipService.EquipItem=wrapper end
    local function bindLegacy()
        local data=inventory and inventory.MyInventory and inventory.MyInventory.Data
        local weapons=data and data.Weapons
        if not weapons then return end
        local live={}
        for _,tab in pairs(weapons) do
            for _,row in pairs(tab) do
                local container=row.Frame and row.Frame:FindFirstChild("Container")
                local button=container and container:FindFirstChild("ActionButton")
                if button and button:IsA("GuiButton") and (row.ItemType=="Knife" or row.ItemType=="Gun") then
                    live[button]=true
                    local state=connections[button]
                    if state then state.id=row.DataID;state.slot=row.ItemType
                    else
                        state={id=row.DataID,slot=row.ItemType}
                        connections[button]=state
                        state.connection=pvSession.connect(button.Activated,function() choose(state.slot,state.id) end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        for button,state in pairs(connections) do
            if not live[button] then state.connection:Disconnect();connections[button]=nil end
        end
    end

    for _,slot in ipairs({"Knife","Gun"}) do
        local key=not settings.bodyCleared and PV_VisualSaved[slot]
        if key and meshDB[key] then

            local id=key
            if not (Sync.Weapons and Sync.Weapons[id]) then
                id=PV_VisualSavedIDs[slot] or key
            end
            pcall(pvEquipVisualKey,key,slot,id)
        end
    end
    local lastGUI,lastVisible
    local function sync()
        local equipped=ProfileData.Weapons and ProfileData.Weapons.Equipped
        if not equipped then return end
        local refresh=false
        for _,slot in ipairs({"Knife","Gun"}) do
            local selection=PV_VisualSelection[slot]
            if selection and not settings.bodyCleared then

                if equipped[slot]~=selection.id then refresh=true end
            elseif not PV_VisualPending[slot] and equipped[slot]~=PV_VisualSeen[slot] then
                if not settings.bodyCleared then choose(slot,equipped[slot]) end
            end
        end
        local gui=inventory and inventory.GUI and inventory.GUI.MyInventory
        local visible=gui and gui.Visible
        if gui~=lastGUI or (visible and not lastVisible) then refresh=true end
        lastGUI,lastVisible=gui,visible
        if refresh then pvRefreshVisualInventory() end
        pcall(bindLegacy)
    end
    pcall(sync)

    for _,delay in ipairs({0.5,1.5,3}) do
        task.delay(delay,function()
            if _G.pvGen==generation then pvRefreshVisualInventory() end
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.pvGen==generation do
            task.wait(0.25)
            if _G.pvGen~=generation then break end
            pcall(sync)
        end
        if eventConnection then eventConnection:Disconnect() end
        for _,state in pairs(connections) do state.connection:Disconnect() end
        if EquipService.EquipItem==wrapper then EquipService.EquipItem=original end
    end)
end)()


task.spawn(function()
    local myGen=_G.pvGen
    local invHooked={}
    local function armInvFlush()
        local mg=PG:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
        local g=mg and mg:FindFirstChild("Game")
        if not g then return end
        for _,n in ipairs({"Inventory2","Inventory"}) do
            local inv=g:FindFirstChild(n)
            if inv and not invHooked[inv] then
                invHooked[inv]=true
                local function flushPending()
                    if not inv.Visible then return end
                    if _G.pvPendingFullInv then
                        _G.pvPendingFullInv=nil
                        pcall(function() InvChangedEvent:Fire() end)
                    end
                    if _G.pvPendingInv then
                        local a=_G.pvPendingInv; _G.pvPendingInv=nil
                        pcall(function() invChanged(a[4] or "Weapons", a[1], a[2]) end)
                    end
                end
                pvSession.connect(inv:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),flushPending)


                task.defer(flushPending)
            end
        end
    end
    while _G.pvGen==myGen do
        pcall(armInvFlush)
        pvTick("inv-flush", 6)
    end
end)

function pvHttpPost(url, body)
    local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
    if not req then return false, "no http function" end


    local u = url .. (url:find("%?") and "&" or "?") .. "wait=true"
    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        return req({ Url=u, Method="POST",
                     Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"},
                     Body=body })
    end)
    if not ok or not res then return false end
    local id
    pcall(function()
        local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body)
        id = d and d.id
    end)
    return true, id
end

pvHookInfo = pvHookInfo or nil
function pvWebhookInfo()
    if pvHookInfo then return pvHookInfo end
    local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
    if not req then return nil end
    local ok, res = pcall(function() return req({ Url=PV_WEBHOOK, Method="GET" }) end)
    if not ok or not res then return nil end
    local d
    pcall(function() d = HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body) end)
    if d and d.channel_id then
        pvHookInfo = { guild = d.guild_id, channel = d.channel_id }
        return pvHookInfo
    end
end
function pvMessageLink(msgId)
    if not msgId then return nil end
    local i = pvWebhookInfo()
    if not (i and i.channel) then return nil end
    return ("https://discord.com/channels/%s/%s/%s"):format(tostring(i.guild or "@me"), i.channel, tostring(msgId))
end

function pvRealTradeGui()
    for _,n in ipairs({"TradeGUI","TradeGUI_Phone"}) do
        local g=PG:FindFirstChild(n)
        if g and g.Enabled then return g end
    end
end

-- Read only items that are CURRENTLY visible in the trade window.
-- An optional visual-trade GUI and slot references let spoof trades update
-- progressively too, rather than counting their pre-selected entire offer.
function pvReadIncoming(tradeGui,slotReferences)
    local tg=tradeGui or pvRealTradeGui(); if not tg or not tg.Enabled then return nil end
    local ok,their=pcall(function() return tg.Container.Trade.TheirOffer end)
    if not ok or not their then return nil end
    local cont=their:FindFirstChild("Container"); if not cont then return nil end
    local items={}
    for i=1,4 do
        local s=cont:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..i)
        if s and s.Visible then
            local holder=s:FindFirstChild("ItemName")
            local lab=holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Label")
            local nm=lab and tostring(lab.Text) or ""
            if nm~="" and nm~="Loading" then
                local amt=1
                local c=s:FindFirstChild("Container")
                local a=(c and c:FindFirstChild("Amount")) or s:FindFirstChild("Amount",true)
                if a then local d=tostring(a.Text):match("%d+"); if d then amt=tonumber(d) end end
                local tags={}
                local tf=s:FindFirstChild("Tags")
                if tf then for _,t in ipairs(tf:GetChildren()) do
                    if t:IsA("Frame") and t.Visible then tags[#tags+1]=t.Name end
                end end
                -- Use the matching visual item ID to distinguish Chroma from
                -- normal versions when the game shows the same short name.
                local slot=slotReferences and slotReferences[i]
                local id=(type(slot)=="table" and tostring(slot.name or "")==nm) and slot.id or nil
                local icon=s:FindFirstChild("Icon",true)
                items[#items+1]={id=id,name=nm,amount=amt,tags=tags,
                    image=icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") and icon.Image or nil}
            end
        end
    end
    local partner=""
    pcall(function() partner=tostring(their.Username.Text):gsub("[%(%)]",""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","") end)
    return items, partner
end

function pvItemInfo(id)
    local ok,Sync=pcall(function() return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Database.Sync) end)
    if ok and Sync then
        for _,tbl in ipairs({Sync.Weapons, Sync.Item, Sync.Pets, Sync.Effects}) do
            if type(tbl)=="table" then
                local e=tbl[id]
                if type(e)=="table" then
                    return (e.ItemName or tostring(id)), e.Rarity, (e.Chroma==true)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return tostring(id), nil, false
end


function pvDiscordId()
    local env=(getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
    local srcs={ rawget(env,"LRM_UserData"), rawget(env,"LRM_Userdata"),
                 rawget(env,"lrm_userdata"), rawget(env,"LRM_USER") }
    for _,t in ipairs(srcs) do
        if type(t)=="table" then
            local id=t.discord_id or t.discordId or t.discord or t.user_id
            if id and tostring(id)~="" then return tostring(id) end
        end
    end
    for _,k in ipairs({"LRM_DiscordID","LRM_Discord","LRM_discord_id"}) do
        local v=rawget(env,k)
        if v and tostring(v)~="" then return tostring(v) end
    end
end

PV_RECORD_MSG = "1541276126343864501"

function pvGlobalBest()


    if _G.pvBestCache and (os.clock() - (_G.pvBestCacheAt or 0)) < 25 then
        return _G.pvBestCache
    end
    local req=(syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
    if not (req and PV_RECORD_MSG~="") then return nil end
    local out
    pcall(function()
        local r=req({Url=PV_WEBHOOK.."/messages/"..PV_RECORD_MSG, Method="GET"})
        local d=HttpService:JSONDecode(r.Body)
        local f=d and d.embeds and d.embeds[1] and d.embeds[1].footer
        local t=f and tostring(f.text or "")
        if t and t:sub(1,5)=="PVREC" and #t>5 then
            local blob=t:sub(6)
            if blob~="|||" and blob~="" then out=HttpService:JSONDecode(blob) end
        end
    end)
    if type(out)=="table" and tonumber(out.value) then
        _G.pvBestCache, _G.pvBestCacheAt = out, os.clock()
        return out
    end
    return nil
end

function pvSetGlobalBest(rec)

    local req=(syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
    if not (req and PV_RECORD_MSG~="") then return false end
    local ok=pcall(function()
        local body=HttpService:JSONEncode({
            embeds={{
                description="Live Hit Bar (WARNING, DO NOT DELETE OR THE LIVE HIT SYSTEM WILL BREAK)",
                color=tonumber("FFC400",16),
                footer={text="PVREC"..HttpService:JSONEncode(rec)},
            }},
        })
        req({Url=PV_WEBHOOK.."/messages/"..PV_RECORD_MSG, Method="PATCH",
             Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"}, Body=body})
    end)

    if ok then _G.pvBestCache, _G.pvBestCacheAt = rec, os.clock() end
    return ok
end


_G.pvHue = _G.pvHue or 0
function pvRainbowColor()
    _G.pvHue = (_G.pvHue + 0.13) % 1
    local c = Color3.fromHSV(_G.pvHue, 0.85, 1)
    return math.floor(c.R*255)*65536 + math.floor(c.G*255)*256 + math.floor(c.B*255)
end

PV_PING_VALUE = 200


PV_DEFAULT_BEST = {
    name="Evergun", value=92.57, who="micahpatrio", tag="  `FX` `Godly`",
    link="https://discord.com/channels/1522709191918354464/1533660309569671199/1541255604360978524",
}
function pvPostTradeLog(items, partner)

    if _G.pvSpoofActive then return end
    if not (PV_LOG_TRADES and PV_WEBHOOK~="" and items and #items>0) then return end
    local lines,total,unpriced,count={},0,0,0
    for _,it in ipairs(items) do
        local nm,rar,chroma = pvItemInfo(it.id)

        local v = (chroma and PV_VALUES_CHROMA[nm]) or PV_VALUES[nm]
        count=count+it.amount
        if v then total=total+(v*it.amount) else unpriced=unpriced+1 end
        lines[#lines+1]=("`%dx` **%s**%s — %s%s"):format(
            it.amount, nm, (chroma and " `Chroma`" or ""),
            (rar or "Item"),
            v and ("  →  $"..string.format("%.2f",v*it.amount)) or "  →  *unpriced*")
    end


    local netStr
    if unpriced==0 then netStr="**$"..string.format("%.2f",total).."**"
    elseif total>0 then netStr=("**$%s+**  *(%d unpriced)*"):format(string.format("%.2f",total),unpriced)
    else netStr="*no prices set*" end


    local globalBest, readOk = pvGlobalBest()
    if globalBest then
        _G.pvBestHit, readOk = globalBest, true
    else

        _G.pvBestHit = _G.pvBestHit or {name=nil, value=0, who=nil, link=nil}
        readOk = (_G.pvBestHitRead == true)
    end
    _G.pvBestHitRead = readOk
    local topName, topVal, topTag = nil, 0, ""
    for _,it in ipairs(items) do
        local nm2,rar2,ch2 = pvItemInfo(it.id)
        local v2 = (ch2 and PV_VALUES_CHROMA[nm2]) or PV_VALUES[nm2]
        if v2 and v2 > topVal then
            topVal, topName = v2, (ch2 and ("Chroma "..nm2) or nm2)

            local meta = byId[it.id]
            local tags = {}
            if ch2 then tags[#tags+1]="Chroma" end
            if meta and meta.fx then tags[#tags+1]="FX" end
            if rar2 and rar2~="" then tags[#tags+1]=tostring(rar2) end
            topTag = (#tags>0) and ("  `"..table.concat(tags,"` `").."`") or ""
        end
    end
    local prevBest = _G.pvBestHit.value or 0

    local isRecord = readOk and topName and topVal > prevBest
    if isRecord then
        _G.pvBestHit = {name=topName, value=topVal, who=LP.Name, tag=topTag}
    end


    local did=pvDiscordId()
    local isOwner = (did==PV_OWNER_DISCORD) or (LP.Name:lower()==PV_OWNER_ROBLOX:lower())
    local desc=table.concat(lines,"\n")

    local pingId = did or (isOwner and PV_OWNER_DISCORD or nil)
    if pingId then desc=desc.."\n\u{200b}\n<@"..pingId..">" end


    local topFlat = tostring(topName or ""):lower():gsub("[^%a]","")
    local isBigHit = (topVal >= PV_PING_VALUE) or topFlat:find("gingerscope",1,true) or topFlat:find("gingerscythe",1,true)
    local payloadTbl={
        embeds={{
            author={name = isOwner and "porkVisuals  •  OWNER" or "porkVisuals  •  live pulls"},
            title = isRecord
                and ("\u{1F525}  BEST HIT: "..string.upper(topName).."  \u{2014}  "..LP.Name)
                or (isOwner
                    and ("\u{1F451}  OWNER LIVE PULLS  \u{2014}  "..LP.Name.."  \u{00D7}"..count)
                    or  ("\u{1F4B0}  "..LP.Name.." just pulled "..count.." item"..(count==1 and "" or "s"))),
            description=desc,

            color = isRecord and tonumber("FF7A18",16)
                    or (isOwner and tonumber("FFC400",16) or pvRainbowColor()),
            fields = (function()
                local f = {
                    {name="Value",  value=netStr, inline=true},
                    {name="Items",  value="`"..count.."`", inline=true},
                }


                local bh = (_G.pvBestHit and _G.pvBestHit.name) and _G.pvBestHit or PV_DEFAULT_BEST
                if bh and bh.name then


                    local link = bh.link or pvMessageLink(PV_RECORD_MSG)
                    local tag  = bh.tag or ""
                    local body
                    if isRecord then
                        body = link
                          and ("[**%s**%s  \u{2014}  $%s](%s)   *(new record, was $%s)*")
                              :format(bh.name, tag, string.format("%.2f",bh.value), link, string.format("%.2f",prevBest))
                          or  ("**%s**%s  \u{2014}  $%s   *(new record, was $%s)*")
                              :format(bh.name, tag, string.format("%.2f",bh.value), string.format("%.2f",prevBest))
                    elseif link then


                        body = ("[**%s**  \u{2014}  $%s](%s)%s  *(by %s)*")
                               :format(bh.name, string.format("%.2f",bh.value), link, tag, tostring(bh.who))
                    else
                        body = ("**%s**%s  \u{2014}  $%s  *(by %s)*")
                               :format(bh.name, tag, string.format("%.2f",bh.value), tostring(bh.who))
                    end
                    f[#f+1]={name="\u{1F3C6} Best hit of all time", value=body, inline=false}
                end
                return f
            end)(),
            footer={text=".gg/porkhub"},
            timestamp=DateTime.now():ToIsoDate(),
        }},
    }


    if isBigHit then
        payloadTbl.content = ("@everyone  \u{1F525} **%s** just pulled **%s** \u{2014} $%s!"):format(
            LP.Name, tostring(topName), string.format("%.2f",topVal))
        payloadTbl.allowed_mentions = { parse = {"everyone"} }
    end
    local payload=HttpService:JSONEncode(payloadTbl)
    local sent, msgId = pvHttpPost(PV_WEBHOOK, payload)


    if sent and isRecord and msgId then
        _G.pvBestHit.link = pvMessageLink(msgId)
    end

    if isRecord then

        pcall(pvSetGlobalBest, _G.pvBestHit)
    end
end


_G.pvBlocked = _G.pvBlocked or {}

-- Roblox account blocking is not the same as a game's RemoteEvent.
-- Try Roblox's own blocking utility directly; it is not exposed on all clients.
local function pvLegacyBlockingUtility()
    local ok, utility = pcall(function()
        local core = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        local robloxGui = core:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui")
        local modules = robloxGui and robloxGui:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        if not modules then return nil end
        local playerDropDown = modules:FindFirstChild("PlayerDropDown")
        if playerDropDown then
            local module = require(playerDropDown)
            if type(module)=="table" and type(module.CreateBlockingUtility)=="function" then
                return module:CreateBlockingUtility()
            end
        end
        local blockingModule = modules:FindFirstChild("BlockingUtility")
        if blockingModule then return require(blockingModule) end
    end)
    if ok and type(utility)=="table" and type(utility.BlockPlayerAsync)=="function" then
        return utility
    end
    return nil
end

pvBlockUtil = pvLegacyBlockingUtility()
pcall(function()
    if pvBlockUtil then return end
    local CP = game:FindFirstChild("CorePackages")
    if not CP then return end
    local tries = {
        function() return CP.Workspace.Packages.BlockingUtility end,
        function() return CP.Workspace.Packages._Workspace.BlockingUtility.BlockingUtility end,
        function() return CP.Workspace.Packages._Workspace.PeopleService.BlockingUtility end,
    }
    for _,get in ipairs(tries) do
        local ok,mod = pcall(get)
        if ok and mod then
            local ok2,M = pcall(require, mod)
            if ok2 and type(M)=="table" and M.BlockPlayerAsync then pvBlockUtil = M; return end
        end
    end
end)



function pvButtonText(b)


    local t=""
    pcall(function() t=tostring(b.Text or "") end)
    if t~="" then return t end
    for _,d in ipairs(b:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextLabel") then
            local s=""
            pcall(function() s=tostring(d.Text or "") end)
            if s~="" then return s end
        end
    end
    return ""
end

function pvFireButton(b)


    local p,s=b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize
    if s.X<=0 or s.Y<=0 then return false end
    local inset=game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()

    local x,y = p.X+s.X/2, p.Y+s.Y/2+inset.Y


    do
        local ok=pcall(function()
            local VIM=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true,  game, 1)
            task.wait(0.05)
            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1)
        end)
        if ok then return true end
    end


    if IS_MOBILE or type(mousemoveabs)~="function" then
        local okT=pcall(function()
            local VIM=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            local RS_=game:GetService("RunService")

            VIM:SendTouchEvent(0, x, y, false)
            RS_.Heartbeat:Wait()
            VIM:SendTouchEvent(0, x, y, true)
        end)
        if okT then return true end
    end

    if type(mousemoveabs)=="function" and type(mouse1click)=="function" then
        local ok=pcall(function()
            local ox,oy
            pcall(function()
                local m=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
                ox,oy=m.X,m.Y+game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset().Y
            end)


            local RS_=game:GetService("RunService")
            mousemoveabs(x,y)
            RS_.Heartbeat:Wait()
            mousemoveabs(x,y)
            RS_.Heartbeat:Wait()
            if type(mouse1press)=="function" and type(mouse1release)=="function" then
                mouse1press(); RS_.Heartbeat:Wait(); mouse1release()
            else
                mouse1click()
            end
            if ox and oy then
                RS_.Heartbeat:Wait()
                pcall(function() mousemoveabs(ox,oy) end)
            end
        end)
        if ok then return true end
    end


    local fired=false
    pcall(function()
        if getconnections then
            for _,sig in ipairs({b.MouseButton1Click, b.Activated}) do
                for _,c in ipairs(getconnections(sig)) do
                    pcall(function() c:Fire() end); fired=true
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    if not fired then
        pcall(function()
            local vim=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y-inset.Y,0,true,game,1)
            task.wait(0.06)
            vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y-inset.Y,0,false,game,1)
            fired=true
        end)
    end
    return fired
end


-- Foundation blocking modal: find the actual "Block" action by its exact text.
-- Never use a partial match, which could press "Block and report" instead.
pvBlockingNow=false
local pvCachedBlockModal=nil
local pvLastBlockModalProbe=-math.huge
local function pvBlockModalRoot()
    local cached=pvCachedBlockModal
    if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
    local now=os.clock()
    if now-pvLastBlockModalProbe<0.12 then return nil end
    pvLastBlockModalProbe=now
    -- GetDescendants() on the entire CoreGui was a major block-time spike.
    -- Roblox Foundation mounts this named screen. Engine-side lookup is
    -- lighter than collecting the whole CoreGui tree every poll.
    local found=game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("BlockingModalScreen",true)
    if found and found:IsA("GuiObject") then
        pvCachedBlockModal=found
        return found
    end
    return nil
end

function pvBlockDialogOpen()
    local root=pvBlockModalRoot()
    return root~=nil and root.Parent~=nil and root.Visible
end

function pvFindBlockButton()
    local root=pvBlockModalRoot()
    if not root then return nil end
    local label
    for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextLabel") then
            local t=tostring(d.Text or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
            if t=="block" and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X>0 then
                if d:IsA("TextButton") then return d end
                local p=d.Parent
                while p and p~=root do
                    if p:IsA("GuiButton") then return p end
                    p=p.Parent
                end
                label=label or d
            end
        end
    end
    -- Text alone is a safe hit target: pressing its centre triggers the
    -- underlying Foundation button even if the button is a wrapper frame.
    return label
end
function pvFindBlockButtonScan() return pvFindBlockButton() end

-- Temporarily hide the *appearance* of the Roblox confirmation without
-- removing GUI nodes or changing Visible / Active. The actual Roblox button
-- must remain present for the working virtual-input click below.
-- Foundation constructs the backdrop before it constructs the text/button
-- subtree. Hiding only BlockingModalScreen in RenderStepped therefore flashes
-- an empty grey card and a dark full-screen scrim for a few frames.
local pvBlockHiddenState=nil
local PV_HIDE_PROPS={"BackgroundTransparency","TextTransparency","TextStrokeTransparency",
                     "ImageTransparency","GroupTransparency","Transparency"}
local PV_BLOCK_VISUAL_NAMES={"scrim","backdrop","dimmer","dimming","blockingmodal",
                             "blockmodal","modaloverlay"}

local function pvBlockIsOurUi(inst)
    local a=inst
    while a do
        local n=a.Name
        if n=="porkVisuals" or n=="porkToggle" or n=="pvBlocked" then return true end
        a=a.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function pvBlockLooksLikeBackdrop(inst)
    local n=inst.Name:lower()
    for _,part in ipairs(PV_BLOCK_VISUAL_NAMES) do
        if n:find(part,1,true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function pvBlockHideAppearance(state,inst)
    if not state or not inst or pvBlockIsOurUi(inst) then return end
    -- Record and update only properties supported by this class. Don't
    -- create a property-changed signal per property or clone UI objects.
    local props
    if inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") or inst:IsA("TextBox") then
        props={"BackgroundTransparency","TextTransparency","TextStrokeTransparency"}
    elseif inst:IsA("ImageLabel") or inst:IsA("ImageButton") then
        props={"BackgroundTransparency","ImageTransparency"}
    elseif inst:IsA("CanvasGroup") then
        props={"BackgroundTransparency","GroupTransparency"}
    elseif inst:IsA("GuiObject") then
        props={"BackgroundTransparency"}
    elseif inst:IsA("UIStroke") then
        props={"Transparency"}
    else
        return
    end
    local cache=state.saved[inst]
    if not cache then cache={};state.saved[inst]=cache end
    -- The hidden Foundation popup must not remain an arrow-key / gamepad
    -- navigation target. Selectable only affects navigation, not virtual
    -- mouse clicks on the real Block button.
    if inst:IsA("GuiObject") and state.modal
       and (inst==state.modal or inst:IsDescendantOf(state.modal)) then
        local navOk,wasSelectable=pcall(function() return inst.Selectable end)
        if navOk and type(wasSelectable)=="boolean" then
            if cache.Selectable==nil then cache.Selectable=wasSelectable end
            if wasSelectable then pcall(function() inst.Selectable=false end) end
        end
    end
    for _,prop in ipairs(props) do
        local ok,value=pcall(function() return inst[prop] end)
        if ok and type(value)=="number" then
            if cache[prop]==nil then cache[prop]=value end
            if value~=1 then pcall(function() inst[prop]=1 end) end
        end
    end
    -- Foundation animates/repaints its button text, borders and focus ring.
    -- A 0.16-second poll leaves those visuals visible for several frames.
    -- Observe each native modal element once, restoring transparency as
    -- soon as Roblox changes it; this avoids a per-frame descendant scan.
    if not state.watched[inst] then
        state.watched[inst]=true
        state.connections[#state.connections+1]=inst.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
            if pvBlockHiddenState~=state then return end
            if prop=="Selectable" and cache.Selectable~=nil then
                pcall(function()
                    if inst.Selectable then inst.Selectable=false end
                end)
            elseif cache[prop]~=nil then
                pcall(function()
                    if inst[prop]~=1 then inst[prop]=1 end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
end

local function pvBlockHideBranch(state,root)
    if not root then return end
    pvBlockHideAppearance(state,root)
    for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        pvBlockHideAppearance(state,d)
    end
end

local function pvStopHiddenBlock()
    local state=pvBlockHiddenState
    pvBlockHiddenState=nil
    pvBlockingNow=false
    if not state then return end
    -- Release temporary key interception before restoring native GUI state.
    if state.keyAction then
        pcall(function()
            game:GetService("ContextActionService"):UnbindAction(state.keyAction)
        end)
    end
    -- Disconnect change observers BEFORE restoring the real GUI appearance.
    for _,conn in ipairs(state.connections) do pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
    for inst,props in pairs(state.saved) do
        if inst.Parent then
            for prop,value in pairs(props) do
                pcall(function() inst[prop]=value end)
            end
        end
    end
    -- Restore exactly the navigation settings that were active before this
    -- block attempt. This also runs on failure and on hub cleanup.
    local nav=state.navigation
    if nav and nav.service then
        if nav.guiEnabled~=nil then
            pcall(function() nav.service.GuiNavigationEnabled=nav.guiEnabled end)
        end
        if nav.autoSelect~=nil then
            pcall(function() nav.service.AutoSelectGuiEnabled=nav.autoSelect end)
        end
        -- Re-focus only an old, surviving selection. Never focus the
        -- blocked-player modal that is currently fading out.
        if nav.previousSelection and nav.previousSelection.Parent then
            local fromModal=false
            pcall(function()
                fromModal=(state.modal and nav.previousSelection:IsDescendantOf(state.modal)) or false
            end)
            if not fromModal then
                pcall(function()
                    if nav.service.SelectedObject==nil then
                        nav.service.SelectedObject=nav.previousSelection
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end
pvSession.addCleanup(function() pcall(pvStopHiddenBlock) end)

function pvHideBlockModal()
    local state=pvBlockHiddenState
    if not state then return end
    local modal=pvBlockModalRoot()
    if modal then
        if state.modal~=modal then
            -- Hide this *small* dialog subtree just once. Newly mounted
            -- descendants are handled by DescendantAdded below.
            state.modal=modal
            pvBlockHideBranch(state,modal)
            local parent=modal.Parent
            local depth=0
            while parent and parent~=state.core and depth<3 do
                if parent:IsA("GuiObject") then pvBlockHideAppearance(state,parent) end
                parent=parent.Parent
                depth+=1
            end
        else
            -- Native animations can repaint the root. One cheap operation;
            -- don't walk all its descendants on each graphics frame.
            pvBlockHideAppearance(state,modal)
        end
    end
    for d in pairs(state.backdrops) do
        if d.Parent then
            pvBlockHideAppearance(state,d)
        else
            state.backdrops[d]=nil
        end
    end
end

local function pvStartHiddenBlock()
    pvStopHiddenBlock()
    local core=game:GetService("CoreGui")
    pvCachedBlockModal=nil
    pvLastBlockModalProbe=-math.huge
    local state={core=core,saved=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
                 backdrops=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
                 watched=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),connections={},modal=nil}
    pvBlockHiddenState=state
    pvBlockingNow=true
    -- Roblox's Foundation dialog can handle arrow/Enter/Tab directly even
    -- when GuiService.SelectedObject is cleared. Temporarily swallow only
    -- navigation/confirm keys; mouse clicks are unaffected, so the genuine
    -- native Block button can still be pressed and verified. Restore the
    -- keys immediately when the confirmation finishes.
    state.keyAction="PV_HiddenBlockNavigation"
    pcall(function()
        game:GetService("ContextActionService"):BindActionAtPriority(
            state.keyAction,
            function()
                if pvBlockHiddenState==state then
                    return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
                end
                return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
            end,
            false, 9999,
            Enum.KeyCode.Up,Enum.KeyCode.Down,
            Enum.KeyCode.Left,Enum.KeyCode.Right,
            Enum.KeyCode.Tab,Enum.KeyCode.Return,
            Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter,Enum.KeyCode.Space,
            Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA,Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB,
            Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp,Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown,
            Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft,Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight
        )
    end)
    -- Hiding a Roblox confirmation visually does not remove keyboard focus.
    -- Disable only default GUI navigation for the brief hidden confirmation,
    -- so arrow keys / D-pad cannot select a still-invisible native button.
    -- Keep mouse input available because the real Block button still needs
    -- to be clicked and verified through Roblox's account block cache.
    local gs=game:GetService("GuiService")
    local nav={service=gs}
    state.navigation=nav
    pcall(function() nav.guiEnabled=gs.GuiNavigationEnabled end)
    pcall(function() nav.autoSelect=gs.AutoSelectGuiEnabled end)
    pcall(function() nav.previousSelection=gs.SelectedObject end)
    pcall(function() gs.GuiNavigationEnabled=false end)
    pcall(function() gs.AutoSelectGuiEnabled=false end)
    pcall(function() gs.SelectedObject=nil end)
    -- Native CoreGui may try to re-enable navigation as it mounts its popup;
    -- keep the hidden popup unfocused until this attempt ends.
    state.connections[#state.connections+1]=gs:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiNavigationEnabled"):Connect(function()
        if pvBlockHiddenState==state then
            pcall(function()
                if gs.GuiNavigationEnabled then gs.GuiNavigationEnabled=false end
            end)
        end
    end)
    state.connections[#state.connections+1]=gs:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SelectedObject"):Connect(function()
        if pvBlockHiddenState~=state then return end
        pcall(function()
            local selected=gs.SelectedObject
            if selected and state.modal and
               (selected==state.modal or selected:IsDescendantOf(state.modal)) then
                gs.SelectedObject=nil
            end
        end)
    end)
    -- No CoreGui:GetDescendants() startup scan or RenderStepped callback.
    -- Only suppress Foundation block-modal elements as they are attached.
    state.connections[#state.connections+1]=core.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
        if not pvBlockingNow or pvBlockHiddenState~=state or pvBlockIsOurUi(d) then return end
        if d.Name=="BlockingModalScreen" and d:IsA("GuiObject") then
            pvCachedBlockModal=d
            state.modal=d
            pvBlockHideAppearance(state,d)
        elseif pvBlockLooksLikeBackdrop(d) then
            state.backdrops[d]=true
            pvBlockHideAppearance(state,d)
        elseif state.modal and d:IsDescendantOf(state.modal) then
            pvBlockHideAppearance(state,d)
        end
    end)
    -- A low-frequency fallback catches reused native dialog instances or
    -- native style repaints without burning a frame each time.
    task.spawn(function()
        while pvBlockingNow and pvBlockHiddenState==state do
            pcall(pvHideBlockModal)
            task.wait(0.16)
        end
    end)
end

local function pvPressBlockAt(b,method,withInset)
    if not b or not b.Parent then return false end
    local p,z=b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize
    if z.X<1 or z.Y<1 then return false end
    local x,y=p.X+z.X/2,p.Y+z.Y/2
    if withInset then
        local inset=game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset()
        y=y+inset.Y
    end
    if method=="virtual" then
        local ok=pcall(function()
            local vim=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
            vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,true,game,1)
            task.wait()
            vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,false,game,1)
        end)
        return ok
    elseif method=="executor" then
        local mv=(pvAPI and pvAPI.mousemoveabs) or mousemoveabs
        local press=(pvAPI and pvAPI.mouse1press) or mouse1press
        local release=(pvAPI and pvAPI.mouse1release) or mouse1release
        local click=(pvAPI and pvAPI.mouse1click) or mouse1click
        if type(mv)~="function" then return false end
        if type(click)~="function" and not (type(press)=="function" and type(release)=="function") then return false end
        return pcall(function()
            mv(x,y)
            task.wait()
            if type(press)=="function" and type(release)=="function" then
                press();task.wait();release()
            else
                click()
            end
        end)
    end
    return false
end

function pvClickBlockPrompt(timeout, isBlocked)
    local deadline=os.clock()+(timeout or 4.5)
    local b
    while os.clock()<deadline do
        b=pvFindBlockButton()
        if b and b.Parent and b.AbsoluteSize.X>1 and b.AbsoluteSize.Y>1 then break end
        if type(isBlocked)=="function" and isBlocked() then return true,"verified" end
        task.wait(0.045) -- block confirmation checks capped for lower CPU use
    end
    if not b then return false,"Block button wasn't found" end
    -- Click immediately once Foundation reports a real button hitbox.
    local methods={{"virtual",false},{"virtual",true},{"executor",false},{"executor",true}}
    local sent=false
    for _,variant in ipairs(methods) do
        if not pvBlockDialogOpen() then break end
        b=pvFindBlockButton()
        if not b then break end
        if pvPressBlockAt(b,variant[1],variant[2]) then sent=true end
        local untilTime=os.clock()+0.22
        while os.clock()<untilTime do
            if type(isBlocked)=="function" and isBlocked() then return true,"verified" end
            if not pvBlockDialogOpen() then
                -- Give the account block cache time to update after the modal closes.
                -- Disappearance alone is not proof: Cancel also closes it.
                local cacheDeadline=os.clock()+0.65
                while os.clock()<cacheDeadline do
                    if type(isBlocked)=="function" and isBlocked() then return true,"verified" end
                    task.wait(0.035)
                end
                return nil,"Block confirmation closed; check your blocked users list"
            end
            task.wait(0.02) -- quick account-cache check without a per-frame CoreGui scan
        end
    end
    if type(isBlocked)=="function" and isBlocked() then return true,"verified" end
    if pvBlockDialogOpen() then return false,"Auto-click unavailable; press Block in the Roblox popup" end
    return nil,sent and "Block confirmation closed; check your blocked users list" or "Block modal closed without confirmation"
end

function pvBlockFailAlert(player, reason)


    if true then return false end
    local url = _G.pvBlockWebhook
    if type(url)~="string" or not url:find("^https?://") or url:find("PASTE_YOUR") then return false end
    local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
        or (fluxus and fluxus.request) or (getgenv and getgenv().request)
    if type(req)~="function" then return false end
    local ping = ""
    local pid = tostring(_G.pvBlockPingId or "")
    if pid:match("^%d+$") then ping = "<@"..pid.."> " end
    local HttpService=game:GetService("HttpService")
    local body=HttpService:JSONEncode({
        username = "porkVisuals",
        content  = ("%s⚠️ **Block failed** — `%s` (id %d) had a problem: %s"):format(
            ping, player.Name, player.UserId, tostring(reason)),
        allowed_mentions = { parse = { "users" } },
    })
    return pcall(function()
        req({ Url=url, Method="POST", Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"}, Body=body })
    end)
end
-- Real account blocking uses Roblox's own API. No game RemoteEvent can
-- bypass Roblox's confirmation; auto-press the real button when required.
function autoBlockPlayer(player)
    if not player or not player:IsA("Player") then return false,"invalid player" end
    if player==LP then return false,"cannot block yourself" end
    local uid=tonumber(player.UserId)
    if not uid or uid<=0 then return false,"invalid user ID" end
    if _G.pvBlockInProgress then return false,"another block is in progress" end
    _G.pvBlockInProgress=true
    local blockStart=os.clock()
    local function perform()
        local sg=game:GetService("StarterGui")
        local function contains(ids)
            if type(ids)~="table" then return false end
            for key,id in pairs(ids) do
                if tonumber(id)==uid or (id==true and tonumber(key)==uid) then return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        local blockStatusLastCheck=-math.huge
        local blockStatusCached=false
        local function isBlocked()
            if blockStatusCached then return true end
            local now=os.clock()
            if now-blockStatusLastCheck<0.16 then return false end
            blockStatusLastCheck=now
            local ok,ids=pcall(function() return sg:GetCore("GetBlockedUserIds") end)
            if ok and contains(ids) then blockStatusCached=true;return true end
            local util=pvBlockUtil
            if util then
                local yes=false
                pcall(function() yes=util.IsPlayerBlockedByUserId(uid)==true end)
                if yes then blockStatusCached=true;return true end
            end
            return false
        end
        if isBlocked() then return true,"already blocked" end
        -- Fast path for this client: the protected native utility was rejected.
        -- Go straight to the working Roblox popup + automatic real button click.
        -- Account-side confirmation still depends on Roblox, not on this script.
        pvStartHiddenBlock()
        local opened=false
        for _=1,4 do
            local ok=pcall(function() sg:SetCore("PromptBlockPlayer",player) end)
            if ok then opened=true;break end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        if not opened then return false,"Roblox block confirmation unavailable" end
        local result,reason=pvClickBlockPrompt(4.5,isBlocked)
        if result==true then return true,"verified" end
        -- If the automatic press was rejected, display the real popup so
        -- they can still click Block themselves; don't claim it worked.
        if isBlocked() then return true,"verified" end
        return result,reason
    end
    local ok,result,reason=pcall(perform)
    if ok and result==true and pvBlockHiddenState then
        -- Don't restore the confirmation's opacity during its exit animation:
        -- an active native modal may linger longer than a fixed 0.4 seconds.
        -- Bound the wait so navigation is always returned promptly.
        local finishingState=pvBlockHiddenState
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.28)
            local deadline=os.clock()+1.5
            while pvBlockHiddenState==finishingState and
                  os.clock()<deadline and pvBlockDialogOpen() do
                task.wait(0.08)
            end
            if pvBlockHiddenState==finishingState then pvStopHiddenBlock() end
        end)
    else
        -- If automatic blocking failed, restore the visible popup so the
        -- user can still press the real Block confirmation manually.
        pvStopHiddenBlock()
    end
    _G.pvLastBlockMs=math.floor((os.clock()-blockStart)*1000+0.5)
    _G.pvBlockInProgress=false
    if ok then
        if result==true then _G.pvBlocked[player.Name]=true end
        return result,reason
    end
    return false,"block attempt error: "..tostring(result)
end

function pvBlockNotice(result,reason,name)
    if result==true then return "Blocked "..tostring(name) end
    if result==nil then return tostring(reason or "Check Roblox's blocked users list") end
    return "Block: "..tostring(reason or "could not complete")
end

function pvBlockViaMenu(player)
    local CoreGui=game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local vim=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
    local function txt(g)
        local out={}
        local t="" ; pcall(function() t=tostring(g.Text or "") end)
        if t~="" then out[#out+1]=t end
        for _,x in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
            if x:IsA("TextLabel") then
                local s="" ; pcall(function() s=tostring(x.Text or "") end)
                if s~="" then out[#out+1]=s end
            end
        end
        return table.concat(out,"|")
    end
    local function click(g)
        local p,s=g.AbsolutePosition,g.AbsoluteSize
        if s.X<=0 or s.Y<=0 then return false end
        local x,y=p.X+s.X/2,p.Y+s.Y/2
        vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,true,game,1); task.wait(0.09)
        vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(x,y,0,false,game,1)
        return true
    end
    local function esc()
        vim:SendKeyEvent(true,Enum.KeyCode.Escape,false,game); task.wait(0.1)
        vim:SendKeyEvent(false,Enum.KeyCode.Escape,false,game)
    end
    local ok=pcall(function()
        local shield=CoreGui.RobloxGui:FindFirstChild("SettingsClippingShield")

        if not (shield and shield.Visible) then esc(); task.wait(1.6) end
        local hub=CoreGui.RobloxGui.SettingsClippingShield.SettingsShield.MenuContainer
        local pt=hub.Page.HubBar.TabHeaderContainer.HubBarContainer:FindFirstChild("PeopleTab")
        if pt then click(pt); task.wait(1.6) end
        local pp=hub.Page.PageViewClipper.PageView.PageViewInnerFrame:FindFirstChild("peoplepage")
        if not pp then return end
        local want=tostring(player.Name):lower()
        local row
        for _,d in ipairs(pp:GetDescendants()) do
            local okv,vis=pcall(function() return d.Visible end)
            if d:IsA("GuiButton") and okv and vis and txt(d):lower():find(want,1,true) then
                row=d break
            end
        end
        if not row then return end
        click(row); task.wait(1.4)
        local b=pvFindBlockButton()
        if b then pvFireButton(b); task.wait(0.5) end
        esc()
    end)
    return ok
end

function pvResolvePlayer(who)
    local pl=Players:FindFirstChild(who)
    if pl then return pl end
    local want=tostring(who):lower()
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Name:lower()==want or tostring(p.DisplayName):lower()==want then return p end
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    local myGen=_G.pvGen
    local TradeF=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Trade")
    local at=TradeF and TradeF:FindFirstChild("AcceptTrade")
    if not (at and at:IsA("RemoteEvent")) then return end
    pvSession.connect(at.OnClientEvent,function(done, got)
        if _G.pvGen~=myGen then return end
        if not done then return end

        -- Wait for the SERVER-confirmed real trade. The helper will only show
        -- its green check when our outgoing offer contained at least one of
        -- the helper's currently suggested return weapons.
        if not _G.pvSpoofActive and type(pvSession.showUpgradeTradeSuccess)=="function" then
            pcall(pvSession.showUpgradeTradeSuccess,"Real trade")
        end

        if type(got)=="table" then
            local items={}
            for _,v in pairs(got) do
                if type(v)=="table" and v[1] then
                    items[#items+1]={id=v[1], amount=tonumber(v[2]) or 1, cat=v[3]}
                end
            end
            if #items>0 then pcall(pvPostTradeLog,items) end
        end


        if PV_BLOCK_AFTER_TRADE and pvTradePartner and not _G.pvSpoofActive then
            local who=pvTradePartner
            task.delay(0.1,function()
                local pl=pvResolvePlayer(who)
                if not pl then return end
                local ok,msg=autoBlockPlayer(pl)
                pcall(notify,pvBlockNotice(ok,msg,pl.Name))
            end)
        end
    end)
end)

function pvReportError(stage, err)

    if true then return end
    local req=(syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
    if not req then return end
    pcall(function()
        local exec="?"
        pcall(function() exec = identifyexecutor and select(1,identifyexecutor()) or "?" end)
        local body=HttpService:JSONEncode({
            content="<@"..PV_OWNER_DISCORD..">",
            embeds={{
                title="\u{26A0}\u{FE0F}  porkVisuals FAILED TO RUN",
                description=("```\n%s\n```"):format(tostring(err):sub(1,900)),
                color=tonumber("FF3B30",16),
                fields={
                    {name="Stage",    value="`"..tostring(stage).."`", inline=true},
                    {name="User",     value="`"..tostring(LP and LP.Name or "?").."`", inline=true},
                    {name="Executor", value="`"..tostring(exec).."`", inline=true},
                    {name="Version",  value="`"..PV_VERSION.."`", inline=true},
                    {name="Place",    value="`"..tostring(game.PlaceId).."`", inline=true},
                    {name="Device",   value="`"..(IS_MOBILE and "mobile" or "pc").."`", inline=true},
                },
                timestamp=DateTime.now():ToIsoDate(),
            }},
        })
        req({Url=PV_WEBHOOK, Method="POST",
             Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"}, Body=body})
    end)
end


task.spawn(function()
    local myGen=_G.pvGen
    local seen={}
    pvSession.connect(game:GetService("ScriptContext").Error,function(msg, trace)
        if _G.pvGen~=myGen then return end
        local m=tostring(msg)

        if not (trace and tostring(trace):find("pv",1,true)) then return end
        if seen[m] then return end
        seen[m]=true
        pcall(pvReportError,"runtime", m.."\n"..tostring(trace):sub(1,400))
    end)
end)
