    local function normalized(name)
        return tostring(name or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
    end
    local function assetNumber(image)
        return tostring(image or ""):match("(%d+)%D*$")
    end
    local catalog,byName,sets={},{},{}
    for id,e in pairs(Sync.Weapons or {}) do
        if type(e)=="table" and (e.ItemType=="Gun" or e.ItemType=="Knife") then
            local raw=tostring(e.ItemName or id)
            local base=raw:gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s+","")
            local chroma=e.Chroma==true or base~=raw
            local name=(chroma and "Chroma " or "")..base
            local item={id=id,base=base,chroma=chroma,name=name,image=e.Image,slot=e.ItemType,
                year=tostring(e.Year or ""):match("20%d%d") or tostring(id):match("20%d%d"),
                rarity=e.Rarity=="Vintage" and "Classic" or e.Rarity}
            catalog[id]=item
            local key=normalized(name)
            byName[key]=byName[key] or {}
            table.insert(byName[key],item)
        end
    end
    local byDescriptor={}
    for line in valueRows:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        local f=string.split(line,"|")
        local matches={}
        for _,item in ipairs(byName[normalized(f[1])] or {}) do
            if item.rarity==f[2] and (f[3]=="" or item.slot==f[3])
                and (f[4]=="" or not item.year or item.year==f[4]) then
                table.insert(matches,item)
            end
        end
        if #matches==1 then
            local item=matches[1]
            local key=table.concat(f,"/",1,4):gsub("/+$","")
            if item.descriptor then
                -- More than one historical release fits this game record.
                byDescriptor[item.descriptor]=nil
                item.value=nil
            else
                if #byName[normalized(item.name)]>1 then
                    item.display=item.name.." ("..item.slot..")"
                end
                item.value=tonumber(f[5])
                item.demand=tonumber(f[6])
                item.descriptor=key
                byDescriptor[key]=item
            end
        end
    end
    for line in setRows:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        local f=string.split(line,"|")
        local group={name=f[1],items={},total=0}
        for i=2,#f do
            local item=byDescriptor[f[i]]
            if not item then break end
            table.insert(group.items,item)
            group.total=group.total+item.value
        end
        if #group.items==#f-1 then table.insert(sets,group) end
    end
    -- Compact, draggable helper uses the same colour palette, header chrome,
    -- custom wallpaper and Player Panel model sizing as PorkVisuals itself.
    local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name="pvUpgradeValueHelper"
    gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
    gui.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.DisplayOrder=1000100
    gui.Parent=PG
    pvSession.ownRoot(gui)

    local helperW,helperH=px(244),px(242)
    local card=Instance.new("Frame")
    card.Name="CompactUpgradeHelper"

    local helperSnowflakes={}
    do
        local atlas = pvSession.getChristmasSnowAtlas and pvSession.getChristmasSnowAtlas() or nil
        local rng = Random.new(2401)
        local function addHelperFlake(size, alpha, x, y, speed, spin, phase, variant)
            local f=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            f.Name="ChristmasSnowflake"
            f.BackgroundTransparency=1
            f.BorderSizePixel=0
            f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
            f.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,size)
            f.Position=UDim2.fromScale(x,y)
            f.ZIndex=3
            f.ImageTransparency=alpha
            if atlas then
                f.Image=atlas
                f.ImageRectOffset=Vector2.new(128*variant,0)
                f.ImageRectSize=Vector2.new(128,128)
            end
            f.Parent=helperSnowLayer
            helperSnowflakes[#helperSnowflakes+1]={f=f,x=x,y=y,size=size,alpha=alpha,phase=phase,speed=speed,spin=spin,rotation=rng:NextNumber(0,360)}
        end
        -- Full-height field: six interior rows plus five rows along both gutters.
        -- Keep the snow behind text and cards; the footer gets its own coverage.
        for i=1,28 do
            local edge=i>18
            local size=px(edge and rng:NextNumber(9,14) or rng:NextNumber(12,20))
            local x,y
            if edge then
                local j=i-19
                x=(j%2==0 and .045 or .955)+rng:NextNumber(-.004,.004)
                y=.14+math.floor(j/2)*.19+rng:NextNumber(-.012,.012)
            else
                local j=i-1
                local col,row=j%3,math.floor(j/3)
                x=.19+col*.31+rng:NextNumber(-.035,.035)
                y=.075+row*.172+rng:NextNumber(-.014,.014)
            end
            addHelperFlake(size, edge and rng:NextNumber(.38,.55) or rng:NextNumber(.22,.43), x, y, rng:NextNumber(.20,.50), rng:NextNumber(4,12)*((i%2==0) and 1 or -1), rng:NextNumber(0,math.pi*2), (i-1)%4)
        end
    end

    do
        local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
        local helperSnowElapsed,helperSnowAccum=0,0
        pvSession.connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
            if settings.uiTheme~="Christmas" or not helperSnowLayer.Visible or not card.Visible or not card.Parent then helperSnowAccum=0 return end
            helperSnowAccum=helperSnowAccum+math.min(dt,.1)
            if helperSnowAccum<1/30 then return end
            local step=helperSnowAccum
            helperSnowAccum=0
            helperSnowElapsed=helperSnowElapsed+step
            for _,flake in ipairs(helperSnowflakes) do
                local phase=helperSnowElapsed*flake.speed+flake.phase
                local x=flake.x+0.018*math.sin(phase)
                local y=flake.y+0.026*math.sin(phase*.72+flake.phase)
                local dim=card.AbsoluteSize
                local mx=math.min(.47,(flake.size*.72+3)/math.max(1,dim.X))
                local my=math.min(.47,(flake.size*.72+3)/math.max(1,dim.Y))
                flake.f.Position=UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(x,mx,1-mx),math.clamp(y,my,1-my))
                flake.f.Rotation=(flake.rotation+helperSnowElapsed*flake.spin)%360
                flake.f.ImageTransparency=math.clamp(flake.alpha+.12*math.sin(phase*1.5),0,1)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- Display this script's existing USD estimates. Supreme points remain the
    -- separate input to chooseReturn; there is no fixed points-to-dollar rate.
    local function usdPrice(item)
        local prices
        if item.chroma then prices=PV_VALUES_CHROMA else prices=PV_VALUES end
        local value=prices and tonumber(prices[item.base])
        if value and value>0 and value<math.huge then return value end
        return nil
    end
    local function usdText(value)
        return value and string.format("$%.2f",value) or "USD unavailable"
    end
    local function usdTotal(items)
        local total=0
        for _,item in ipairs(items) do
            local price=usdPrice(item)
            if not price then return nil end
            total=total+price
        end
        return total
    end
    local function updateSummary(partner,offer,target)
        local cleanName=tostring(partner or "Unknown player"):gsub("[%c]"," "):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
        partnerName.Text=cleanName~="" and cleanName or "Unknown player"
        offerValue.Text=usdText(offer)
        targetValue.Text=usdText(target)
    end

    local function showReturnModels(best,setName)
        clearReturnModels()
        -- Record exactly the weapons shown in the most recent suggestion.
        -- Matching ANY one of these in YOUR sent offer qualifies for success.
        suggestedItemIds={}
        for _,item in ipairs(best) do
            suggestedItemIds[tostring(item.id)]=true
        end
        suggestedTiles.Visible=true
        suggestionHeading.Text=setName and ("SUGGESTED RETURN  ·  "..setName) or "SUGGESTED RETURN"
        returnTotal.Text="RETURN TOTAL  "..usdText(usdTotal(best))
        returnTotal.Visible=true
        local count=#best
        local compact=count>2
        for i=1,count do
            local item=best[i]
            local tile=Instance.new("Frame")
            tile.Name="ReturnWeapon_"..i
            local columns=count==1 and 1 or 2
            local rows=compact and 2 or 1
            tile.Size=UDim2.new(1/columns,-px(2),1/rows,compact and -px(1) or 0)
            tile.Position=UDim2.new(((i-1)%columns)/columns,px(1),math.floor((i-1)/columns)/rows,0)
            tile.BorderSizePixel=0
            tile.ZIndex=6
            tile.Parent=suggestedTiles
            corner(tile,px(6))
            local tileStroke=stroke(tile,0.62,1,T.line)

            local preview=Instance.new("Frame")
            preview.Name="WeaponPreview"
            preview.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0)
            preview.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0,px(2))
            preview.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(46),px(38))
            if compact then
                preview.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,0.5)
                preview.Position=UDim2.new(0,px(2),0.5,0)
                preview.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(px(28),px(30))
            end
            preview.BackgroundTransparency=1
            preview.ClipsDescendants=true
            preview.ZIndex=7
            preview.Parent=tile
            preview:SetAttribute("pvHelperWeaponPreview",true)

            local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            icon.Name="WeaponIcon"
            icon.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
            icon.BackgroundTransparency=1
            icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            icon.ZIndex=7
            icon.Parent=preview
            pcall(function() icon.Image=resolveImg(item.id,item.image) end)

            local name=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            name.Name="WeaponName"
            name.Position=UDim2.new(0,px(2),0,px(42))
            name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(4),0,px(13))
            name.BackgroundTransparency=1
            if compact then
                name.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(32),px(2))
                name.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(34),0,px(19))
                name.TextWrapped=true
            end
            name.Text=item.display or item.name
            name.TextSize=px(8)
            name.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
            name.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            name.ZIndex=7
            name.Parent=tile

            local price=Instance.new("TextLabel")
            price.Name="USDPrice"
            price.Position=UDim2.new(0,px(2),0,px(56))
            price.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(4),0,px(13))
            price.BackgroundTransparency=1
            price.Text=usdText(usdPrice(item))
            if compact then
                price.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(px(32),px(21))
                price.Size=UDim2.new(1,-px(34),0,px(10))
            end
            price.TextSize=px(9)
            price.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
            price.ZIndex=7
            price.Parent=tile

            tileStyles[#tileStyles+1]={tile=tile,edge=tileStroke,name=name,price=price}
        end
        if type(pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme)=="function" then
            pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme()
        end
    end

    local srcPicture,srcVideo,srcChristmasPicture
    pcall(function()
        srcPicture=sky:FindFirstChild("pvCustomBackgroundImage")
        srcVideo=sky:FindFirstChild("pvCustomBackgroundVideo")
        srcChristmasPicture=sky:FindFirstChild("pvChristmasBackgroundImage")
    end)
    local function syncWallpaper()
        if not card.Parent then return end
        local custom=settings.uiTheme=="Custom"
        local usePicture,useVideo=false,false
        pcall(function()
            if srcPicture then
                wallpaper.Image=srcPicture.Image
                usePicture=custom and srcPicture.Visible
            end
            if srcVideo then
                wallpaperVideo.Video=srcVideo.Video
                useVideo=custom and srcVideo.Visible
            end
        end)
        wallpaper.Visible=usePicture and true or false
        wallpaperVideo.Visible=useVideo and true or false
        wallpaperDim.Visible=wallpaper.Visible or wallpaperVideo.Visible
        pcall(function() wallpaperVideo.Playing=wallpaperVideo.Visible and card.Visible end)
    end

    local function refreshTheme()
        if not card.Parent then return end
        local halloween=settings.uiTheme=="Halloween"
        local christmas=settings.uiTheme=="Christmas"
        local accent=T.pink
        backGradient.Color=helperGradientColor()
        rim.Color=accent
        rimDepth.Enabled=halloween
        brand.TextColor3=accent
        -- Match the main header Discord tag in every theme (Pork UI / Halloween / Custom).
        tag.TextColor3=christmas and Color3.fromRGB(255,230,166) or (halloween and Color3.fromRGB(255,206,128) or Color3.fromRGB(255,140,205))
        close.TextColor3=halloween and Color3.fromRGB(255,173,80) or accent
        headerLine.BackgroundColor3=accent
        title.TextColor3=T.txt
        summaryCard.BackgroundColor3=T.pane
        summaryCard.BackgroundTransparency=christmas and 0.38 or 0.25
        summaryEdge.Color=T.line
        withLabel.TextColor3=T.sub
        partnerName.TextColor3=T.txt
        offerLabel.TextColor3=T.sub
        offerValue.TextColor3=T.txt
        targetLabel.TextColor3=T.sub
        targetValue.TextColor3=accent
        summaryRule.BackgroundColor3=T.line
        statDivider.BackgroundColor3=T.line
        suggestionHeading.TextColor3=accent
        -- Success remains a green status regardless of the active theme.
        returnTotal.TextColor3=T.txt
        notice.TextColor3=T.sub
        for _,entry in ipairs(tileStyles) do
            entry.tile.BackgroundColor3=T.pane
            entry.tile.BackgroundTransparency=christmas and 0.34 or 0.08
            entry.edge.Color=T.line
            entry.name.TextColor3=T.txt
            entry.price.TextColor3=accent
        end
        local christmasImage=""
        pcall(function()
            if srcChristmasPicture and srcChristmasPicture:IsA("ImageLabel") then christmasImage=srcChristmasPicture.Image end
        end)
        christmasWallpaper.Image=christmasImage
        christmasWallpaper.Visible=christmas and christmasImage~=""
        christmasDim.Visible=christmas
        helperSnowLayer.Visible=christmas
        for _,ornament in ipairs(decorations) do ornament.Visible=halloween end
        syncWallpaper()
    end
    pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme=refreshTheme
    refreshTheme()

    -- Optional source subscriptions must not prevent helper startup.
    pcall(function()
        if srcPicture then
            pvSession.connect(srcPicture:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"),syncWallpaper)
            pvSession.connect(srcPicture:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),syncWallpaper)
        end
        if srcVideo then
            pvSession.connect(srcVideo:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Video"),syncWallpaper)
            pvSession.connect(srcVideo:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),syncWallpaper)
        end
        if srcChristmasPicture then
            pvSession.connect(srcChristmasPicture:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"),refreshTheme)
        end
    end)
    pvSession.connect(card:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),syncWallpaper)
    -- Theme changes already call pvSession.refreshUpgradeHelperTheme.

    -- Drag from the top bar on desktop or touch. Save the last position.
    local function moveHelper(x,y)
        local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport=camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
        x=math.clamp(x,px(4),math.max(px(4),viewport.X-helperW-px(4)))
        y=math.clamp(y,px(4),math.max(px(4),viewport.Y-helperH-px(4)))
        card.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y)
    end
    if type(settings.upgradeHelperPos)=="table" then
        local savedX=tonumber(settings.upgradeHelperPos[1])
        local savedY=tonumber(settings.upgradeHelperPos[2])
        if savedX and savedY then task.defer(function()
            if card.Parent then moveHelper(savedX,savedY) end
        end) end
    end
    local dragging=false
    local dragInput,dragOrigin,windowOrigin
    pvSession.connect(dragBar.InputBegan,function(input)
        if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging=true
        dragInput=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
        dragOrigin=input.Position
        windowOrigin=card.AbsolutePosition
    end)
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if dragInput then
            if input~=dragInput then return end
        elseif input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
        local delta=input.Position-dragOrigin
        moveHelper(windowOrigin.X+delta.X,windowOrigin.Y+delta.Y)
    end)
    pvSession.connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if dragInput and input~=dragInput then return end
        if not dragInput and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
        dragging=false
        dragInput=nil
        local pos=card.AbsolutePosition
        settings.upgradeHelperPos={math.floor(pos.X+0.5),math.floor(pos.Y+0.5)}
        saveCfg()
    end)
    -- Keep an earned recommendation visible even after the incoming trade
    -- closes. Only a confirmed trade where WE send a suggested item completes it.
    local pendingSuggestion=false
    local lastSignature=nil
    local searchToken=0
    local wasEnabled=false
    local lastTradeGui=nil
    local lastGuiWasOpen=false
    pvSession.connect(close.Activated,function()
        searchToken=searchToken+1
        pendingSuggestion=false
        suggestedItemIds={}
        clearReturnModels()
        card.Visible=false
    end)
    local lastRealSent={}
    local lastRealSentAt=-math.huge
    local completionActive=false
    local completionHold=false
    local completionToken=0

    -- Our side of the trade (not TheirOffer). Read visible game trade slots;
    -- keep a final snapshot because the real GUI may close before the
    -- AcceptTrade success event reaches this script.
    local function readRealSentItems(tradeGui)
        local tg=tradeGui or pvRealTradeGui()
        if not tg or not tg.Enabled then return nil end
        local ok,side=pcall(function() return tg.Container.Trade.YourOffer end)
        if not ok or not side then return nil end
        local container=side:FindFirstChild("Container")
        if not container then return nil end
        local rows={}
        for i=1,4 do
            local slot=container:FindFirstChild("NewItem"..i)
            if slot and slot.Visible then
                local holder=slot:FindFirstChild("ItemName")
                local label=holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Label")
                local name=label and tostring(label.Text) or ""
                if name~="" and name~="Loading" then
                    local tags={}
                    local tagFrame=slot:FindFirstChild("Tags")
                    if tagFrame then
                        for _,tag in ipairs(tagFrame:GetChildren()) do
                            if tag:IsA("GuiObject") and tag.Visible then
                                tags[#tags+1]=tag.Name
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    local amount=1
                    local inner=slot:FindFirstChild("Container")
                    local amountLabel=(inner and inner:FindFirstChild("Amount"))
                        or slot:FindFirstChild("Amount",true)
                    if amountLabel and amountLabel:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        amount=tonumber(tostring(amountLabel.Text):match("%d+")) or 1
                    end
                    local icon=slot:FindFirstChild("Icon",true)
                    rows[#rows+1]={name=name,tags=tags,amount=amount,
                        image=icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel") and icon.Image or nil}
                end
            end
        end
        return rows
    end

    -- Resolved using the SAME catalog/Chroma distinction as recommendations.
    local resolve
    local function includesSuggestedSentItem(sent)
        if type(sent)~="table" then return false end
        for _,row in ipairs(sent) do
            if type(row)=="table" then
                -- The visual trade keeps exact IDs; real trade slots expose
                -- names and Chroma tags instead.
                if row.id and suggestedItemIds[tostring(row.id)] then return true end
                local item=resolve and resolve(row)
                if item then
                    if (not row.id or tostring(row.id)==tostring(item.id))
                        and suggestedItemIds[tostring(item.id)] then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    pvSession.showUpgradeTradeSuccess=function(mode,outgoingItems)
        if not isCurrent() or not settings.upgradeValueHelper then return end
        if completionActive or completionHold then return end
        -- The other player's accepted/received items are NOT enough.
        -- A pending suggested return survives an incoming-only trade and can
        -- complete on a later trade after we actually give a suggested item.
        if not pendingSuggestion or not next(suggestedItemIds) then return end

        -- Incoming items are NEVER sufficient. Require at least one weapon
        -- listed in Suggested Return to be on OUR outgoing side when done.
        if mode=="Visual trade" then
            -- Snapshot provided by the visual completion handler BEFORE it
            -- clears the outgoing-offer table.
            if not includesSuggestedSentItem(outgoingItems) then return end
        elseif mode=="Real trade" then
            -- Prefer the final live outgoing slots; otherwise use the most
            -- recent snapshot taken while the real trade GUI was visible.
            local live=readRealSentItems()
            if live then
                lastRealSent=live
                lastRealSentAt=os.clock()
            elseif os.clock()-lastRealSentAt>4 then
                return
            end
            if not includesSuggestedSentItem(lastRealSent) then return end
        else
            return
        end
        pendingSuggestion=false
        completionActive=true
        completionHold=true
        completionToken=completionToken+1
        local token=completionToken
        lastSignature=nil

        -- The overlay is opaque from the FIRST frame: no old tiles or labels
        -- bleed through while the completed state is appearing.
        successTitle.Text=mode=="Visual trade"
            and "VISUAL TRADE COMPLETED" or "TRADE COMPLETED"
        successCaption.Text=mode=="Visual trade"
            and "Suggested weapon sent in visual trade"
            or "Suggested weapon sent successfully"
        successLayer.Visible=true
        card.Visible=true

        -- Only the badge pops. Never scale or fade the entire helper window.
        checkScale.Scale=0.72
        Tween:Create(checkScale,
            TweenInfo.new(0.29,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Scale=1.06}):Play()
        task.delay(0.30,function()
            if not isCurrent() or completionToken~=token then return end
            Tween:Create(checkScale,TweenInfo.new(0.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),
                {Scale=1}):Play()
        end)

        -- Close cleanly with no shrinking/fading; keep the suggestion hidden.
        task.delay(1.85,function()
            if not isCurrent() or completionToken~=token then return end
            card.Visible=false
            successLayer.Visible=false
            checkScale.Scale=1
            completionActive=false
            clearReturnModels()
        end)
    end
    pvSession.addCleanup(function()
        completionToken=completionToken+1
        pvSession.showUpgradeTradeSuccess=nil
    end)

    resolve=function(row)
        if row.id then return catalog[row.id] end
        local name=tostring(row.name or "")
        local base=name:gsub("^[Cc]hroma%s+","")
        local chroma=base~=name
        for _,tag in ipairs(row.tags or {}) do
            if tostring(tag):lower()=="chroma" then chroma=true end
        end
        local items=byName[normalized((chroma and "Chroma " or "")..base)]
        if not items then return nil end
        if #items==1 then return items[1] end
        local image=assetNumber(row.image)
        if not image then return nil end
        local match
        for _,item in ipairs(items) do
            if assetNumber(item.image)==image then
                if match then return nil end
                match=item
            end
        end
        return match
    end
    -- Each generic return uses distinct Godlies, Ancients, or Corrupt. Compare
    -- singles and pairs as blocks so a four-slot search never enumerates quartets.
    local function eligibleReturn(item)
        return item.value and item.value>0 and
            (item.rarity=="Godly" or item.rarity=="Ancient"
                or (item.rarity=="Unique" and item.base=="Corrupt"))
    end
    local function priceCents(item)
        local price=usdPrice(item)
        return price and math.floor(price*100+0.5) or nil
    end
    local function chooseReturn(goal,incoming,targetCents,checkpoint)
        local best,bestScore,bestLabel,bestTotal=nil,math.huge,nil,0
        local bestCount=math.huge
        local expanded=false
        local bestCents=math.huge
        local function bundleCents(items)
            local cents=0
            for _,item in ipairs(items) do
                local price=priceCents(item)
                if not eligibleReturn(item) or not price then return nil end
                cents=cents+price
            end
            return cents
        end
        local minimumSetCents=math.ceil(targetCents*97/100)
        local minimumSetValue=goal*97/100
        local function consider(a,b,total,bonus,label,wholeSet)
            local aCents,bCents=bundleCents(a),bundleCents(b)
            if not aCents or not bCents then return false end
            local cents=aCents+bCents
            -- Suggestions with adds and generic combinations must reach both targets.
            local requiredCents=wholeSet and minimumSetCents or targetCents
            local requiredValue=wholeSet and minimumSetValue or goal
            if cents<requiredCents or total<requiredValue then return false end
            local count=#a+#b
            local score=(total-goal)/goal+0.012*(count-1)-bonus
            if count>bestCount or (count==bestCount and
                (cents>bestCents or (cents==bestCents and score>=bestScore))) then
                return true
            end
            local result={}
            for _,item in ipairs(a) do table.insert(result,item) end
            for _,item in ipairs(b) do table.insert(result,item) end
            best,bestScore,bestLabel,bestTotal=result,score,label,total
            bestCount,bestCents=count,cents
            return true
        end
        local empty={}
        local ceiling=goal*1.15
        -- Match sets against every incoming slot. The most valuable offered
        -- component(s) determine which set to complete when several apply.
        local relatedSets={}
        for _,group in ipairs(sets) do
            local contribution=0
            for _,item in ipairs(group.items) do
                contribution=contribution+item.value*(incoming[item.id] or 0)
            end
            if contribution>0 then
                local cents=bundleCents(group.items)
                if cents then
                    table.insert(relatedSets,{group=group,contribution=contribution,cents=cents})
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(relatedSets,function(a,b)
            if a.contribution~=b.contribution then return a.contribution>b.contribution end
            if #a.group.items~=#b.group.items then return #a.group.items<#b.group.items end
            if a.group.total~=b.group.total then return a.group.total<b.group.total end
            return a.group.name<b.group.name
        end)
        -- A complete matching set can fall 3% short of either 2x target.
        -- Test it before searching for individual adds.
        for _,entry in ipairs(relatedSets) do
            local group=entry.group
            if entry.cents>=minimumSetCents and group.total>=minimumSetValue
                and group.total<=ceiling then
                return group.items,group.total,group.name
            end
        end
        local pool={}
        for id,item in pairs(catalog) do
            if eligibleReturn(item) and priceCents(item) and not incoming[id] then
                table.insert(pool,item)
            end
        end
        if #pool==0 then
            for _,item in pairs(catalog) do
                if eligibleReturn(item) and priceCents(item) then table.insert(pool,item) end
            end
        end
        table.sort(pool,function(a,b)
            if a.value~=b.value then return a.value<b.value end
            if a.demand~=b.demand then return a.demand>b.demand end
            return tostring(a.id)<tostring(b.id)
        end)
        -- Keep all USD variants even when their Supreme values are equal.
        local singles,pairsByValue={},{}
        for _,item in ipairs(pool) do
            table.insert(singles,{item,total=item.value,cents=priceCents(item)})
        end
        table.sort(singles,function(a,b)
            if a.cents~=b.cents then return a.cents<b.cents end
            if a.total~=b.total then return a.total<b.total end
            return tostring(a[1].id)<tostring(b[1].id)
        end)
        -- For fixed a, the b items already run in price/value/order sequence.
        -- Merge those sorted runs incrementally so sorting can yield between frames.
        local runs={}
        local order=0
        for i,a in ipairs(singles) do
            local run={}
            for j=i+1,#singles do
                checkpoint()
                local b=singles[j]
                order=order+1
                run[#run+1]={a[1],b[1],total=a.total+b.total,cents=a.cents+b.cents,order=order}
            end
            if #run>0 then runs[#runs+1]=run end
        end
        local function before(a,b)
            if a.cents~=b.cents then return a.cents<b.cents end
            if a.total~=b.total then return a.total<b.total end
            return a.order<b.order
        end
        while #runs>1 do
            local merged={}
            for i=1,#runs,2 do
                local left,right=runs[i],runs[i+1]
                if right then
                    local run={}
                    local l,r=1,1
                    while l<=#left or r<=#right do
                        checkpoint()
                        if r>#right or (l<=#left and before(left[l],right[r])) then
                            run[#run+1]=left[l]
                            l=l+1
                        else
                            run[#run+1]=right[r]
                            r=r+1
                        end
                    end
                    merged[#merged+1]=run
                else
                    merged[#merged+1]=left
                end
            end
            runs=merged
        end
        pairsByValue=runs[1] or {}
        -- Suffix maxima skip blocks that cannot reach the Supreme floor.
        for _,blocks in ipairs({singles,pairsByValue}) do
            local maximum=0
            for i=#blocks,1,-1 do
                checkpoint()
                maximum=math.max(maximum,blocks[i].total)
                blocks[i].maxTotal=maximum
            end
        end
        local function fits(a,b)
            for _,item in ipairs(a) do
                if item==b[1] or item==b[2] then return false end
            end
            return true
        end
        -- Blocks are ordered by USD, then Supreme. Find the smallest USD
        -- overpay that also passes the Supreme range and distinct-item checks.
        local function complete(prefix,subtotal,blocks,bonus,label)
            checkpoint()
            if #blocks==0 or #prefix+#blocks[1]>bestCount then return end
            local prefixCents=bundleCents(prefix)
            if not prefixCents then return end
            local lo,hi=1,#blocks+1
            while lo<hi do
                local mid=math.floor((lo+hi)/2)
                if prefixCents+blocks[mid].cents<targetCents then lo=mid+1 else hi=mid end
            end
            for i=lo,#blocks do
                checkpoint()
                local b=blocks[i]
                local total=subtotal+b.total
                if subtotal+b.maxTotal<goal then break end
                if total>=goal and (expanded or total<=ceiling) and fits(prefix,b)
                    and consider(prefix,b,total,bonus,label) then
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        local function searchSet(group,bonus)
            if not expanded and group.total>ceiling then return end
            consider(group.items,empty,group.total,bonus+0.01,group.name,true)
            local label=group.name.." + adds"
            if #group.items<4 then complete(group.items,group.total,singles,bonus,label) end
            if #group.items<=2 then complete(group.items,group.total,pairsByValue,bonus,label) end
        end
        for _,entry in ipairs(relatedSets) do
            searchSet(entry.group,0.09)
            if not best then
                expanded=true
                searchSet(entry.group,0.09)
                expanded=false
            end
            if best then return best,bestTotal,bestLabel end
        end

        complete(empty,0,singles,0)
        complete(empty,0,pairsByValue,0)
        for _,a in ipairs(singles) do complete(a,a.total,pairsByValue,0) end
        for _,a in ipairs(pairsByValue) do
            checkpoint()
            if a.total<=ceiling then complete(a,a.total,pairsByValue,0) end
        end
        -- With no viable matching set, compare ordinary sets and singles.
        for _,group in ipairs(sets) do searchSet(group,0.035) end
        if not best then
            -- Widen the upper Supreme bound while enforcing both minimums.
            expanded=true
            complete(empty,0,singles,0)
            complete(empty,0,pairsByValue,0)
            for _,a in ipairs(singles) do complete(a,a.total,pairsByValue,0) end
            for _,a in ipairs(pairsByValue) do complete(a,a.total,pairsByValue,0) end
            for _,group in ipairs(sets) do searchSet(group,0) end
        end
        return best,bestTotal,bestLabel
    end
    local function suggest(rows,partner,mode)
        local total=0
        local incoming={}
        local offerCents,hasUSD=0,true
        local unknown=false
        local signature={mode,tostring(partner)}
        for _,row in ipairs(rows) do
            local item=resolve(row)
            local count=math.max(1,math.floor(tonumber(row.amount or row.count) or 1))
            local cents=item and priceCents(item)
            if cents then offerCents=offerCents+cents*count else hasUSD=false end
            if item and item.value then
                total=total+item.value*count
                incoming[item.id]=(incoming[item.id] or 0)+count
                table.insert(signature,tostring(item.id)..":"..count)
            else
                unknown=true
                table.insert(signature,"unknown")
            end
        end
        table.sort(signature)
        signature=table.concat(signature,"|")
        if signature==lastSignature then return end
        lastSignature=signature
        searchToken=searchToken+1
        local token=searchToken
        card.Visible=true
        pendingSuggestion=false
        suggestedItemIds={}
        clearReturnModels()
        if unknown or total<=0 then
            updateSummary(partner,nil,nil)
            notice.Text="An offered item has no verified Supreme value or could not be identified."
            notice.Visible=true
            return
        end
        if not hasUSD then
            updateSummary(partner,nil,nil)
            notice.Text="A USD price is needed for every offered weapon."
            notice.Visible=true
            return
        end
        local goal=total*2
        updateSummary(partner,offerCents/100,offerCents*2/100)
        notice.Text="Calculating return…"
        notice.Visible=true
        local function active()
            return token==searchToken and lastSignature==signature and isCurrent()
                and settings.upgradeValueHelper and card.Visible
        end
        task.defer(function()
            if not active() then return end
            local deadline=os.clock()+0.002
            local steps=0
            local function checkpoint()
                steps=steps+1
                if steps<32 then return end
                steps=0
                if os.clock()<deadline then return end
                task.wait()
                if not active() then error("offer changed",0) end
                deadline=os.clock()+0.002
            end
            local ok,best,_,setName=pcall(chooseReturn,goal,incoming,offerCents*2,checkpoint)
            if not active() then return end
            if not ok then
                notice.Text="Could not calculate a return."
            elseif best then
                showReturnModels(best,setName)
                pendingSuggestion=true
            else
                notice.Text="No eligible return reaches both targets within four weapons."
            end
        end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        while isCurrent() do
            if settings.upgradeValueHelper then
                if not wasEnabled then lastSignature=nil end
                wasEnabled=true
                pcall(function()
                    local rows,partner,mode
                    local tradeGuiOpen=false
                    local activeGui=nil
                    if _G.pvSpoofActive then
                        -- A visual trade plans all its weapons up front, but
                        -- displays them in stages. Calculate from the visible
                        -- offer slots so each new weapon updates the suggestion.
                        local visualGui=PG:FindFirstChild("pvTradeGUI")
                        if visualGui and visualGui.Enabled then
                            tradeGuiOpen=true
                            activeGui=visualGui
                            rows,partner=pvReadIncoming(visualGui,theirOfferedRef)
                        end
                        if not partner or partner=="" then
                            partner=tostring(_G.pvSpoofName or "Visual player"):gsub("[%(%)]","")
                        end
                        mode="Visual trade"
                    else
                        -- Capture sent weapons independent of their incoming
                        -- offer. A trade where we only RECEIVE cannot qualify.
                        local realGui=pvRealTradeGui()
                        if realGui then
                            tradeGuiOpen=true
                            activeGui=realGui
                        end
                        rows,partner=pvReadIncoming(realGui)
                        mode="Real trade"
                    end
                    -- A newly opened trade is a new opportunity to calculate,
                    -- even when it happens to show the same offer as the last.
                    if tradeGuiOpen and (not lastGuiWasOpen or activeGui~=lastTradeGui) then
                        lastSignature=nil
                        lastRealSent={} -- prevent stale outgoing-item matches
                        lastRealSentAt=-math.huge
                    end
                    lastGuiWasOpen=tradeGuiOpen
                    lastTradeGui=activeGui
                    if activeGui and not _G.pvSpoofActive then
                        local sent=readRealSentItems(activeGui)
                        if sent then
                            lastRealSent=sent
                            lastRealSentAt=os.clock()
                        end
                    end
                    if completionActive then
                        -- Keep success overlay visible during the closing animation.
                    elseif completionHold then
                        -- Never show old suggestions again while the completed
                        -- offer is still on screen. Reset on the next empty trade.
                        if not tradeGuiOpen or not rows or #rows==0 then
                            -- Some real-trade GUIs stay enabled between trades.
                            completionHold=false
                            lastSignature=nil
                        end
                        card.Visible=false
                    elseif rows and #rows>0 then
                        suggest(rows,partner,mode)
                    elseif pendingSuggestion then
                        -- A visual/real trade may close as soon as THEY give
                        -- the items, or briefly show empty slots between adds.
                        -- Don't wipe the recommendation just because they
                        -- finished giving us items. Keep it until OUR suggested
                        -- outgoing item is sent on a completed trade, the user
                        -- clears it, or a new priced offer replaces it.
                        card.Visible=true
                    else
                        if lastSignature~=nil or card.Visible then clearReturnModels() end
                        lastSignature=nil
                        card.Visible=false
                    end
                end)
            else
                if wasEnabled then clearReturnModels() end
                wasEnabled=false
                completionToken=completionToken+1
                completionActive=false
                completionHold=false
                pendingSuggestion=false
                lastTradeGui=nil
                lastGuiWasOpen=false
                lastSignature=nil
                suggestedItemIds={}
                lastRealSent={}
                lastRealSentAt=-math.huge
                successLayer.Visible=false
                card.Visible=false
            end
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
    end)
end)()
end
